articleTitle: Quantum-Enhanced Phase Detection in a Lithium Niobate Photonic Integrated Circuit
abstract: Squeezed light promises improved optical measurement sensitivity. We present a photonic integrated circuit with an embedded squeezed light source. It achieves 4% SNR improvement over shot-noise and paves the way toward deployable quantum optical sensors.

articleTitle: Transfer Printing of InGaN/GaN Quantum-Well Based Light Emitting Diodes
abstract: We demonstrate the transfer printing of an InGaN/GaN-QW based LED on a silicon substrate, emitting around 470 nm. This result is the first step toward heterogeneous integration of GaN-based devices on CMOS-compatible SiN photonic circuits.

articleTitle: Purcell-enhanced X-ray Imaging in Ultra-thin Scintillators
abstract: We demonstrate improved X-ray imaging using nanophotonic scintillators. Our scintillators rely on Purcell enhancement for brighter and faster emission. Applying this concept in radiology and nuclear medicine could enable a significant reduction of X-ray dose.

articleTitle: Complex Transformation of Ultrafast Pulses using Dielectric Metasurfaces
abstract: Dielectric-metasurface-enabled pulse shaper provides a versatile platform for custom engineering the spatiotemporal evolution of ultrafast optical pulses. Here, we investigate its ability to perform complex optical transformations, such as mathematical operations, on femtosecond time-scale pulses.

articleTitle: A plasmonic "rainbow" chip for intelligent spectrometer
abstract: Here we report a plasmonic "rainbow" chip for spectroscopic sensing. By analyzing a single image with deep neural network, this image-based system can precisely determine the spectroscopic and polarimetric information of the incident light.

articleTitle: Modeling of the Optical and Electrical Degradation of 845 nm VCSILs
abstract: Optical and electrical degradation of novel micro-transfer-printed VCSILs is investigated. Modeling of experimental data suggests that the main degradation mechanism is represented by the relocation of impurities, originating from the p-side, toward the active region.

articleTitle: Low-voltage integrated lithium niobate phase modulator for efficient electro-optic comb generation
abstract: We realize an EO comb generator with 15× reduction in electrical power consumption using a multi-loop mode-multiplexing design, generating 47 comb lines using a moderate RF driving power of 28 dBm at 25 GHz.

articleTitle: Deploying Machine Learning in Distributed Sensing to Increase Resilience of Fiber Optic Infrastructure
abstract: We report a novel approach to the security of fiber optic infrastructures utilizing state of polarization analyzes or Mach-Zehnder interferometry and using supervised or unsupervised machine-learning models for unauthorized cable manipulation detection.

articleTitle: Higher Order Sidebands Generation by Breaking Mechanical PT Symmetry in Optomechanical System
abstract: We investigated the higher-order optical sideband generation in an optomechanical system by breaking mechanical PT symmetry with continuous wave laser drive. We achieved this by tuning the system parameters instead of conventional method of controlling the driving power.

articleTitle: Film thickness measurement on transparent substrate based on spectral interference ellipsometry
abstract: We proposed a thickness measurement method of film without the frustration of back-surface reflection. It directly separated the back reflection information from transparent substrate in Fourier domain. The measurement precision was better than 1 nm.

articleTitle: 16 dBm bismuth-doped fiber laser at 1725 nm
abstract: We demonstrate a continuous-wave ring-cavity bismuth-doped fiber laser emitting at 1725 nm. By optimizing the output coupling ratio to maximize the laser power, we obtain 16.1 dBm at a pump power of 511 mW.

articleTitle: Resonant Tunneling Diodes: Mid-Infrared Sensing at Room Temperature
abstract: Resonant tunneling diode photodetectors with GaInAsSb absorbers appear to be promising architectures with a simple design for mid-infrared sensing operations at room temperature. We demonstrate how the drift, accumulation and escape efficiencies of photogenerated carriers influence the electrostatic modulation of the sensor’s electrical response.

articleTitle: Low-temperature and hydrogen-free silicon dioxide cladding for integrated photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a hydrogen-free low-loss silicon oxide film deposited with SiCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> precursor. A very wide low-loss window of 1300 nm to 1620 nm is achieved at deposition temperature as low as 300 °C.

articleTitle: Helical plasma filaments in optical fibers
abstract: We demonstrate that exploiting the cylindrical geometry of optical fibers allows for the ignition of helical-shaped plasma filaments.

articleTitle: Fundamental Limits to Enhancing the Local Density of States Through Nanostructuring
abstract: We analyze bounds to the electromagnetic local density of states achievable via material structuring, deriving novel results including finite bound saturation in the infinite susceptibility limit and sub-linear bandwidth scaling for lossy materials.

articleTitle: Enhance Nonlinear Response of Dielectric Polaritonic Metasurface coupled to Lattice Resonance
abstract: We report giant nonlinear response and relaxed intensity saturation for second-harmonic-generation (SHG) from nonlinear dielectric polaritonic metasurfaces. Experimentally, 21 mW of SHG peak power and 0.37% of SHG conversion efficiency at 10.55 μm were achieved.

articleTitle: Buried Heterostructure Lasear Using IFVD Quantum Well Intermixing technique
abstract: A new buried heterostructure (BH) waveguide laser made by using IFVD quantum well intermixing (QWI) is demonstrated. 110nm blueshift QWI was attained for defining waveguide, leading to CW Fabry-Perot laser with >2mW at 1490nm.

articleTitle: Fast-Controlled and Time-Slotted Photonically Interconnected Edge Computing and Time-Sensitive Networks
abstract: Exploiting a supervisory channel we demonstrate fast FPGA-based control and switching for transparently photonically connected edge data centers. Results show microsecond-time control, time-slotted operation and deterministic latency with nanosecond jitter supporting time sensitive applications.

articleTitle: Electro-Optic Imaging Millimeter-Wave Propagation On-Wafer
abstract: We demonstrate an electro-optic imaging system for millimeter-waves propagating along a coplanar waveguide. Using dual optical frequency combs and a polarization resolved microscope, we image signals with bandwidth >100 GHz and >48 dB dynamic range.

articleTitle: All-Optical Control of Soliton Microcomb Repetition-Rate through a Second CW Laser
abstract: Repetition-rate locking of soliton microcombs through the injection of an auxiliary continuous-wave laser in the spectral wing of the soliton is studied, resulting in significant phase-noise reduction and all-optical control.

articleTitle: Time-Stretch Coherent Raman Scattering Spectroscopy Running at 50,000,000 Spectra/s
abstract: We demonstrate broadband coherent Raman scattering (CRS) spectroscopy of liquid organic compounds at the record highest spectral acquisition rate of 50 MHz, which is 100-1000 times higher than the other high-speed CRS spectroscopy techniques.

articleTitle: Frequency of the unmodulated 778-nm rubidium clock measured in high vacuum
abstract: We update the frequency of a 778-nm two-photon-transition-based rubidium clock by a novel approach, where the frequency measurement is performed in high vacuum and with fitting the unperturbed spectral lineshape.

articleTitle: Photonic Bragg gratings with cladding asymmetry for polarization independent and rotation filter
abstract: We present a single-etched polarization-independent Bragg filter using cladding asymmetry. An air cladding strongly couples TE and TM modes, rotating its polarization status and achieving polarization-insensitive Bragg reflection at the average of both Bragg wavelengths.

articleTitle: Fluidic assisted self-alignment transfer and integration of micro light-emitting diodes using engineered van der Waals forces
abstract: We fabricated van der Waals forces engineered microLEDs and confirmed their transfer method with single-face alignment in a fluidic environment. This transfer and integration results can provide a key solution for the microLED display.

articleTitle: CW-lasing 980 nm InGaAs/GaAs/GaAsP QW lasers monolithically grown on (001) Si
abstract: We report continuous-wave (CW) lasing of electrically-pumped InGaAs/GaAs/GaAsP quantum well (QW) lasers grown on Si. The lowest threshold current is 40 mA, with an output power of 92.8 mW and maximum operating temperature of 95 °C.

articleTitle: Single Quantum Sensor Simultaneously Measuring Fields Across Six Octaves
abstract: Rydberg quantum sensors offer the potential for capabilities inaccessible to classical systems. Here we perform simultaneous phase and amplitude sensing of five rf fields spanning 1.7 GHz to 116 GHz and implement a digital communications receiver.

articleTitle: Anomalous Dispersion of Strongly Coupled Surface Plasmon Polaritons and Dye Molecules
abstract: We have observed and qualitatively explained anomalous dispersion of surface plasmon polaritons strongly coupled (in the Kretschmann geometry) to PMMA polymer single doped and co-doped with highly concentrated Rhodamine 590 and Rhodamine 610 dye molecules.

articleTitle: Attojoule/bit Folded Thin Film Lithium Niobate Coherent Modulators using Air-Bridge Structures
abstract: We report on an air-bridge-assisted folded thin-film lithium niobate coherent modulator, enabling driverless 703 Gb/s/carrier line data rate transmissions over 1120 km with an ultralow electrical power consumption of 479 aJ/bit.

articleTitle: Generation of frequency-bin-encoded ququarts in a programmable silicon photonic chip
abstract: We present a programmable silicon photonic device for the generation of frequency bin entangled qudits, in which bin spacing, qudit dimension, and bipartite quantum state can be directly reconfigured on a chip.

articleTitle: Mode Expansion Tapers via Inverse Design
abstract: Compact, low-loss mode-expansion tapers for red light are demonstrated. Inverse design methods enable 50 μm long tapers from single-mode to 8- and 18 μm wide waveguides with measured losses of 0.05 and 1.05 dB/taper respectively.

articleTitle: Toward hybrid integration of exotic materials in an electronic-photonic CMOS platform via substrate removal
abstract: We demonstrate direct access to the silicon device layer of a monolithic CMOS electronics-photonics platform with a full-digital back-end-metal stack, in post-fabrication at die level, allowing the integration of functional materials (e.g. into slot waveguides).

articleTitle: Various Scattering Regimes of Truncated Cone Particles
abstract: Here, we show how to use out-of-plane symmetry breaking using easy-to-fabricate truncated nanocones. Using the same shape, it is possible to achieve various types of Kerker effects, hybrid anapole regime and other peculiar effects.

articleTitle: Next Generation UV-Visible Single-Mode Fibers
abstract: We report the results of a new optical fiber fabrication approach we have developed to produce broadband, UV-Visible guiding, single-mode, hollow-core fibers with performance levels that meet or exceed current commercial single-mode fibers.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of High Efficiency Large Angle Polarization Insensitive Retroreflecting Metasurface for Magneto-Optical Traps
abstract: Metasurface retroreflectors can dramatically reduce the size and weight of chip-based magneto-optical traps. However, large-angle optical-frequency metasurface retroreflectors suffer from low efficiency and polarization distortions. Using inverse-design we demonstrate a high-efficiency large-angle polarization-maintaining metasurface retroreflector.

articleTitle: Observation of the Burstein-Moss Effect in GaAs Wafers via Few-Cycle Transient Dispersion Measurement
abstract: We report time-resolved measurements of transient dispersion in GaAs wafers using few-cycle pump-probe reflectometry. Comparisons among samples show good agreement with the Burstein-Moss effect model.

articleTitle: Waveguide Bragg Grating Based Humidity Sensing Chip Associated With PVA-PDMS Film
abstract: We demonstrated a novel relative-humidity sensing chip (RHSC), which is based on waveguide Bragg grating assistant with PVA-PDMS. The RHSC shows a 7pm/RH% sensitivity at the range of 50%RH to 90%RH.

articleTitle: 643 mW Average Power Lithium Niobate THz Source
abstract: We demonstrate power scaling of a THz source based on the tilted-pulse front method in lithium niobate to a record-high average power of 643 mW, obtained at 40 kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Demonstration of IQ-channel Multiplexed Coherent DP-4ASK Signal with Reduced DAC Power Consumption for Downlink Transmission with Access-span Length Difference
abstract: In coherent PON downlink transmission with 10-km access-span length difference between two ONUs, the adaptive IQ-imbalanced DP-4ASK signal can save the 22 % power consumption of the Q channel of DAC for IQ-balanced DP-4ASK signal.

articleTitle: A Single-Photon Dictionary to Support the Emerging Quantum Industry
abstract: We present definitions of terms relevant to single-photon sources and detectors designed to foster a common language and promote clarity and understanding, support commercialization and device specifications, and facilitate the development of single-photon quantum technologies.

articleTitle: Langevin’s model for soliton molecules in ultrafast fiber ring laser cavity: investigating the interplay between noise and inertia
abstract: We describe the vibration pattern of a soliton-molecule using the Langevin’s model, i.e. noise source combined with a deterministic model. This simpler model allows investigating the interplay between fluctuation and dissipation mechanisms at play.

articleTitle: A Bias-instability-enhanced Dual-polarization Fiber-optic Gyroscope for Precision Measurement
abstract: A dual-polarization fiber-optic gyroscope with a delay coil is realized. The bias instability reaches 5 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup> °/h. An earthquake with an epicentral distance of 4200 km has been recorded, indicating the ability for precision measurement.

articleTitle: Photon-pair generation and Second harmonic generation experiment on LiNbO3 on insulator
abstract: We fabricate nano-size photonic waveguides and micro-ring resonators on LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-on-insulator platform, then measure their classical optical properties, including propagation loss and SHG. Using SHG results, photon-pair generation experiments are carried out, CAR value reaches 1548.

articleTitle: Optimizing the design of two-section integrated lasers for a larger excitability regime
abstract: Using the Yamada model, the influence of saturable absorber length and mirror reflectivities on the excitability window of an integrated laser is investigated. A short absorber and low reflectivity mirrors are beneficial for a large excitability window.

articleTitle: Tunable Light Source Powered by LDLS™ and Liquid Crystal Tunable Filter for Hyperspectral Applications
abstract: A tunable light source designed with a laser-driven light source and a liquid crystal tunable filter is proposed and evaluated. Modeling results of in-band fluxes, FWHM bandwidths between 400nm and 800nm are presented.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Sources at On-Demand Wavelengths via Seeded Intermodal Raman Scattering
abstract: We numerically show that controlling the power of a low-power 500 ps-pulse seed can, via intermodal Raman scattering, tune the wavelength of a ~MW peak power level 100-fs soliton, yielding a versatile color-tunable all-fiber energetic ultrafast pulse source.

articleTitle: Configuration-dependent SHG Behaviors of Doubly SP-Resonant Asymmetric Al Nanorod Dimers
abstract: We present SHG behaviors of doubly SP resonant asymmetric Al nanorod dimers. Appropriate arrangements of two nanorods enable us to exert active controls of SHG conversion efficiencies, form of nonlinear susceptibility tensors, and circular dichroism.

articleTitle: National eXtreme Ultrafast Science (NeXUS) user facility
abstract: NeXUS is one of the NSF mid-scale facilities, which major mission is to make the cutting-edge attosecond technology available to the scientific community.

articleTitle: Transforming the idler of an OPCPA system into a high-fidelity pulse
abstract: This paper describes an alternate mode of operating an existing petawatt class laser (MTW-OPAL) to utilize the idler by addressing angular dispersion and spectral phase reversal.

articleTitle: Multilayer Anti-Reflective Metasurfaces for High-Efficiency Visible Micro-Photonics
abstract: We introduce a novel multilayer metasurface design paradigm, and leverage it to design and fabricate anti-reflective metalenses at various resolving powers. We demonstrate that transmission and focusing efficiencies of multilayer metalenses outperform their single-layer counterparts.

articleTitle: Sub-standard quantum limit estimation precision for a wide resources range
abstract: Quantum metrology protocols need to face several issues when implemented in realistic scenarios. Here, we experimentally demonstrate quantum-enhanced estiamtion precisions in both a single and multiparameter framework maintained for an exceptionally large range of resources.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Line-by-Line Pulse Shaper for Driving Josephson Junctions
abstract: We present a high-resolution line-by-line pulse shaper at 1064 nm designed to produce arbitrary pulse patterns for driving Josephson junctions. We generate complex pulse patterns and verify line-by-line operation on a 1 GHz-spaced comb.

articleTitle: Spectral Restoration of Optical Comb by Low-Resolution Scanning Etalon Combined with Inverse Matrix Deconvolution Processing
abstract: We demonstrate spectral measurement of frequency components generated from an electro-optic-modulator-based comb generator. Even with a cost-effective, low-resolution scanning etalon, the spectra of comb lines can be recovered and analyzed through an inverse-matrix deconvolution process.

articleTitle: Optical Binding of Dielectric Kerker Dimers
abstract: High-refractive index dielectric particles can satisfy the Kerker scattering conditions. We demonstrate the wavelength-dependent dynamics of silicon dimers and we establish the conditions for their stable longitudinal binding.

articleTitle: Electron Correlations and Memory Effects in High Harmonic Generation from Perovskite BiFeO3
abstract: We analyze the effects of electron correlations and memory in high harmonic generation from BiFeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> using Dynamical Mean-Field Theory and Time-Dependent Density-Functional Theory. We observe both effects lead to an extension of the harmonic cutoff.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction of Brillouin Sensor Signal by using Brillouin Gain and Loss Spectra
abstract: We evaluated the noise in slope-assisted (SA) Brillouin optical time domain analysis based on Brillouin gain and loss spectra and found out an effect that the noise is reduced compared with conventional SA methods.

articleTitle: Exciton-driven Floquet-Bloch states in Van der Waals semiconductors
abstract: We observe Floquet states driven by the time-periodic oscillations in self-energy due to an exciton in a monolayer Van der Waals semiconductor.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Mechanical Simulation of A Hybrid Micro-Integrated Diode Laser Module Developed for Space-Borne Application
abstract: We present the mechanical simulations of a compact laser module intended for space-borne application on a small satellite. The device is designed to withstand the 10+ g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rms</inf> random vibration without mechanical deterioration of the internal components.

articleTitle: Nonlinear time-resolved spectroscopy with extremely high temporal dynamic range
abstract: We present nonlinear time-resolved spectroscopy based on time filtering of femtosecond frequency combs by pulse gating in a dual-channel amplifier delivering millijoule energies with electronically-tunable femtosecond-precise delays of output pulses from femtoseconds to milliseconds.

articleTitle: Michelson and Mach-Zehnder Hybrid Interferometer for Undetected-Photon Optical Coherence Tomography at Infrared Wavelength
abstract: Wavelength-domain optical coherence tomography is demonstrated at infrared wavelength through measurement of visible photons from a hybrid-type induced-coherence interferometer. Interference visibility is maximized by optimizing relevant heralding efficiencies between photons of the inter-band entangled pairs.

articleTitle: Time-Refraction with Moving Time-Interfaces
abstract: We present an experimental study of time-refraction with propagating time-interfaces. We observe the special spectral signature of time-reflections generated by these interfaces, paving the way for their experimental demonstration in the optical regime.

articleTitle: Investigation of shock-waves generated by ps UV filaments
abstract: Shock-waves generated by UV filaments are investigated. The shock-wave first nonlinearly propagates with a super-sonic velocity, thereafter linearly at a group velocity close to the speed of sound, which is determined by the filament preparation.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Coherent Excitation of an Ytterbium Ion with Single Laser Pulses
abstract: We demonstrate coherent excitation of a <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">171</sup>Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ion using a single near-resonant picosecond ultrafast pulses with maximum population transfer of 94(1)%. This is an important requirement for sub-microsecond fast quantum logic gate with trapped-ion qubits.

articleTitle: Frequency noise metrology of SiN microresonators with Qs of 100 million at the thermodynamical bounds
abstract: The thermorefractive noise of a high-quality factor silicon nitride resonator is measured in a vacuum chamber using Hz-linewidth laser. This scheme allows noise measurement without being concerned about laser frequency noise or environmental effects

articleTitle: VLSI Quantum Graph Photonics
abstract: We report a graph-based very-large-scale-integrated silicon-photonic quantum chip. Having the correspondence between quantum chip and graph theory, we demonstrate the generation of multiphoton multidimensional entanglement and determination of modulus-squared Hafnian (Permanent) of graph’s adjacency matrices.

articleTitle: High energy-resolution transient ghost absorption spectroscopy
abstract: We utilize ghost spectroscopy for the measurement of photo-induced ultrafast dynamics using self-amplified spontaneous emission from free-electron lasers. We show that the spectral resolution is sufficient to detect small shifts in the L-edge of silicon.

articleTitle: Optical Resonance Conditions of Coupled Cavity VCSELs
abstract: DC measurements of differential resistance are used to identify resonance conditions in coherent 2x1 VCSEL arrays. Enhancement of small-signal modulation bandwidth and RIN and self-oscillation is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Reentrant delocalization transition in one-dimensional photonic quasicrystals
abstract: We theoretically predict and experimentally observe that the localization of light in one-dimensional photonic quasicrystals is followed by a second delocalization transition on increasing quasiperiodic modulation strength - an example of a reentrant transition.

articleTitle: Measurements of human cerebral blood flow changes with speckle contrast optical spectroscopy
abstract: We have developed the fiber-based speckle contrast optical spectroscopy (SCOS) system to measure human cerebral blood flow (CBF) and brain functions, and demonstrated that SCOS outperforms traditional diffuse correlation spectroscopy (DCS) systems.

articleTitle: Photon-Induced Near-Field Interaction in Ultrafast Point-Projection Electron Microscopy
abstract: We report the first study of ultrafast, slow (<100 eV) free electron wavepackets with optical near fields. This interaction is probed in a point-projection-microscope with 50fs temporal resolution using strongly localized fields around a nano-antenna.

articleTitle: Narrow-beam Single-photon Source Based on a hBN Nanocrystal in a 3D-printed Ultralow-fluorescence Microlens
abstract: We present a room-temperature single-photon source consisting of an hBN nanocrystal emitter inside an ultralow-fluorescence 3D-printed elliptical polymer microlens. The single-photon emission is highly directional, which renders objective lenses with high numerical aperture obsolete.

articleTitle: Inducing Magnetism in LiNbO3
abstract: With circularly polarized terahertz pulses, we excite a pair of degenerate perpendicularly polarized phonons in LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. The resulting circular ionic motion induces a magnetic field in LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, which is measured through the Faraday effect.

articleTitle: Monolithic Integration of Lithium Niobate and Chalcogenide Phase-Change Material for Neuromorphic Computing
abstract: We show the integration of chalcogenide phase-change material together with electro-optic modulators in the Lithium-Niobate-On-Insulator platform enabling on-chip calculation and non-volatile memory functionality for neuromorphic computing.

articleTitle: Compact Agnostic Receiver based on Silicon Optical Ring Modulators
abstract: We demonstrate a compact agnostic receiver system based on orthogonal sampling using optical ring modulators. An analog, as well as a normal and a Nyquist digital channel are processed simultaneously by the same device.

articleTitle: Quantum-level Storage of Telecom Light in a Fiber-Integrated Memory
abstract: We demonstrate the storage and retrieval of single-photon-level telecom pulses in a fiber cavity formed by fiber Bragg gratings at either end. We demonstrate storage beyond 1 μs, and show retrieved photons maintain a high fidelity with the input.

articleTitle: XPM Phase Noise Mitigation in Long-haul WDM Coherent Systems by Digitally Up-converting OSC Baseband
abstract: We proposed a simple OSC coding method to mitigate the OSC-induced nonlinear phase noise in high-speed DWDM system. Experimental results show that the OSNR budget on the 400G channel of 1280-km transmission is improved by 0.96 dB. (e-mail: cstech@optica.org).

articleTitle: CLONETS-DS Clock Network Services-Design Study Strategy for clock services over optical-fibre networks
abstract: The precise time and frequency transmissions based on optical fibre have evolved recently. The time and frequency transfer methods by GSSN are becoming gradually obsolete, definitely providing lower measurements than we can do. Yet, we do struggle with the best effotrt to enable clock comparison, and to utilize the experience with the fibre. An optical clock, they will need to be connected to others, so the collaboration is essential. We present here the further development of infrastructure in mentioned research field. And the synergy of shared entities like QKD, relativistic geodesy, any industrial and societal applications within the shared fibre, where we have been focused on.

articleTitle: Microsphere-assisted Hybrid Spectroscopic Reflectometry Using Hyperspectral Imaging for Nanospot 3D Semiconductor Metrology
abstract: We first demonstrate a microsphere-assisted spectroscopic reflectometry technique using hyperspectral imaging geometry, resulting in the extremely small spot measurement with the maximized throughput. The proposed technique is suitable for the measurement of complex semiconductor devices.

articleTitle: RF Stabilization of Vernier Dual-microcombs
abstract: Leveraging the Vernier dual-comb method, we self-reference a THz octave¬spanning microcomb with f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CEO</inf> ~100 GHz - normally too high for typical detection equip¬ment - and translate the stability of an RF reference to optical frequencies.

articleTitle: Ultrafast reconfigurability of circular dichroism from bound-states-in-the-continuum metasurfaces
abstract: We demonstrate a large and ultrafast reconfigurable circular dichroism arising from degenerate and tunable high-Q quasi-bound states-in-the-continuum resonances on a silicon metasurface using pump–probe spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Alignment-free Sr MOT with integrated metasurfaces for a compact Sr optical clock
abstract: We demonstrate an alignment-free <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Sr magneto optical trap with fully integrated multi-color metasurface photonics. We characterize the functionality of these metasurfaces to facilitate laser cooling and trapping for a compact optical clock.

articleTitle: Computing the Optical Response of Metasurfaces Under Partially Coherent Illumination
abstract: We show that the approximate optical response of a periodic nanostructure with respect to normally incident partially coherent illumination can be reconstructed by a single electromagnetic simulation.

articleTitle: Microresonators With Nanodiamonds Fabricated via Two-Photon Polymerization for Quantum Photonics
abstract: Polymeric microresonators embedded with nanodiamonds containing NV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> color-centers were fabricated via two-photon polymerization technique, presenting Q factors in the order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>, and one to three fluorescent nanodiamonds per structure.

articleTitle: Soliton Pair Dynamical Transition in Mode-locked Lasers
abstract: We report a dynamical transition between steady states of optical solitons in a mode-locked fiber laser. We model the transition theoretically using a Haus equation-based numerical simulation and a simplified analytical model.

articleTitle: Vibrational exciton nanoscopy: a molecular ruler to image structure, coupling, and disorder on their elementary scales
abstract: We develop a new method of high-resolution infrared nano-spectroscopy based on intermolecular vibrational wavefunction delocalization to image previously inaccessible structural disorder in functional materials on the molecular scale.

articleTitle: Spectral Pulsations of Dissipative Solitons in Fiber Lasers
abstract: We employ real-time spectral measurements to investigate the transitions from the stable mode locking to period doubling and long-period pulsations. We analyze the new frequencies generated during the sequence of bifurcations and report an entrainment where the period of the long oscillation locks to multiples of the cavity roundtrip time.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Dual-Comb Spectroscopy at 9.5 μm for Plasma-Assisted Ammonia Production
abstract: We measure ammonia (NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) production in nitrogen-hydrogen (N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>:H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) plasmas using high-resolution quantum cascade laser dual-comb spectroscopy in the long-wave infrared. Doppler-broadened NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> spectra reveal temperature profiles and product abundances as a function of plasma conditions.

articleTitle: 1358 nm High-Power DFB Lasers with Integrated Spot-Size-Converter
abstract: We demonstrated a high power 1358 nm DFB laser with integrated spot-size converter. Output power over 66 mW at 200 mA and SMSR over 55 dB has been realized.

articleTitle: Quantum cryptographic protocol implementation using a highly-efficient cold-atom-based quantum memory
abstract: We report on a highly-efficient cold-atom-based quantum memory and its use to perform a quantum money protocol. We also simulate the multi-mode capacity of this quantum memory using Hermite-Gaussian modes of light.

articleTitle: Optical Spectroscopy of Telecom-Wavelength Single Vanadium Quantum Emitters in SiC
abstract: We investigate the optical properties of vanadium single defects in SiC. We provide the first experimental verification of its optical selection rules and observe surprising sub-GHz photoluminescence inhomogeneous distributions, critical for telecom quantum technology applications.

articleTitle: Squeezing enhancement by suppression of noise through a resonant interferometric coupler
abstract: We present an integrated device in which a resonant interferometric coupler allows for the suppression of nonlinear parasitic processes and the efficient generation of squeezed light via spontaneous four-wave mixing.

articleTitle: Temporal Imaging using Integrated Electro-Optic Time Lens on Thin Film Lithium Niobate
abstract: We realize a temporal magnifying and 2f system using a lithium-niobate-chip-based electro-optic time lens. We achieve a temporal magnification factor up to 7.25 and Fourier transform operation of the input pulses with sub-picosecond resolution.

articleTitle: Generation and propagation of dissipative optical solitons in fiber cavities
abstract: Here we present some early experimental studies on the propagation of optical pulses in fiber cavities that provided significant insights for the comprehension of the complex dynamics underlying dissipative soliton propagation

articleTitle: Polarization-Induced Topological Edge and Corner States in Chern Photonic Crystals
abstract: Polarization is not a well-defined quantity in Chern insulators. Using gyromagnetic photonic crystals, we show that a notion of relative-polarization can be well-defined in Chern insulators leading to topological edge and corner states.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach to Third-order Parametric Down-conversion
abstract: We propose an integrated platform for the deterministic generation of non-Gaussian states by third-order parametric down-conversion. We suggest an approach to its experimental demonstration by photon triplet detection, predicting a rate up to 100 Hz.

articleTitle: Security Flaws From Time-Varying Encoding in High Speed MDI QKD
abstract: Electro-optic phase modulators are commonly used for polarization and phase encoding in quantum key distribution. Here, a novel state preparation flaw which arises during high speed electro-optic phase modulation is identified and characterized. The impact of this state preparation flaw on the secure key rate is quantified.

articleTitle: Terahertz phonon polariton concentrator based on perovskite oxides
abstract: We report the experimental demonstration of surface phonon-polaritonic devices in a broad spectral range of 7-13 THz based on SrTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. We designed planar ultrafast concentrators that amplifies transient electric field by 6 times and measured an average field of 0.5 GV/m in an optically resolvable area in the far field.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Control of Reconfigurable Metasurface for Real-time Holographic Beam Steering
abstract: We present a reconfigurable metasurface that generates a far-field map using deep learning combined with a scattering equation in Born approximation. Our algorithm enables a real-time generation of holographic beaming with a microsecond-order generation time.

articleTitle: Endogenous BOTDA in Self-Homodyne Coherent Detection Transmission System
abstract: Embedded with 400-Gbps self-homodyne coherent transmission architecture, an endogenous Brillouin optical time-domain analyzer is proposed and achieved with a spatial resolution of 3 meters and a relative frequency error < 2 MHz.

articleTitle: Higher-order Topological States in Fractal-like Photonic Lattices
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally demonstrate higher-order topological corner states in the first-generation Sierpinski fractal-like photonic lattices, suggesting that the topological origin of these corner states can be directly associated with that of the lowest-generation lattice.

articleTitle: Prediction of ischemia reperfusion injury zone using in silico model of cardiac injury zone
abstract: Myocardial infarction (MI) is the leading cause of mortality in the US and worldwide. MI following an ischemic incident can have detrimental consequences including heart failure. Ischemia Reperfusion (IR) injury following MI results in irreversible damage to the anatomy of the vasculature, and dysfunction of cardiomyocytes and myocardial tissue. These changes in time precipitate heart failure (HF) leading to loss of cardiac structural and functional integrity. In the present study, we are developing an in silico model of cardiac vasculature to quantify size of IR zone.

articleTitle: Quiet point engineering for low-noise microwave generation with soliton microcombs
abstract: In this work, we employ the avoided mode crossing engineering in microresonators for the ultra-low noise microwave generation with dissipative Kerr solitons.

articleTitle: Future Optical Access-Metro Platforms for Advanced Services in the 6G Era
abstract: We discuss how the access and metro networks can evolve to support more advanced services in the 6G era with a focus on access-metro platforms based on distributed computing and optical networking.

articleTitle: Single extracellular vesicle trapping, and manipulation assisted by plasmonic mirror-enhanced optical anapole mode
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate trapping and manipulation of single extracellular vesicle using optical anapole state for the first time. It provides a promising platform for single extracellular vesicle analysis with high throughput.

articleTitle: Projection-slice four-wave-mixing spectroscopy using frequency combs
abstract: We demonstrate projection-slice spectroscopy using frequency combs that enables rapid measurements of couplings between sample’s excited states. This information is not easily accessible with other one-dimensional methods and is critical for imaging and chemical sensing.

articleTitle: Phase-defined dissipative soliton molecules in ultrafast laser resonators
abstract: Artificial manipulations on dissipative soliton molecules stimulate the exploration for controllable temporal and internal assemblies. Phase-defined four regions are implemented to constitute the high-distinguishable quaternary encoding format and realizes the all-optical storage.

articleTitle: Potassium Titanyl Phosphate Material Engineering Boosting Integrated Optical Source Performance
abstract: We study the interaction of gray tracking and DC ionic conductivity in Potassium Titanyl Phosphate (KTiOPO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, KTP) and present a novel way to reduce conductivity via a potassium nitrate treatment improving the device quality.

articleTitle: High Extinction Ratio Integrated Reconfigurable Distributed Bragg-Reflector from Lithium-Niobate-on-Insulator for Precise Pulse Shaping at Strontium Spectral Lines
abstract: We design and demonstrate tunable distributed Bragg reflectors on thin film Lithium-Niobate-on-Insulator, at strontium spectral lines. A Mach-Zehnder-Interferometer geometry allows electrically modulated pulse shaping with high extinction ratios of 30 dB.

articleTitle: Low Stress Bilayer LPCVD-PECVD SiN Waveguides for Kerr Frequency Comb Generation
abstract: We demonstrate a foundry-compatible platform based on bilayer LPCVD-PECVD SiN waveguides. Using microrings fabricated from our bilayer waveguide, we show a Kerr soliton frequency comb spanning 300 nm with 125 mW of pump power.

articleTitle: Effects of Light Backscattering on Injection-Locking Conditions in Strongly Injection-Locked Whistle-Geometry Semiconductor Ring Lasers
abstract: We investigate the impact of light backscattering between the two counterpropagating modes on injection-locking conditions in strongly injection-locked unidirectional whistle-geometry semiconductor microring lasers and on their high-speed modulation performance.

articleTitle: Reservoir Computing-based Multi-Symbol Equalization for PAM 4 Short-reach Transmission
abstract: We propose spectrum-sliced reservoir computer-based (RC) multi-symbol equalization for 32-GBd PAM4 transmission. RC with 17 symbols at the output achieves an order of magnitude reduction in multiplications/symbol versus single output case while maintaining simple training.

articleTitle: Raman enhancement induced by localization of light (TiO2@Silica plus silica nanoparticles)
abstract: Strong enhancement of the Raman signal is observed in ethanol suspension of TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>@Silica, being stronger as the TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>@Silica filling fraction is increased above threshold, and when silica nanoparticles are added.

articleTitle: Continuous-variable quantum key distribution with true local oscillator
abstract: In continuous variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD), using a truly local (not transmitted over the network) oscillator improves security. Here we report the first implementation of this CV-QKD scheme over a deployed optical fiber network.

articleTitle: Gigahertz Dual-Comb Modelocked Laser: High Power and High Coherence in Free-Running Operation
abstract: We demonstrate a single-cavity dual-comb laser combining 1-GHz repetition rate, 3-W average power, and 78-fs pulses via an intracavity biprism. The laser’s low noise properties enable a fully coherent dual-comb spectroscopy measurement on acetylene.

articleTitle: Statistical mechanics of the orbital angular momenta in the presence of radially symmetric random perturbations in nonlinear multimode fibers
abstract: We show that, in the presence of radially symmetric random perturbations, the orbital angular momenta of a multimode nonlinear fiber will relax into a Rayleigh-Jeans distribution characterized by a well-defined optical temperature and chemical potential.

articleTitle: Coherent OAM Modulation Technique using Versatile Phase Controllability of Multi-optical-combs towards Sensitive and Rapid Spatiotemporal Spectroscopy
abstract: A new orbital angular momentum (OAM) modulation method is demonstrated based on the high phase controllability of multi-optical-combs. The developed method will lead to sensitive and rapid spatiotemporal spectroscopy using optical frequency combs.

articleTitle: Spectral Properties and Photon-Number Distribution of Highly-Nondegenerate Entangled Photons
abstract: We obtain specific spectral properties of highly-nondegenerate entangled photons measured by photon-number-resolving detectors under different focusing schemes, and observe the distribution changing from Poissonian to thermal as wavelength leaving away from their peak.

articleTitle: 308 Tb/s Real-Time Transmission over 1260 km Widened C+L band EDFA Amplified Weakly Coupled 7-Core MCFs using 400 Gb/s/carrier Transceivers
abstract: We demonstrate a 308 Tb/s transmission over 1260 km 7-core fiber link using real-time 400Gb/s/carrier transceivers and widened C+L band EDFAs, achieving a record capacity-distance product in commercial-ready systems to the best of our knowledge.

articleTitle: Machine Learning enabled compensation of Phase-to-Amplitude Distortion in OPC systems
abstract: We numerically demonstrate a digital signal processing method for compensating the phase-to-amplitude distortion caused by the interaction of imperfect counter-phasing pump dithering with the dispersive fibre channel in optical phase conjugated trans-mission systems.

articleTitle: Wide-Angle Single-lobe Beam-Steering using Optical Phased Arrays on Implantable Neural Probes
abstract: We demonstrate single-lobe beam-steering over ~50° at λ=440-460 nm using an end-fire optical phased array coupled to a 1D grating for out-of-plane emission. The devices were integrated on implantable neural probes for targeted optogenetics.

articleTitle: WDM Photonic Synaptic Interconnects for Sparse Photonic Neural Networks
abstract: We propose a new wavelength-division-multiplexed silicon photonic synaptic interconnect based on silicon microring resonators in between two silicon nitride star couplers. Further, we experimentally observe the reconfigurability of the proposed scheme on foundry-enabled chip.

articleTitle: Negative Quasiprobabilities Enhance Phase Estimation in Quantum-Optics Experiment
abstract: Uncertainty principles limit measurement precision, via operator noncommutation. Wielded correctly, noncommutation can boost precision. We relate metrological enhancement with negative quasiprobabilities, quantum extensions of probabilities. In a phase measurement, we amplify the precision per detected photon by two orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Tunable probabilities from the quantum vacuum
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of random bits with tunable probability distribution in an optical parametric oscillator. Bits are encoded into the phase statistics of the signal field, which are tuned by a small bias field.

articleTitle: All-Fiber Visible Light Generation using Orbital Angular Momentum mediated Parametric Nonlinearities
abstract: Multi-stage four-wave mixing governed by orbital angular momentum selection rules enables all-fiber generation of visible light at 659 nm that is power-scalable.

articleTitle: Laser-based micro-machining of high precision glass ferrules for 2D fiber arrays
abstract: High-precision ferrules for 2D fiber arrays are fabricated with laser-based micro-machining using ultrashort pulse lasers. We demonstrate sub-micrometer diameter control accuracy and excellent reproducibility on a large number of devices.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Acquisition of Hybrid-Amplified THz-Repetition-Frequency Bursts
abstract: We demonstrate single-shot acquisition of hybrid two-step amplified bursts, in which spectral modulations are deliberately suppressed in a femtosecond chirped-pulse amplifier and then recovered in an optical parametric amplifier, anticipating several exciting resonant multiphoton applications.

articleTitle: Self-supervised neural network for holographic microscopy
abstract: We present a self-supervised hologram reconstruction neural network trained using a physics-consistency loss, which achieves superior generalization to reconstruct holograms of various samples, without previously having/seeing any experimental data or prior knowledge regarding the samples.

articleTitle: Quantitative Glucose Detection Using Terahertz Wireless Communication for THz Joint Communication and Sensing
abstract: We demonstrate quantitative glucose detection using terahertz (THz) wireless communication for THz joint communication and sensing. The experimental results show a strong correlation between glucose concentrations and performance parameters including the eye amplitude and error vector amplitude in the eye and constellation diagrams.

articleTitle: Sub-Hertz Reciprocal Frequency Readout for Chip-Scale Optomechanical Inertial Navigation
abstract: We further our work on precision optomechanical inertial sensing by designing an integrated frequency counter for RF readout of our inertial sensor. We implement signal conditioning and frequency-to-digital conversion, obtaining a sub-Hertz measurement resolution.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonics-Based All-Optical Image Compression
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical image compression technique using on-chip nanophotonic disordered media to perform local random transformations. Our compression technique is fast, scalable, and may consume about 50 times less energy than electronic compression.

articleTitle: Brillouin scattering by surface acoustic waves in Z-cut lithium niobate ridge waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate through numerical simulations that Z-cut Lithium Niobate on Insulator (LNOI) ridge waveguides may support confined short-wavelength surface acoustic waves that strongly interact with optical fields through backward Brillouin scattering.

articleTitle: Deployment of Ground-based LHR Sensor for Greenhouse Gas Vertical Profile Measurements
abstract: Construction and automation of an observatory dome and LHR instrument for simultaneous detection of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O.

articleTitle: High-Performance Sub-Wavelength Grating Assisted Compact WDM/MDM Hybrid (De)Multiplexer
abstract: A compact (70 μm) hybrid device that can multiplex two modes, TE0 and TE1, and two wavelengths, 1550 and 1310 nm is demonstrated. Experimental results exhibit an insertion-loss of 1.5 dB and crosstalk < 18 dB.

articleTitle: Vortex Formation of Active Particles within a Confined Geometry by Velocity Alignment
abstract: we have developed an optical feedback control system with synchronous control of active particles to study collective motion in nature. Fish-like vortex is observed within a circular confined geometry based on the particles’ velocity alignment.

articleTitle: Photonic Neural Cellular Automata for Self-Organized Image Classification
abstract: Neural networks based on Cellular Automata (CA) have recently yielded more robust, reliable, and parameter-efficient machine learning models. We experimentally demonstrate the first photonic implementation of CA which successfully performs image classification on the Fashion-MNIST dataset.

articleTitle: Adaptive Mitigation of Equalization-induced High-frequency Amplification Noise in Faster-than-Nyquist Coherent Optical Communications
abstract: A novel adaptive mitigation scheme of amplified high-frequency noise in Faster-than-Nyquist (FTN) 16QAM coherent systems. It not only has a low level of complexity but also exhibits comparable performance to that of traditional schemes.

articleTitle: Non-Hermitian selective thermal emitter for thermophotovoltaics
abstract: Selective thermal emitters can boost the efficiency of heat-to-electricity conversion in thermophotovoltaic systems only if their spectral selectivity is high. We demonstrate a non-Hermitian metasurface-based selective emitter operating at 1200 K in a GaSb-thermophotovoltaic cell.

articleTitle: A quantum-bit encoding converter for quantum interconnects
abstract: Here we demonstrate the conversion of quantum information between optical discrete- and continuous-variable qubits. We certify the protocol with fidelities exceeding the classical limit. Our result demonstrates an essential tool for enabling interconnected quantum architectures.

articleTitle: Picoliter-volume refractive index sensor 3D-printed in silica glass on an optical fiber tip
abstract: We demonstrate a refractive index sensor additively 3D-printed in silica glass on an optical fiber tip. The sensor shows a sensitivity of 900 nm/RIU and measures a liquid volume as small as 0.6 pl.

articleTitle: Inherited topological edge states in photonic trimer lattices
abstract: We show that topological properties of edge states in trimer lattices are inherited from the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, albeit not featuring the traditional Zak phase invariant. Such edge states are demonstrated in a photonic platform.

articleTitle: Mitigating TMI using Multimode Excitation in Fiber Amplifiers with Gain Saturation
abstract: We present a theory of TMI threshold for highly multimode excitations in fiber amplifiers with gain saturation. We show TMI threshold increases 6-fold when all 30-modes are excited equally in a 2D waveguide, compared to fundamental mode-only excitation.

articleTitle: A Terahertz Hollow-Core Optical Fiber with Low Confinement Loss for Orbital Angular Momentum Modes Transmission
abstract: A terahertz hollow core optical fiber is designed to support orbital angular momentum modes up to l=3. The fiber exhibits low confinement loss (0.003dB/cm), flat dispersion and wide bandwidth (0.9-1.2 THz and 1.425-1.85 THz).

articleTitle: Near-Field Terahertz Emission Spectroscopy of Non-Linearities using Free Electrons
abstract: The interaction of free-electron pulses with THz near-fields imprints a rich structure on the electron spectrum. We exploit this interaction in an ultrafast electron microscope distinguishing THz-generating non-linear mechanisms of optical rectification and photo-Dember effect.

articleTitle: First observation of plasmon-enhanced harmonic generation driven by a mid-IR laser in a single metallic funnel structure
abstract: We have experimentally observed plasmon-enhanced third and fifth harmonic generation in a gas-filled single funnel structure driven by a mid-IR laser for the first time, paving the way to generate coherent XUV at a high repetition rate.

articleTitle: Efficient Silicon Photonic Add-Drop Microdisk Filters for DWDM Systems
abstract: We propose add-drop microdisk filters for demultiplexing in DWDM systems and demonstrate a 41% reduction in thermal tuning energy with smaller 1.6 µm radius microdisks, requiring only 1.5 mW tuning on average.

articleTitle: Guiding of Spectroscopic Signal with a Concatenated Filament-Driven Waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate the guiding of characteristic emission from a laser-produced plasma through a concatenated filament-driven thermal waveguide. The concatenated arrangement increases the signal-to-background ratio in remote laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Spinning Meta-Cam: Spectro-Polarimetric Long-wave Infrared Thermal Imaging based on Spinning Metasurfaces
abstract: We demonstrate spectro-polarimetric long-wave infrared thermal imaging based on the dispersive polarization modulation in spinning metasurfaces and computational spectral reconstruction algorithms.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics in 2D materials and their on-chip integration
abstract: The nonlinear optical characterization of a range of two-dimensional (2D) and lamellar materials will be presented, highlighting frequency conversion applications. Their on-chip integration with photonic waveguides will then be described and discussed.

articleTitle: High-resolution Imaging with Scattered X-ray Radiation
abstract: We demonstrate ghost imaging with scattered x-ray radiation for the first time and show that its spatial resolution is significantly higher than the resolution of standard present-day methods that rely on x-ray scattering.

articleTitle: Structural and optical characterization of nanometer sized MoS2/graphene heterostructures for potential use in optoelectronic devices
abstract: We show growth of heterostructures on Ir(111) crystal and subsequent transfer to a Si wafer. This remedies substrate constraints imposed by MBE and allows to harness its advantages for applications in (opto)electronics and quantum technology.

articleTitle: All-Optical Spiking Membrane III-V Laser on Si
abstract: We present an all-optical photonic spiking neuron based on a membrane laser on silicon with optical feedback. Ultrafast dynamics with ~200-ps refractory periods using 10-GHz signals are demonstrated, at a laser-energy cost of ~10 pJ/spike.

articleTitle: All-optical control of single-photon wavepackets via Kerr nonlinearity induced refractive index fronts
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the efficient, broadband (4.7 THz), and controllable all-optical manipulation of single photons in a nonlinear photonic crystal fiber, in agreement with performed simulations of nonlinear pulse propagation, based on the quantum-classical correspondence principle.

articleTitle: High power and high modulation bandwidth deep-ultraviolet LEDs with microcavities and reflectors
abstract: In this work, we fabricated a deep ultraviolet light-emitting diode with SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-based microcavity, which can enlarge the light output power and modulation bandwidth, eventually facilitating to establish viable high-speed optical wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Generation of high-energy, narrow-linewidth pulses from an Er,Yb:glass planar waveguide amplifier with a large-core and double-clad structure
abstract: We develop an Er,Yb:glass planar waveguide amplifier with a large-core and double-clad structure that outputs pulses with energy exceeding 40 mJ. The saturation fluence and the small-signal gain are 8.7 J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 10.0, respectively.

articleTitle: Enhanced Control of Intermodal Coupling in Photonic Waveguides
abstract: We introduce a rigorous first-principles methodology to simultaneously couple multiple transverse spatial modes of multimode waveguides with arbitrary amplitudes/phases and show techniques to suppress undesired crosstalk arising from nonideal nonlinear effects by ~20 dB.

articleTitle: Cavity Optomechanics with WSe2 Single Photon Emitters
abstract: We demonstrate surface acoustic wave cavity optomechanics with WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> single-photon emitters with modulated resonance linewidths indicative of deformation potential coupling. We observe dynamic fine-structure mixing that may enable entangled-photon pair generation from 2D materials.

articleTitle: Pressure-Based Motion Artifact Reduction by Least Mean Squares Adaptive Filtering
abstract: We present a pressure sensor for motion detection in photoplethysmography and implement an adaptive filter using pressure data as a reference to significantly improve the accuracy of heart rate estimation by peak finding.

articleTitle: Optimal quantum encoding of an oscillator into two oscillators
abstract: We solve the problem of finding the optimal two-mode oscillator-to-oscillator code for continuous-variable error correction—demonstrating that the two-mode-squeezing code with a hexagonal Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill state is best.

articleTitle: Topological Photonic Circuit for Beam Splitting, Routing, and Far Field Steering
abstract: Nonmechanical robust far field beam scanning is highly demanded for integrated photonics. Here we report an on-chip optical beam splitting, routing, and wavelength-sensitive far field steering enabled by a topological photonic integrated circuit.

articleTitle: Zero second-order-dispersion microcombs using CMOS-ready photonics
abstract: The wavelength of zero group-velocity-dispersion is engineered in a silicon-nitride coupled-ring resonator. The resonator is hybridly-integrated with a semiconductor laser pump to produce high-power-efficiency microcombs spanning a bandwidth of 9.9 nm near 1560 nm.

articleTitle: Quantum Photonic chip-based Realization of Logic Gates
abstract: Quantum logic gates are the backbones of quantum information processing (QIP), wherein the typical three-qubit Fredkin and Toffoli gates are essential in quantum computation and communication. Here we propose a scheme for realizing such kinds of three-qubit based on a programmable nonunitary matrix on a photonic chip.

articleTitle: Spin Momentum Locking Induced Dynamic Circular Dichroism in Extraordinary Optical Transmission
abstract: A dynamic circular dichroism is observed in the extraordinary optical transmission of a symmetric nanohole array. It is attributed to extrinsic chirality resulting from the spin-momentum locking between surface plasmon polaritons and the incident light.

articleTitle: Surface-plasmon-enhanced strain-wave detection on segmented gratings
abstract: We report on surface-plasmon-polariton-enhanced measurements of strain-wave-induced time-dependent diffraction changes of a Au-covered, segmented grating. Surface Acoustic Waves and Longitudinal Waves are identified and enhanced by a factor of 15 and 4.6, respectively.

articleTitle: Nanostructurization to optimize weakly-coupled few-mode fiber for mode-division-multiplexed systems
abstract: We present the optimization of four modes optical fiber structure for mode-division multiplexing systems using nanostructurization. The nanostructurization allows to fabrication of fibers with arbitrarily designed refractive index distribution based on two glasses.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Crosstalk in Tellurite Multi-Core Fiber for Near-Infrared Image Transportation
abstract: Crosstalk in tellurite and silica multi-core fibers was calculated. The results showed that tellurite fibers can provide 1.83 times the resolution and 2.5 times the brightness compared to silica fibers in image transportation at 1.55 µm.

articleTitle: Quick Quantum Steering: Overcoming Loss and Noise with Qudits
abstract: We formulate and demonstrate a test of quantum steering under extreme conditions of loss and noise, free of the fair-sampling loophole, with a dramatic reduction in measurement time counter-intuitively achieved through the use of qudits.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Pump-Probe Nano-Imaging with Far-From-Equilibrium Excitation
abstract: Heterodyne vis-pump IR-probe nano-imaging is developed to reveal, with simultaneous spatial, spectral, and temporal resolutions, solar-cell relevant polaron dynamics in perovskites and thermal transport across 2D heterointerfaces in phonon-polariton nano-thermometry.

articleTitle: Resonance for analog recurrent neural network
abstract: Resonance, as a ubiquitous feature across many wave systems, is a natural candidate for analog computing in temporal signals. We demonstrate that resonance can be used to construct stable and scalable recurrent neural networks. By including resonators with different lifetimes, the computing system develops both short-term and long-term memories simultaneously.

articleTitle: Mechanical sharing dual-comb fiber laser with high relative frequency stability
abstract: We demonstrate a mechanical sharing dual-comb fiber laser that integrates allpolarization-maintaining configuration. Relative phase stability of nearest comb mode in the dualcomb laser in free-running operation is evaluated to be 8.98 rad (1 kHz−1 MHz).

articleTitle: Loading and unloading a time cavity moving at the speed of light
abstract: We consider nonlinear-photonic cavities, flying at the speed of light, with the ability to trap photons. We demonstrate that a nonreciprocal interaction channel can serve to load and unload the cavity.

articleTitle: Chiral Optofluidics Based on Thermoplasmonic Circular Dichroism
abstract: A new concept of optofluidic circular dichroism is proposed based on a chiral metamaterial perfect absorber. The maximum CD and g-factor reach 0.9 and 1.73, and the concept can be used for ight-sensitive optofluidic applications.

articleTitle: Beyond 100-GHz bandwidth with monolithic indium phosphide integrated circuits
abstract: 100GHz-class modulators and detectors are fabricated and demonstrated on integrated photonic platforms. We analyse current energy and bandwidth limitations for high performance platforms and elaborate the opportunities for 200GHz bandwidth indium phosphide integrated photonics.

articleTitle: The plasmonic Kapitza-Dirac effect and electron shaping with plasmonic fields
abstract: We present a novel method to shape single-electron wavepackets via their interaction with tunable plasmonic fields. We further demonstrate the first instance of electron diffraction from a standing electromagnetic surface wave – a plasmonic Kapitza-Dirac effect.

articleTitle: Data-efficient Modeling of Optical Matrix Multipliers Using Transfer Learning
abstract: We demonstrate transfer learning-assisted neural network models for optical matrix multipliers with scarce measurement data. Our approach uses < 10% of experimental data needed for best performance and outperforms analytical models for a Mach-Zehnder interferometer mesh.

articleTitle: Topology optimization of a broadband and fabrication-friendly polarization splitter-rotator on silicon platform
abstract: A fabrication-friendly polarization splitter-rotator is designed by particle swarm optimization. The device has a short length of 26.62 µm and <1 dB loss with 127 nm optical bandwidth.

articleTitle: Transmission Efficiency Limit for Nonlocal Metalenses
abstract: We derive a fundamental bound on the transmission efficiency of diffraction-limited nonlocal metalenses. We show that high efficiency at large numerical aperture re-quires the entrance aperture to be smaller than the output aperture.

articleTitle: Noise canceling in optical measurement using broadband antiphase pulses by phase-controlled optical frequency comb
abstract: Noise canceling technique using destructive interference by broadband antiphase pulses generated by phase-controlled optical frequency comb was proposed. By simply controlling two frequencies of the comb, background noise is well-canceled as demonstrated in tomography.

articleTitle: Thermal tuning of Brillouin Lasing in Silica Microspheres
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate thermal control of Brillouin phase-matching, bypassing thermal drifts of resonances, we were able to identify the resonances involved.

articleTitle: Higher-order topological corner states in a distorted photonic Kagome lattice
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate photonic higher-order topological corner states in a C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>- symmetric lattice of "inverse star of David" shape – the distorted Kagome lattice. Topological nature of such corner states is discussed from the fractional corner anomaly.

articleTitle: Chalcogenide Glasses Microresonators with Ultra-high Qfactor in Near- and Mid-infrared Regions
abstract: We report the record on-chip quality(Q)-factor for diverse chalcogenide glasses, reaching the loss of optical fibers on near- and mid-infrared. The maximum Q-factor is 2.15×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> and 2.91×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> in 1.55 μm and 3.67 μm wavelength, respectively.

articleTitle: Direct Nanoplastics Detection Below the Diffraction Limit Using Micro Raman
abstract: Raman spectra of polystyrene nanoparticles of 50 nm diameter were directly measured using micro-Raman spectroscopy. Data analysis demonstrated that particles as small as 20 nm could be directly measured with this simple and robust technique.

articleTitle: 100 GHz Amplified Mode-locked Frequency Comb with 80 Gbaud NRZ Transmission Ability Based on Ultra-fast Quantum Dot Technology
abstract: We demonstrate a 100 GHz repetition rate mode-locked based OFC source and a high gain SOA based on ultra-fast QD dynamics. High-speed optical NRZ data transmission of >80G baud is achieved with the amplified comb.

articleTitle: Topology-Preserving Nonlinear Structured Light Generation from All-Dielectric Metasurfaces
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the simultaneous generation of phase-locked structured light beams, including optical vortices, Hopf links, and trefoil knots at fundamental and tripled frequencies in all-dielectric nonlinear optical metasurfaces.

articleTitle: Non-volatile reconfigurable metasurface for free-space phase-only modulation
abstract: We demonstrated a nonvolatile electrically reconfigurable metasurface based on low-loss phase-change materials Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> with phase-only (~0.25π) modulation in the free-space. The tunable metasurface is robust against reversible switching over 1,000 times.

articleTitle: Comparison of Coherent and Incoherent Donut Beams for Deep Tissue STED Microscopy
abstract: We numerically compare the null quality for STED microscopy generated by Laguerre-Gaussian beams with orbital angular momentum and donut beams generated by incoherent addition of orthogonal Hermite Gaussian beams when imaging deep biological tissue.

articleTitle: Fundamental Coexistence Limit of Quantum States with White Rabbit Synchronization in Quantum Networks
abstract: We theoretically establish a distance limit and experimentally demonstrate coexisting quantum and classical channels in common fiber. When coexistence criteria are met, a single-mode fiber can carry >100 quantum channels and classical synchronization channels.

articleTitle: Distinguishing thermal from non-thermal ("hot") carriers in illuminated molecular junctions
abstract: We develop the theory necessary to explain the experimental measurement of the non-thermal electron distribution in a plasmonic molecular junction in [2]. This reveals that the original interpretation of the measurements was inaccurate.

articleTitle: High-order resonances of solitons in a passive coherently driven cavity with a parabolic potential
abstract: We predict the formation of high-order dissipative solitons in a dissipative cavity with a parabolic potential. We show that high-order soliton resonances are mainly populated by modes of different orders.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Spatiotemporal Characterization Using Multispectral Wavefront Sensing
abstract: Multispectral wavefront sensing techniques are employed for single-shot spatiotemporal characterization. Phase diversity and lateral shearing are used with a multispectral camera to characterize radial group delay, compressor grating misalignment, and optical parametric chirped-pulse-amplification performance.

articleTitle: On-Chip Pure χ(3) Parametrically-Driven Temporal Cavity Solitons
abstract: We demonstrate theoretically and experimentally that a bichromatic degenerate Kerr optical parametric oscillator can parametrically-drive bi-phase temporal cavity solitons. Our experiments are performed in Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microresonators and constitute the first observation of such dissipative solitons.

articleTitle: Two-Step Hot Electron Decay in Ti1-xAlxN Films
abstract: We report two-step electron-phonon interaction process in MBE-grown Ti<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>N thin films. Strong and ultrafast (<0.2 ps) as well as long-living (≥1 ns) electron-phonon interaction is observed for Ti-rich Ti<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>N in the whole visible spectral range.

articleTitle: Effect of laser and target parameters on excitation dynamics and damage in silicon
abstract: Three-Temperature modeling combined with FDTD is used to study laser excitation and damage in silicon. The model reproduces parametric dependencies observed in damage threshold of silicon and is consistent for a range of interaction conditions.

articleTitle: Polarization-entangled sources using waveguide-coupled two-microring-resonators in a silicon nitride platform
abstract: We demonstrate polarization-entangled photon-pairs in a Si3N4 platform adopting a single-waveguide-coupled two-microring-resonators structure. We design different microring parameters to obtain indistinguishable orthogonally polarized photon-pairs in the spectral domain. The measured visibility is ~ 85%.

articleTitle: Vector atomic magnetometer based on EIT in Rb vapor
abstract: By analyzing the relative frequencies and amplitude of multiple electromagnetically induced transparency resonances in external magnetic field, we achieve scalar magnetometer sensitivity $ < 5{\text{pT}}/\sqrt {{\text{Hz}}} $, and can determine the B-field direction with angular sensitivity < 1° using machine learning and optical lock techniques in a 100 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> atomic vapor cell.

articleTitle: GaAs Site-controlled Pyramidal Quantum Dots as Spin Qubit Sources for a Photonic Cluster State Construction: the Role of Light-hole-like Excited States
abstract: We present a comprehensive spectroscopic study of highly uniform energetic structure of Pyramidal site-controlled GaAs quantum dots specifically directing our interest to their applicability to the photonic cluster state generation.

articleTitle: Ultra-narrowband interference circuits for 1.25 GHz gated single-photon InGaAs/InP avalanche photodiodes
abstract: We report a novel ultra-narrowband interference circuit (UNIC) for low noise photon counting of 1.25GHz gated InGaAs/InP avalanche photodiodes. We achieve record-low afterpulsing probability of 0.5% at a detection efficiency of 25.3%.

articleTitle: Topological Energy Pumping in Floquet Synthetic Dimensions with a Driven-Dissipative Photonic Molecule
abstract: We introduce topological energy pumping in a quasiperiodically-modulated photonic molecule with two Floquet synthetic dimensions. We predict experimental signatures of topology that are enhanced by the driven-dissipative nature of our half-BHZ-model implementation.

articleTitle: Pipeline Two-phase Flow Sand Concentration Monitoring based on Distributed Acoustic Sensing
abstract: A non-invasive online method for pipeline sand connection detection based on dynamic peak-seeking is proposed and demonstrated. The test results show that the proposed method can identify the minimum sand concentration as low as 0.02%.

articleTitle: Advanced Circular Dichroism Measurement Method with Circular Polarization Switching Dual-comb Spectroscopy
abstract: This study demonstrated well-controlled circular polarization switching dual-comb spectroscopy using coherent controllability of combs. Applicability of circular dichroism spectroscopy has been verified using circular polarizers. The developed method realizes high-sensitivity, high-speed, and broadband circular-dichroism characterizations.

articleTitle: Triple-Etch Grating for Near Perfect Coupling at Normal Incidence
abstract: We numerically demonstrate a grating coupler design with a peak efficiency of 96%(−0.18dB) at normal incidence on standard Silicon-On-Insulator. This design takes into account fabrication constraints suitable for E-beam lithography and can be realized through three consequtive etch steps.

articleTitle: Smart Nonlinear Photonics: From On-chip Pulse Processing to Tailored Nonlinear Fiber Propagation
abstract: We review recent work using integrated and fibered platforms for advanced optical processing techniques. We show that machine learning in photonics systems can be leveraged to generate custom optical wave-packets relevant for targeted applications.

articleTitle: An Explicit Formula for Electron-hole Recollisions by Extreme Tailoring of Feynman Path Integrals
abstract: An explicit formula is derived for analysis of high-order sideband generation in a two-band model. We show the possibility of extracting information on band structures and dephasing rates from sideband signals with simple algebraic calculations.

articleTitle: United time and frequency spectroscopy with engineered dual comb spectrometer
abstract: We report a dual-comb spectrometer having engineered pulse trains used to study two-level system dynamics with high frequency and temporal resolutions. The excitation evolution of rubidium isotopes was measured with a resolution of 4ns.

articleTitle: Single-particle–single-photon Coupling Using a Circuital Metamaterial Cavity
abstract: We propose a surface-plasmon-inspired circuital-metamaterial cavity that achieves record-breaking interaction strength between charged-particles and photons. The cavity drives emission of multiple microwave photons per particle, enabling strong particle-photon entanglement for applications in free-particles quantum optics.

articleTitle: A highly stable and 2.4 × 109 quality factor packaged microrod resonator
abstract: We demonstrate a highly stable and ultrahigh quality factor of 2.4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> pack-aged microrod resonator in which Kerr optical frequency combs are generated to realize data transmission at total rate up to 100 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Generalized Energy Conservation Relation in a Space-Time Varying Medium
abstract: A generalized form of energy conservation relation is derived for a space-time varying medium. We use this relation to discuss the condition under which parametric gain can exist in such a medium.

articleTitle: Optimal Design and Manufacturing Process of Substrate-Free Surface Plasmon Nanolaser
abstract: In this study, we calculate the minimum size of SIM-structured nanolasers and propose corresponding fabrication methods to achieve optical mode volumes and physical volumes close to those of LSP-mode nanolasers.

articleTitle: White Light Generation and Few Cycle Pulse Compression in Cascaded Multipass Cells
abstract: We report supercontinuum generation and pulse compression in two stacked multipass cells based on dielectric mirrors. The 230 fs pulses at 1 MHz containing 12 µJ were compressed down to 7 fs, corresponding to 1.0 GW peak power.

articleTitle: Pseudospin evolution and vortex transmutation due to topological singularity mapping in photonic graphene
abstract: The charge of converted vortices from topological singularity mapping is usually invariant during propagation. Here, we demonstrate pseudospin evolution and periodic vortex transmutation by proper excitation of a ring spectrum in the Dirac cone.

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Cr:ZnS Single-Cavity Laser Operating at 2.36-µm
abstract: The first single-cavity SESAM-based dual-modelocked laser operating at 2.36 µm is presented. It was achieved by spatially multiplexing two pulse trains in a Cr:ZnS solid-state laser cavity.

articleTitle: High-dimensional mode-entangled photon pairs from a tapered silicon waveguide
