abstract: We present a proposal for creating high-dimensional entangled photon pairs in a tapered silicon waveguide through intermodal four-wave mixing. We show that 4D Bell states can be obtained with 98 % fidelity.

articleTitle: Combination of Optical Phase Conjugation and Advanced Pruning Techniques to reduce the Computational Complexity of Neural Network-Based Equalisers
abstract: Combining midlink optical phase conjugation and different pruning techniques is proposed to develop low complexity complex-valued neural networks based equalisers in a PDM 28 Gbaud 64 QAM transmission over 400km of SSMF.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Color Purity for InGaN Red Micro-LEDs by Modified Distributed Bragg Reflector
abstract: Considering the wavelength shift caused by quantum-confined Stark effect (QCSE) in red InGaN micro-LED, the simulation results herein indicate that the modified distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) can provide a 42% amelioration in color purity.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Learning-Based Shack-Hartmann Wavefront Reconstruction
abstract: This abstract describes experimental results of a Shack-Hartmann based neural network (ISNet) for turbulent wavefront reconstruction. After transfer learning ISNet from simulated data to experimental data, results show improved wavefront reconstruction compared to Shack-Hartmann reconstruction.

articleTitle: Vertical Silicon-on-Insulator Coupler for High Density Optical Interconnects
abstract: We present an ultra-compact dual-polarization coupler working at normal incidence to the chip surface for use with multi-core fibers with a core-to-core spacing down to 15µm. The coupler achieves an unprecedented efficiency of −3.8dB for a device with a footprint of only 100µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and a 3-dB bandwidth of 59nm.

articleTitle: Compact Bragg grating with narrow stopband designed by inverse design
abstract: Inverse design is used to realize a compact Bragg grating (BG) with narrow stopband for filtering and sensing applications. Design policy was discussed for various conditions, and the BG with narrow stopband was experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Atomic memory on the external degrees of freedom of an ensemble of two-level atoms
abstract: A theoretical and experimental analysis is developed for an atomic memory based on recoil-induced resonance. Control of such memories on external degrees of freedom is crucial to explore higher order nonlinearities for storage of information.

articleTitle: Monolithic MQW Polarization Mode Controller Integrated with Sidewall Grating DFB Laser
abstract: An AlGaInAs MQW polarization mode rotator is monolithically integrated with a side wall grating DFB laser and differential phase shifter to achieve TE to circular and then linear polarization conversion.

articleTitle: Non-Hermitian Topologically Enhanced Sensing
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate enhanced sensitivities within non-Hermitian topological lattices realized in a dissipatively-coupled network of time-multiplexed resonators. Our demonstration paves the way for realizing optical sensors with unprecedented sensitivities using notions of non-Hermiticity and topology.

articleTitle: Integrated photonics demonstration of zero-curvature eigenfunctions
abstract: We apply the homomorphism between the Schrödinger and Helmholtz-Maxwell wave equations to experimentally demonstrate an integrated photonic analogue of the zero-curvature eigenfunctions predicted in quantum mechanics.

articleTitle: Extreme Ultraviolet Metaoptics enabled by Vacuum Guiding
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a dielectric metalens operating at 50 nm wavelength by leveraging that holes in a Silicon membrane guide extreme ultraviolet light. A knife edge measurement shows focusing down to 1.7 times the diffraction limit.

articleTitle: Short-pulse generation from photonic-crystal lasers by direct sinusoidal modulation
abstract: We numerically and experimentally investigate transient characteristics of photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers with direct sinusoidal modulation toward high-speed, high-power, free-space optical communications. We demonstrate the generation of short-pulse trains with a watt-class peak power and a GHz-class repetition frequency synchronous to the electrical signal.

articleTitle: Metropolitan Single-Photon Distribution at 1550 nm for Random Number Generation
abstract: Quantum communication networks are used for QKD and metrological applications. We present research connecting two nodes ≈ 20 kilometers apart over the municipal fiber network using semiconductor quantum dots emitting at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Periodic energy exchange in transient cavity-cavity strong coupling at terahertz frequency
abstract: We investigate the transient process of strong coupling between two terahertz (THz) microcavities, unveiling a Rabi-like oscillation in the coupling system featured by a periodic energy exchange between the two microcavities.

articleTitle: Soliton Microcombs at 1064 nm Enabled by a Nanophotonic Bandgap
abstract: We demonstrate dark-soliton microcombs in the 1064 nm band, using a nanophotonic bandgap for tunable phase-matching in normal dispersion. Nanophotonic design enables microcomb spectrum tailoring, here with fifty modes at 200 GHz spacing and 10 dB flatness.

articleTitle: Engineering Design of Integrated III-V/SiN Quantum-well and Quantum-dot Lasers
abstract: Spectrally-pure lasers are paramount in various fields. Progression to Hz-level lasing linewidth in III-V/SiN lasers with quantum-dot active regions is predicted here. Using parametric studies, one can produce timely results in engineering designs.

articleTitle: Sub-2-cycle GW-peak-power 9.5 μm OPA
abstract: We present an optical parametric amplifier (OPA) pumped with a 2.4 μm Cr:ZnSe laser and generating 93 μJ pulses at 9.5 μm, 1 kHz with sub-2-cycle pulse duration, 1.6 GW peak power, and excellent beam quality. The results open a wide range of applications in attosecond physics (especially in solids), remote sensing, and bio-relevant spectroscopy.

articleTitle: All-function Integrated Silicon Photonic Tensor Core (PTC) AI Accelerator
abstract: Here we present our architecture for Silicon Photonic Tensor Core (PTC) capable of accelerating computational needs of neural networks and augmented/virtual reality applications. We present a novel fully-integrated PTC including chip-based lasers, modulators, and photodetectors.

articleTitle: Efficient, compact and reliable fibred single-photon source in the solid-state
abstract: We experimentally achieve state-of-the-art performance of a pigtailed solid-state quantum light emitter, with MHz pulsed count rate, high single-photon purity and indistinguishability. The source device performs with high stability over hours in rack-size cryostats and optical control modules for stand-alone operation.

articleTitle: Aladin UV Lidar over 4 years of operation and 6 billion shots emitted in space
abstract: Aeolus is operating in-flight since more than 4 years and has generated 6.4 billion UV laser shots. The progressive received signal decrease was recently partially compensated by switching laser A on, allowing extending mission lifetime.

articleTitle: Water Bubble Detection in Turbid Water Using Polarimetric imaging
abstract: We investigated the feasibility of using polarimetric imaging for water bubble detection in turbid water. We demonstrated that the best strategy is to utilize total internal reflection and capture the degree of circular polarization images.

articleTitle: Optically computed full field Doppler phase microscopy for dynamic imaging
abstract: We investigate a full field Doppler phase microscopy (FF-DPM) technology based on an innovative optical computation strategy that enables depth resolved imaging and phase quantification. FF-DPM takes en face measurement of Doppler phase shift and quantitatively images the axial motion within the en face plane.

articleTitle: Deep-Strong Coupling between Cavity Photons and Terahertz TO Phonons in PbTe
abstract: We have investigated the resonant coupling of photons with TO phonons in lead telluride in small-mode-volume terahertz cavities, observing a giant vacuum Rabi splitting on the order of the bare cavity–phonon frequency.

articleTitle: Tight-Locking Mid-Infrared Quantum Cascade Frequency Combs by Near-Infrared Light Injection
abstract: We demonstrate the tight-lock of a mid-infrared quantum cascade laser frequency comb by near-infrared light modulation. Our result, improved mutual coherence compared to drive-current modulation alone, is pertinent for highly-sensitive dual-comb spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Design and Model of On-Chip Metalens for Silicon Photonics Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Convolution Neural Networks are one of the most diffuse Neural Networks. Here, we present a Silicon photonic CNN chip that leverages hardware complexity by exploiting Fourier light properties to perform convolution operations, focusing on the chip-based Fourier-lens.

articleTitle: High-speed hyperspectral and phase-contrast THz imaging using differential chirped pulse down conversion
abstract: We demonstrate a THz imaging system using chirped pulses to acquire amplitude and phase information of various samples, enabling hyperspectral imaging and axial optical path delay determination approximately 50x better than the diffraction limited lateral resolution. Official contribution of the National Institute of Standards and Technology; not subject to copyright in the United States.

articleTitle: Spectrum-Based Selective Monitoring of Propagation Effects
abstract: We propose a machine learning based method to estimate the proportion of interchannel and intra-channel nonlinear effects. The model is tested with simulations over different power profiles, fiber attenuations, span lengths and chromatic dispersions.

articleTitle: All-Optical Computing of a Group of Linear Transformations Using a Polarization Multiplexed Diffractive Neural Network
abstract: We report the all-optical implementation of a group of arbitrary complex-valued linear transformations using a polarization multiplexed diffractive optical network that consists of spatially-engineered isotropic diffractive surfaces and pre-determined linear polarizer arrays.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion with a high-Q thin-film lithiun niobate microring resonator
abstract: We report a low-loss thin-film l ithium-niobate-on-insulator p latform, and demonstrated a high-Q microring resonators with a lowest propagation loss of 0.05dB/cm. A wavelength conversion efficiency of -32dB was achieved with 6.6dBm pump power.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Fabrication-Robust, Low-Loss, and Compact Waveguide Bends
abstract: We report an inverse design method for waveguide bends. We design a TE0-TE4 waveguide bend with an effective radius 14.96 µm and loss less than 0.4 dB over a 250 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Correlations of chaotic light in Kerr microresonators
abstract: We experimentally investigate the dynamics of dissipative chaotic modulational instability in Kerr microresonators. Correlations of these waveforms are revealed in both temporal and spectral domain.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocal Thermal Emission based on Space-Time Modulation of Graphene
abstract: We present a non-reciprocal thermal emitter based on the dynamic space-time modulation of graphene. Compound symmetry in the system gives rise to a new dimension of tunable thermal emission in non-reciprocal systems.

articleTitle: Strong Light-Matter Interactions for Intersubband Transition in a Flexible Single Quantum Well Structure
abstract: We demonstrate ultrastrong coupling between intersubband transitions in single semiconductor quantum well and resonant modes of photonic nanocavities implemented on both rigid and flexible substrates. The Rabi splitting reaches 27% of the intersubband transition frequency.

articleTitle: Quantum-relevant optical nonlinearity in aluminum nitride
abstract: Record-high electro-optic coefficient in thin-film AIN is demonstrated by introducing Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.75</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.25</inf>N multiple quantum-wells. Ferroelectricity is reached with novel ScAlN quantum structures, developed to enhance <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> nonlinearity toward quantum relevance.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Multi-Function Integrated RF Photonic Front-End
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the first ever integrated RF photonic front-end capable of simultaneous tunable filtering and phase shifting. We achieve, at the same time, >50 dB notch filtering tunable from 3.9 to 8.1 GHz and tunable 2π phase shift from 12 to 20 GHz, with an optimized noise figure of 24 dB and a spurious-free dynamic range of 105 dB • Hz <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup>.

articleTitle: Mie-Resonant Anti-Reflection Microstructures for Long-Wave Infrared Transmission Optics
abstract: We demonstrate that Mie resonant nanophotonic anti-reflection structures enable Silicon to function as an effective transmission optic over long-wave infrared wavelengths. This approach enables a window with 40% greater transmission than bare Si.

articleTitle: Chaotic dynamics of a broad-area VCSEL
abstract: We investigate the polarization, spatial, spectral and dynamic properties of a broad-area VCSEL in continuous-wave operation. The transverse and polarization mode competition results in a complex bifurcation scenario leading to chaotic dynamics.

articleTitle: Time reflection and refraction in synthetic frequency dimension
abstract: We demonstrate that time reflection and refraction can be observed in a two-band model centered around a non-zero reference energy. Our model can be physically implemented as a system of two coupled dynamically-modulated ring resonators.

articleTitle: Fabrication of a Polariton Cavity via Mid-IR Laser Excitation
abstract: We fabricate polariton cavities in hBN with Q-factors > 70. Our approach is based on strong, resonant phonon excitation at 7.3 µm with femtosecond pulses causing the sample to "unzip" and produce a phonon reflection.

articleTitle: Decreasing SNSPD Jitter to Sub-3 ps Upon Increased Photon Illumination
abstract: We investigate the timing accuracy of SNSPDs under illumination with varying photon numbers and find a reduction of latency time by more than 100 ps as well as sub-3 ps jitter at high photon flux.

articleTitle: High-performance chip-to-chip QKD with hybrid integrated photonics
abstract: Here we demonstrate a hybrid integrated quantum key distribution chip which combines through edge-coupling an ultra-low-loss SiN interferometer with a high-speed InP phase modulator. This novel devices produces record chip-to-chip secure key rates.

articleTitle: Dual-band Optical Isolation in Thin-film Lithium Niobate Based on Dynamic Modulation
abstract: Current integrated optical isolators have limited bandwidths due to stringent phase-matching, resonant structures, or absorption. We demonstrate broadband optical isolation in thin-film lithium niobate that simultaneously achieves ~ 100 nm isolation bandwidth at visible and telecom wavelengths.

articleTitle: Dual-Pump Pump-Probe Method for Characterizing Nonlinear Loss of Optical Waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate a method to characterize the nonlinear loss of high index contrast waveguides as a function of wavelength using a dual-pump pump-probe setup. Loss characteristics of amorphous silicon waveguides are extracted.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Ultrashort Pulse Laser Processing Based on Novel In-Process Monitoring and AI High-Speed Optimization
abstract: We have developed ultrashort pulse data-driven active laser processing for higher precision and productivity, in which process parameters can be controlled in real-time based on in-process monitoring data and artificial intelligence optimization.

articleTitle: Analysis of Rydberg Excitation in Rubidium
abstract: We demonstrate Rydberg state excitation in thermal rubidium vapor through the 6p state using light at 420 nm and 1015 nm. The system is analyzed through fluorescence, electromagnetically induced transparency and microwave coupling.

articleTitle: Compact and Robust Laser Stabilization System Using a Vibration-Insensitive All-Fiber Ring-Resonator
abstract: We stabilize a 1550-nm laser to a vibration-insensitive optical fiber delay with 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup>-level vibration sensitivity using a fiber ring-resonator configuration. A minimal frequency instability of 2.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-14</sup> at 0.03-s averaging time is achieved in non-vacuum environment.

articleTitle: 190 mJ & 85 ns Electro-Optically Q-switched 2.79 µm Cr:Er:YSGG Laser
abstract: We report on a 2.79 μm flashlamp pumped electro-optically Q-switched Cr:Er:YSGG laser. The maximum output energy of 190mJ was demonstrated in 85 ns pulses at a 3 Hz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Automated Bell Inequality Violation using Uncalibrated Fiber Squeezing Polarization Controllers
abstract: We experimentally report on a real-time self-guided method to search for maximal CHSH violations between two observers sharing polarization entangled photon pairs using uncalibrated piezoelectric fiber squeezers as polarization controllers.

articleTitle: Optomagneto control of singlet fission charge multiplication dynamics in single organic semiconductor crystals
abstract: Over a 0-7 T range, transient absorption microscopy on anthradithiophene organic crystals shows that singlet to triplet pair state conversion is anticorrelated with fluorescence yield. This shows how the dominant singlet fission charge multiplication pathway can be switched-off with increasing B-field or by changing the molecular packing motifs.

articleTitle: Using Cross-phase Modulation to Transfer Coherence Between a Cr:Zns Frequency Comb and its Optical Pump
abstract: We phase-lock a frequency comb based on a few-cycle Cr:ZnS laser oscillator to its narrow-linewidth optical pump, creating a set of mutually coherent optical frequency combs that span from the visible to the long-wave IR.

articleTitle: Pure Quintic Dispersion Microresonator Frequency Combs
abstract: Pure fifth-order chromatic dispersion-based frequency combs are theoretically and numerically investigated. We find that multiple bright, dark, and multi-peak soliton solutions exist simultaneously.

articleTitle: Real-time hyperspectral video understanding via universal metasurface encoders
abstract: We here present Hyplex™, an artificial i ntelligent h ardware a nd software optoelectronic platform for acquiring and processing high-resolution hyperspectral videos at 30 frames per second. We will illustrate the implementation and various applications in the field.

articleTitle: High-Power 1.3 μm Wavelength Operation of Asymmetric Double-Lattice Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Lasers
abstract: We demonstrate high-power, single-mode operation of 1.3-μm-wavelength InP-based photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers. At room temperature, output powers of over 250 mW under continuous-wave conditions and over 8.5 W under pulsed conditions are achieved.

articleTitle: An Etchless Integration Platform for Superconducting Nanowire Single Photon Detectors
abstract: We introduce a new etchless integration platform for superconducting nanowire single photon detectors based on bound states in the continuum polymer strip waveguides, which enables dense fabrication of high-efficiency detectors in planar photonics circuits.

articleTitle: Bound states in the continuum in heterogeneous lithium niobate and silicon nitride waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate bound states in the continuum (BIC) in heterogeneously integrated thin-film lithium niobate and silicon nitride waveguide. With the BIC mode, a compact Mach-Zehnder interferometer is proposed as an electro-optic intensity modulator.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystals with a Twist
abstract: Twisted bilayer photonic crystal slabs have two degrees of freedom, twist angle and interlayer spacing, that permit the engineering of nanoscale devices that exhibit novel behavior and open the door to real-time reconfigurable devices.

articleTitle: Characterizing photon emission from a quantum dot excited by long above-band pulses
abstract: We experimentally investigate the quality of single photons produced with long-pulse above-band excitation of a quantum dot embedded in a semiconductor nanowire and model the results via rate equations and Markov-chains.

articleTitle: Octave-spanning microcombs generation with controllable intracavity soliton states
abstract: We propose a monolithically integrated scheme to efficiently generate robust octave-spanning microcombs with controllable intracavity soliton states using a single CW pump.

articleTitle: Phase-Locking of a Gunn Oscillator by Electro-Optic Detection Using Mach-Zehnder-Modulator-Based Flat Comb Generator
abstract: Phase-locking of a Gunn oscillator by electro-optic detection using a Mach-Zehnder-modulator-based flat comb generator has been demonstrated. By feeding back beat signals to the Gunn oscillator system, phase-locking of was successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Free-electron-based interferometry for enhanced, phase-resolved near-field imaging
abstract: We propose a novel scheme for phase-resolved near-field imaging using free electrons. Our scheme relies on algorithmic extraction of the complex-valued electron-field coupling. Pre-shaping the electron wavefunction facilitates superior sensitivity relative to the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: 18 GHz Frequency Comb in the UV via On-Chip Cascaded Harmonics
abstract: We report on an 18 GHz repetition-rate electro-optic frequency comb centered at 390 nm via on-chip cascaded harmonic generation covering more than 2000 lines across 40 THz of optical bandwidth.

articleTitle: Nonlinear quantum logic with colliding graphene plasmons
abstract: We present a theoretical study of a quantum logic gate based on two colliding plasmons in a single graphene nanoribbon with an intrinsic optical nonlinearity. The gate performance is only limited by the plasmon lifetime.

articleTitle: Selective laser crystallization of germanium in amorphous Ge/Si multilayer stacks
abstract: Selective laser crystallization of germanium in multilayer stacks consisting of alternating amorphous nanosized films of silicon and germanium deposited on silicon and glass substrates has been achieved using near- and mid-infrared ultrashort laser pulses.

articleTitle: Decorrelated Source for Heralded Indistinguishable Photons at 1550 nm in Rb:KTP Waveguides
abstract: We present the fabrication, characterisation and modelling of an in-house fabricated source of decorrelated, indistinguishable photon pairs at 1550 nm based on a periodically poled Rb:KTP waveguide.

articleTitle: Numerical Studies of an Optical Parametric Amplifier Seeded by a Fiber-Amplified Pulse
abstract: We report on simulations in 2D space and time of a tunable optical parametric amplifier in Type-I BBO that is seeded by a broad spectrum, high spectral energy density, fiber-amplified pulse.

articleTitle: Freely Controllable Spectral Peak Generation Using 206 MHz All-PM Fiber Laser Comb and LCOS-SLM
abstract: We demonstrated freely controllable spectral peak generation using 206 MHz figure-9 fiber laser comb, LCOS-SLM, and nonlinear fibers. Selected comb modes were extracted as the spectral peaks with high signal to background ratio >30 dB.

articleTitle: Proposal for a Density-Engineered Bose-Einstein Condensate for Long-Lived Quantum Memory
abstract: We propose a scheme that exploits matter-wave optics in microgravity to increase the coherence time of quantum memories based on untrapped Bose-Einstein condensates by minimizing the density-dependent decoherence effects.

articleTitle: Free-electron interactions with photonic GKP states: error correction and universal quantum computation
abstract: We find that interactions of coherently-shaped free electrons with photons enable universal quantum computation and error correction with GKP qubits. The electron can entangle multiple GKP qubits, creating GHZ and cluster states.

articleTitle: Demonstration of ultra-compact setup for synthesis of space-time wave packets
abstract: We introduce an ultra-compact and robust system to generate space-time wave packets based on chirped volume Bragg gratings to spatially resolve the spectrum, which reduced the volume of the synthesis setup down to 25 × 25 × 8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Scalable Nanoimprint Manufacturing of Multi-layer Metasurfaces for Compact Polarimetric Imaging System
abstract: We demonstrate a scalable approach to fabricate multiple layers of metasurfaces by nanoimprint lithography (NIL), and further integrate the metasurface structures on ultra-compact polarimetric imaging system. The approach can significantly reduce the processing time and cost in manufacturing large-scale optical devices, in the meanwhile minimizing optical loss from defects and roughness in conventional fabrication.

articleTitle: Electrically-controlled Varifocal and Bifocal-Bicolor Metalenses Embedded in a Liquid Crystal
abstract: We demonstrate highly-compact multifunctional zoom components based on low-loss all-dielectric metasurfaces integrated with liquid crystals (LCs). These devices could find use in next-generation imaging systems including mobile cameras and wearable mixed-reality displays.

articleTitle: Simple description of ultrafast single-photon wavepackets interacting with moving fronts
abstract: We consider photons experiencing reflection, tunneling or trapping by refractive index fronts moving at the speed of light. We show that evolution equations in such situations are determined uniquely via the quantum-classical correspondence principle.

articleTitle: Line Positions and Intensities of 12CH3I around 2971 cm−1 from Frequency Comb Fourier Transform Spectroscopy
abstract: We use the high-resolution spectrum of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup>CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>I measured using a comb-based Fourier transform spectrometer to extend line assignments to the 2971 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> region and introduce line positions and intensities of the ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> and ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>+ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> bands.

articleTitle: Writable and Erasable Second Harmonic Generation from Crystal-Derived All-Glass Optical Fibers
abstract: All glass optical fibers drawn from crystalline precursors via the molten core method demonstrate instantaneous and greatly enhanced second harmonic generation. Results when pumping in the NIR at relatively low powers (< 1W) are presented.

articleTitle: Ultrafast dynamics of plasmons and free carriers in 2D MXenes
abstract: We use transient optical absorption and time-resolved terahertz THz spectroscopy to investigate photoexcitations in Ti<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, Mo<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Ti<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, and Nb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>C. Measurements reveal pronounced plasmonic effects. Monitoring them provides insights into thermal relaxation processes and low thermal conductivity.

articleTitle: Ultra-Efficient Plasmonic Phase-Change Devices on SOI Platform
abstract: Small footprints and low energy consumption are the long-seeking metrics for photonic computing. Here, we combine grating structures with plasmonic nanogap devices and demonstrate less than 4pJ optical switching energy with stable multilevel performance.

articleTitle: A monolithic bulk ppKTP cavity for quantum frequency conversion from 637 nm to telecom wavelength
abstract: We demonstrate an efficient low-noise quantum frequency converter based on a thermally self-stabilizing monolithic bulk ppKTP cavity for the conversion of single photons from nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to telecommunication wavelength.

articleTitle: DBR laser integrated with SOA and SSC for FMCW LiDAR system
abstract: We demonstrated a DBR laser realizing 114 mW output power. By applying the SSC structure, the coupling efficiency to 2.5 μm and 5 μm lensed fiber reaches 57% and 51%, respectively.

articleTitle: CO2 Leakage Detection by Raman Spectroscopy with Hollow Core Photonic Crystal Fiber
abstract: We demonstrated Raman-based detection of CO2 in hollow core photonic crystal fiber with 532nm or 785nm excitation sources at various gas concentrations and pressures. We also carried out kinetics studies and comparison with simulations.

articleTitle: 2D Zero-Contrast Gratings for Unpolarized Transmission-Mode Mid-Infrared Bandpass Filtering
abstract: We demonstrate polarization insensitive mid-infrared spectral bandpass filters in a single-layer silicon on sapphire process. Guided mode resonances, excited via 2D cuboid gratings, produce bandpass features with experimentally measured Q-factors >127, within broad extinction bands.

articleTitle: Observation of Kilometer Propagation of Space-time Wavepackets
abstract: We observe for the first time, a propagation invariant space-time wave packet propagating a kilometer in turbulent conditions. Ultimately, we produce a 2 mm STWP which is propagation invariant and outperforms the equivalent Gaussian beam by 100x.

articleTitle: Unveiling attractive and repulsive dynamics of self-assembled dissipative soliton molecules
abstract: Real-time spectroscopy enriches our knowledge of the build-up and transient dynamics of ultrashort pulses. By virtue of the ultrafast spectral interferometry, we unveil the attractive and repulsive dynamics of self-assembled dissipative soliton molecules vividly.

articleTitle: Electro-optic sampling of the waveforms produced by an optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We report field-resolved detection of few-cycle pulses generated by a subharmonic optical parametric oscillator (OPO) with an octave-wide spectrum centered at 4 µm using near-infrared probe pulses phase-locked to the OPO output.

articleTitle: Development of Free-Form Fibers with Square Mode and Flat Intensity Distribution
abstract: A use of the nanostructuring approach allows shaping intensity distribution to form a fundamental mode into a square cross-section and flat top-hat intensity distribution in the fiber. A proof-of-concept silica nanostructured fiber with 24 µm core is developed and characterized. We have demonstrated a square mode propagation with top-hat intensity distribution.

articleTitle: Highly Efficient Atmospheric Gases Detection Using Slow Light Effect Induced in Vertical Photonic Crystal Waveguide Arrays
abstract: We present a 2D hexagonal air hole lattice photonic crystal with a slow light effect, by introducing a vertical hollow core in the center as a spectrometer to confine light in a small volume and interact with the analytes at a low group velocity. This device offers the possibility for spatial compression and room-temperature operation.

articleTitle: A hertz-linewidth Erbium laser based on photonic integrated circuits
abstract: We demonstrate a photonic integrated circuit-based Erbium laser by endowing an ultralow-loss silicon nitride integrated optical cavity with Erbium-based gain. The free-running laser achieves 50 Hz intrinsic linewidth, 17 mW output power, and 40 nm wavelength tuning.

articleTitle: Optical Parametric Oscillator with Random Feedback
abstract: We report the first random optical parametric oscillator with amplification enabled by modulation instability gain. Rayleigh scattering provides feedback in a distinguished piecewise distributed cavity along a 5.45-km long single mode fiber.

articleTitle: In Situ Control of Kerr Nonlinear Coefficient by Cascaded Pockels Effect in Micro-Ring Resonator
abstract: We report the in situ control of the integrated Kerr nonlinear coefficient through its interplay with the cascaded Pockels nonlinear process. The effective Kerr nonlinearity can be tuned over 10 dB without redesigning photonic structures.

articleTitle: Soliton order preservation for high-efficiency and broadly tunable self-frequency shift
abstract: We introduce soliton order preservation, a pumping mechanism that leads to soliton self-frequency shift with simultaneous high energy conversion efficiency (ECE) and broad tunability. We demonstrate tunable solitons over 180 nm while maintaining ECE>80%.

articleTitle: Non-destructive Direct Pericarp Thickness Measurement of Sorghum Kernels with Fiber-based Extended Focus Optical Coherence Microscopy
abstract: We apply high-resolution Bessel-beam extended focus optical coherence microscopy for non-destructive morphological phenotyping of sorghum seeds. We obtain accurate thickness measurements with a reduced tendency to overestimate the thickness of thin phenotypes.

articleTitle: Wavelength Multiplexed Photonic Edge Computing in the Output Stationary Frame
abstract: We propose a photonic edge computing architecture based on WDM, broadband modulation, and output-stationary integration. Using this scheme, we demonstrate 98.8%-accurate DNN inference over an 86-km deployed fiber link with 3 THz optical bandwidth.

articleTitle: Silicon Nitride based photonic integrated circuit technology and integration opportunities
abstract: We present our work on silicon nitride(SiN) integrated devices and circuit development operating in the visible-to-infrared spectrum. Integration of SiN-on-SOI will be discussed along with Challenges and opportunities related to material and device integration.

articleTitle: Continuous Time-Frequency Analysis of Ultra-broadband Optical Waveforms by Algorithmic Unwrapping
abstract: We demonstrate a spectral unwrapping algorithm for electro-optic time-lens spectrograms enabling the analysis of ultra-broadband signals. This allows the 56 GHz instantaneous bandwidth to be continuously shifted to analyze waveforms over more than 550 GHz.

articleTitle: Reaching the Ultimate Efficiency of Solar Energy Harvesting with a Nonreciprocal Multijunction Solar Cell
abstract: We introduce a nonreciprocal multijunction solar cell that can reach the Landsberg limit with an infinite number of layers. With a finite number of layers, such a cell can outperform a standard reciprocal multijunction cell.

articleTitle: Influence and mitigation of crosstalk and noise on quantum communication
abstract: We discuss the influence of crosstalk on quantum communication networks and its mitigation. It was shown that choosing the parameters for the network that uses the phase stochastic resonance phenomena can increase the signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Strong Visible Defect Luminescence From Infrared-Pumped Barium Fluorosilicate Glass Fiber
abstract: A barium fluorosilicate glass fiber, when pumped in the infrared, exhibits powerful green luminescence whose intensity maintains a Pekarian-lineshape. Combined with correlated Raman spectroscopy, oxygen-excess surface defects are suggested as the origin.

articleTitle: 60-Mode Erbium Doped Fiber Amplifier with Low Differential Modal Gain
abstract: We numerically simulate a telecom fiber amplifier with a recently demonstrated fiber that transmits 60 uncoupled modes. We predict differential modal gains as low as 0.5 dB with a simple pump profile comprising only two modes.

articleTitle: Absolute Frequency Referencing in the Deep-UV Region for Metrological Application
abstract: A comb-assisted frequency chain linking the UV domain to the near-infrared region has been developed with the aim of performing precision linear spectroscopy of mercury atoms at 253.7 nm for temperature metrology.

articleTitle: Automated Full-Field Analysis of Terahertz Hyperspectral Images
abstract: We combine amplitude and phase components of terahertz transmission data to improve the accuracy of hyperspectral analysis. By incorporating machine learning methods, we demonstrate fully automated distinction of sample components with high fidelity.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Probing of Time-Dependent Ion-Distribution Profile in Light-Emitting Electrochemical Cells by An Advanced Confocal Microscope
abstract: Herein, we propose a pure optical design studying the spatial ion-distribution of organic films in light-emitting electrochemical cells, which can be further used to observe numerous ion-distributions inside organic/inorganic materials, Li-ion batteries, or micro-fluid channels.

articleTitle: Optical Vortex Generation via Nonlinear Wave Mixing of Tightly Confined Modes in Optical Nanofiber
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate optical vortex generation via spin-orbit-interaction-assisted intermodally phase-matched third-harmonic generation in a silica-glass multimode adiabatic optical nanofiber. Our scheme operates with a single Gaussian pump beam and simple pump polarization control.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Enabled Reconfigurable Terahertz Holograms with Cascaded Diffractive Optical Elements
abstract: This work demonstrates the design, fabrication, and measurement of cascaded diffractive optical elements to enable the realization of reconfigurable terahertz holograms by altering either the number, spacing, order and rotational alignment of the elements.

articleTitle: Quantum critical electro-optic materials for photonics
abstract: We show that the quantum paraelectric material SrTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> displays an exceptionally strong electro-optic tunability at cryogenic temperatures. This has wide-reaching implications for a variety of applications in quantum science.

articleTitle: Dispersion Control of High-quality Ge23Sb7S70 Reflowed Wedge Resonators
abstract: We report Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">70</inf> chalcogenide reflowed wedge resonators with up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> quality factors fabricated through reflow. The continuously varying sidewall angle can be engineered to support flat, close-to-zero dispersion modes despite large material dispersion.

articleTitle: Inner-Wall Grating Double Slot Microring Resonator for High Sensitivity and Large Measurement Range Label-Free Biochemical Sensing
abstract: Based on the SOI platform, a double slot micro ring resonator with inner wall angular gratings is achieved with the highest sensitivity of 562.564 nm/RIU and a large measurement range of 72.62 nm.

articleTitle: Four-Waveguide Crossing Functions Utilizing Anisotropic Van der Waals 2D GeAs
abstract: we demonstrate a hybrid integration of anisotropic multilayer 2D GeAs on the SiPh platform for on-chip light manipulation. Results show a remarkable light attenuation ratio difference between the two orthogonal in-plane crystal axes orientations of ~ 3.5.

articleTitle: Precise beam-forming from integrated optics for trapped-ion addressing
abstract: We present a design methodology for waveguide-to-free-space grating outcouplers enabling flexible emission angles and unprecedented precision in transverse focusing. We demonstrate its capabilities with micron-scale focusing of fundamental and higher-order modes, including Laguerre-Gaussian "vortex" beams.

articleTitle: Subwavelength-Modulated Waveguides for Phase-matching Photons and Low-Energy Electrons
abstract: We investigate dielectric waveguides with subwavelength-scale modulation for applications in free-electron-photon interactions. We show that such waveguides are capable of supporting low-loss modes that can efficiently couple to co-propagating, <10-keV electrons.

articleTitle: Silicon Rich Nitride Huygens Metasurface in the Visible Regime
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a Huygens metasurface in the visible regime utilizing Silicon rich Nitride (SRN). Offering high refractive index and CMOS compatibility, SRN is an outstanding candidate to replace the widely used TiO2.

articleTitle: Frozen Mode Regime and Stationary Inflection Points in a Coupled Three Waveguides Model
abstract: The formation of high-order exceptional points (often called stationary points), opens new avenues to important applications. Here we introduce a new integrated optical periodic structure, exhibiting exceptional points of the type: stationary inflection point.130.3120 Integrated optics devices,140.3460 Lasers.

articleTitle: Optical Phased Array Super-Cell Beyond the Reticle Limit
abstract: We present an optical phased array super-cell spanning four reticles and containing over 49,152 active elements. The device enables cross-reticle light routing between 24 OPAs, along with coherent combination using intra- and inter-reticle IQ receivers.

articleTitle: What is New in Multimode Fibers for Space Division Multiplexing?
abstract: The most recent advances on multimode fibers for space-division-multiplexed transmissions are presented. Results demonstrate the potential and maturity of this technology for future optical communications networks.

articleTitle: A Lab-on-a-chip Sensing Platform Enabling Concurrent Detection Using Subwavelength Grating Micro-ring Resonator
abstract: We developed a lab-on-a-chip optical biosensor that realized the concurrent detection of two analytes with high sensitivity. The silicon photonic chip is integrated with a microfluidics chip, which offers a promising solution to point-of-care detection.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocal Interparticle Forces in Kerker Dimers
abstract: We show that, for a two-Kerker-particle system, the interparticle forces are so highly nonreciprocal that the force on the center-of-mass can be opposite to the propagation direction of incident light.

articleTitle: Development of a Quantum-Cascade Laser Absorption Spectrometer for Rapid and Precise Measurement of 13C-18O and 18O-18O Clumping in CO2
abstract: Kinetic effects bias paleotemperature signals preserved in carbonate <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>C-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O clumping. Measurements of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O clumping can resolve these biases. We present a prototype laser spectrometer that simultaneously measures <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>C-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O clumping to precisions of <0.25‰.

articleTitle: 35W Carrier-Envelope-Phase-Stable Few-Cycle Mid-Infrared OPCPA at 10 kHz
abstract: We demonstrate a carrier-envelope-phase-stable mid-infrared optical parametric amplifier, delivering 20fs pulses at 3.5 mJ energy. Its excellent stability and high repetition rate make it an outstanding frontend for high flux, soft x-ray attosecond spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Adaptive Phase-Change Metasurfaces for Passive Radiative Cooling
abstract: We report a class of adaptive and tunable metasurfaces incorporating transparent conducting oxides (Aluminum-doped Zinc Oxide, AZO) and patterned phase-change materials (Vanadium Dioxide, VO2) for radiative cooling applications within the atmospheric transparency window (8-13 µm).

articleTitle: Sympathetic Cooling of Trapped Yb+ Ion Chain
abstract: We explore sympathetic cooling as a mechanism to cool the motion of an ion chain without disturbing their qubit states. A narrow linewidth transition in a different isotope is used to implement the cooling process.

articleTitle: Intermodal strong coupling and wideband, low-loss isolation in silicon
abstract: We demonstrate wideband strong coupling between two photonic bands via electrically-driven acousto-optic scattering. Based on this system, we demonstrate a non-magnetic, low-loss (< 1 dB) and broadband (59 GHz 10 dB isolation bandwidth) optical isolator.

articleTitle: High-speed impact detection based on a dual-comb fiber Bragg grating array sensing system
abstract: Fast structure dynamics are recorded by monitoring spectral response of a dense FBG array using a dual-comb sensing system with a ~2 kHz demodulation rate . Results show great potential for high-precision real-time structure monitoring.

articleTitle: Employing the Vernier Effect for Sensitivity Enhancement in a Distributed Optical Fiber Sensor
abstract: Distributed optical fiber sensing based on microwave photonics with significantly improved and tunable sensitivity enabled by the distributed Vernier effect is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Nonintrusive Fiber Optic LIB Inner Gas Pressure Sensor Based on Characteristic Frequency Shift
abstract: A nonintrusive lithium-ion battery(LIB) inner gas pressure monitoring via fiber optic vibration sensor is demonstrated with a sensitivity of 2.24kHz/MPa and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of 0.996. It provides a potential path for early-warning of LIBs thermal runaway.

articleTitle: Exploiting 2D MXene nanosheets for ultrasensitive plasmonic biosensing
abstract: We revealed the potential of exploiting 2D MXene nanosheets as plasmonic substrates for enhanced biosensing. The detection of BSA molecules based on MXene-on-Au substrate was successfully demonstrated with a detection limit down to 10 fM.

articleTitle: Integration of Colloidal PbS Quantum Dots with Silicon Nanophotonics
abstract: Silicon nanophotonics lacks light sources needed for on-chip applications like ultra-low-power lasing. In this work, we demonstrate integration and room temperature operation of PbS colloidal quantum dots coupled to silicon nanophotonic devices.

articleTitle: Stabilization of fiber-based interferometer with single photons

authors.preferredName: Luis Javier González Martin Del Campo

abstract: Stabilizing fiber-based interferometers is a challenge. Here we show a visibility of 0.96 ±0.03 (phase resolution σ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</inf> = 0.012λ ) by only single-photon processing with fiber phase variations of 230°/s. Applications range from coherent optical communication to advanced quantum communication protocols.

articleTitle: An Operator-Based Approach to Topological Photonics
abstract: We develop a framework for assessing a photonic structure’s topology directly from its effective Hamiltonian and position operators, as expressed in real space, and without the need to calculate its Bloch eigenstates or band structure.

articleTitle: Visible 780 nm SBS laser with mW level threshold in an ultra-high 145 million Q integrated waveguide resonator
abstract: We demonstrate 780nm Brillouin lasing in a waveguide coupled Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> resonator with record-low loss (0.36dB/m) and record-high Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf> =145x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>. A 3mW S1 threshold is measured and cascaded S2 and S3 operation are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fully-Passive Optical Packaging of Arrays of Surface-Normal Electroabsorption Modulators to Fiber Arrays
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, fully-passive, optical packaging of an 8-channel array of surface-normal electroabsorption modulators to arrays of standard single-mode fibers. We validate our packaging approach through 25 Gbit/s NRZ-OOK modulation.

articleTitle: Coherent Dynamics of the Swing-up Excitation Technique
abstract: We demonstrate the coherent character of the recently proposed swing-up excitation using two red-detuned pulses with an InGaAs quantum dot by exploring the multidimensional parameter-space and investigate the quality of photons generated using this scheme.

articleTitle: Approaching the TW-regime with mJ-class picosecond pulses post-compressed to 13 fs
abstract: We demonstrate efficient post compression of 9.45 mJ, 1.2 ps pulses to 13 fs at 1 kHz repetition rate using a two stage gas filled multi pass cell system reaching near terawatt peak power.

articleTitle: Wavelength-Multiplexed Multi-User Quantum Network Based on High-Dimensional Time-bin Encoding
abstract: We have developed a multi-user QKD network using wavelength multiplexing and high-dimensional arrival-time encoding. We have demonstrated an order of magnitude key rate improvement against recent implementations with >1 bits/photon efficiency.

articleTitle: Distributed detection of quantum light: efficient photon number resolution without optical mode multiplication
abstract: We demonstrate a new method of quantum light detection based on coherent absorption of a single optical mode in a distributed array of superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors for efficient and scalable photon number resolution.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Laser Inscription of Eccentric Waveguide in Optical Fiber for Rayleigh Scattering Enhancement
abstract: We report an eccentric waveguide incribed by Femotosecond laser to enhance Rayleigh scattering level for distributed fiber sensing. The signal can be increased by about 30dB with low transmission loss.

articleTitle: Feasibility of Real-Time Satellite to Ground QKD
abstract: We estimate the classical communication data rate required for implementing real-time space to ground quantum communication using a small satellite. We also estimate the link efficiencies of classical laser communication from earth to satellite and derive requirements for the transceivers, specifically considering off-the-shelf communication standards.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Regenerative Amplifier with Net Negative Nonlinearity for Ultrashort-Pulse Generation
abstract: We exploit self-defocusing nonlinearity from phase-mismatched second-harmonic-generation for nonlinear spectral broadening in a Yb:YAG thin-disk regen. We demonstrate direct amplification of 10-μ J, 1.2-ps pulses to 0.47 mJ with broadened spectrum that can support <400-fs pulses.

articleTitle: A Chirped Pulse Amplifier at 4.05 μm Based on Cryogenically Cooled Fe:ZnSe
abstract: A ~15-GW peak power, 1.1-W average power, mid-wave-infrared, femtosecond laser based on Fe:ZnSe and pumped by free-running Er:YAG lasers was demonstrated. 247-fs, 3.7-mJ pulses centered at 4.05 μm were produced at 300 Hz.

articleTitle: Generation of GHZ States with Time-bin Qubits
abstract: We report our progress towards the first experimental demonstration of three photon time-bin GHZ entangled states. We also develop a theoretical model based on phase-space techniques to support the experimental results.

articleTitle: Mirrored-Twin Rectangular SRR Based Metamaterial for Improving Signal-To-Noise Ratio of 1.5T MRI
abstract: We designed a mirrored-twin split-ring-resonator (SRR) based metamaterial for magnetic field enhancement in 1.5T MRI. Simulation estimates a twenty-five-fold enhancement in magnetic field which would lead to a significant boost of signal-to-noise-ratio of scanned images.

articleTitle: Adaptive multiparameter estimation at the quantum bound on chip
abstract: The achievement of quantum-enhanced estimation precision is a fundamental challenge. Here, we prove experimentally the saturation of the ultimate quantum limits employing an integrated photonic sensor and developing a fully artificial intelligence-based adaptive protocol.

articleTitle: Time-reversed ultranarrow-band telecommunication photon-pair sources over 10,000 modes
abstract: We report the first time-reversible ultranarrow-band photon-pair generation with 42 MHz free-spectral range, 4.6 MHz linewidth via singly-filtered biphoton frequency combs. Our photon-pair sources have over 10,000 modes in telecommunication band.

articleTitle: Heavy metal water pollution sensor based on Green Fluorescent Protein
abstract: In this study, the possibility of monitoring heavy metal pollution in water using Green Fluorescent Protein was analyzed. Two measurement systems based on glass capillary and fluorescence signal fading measurements were considered and optimized.

articleTitle: Fully clad tantalum pentoxide on-chip optical frequency comb
abstract: Here we demonstrate the first fully-clad sputtered tantalum pentoxide (Ta<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>) on-chip optical frequency comb and validate its use as a multi-wavelength source for optical communications.

articleTitle: Millivolt-scale, high-speed electro-optic ring modulators for a wide cryogenic temperature range
abstract: We demonstrate III/V-on-Si modulators with ~10 mVpp modulation and Gbps speed over wide cryogenic temperature ranges (4K-60K). This is enabled by enhanced electro-optic effects of III/V quantum-wells and minimal III/V free-carrier freeze-out at cryogenics.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously Integrated III–V-on-Lithium Niobate Lasers, LEDs and Photodetectors
abstract: Lithium niobate-on-insulator (LNOI) has become a very promising integrated photonics platform. Here we present the heterogeneous integration of InP-based semiconductor lasers, LEDs and photodetectors on LNOI waveguide circuits.

articleTitle: Single Mode Optical Fiber Couplers Made of ZBLAN Glass
abstract: We demonstrate single-mode ZBLAN optical fiber couplers. A coupling ratio of 61%/39% is achieved with insertion loss of 4.3 dB at a wavelength of 2.7 µm. Couplers are reproducible and remain stable over >180 days.

articleTitle: High-definition microprint of metal-nanoparticles by optical vortex induced forward transfer
abstract: We present the first demonstration of 2-dimensional direct-microprint of ultrafine circle metallic dots, consisting of close-packed gold nanoparticles, with ultrahigh definition by employing optical vortex induced forward transfer.

articleTitle: Serving Verifiable, Device-Independent Randomness to the Public
abstract: Device-independent random number generators can be certified unhackable simply by the impossibility of superluminal signaling. We demonstrate a novel protocol to transparently operationalize this security through a public randomness beacon service.

articleTitle: A Photoexcited Actively Tunable Terahertz Metamaterial Encoder
abstract: This work numerically and theoretically demonstrates a photoexcited terahertz (THz) metamaterial-based two-bit binary encoder using tunable conductivity of silicon as a function of incident pump power. Obtained four binary codes are useful in chip communication.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of a Terahertz Quantum Algorithm Emulator
abstract: A metastructure-based on a graded-index lens is presented for the terahertz regime as an emulator for quantum algorithms. Further optimization is presented by applying machine learning in an inverse design strategy.

articleTitle: High-Q thin film lithium niobate microrings fabricated with wet etching
abstract: Using wet etching method, we realized microrings with intrinsic quality factor over 1.19 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> based on thin film lithium niobate on insulator. This method features low cost, high throughput and high reproducibility.

articleTitle: 3 kW single-end forward-pumped fiber laser via pump recycler and oscillator length optimization
abstract: We report a single end forward-pumped fiber laser with 3.03 kW record power. A pump recycler enhances pump absorption at 915 nm, and oscillator length is optimized to mitigate transverse mode instability.

articleTitle: 55-fs Pulse Generation from a SESAM Mode-Locked Tm:GdScO3 Laser at 2029 nm
abstract: We demonstrate SESAM mode-locking of a Tm-laser based on the orthorhombic multisite Tm:GdScO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> crystal, generating 55-fs pulses at 2029 nm with an average output power of 158 mW at a repetition rate of 71.6 MHz.

articleTitle: Distributed dynamic strain measurement with high accuracy and high spatial resolution based on DPP-BOTDA
abstract: We present 5 Hz dynamic strain measurement with a spatial resolution of 5 cm and accuracy of 5 µɛ in a 100-m-long polarization maintaining fiber by using DPP-BOTDA. The strain range is about 2000 µɛ.

articleTitle: Inverse designed nanophotonics in thin-film lithium niobate
abstract: We develop a 3D gradient-based inverse design model specially tailored for the LNOI platform, and experimentally demonstrate a spatial-mode multiplexer, a waveguide crossing and a compact waveguide bend with low loss and crosstalk.

articleTitle: Single-Pass Configuration mW-Class Broadband Mid-Infrared Comb Using a Waveguide-Type PPLN Crystal
abstract: We generated a broadband mid-infrared comb of 2.4-4.6 μm with an output of 4.2 mW based on an Er:fiber comb as a fundamental light using a waveguide-type PPLN crystal. This system is robust due to its single-pass configuration.

articleTitle: Ultracoherent Diamond Nanomechanical Resonators Protected by A Phononic Band Gap
abstract: We report the design, fabrication and characterization of diamond cantilevers embedded in a phononic crystal lattice. The ultracoherent mechanical modes feature Q-factors exceeding 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> at frequencies as high as 100 MHz.

articleTitle: Electron Dynamics Under an Effective Photon-Statistics Force
abstract: We predict and demonstrate a novel effective force exerted on matter when illuminated by light with non-classical photon-statistics. For squeezed-vacuum irradiation, the photon-statistics force stretches and squeezes matter wavefunctions, leading to emission of squeezed-vacuum harmonics.

articleTitle: Visualizing Momentum Forbidden Dark Exciton in Layered Semiconductor
abstract: Compressive strain in WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> modifies the band alignment and enables intervalley exciton-phonon scattering, enhancing the formation of dark intervalley excitons. Dark exciton emission depends on local strain, and it can be used for strain sensing.

articleTitle: Suppression of intrinsic backscattering in integrated optical resonators via acoustic pumping
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate on-chip backscattering suppression with acoustic pumping in integrated LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> racetrack resonators. We show the recovery of the intrinsic linewidth(0.14GHz) of an optical mode from a Rayleigh-scattering induced doublet state(0.32GHz) with backreflection suppression.

articleTitle: Temperature-insensitive 2 mL Optical Reference Cavity with a Microfabricated Mirror
abstract: We present a 466,000 finesse, 2 mL optical reference cavity for a strontium lattice optical clock, featuring a microfabricated curved mirror, first-order insensitivity to temperature fluctuations, and low phase noise consistent with 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−14</sup> performance.

articleTitle: High-Power Pulsed Green Fiber Laser via High-Efficiency Second Harmonic Generation
abstract: 200W 532nm single-mode ns-laser with 10MHz-repetition-rate was developed by second-harmonic generation of 1064nm fiber laser. 60% conversion efficiency was achieved in a single-pass scheme by increasing the effective interaction volume between light and crystal.

articleTitle: Bragg soliton dynamics on an ultra-silicon-rich nitride chip
abstract: We present recent results on Bragg solitons, gap solitons and associated phenomena on a chip. Experimental observations of Bragg soliton-effect temporal compression, fission, optical parametric Bragg amplification and gap soliton-based tunable slow light are reported.

articleTitle: Flow-through Photonic Crystal Biosilica Optofluidic Device: a Platform for Ultra-Sensitive SERS Detection
abstract: We present a flow-through optofluidic SERS device with parts-per-quadrillion (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup>) sensitivity towards fentanyl. High density silver nanoparticles on photonic crystal bio-silica and enhanced mass transfer kinetics consequent to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>× improved sensitivity and rapid sensing time.

articleTitle: Design and Characterization of High-Q Micro-Ring Resonator using X-Cut LNOI
abstract: We present the optimum fabrication/design of 200nm thick X-cut Lithium Niobate on an Insulator (LNOI) micro-ring resonator where we report Q-factors in excess of 75,000, the highest reported to date in this material system.

articleTitle: Electric Field Sampled Dual Frequency Comb Spectroscopy in Real Time Based on Ultrafast Cr:ZnS Laser Platform
abstract: We report the first demonstration of electro-optical sampling using two mutually coherent Cr:ZnS frequency combs. We recorded comb-mode resolved spectra of ammonia (8 – 12 μm) with high dynamic range and in real time.

articleTitle: Wide-angle optical beam steering using phase-change materials for tunable gratings
abstract: By incorporating the ultralow-loss phase-change materials (PCMs) into wavelength-agile gratings, the change in the refractive index due to the crystalline phase-state change of PCMs facilitates the expansion of the field-of-view (FOV) of optical beam steering (OBS), achieving a large scanning range over 64°.

articleTitle: Non-line-of-sight Full-Stokes Polarimetric Imaging with a Solution-processed Metagrating
abstract: The polarized diffraction from inexpensive, self-assembled conducting-polymer metagratings indicates nonlocal, spatially-varying birefringence. We demonstrate their application in a simple, single-shot, and low-cost non-line-of-sight full-Stokes imaging system.

articleTitle: All-Optical Purification of Arbitrary Spectral Waveforms via Cross-Phase Modulation Based Spectral Talbot Amplifier
abstract: Using cross-phase modulation based spectral Talbot amplifier, we achieve purification and in-band noise mitigation of arbitrary broadband spectral waveforms. The optical signal-to-noise-ratio is improved by 9 dB, enabling recovery of spectral waveforms hidden under noise.

articleTitle: Red Emissive Carbon Dots with a Large Stokes Shift for Color-Conversion LEDs
abstract: We present new red emissive carbon dots with 219 nm Stokes shift and 45.2% quantum yield. The photoluminescence mechanism for the large Stokes shift was proposed. Printable luminescence patterns and color-conversion LEDs were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Wavelength-Switching in Single-Mode Injection-Locked Dual-Mode DFBLD Enables Phase Shift Keying for QKD
abstract: Wavelength selective injection-locking of a 1545.59-/1548.18-nm dual-mode DFBLD with a transient-current-switched single-mode master DFBLD is performed for differential phase-shift-keying and delay-interferometric on-off-keying at 192 MHz that enables secure and complex quantum-key-distribution via alternative wavelength switching.

articleTitle: A compact silicon photonic quantum coherent receiver with deterministic phase control
abstract: We demonstrate a quantum-limited silicon photonic coherent receiver with 26.0 dB shot noise clearance, 34.6 μW knee power, and 0.00200 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> chip area. We measure squeezed vacuum with the integrated receiver and demonstrate phase-locking to the squeezed quadrature.

articleTitle: A Novel Guard Interval Approach for NFDM Transmission
abstract: A novel reduced-complexity scheme of guard interval based on cyclic extension for NFDM system with continuous spectrum is introduced, increasing the transmission reach by 300 km for 16QAM signal and 100 km for 32QAM.

articleTitle: Tunable Twyman-Green Interferometry for Motion-Free Simultaneous Thickness and Refractive Index Measurements
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel bulk motion-free tunable and actively-controlled Twyman-Green interferometer for simultaneously estimating the refractive index and thickness of transparent glass block samples.

articleTitle: Femtosecond fiber delivery for industrial applications
abstract: We report on a femtosecond fiber delivery system for industrial applications. The delivery system is coupled to a Satsuma industrial femtosecond laser with average output power of 20W and 60µJ pulse energy and polarisation control.

articleTitle: Theoretical model of nonlinear noise in the b-modulated dual polarization optical transmission systems
abstract: We derive an analytical channel model for optical communication systems employing dual-polarization nonlinear frequency division multiplexing based on b-modulation.

articleTitle: Beam Cleaning of Femtosecond Pulses in a Multimode Fiber Amplifier
abstract: We study beam cleaning of femtosecond pulses induced by gain in a Graded-Index Multimode Fiber Amplifier. Mode-resolved energy measurements show that beam cleaning results in high fundamental mode content (~ 50% of the pulse energy).

articleTitle: Ultrastrong Spin-Photon Coupling in Gadolinium Gallium Garnet
abstract: We examine ultrastrong coupling of an ensemble of paramagnetic spins in Gd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf> with terahertz photons in the presence of a high external magnetic field both in the bulk and thin-film limits.

articleTitle: Parity-Phase conjugation (PPC) and power eigenchannels in non-Hermitian fibers
abstract: By introducing the concepts of Parity-Phase conjugation and power eigenchannels, we show that perfect phase conjugation is possible in a single non-Hermitian multimode fiber, and determine the optimal initial conditions for maximum amplification.

articleTitle: The MEC-U Project at LCLS
abstract: We describe the Matter in Extreme Conditions Upgrade (MEC-U) project, co-locating kilojoule long pulse and high repetition rate petawatt lasers with LCLS in a new experimental hall at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory.

articleTitle: Super- and subradiant quantum dynamics between pairs of solid-state optical emitters
abstract: We realize photon-mediated coupling between multiple pairs of quantum dots, embedded in a nanophotonic waveguide and probe collective super- and subradiant emission dynamics. Our results are promising for quantum information processing with multiple optical emitters.

articleTitle: Multidirectional Visible Flatband Dispersion in Lieb Lattice Metasurfaces
abstract: A Lieb lattice with vertical symmetry breaking, implemented in a free-space accessible metasurface, hosts photonic flatband dispersion in multiple dimensions, opening new possibilities in imaging and optical processing.

articleTitle: Calorimetric Measurement of Morphology-dependent Resonances in Microwave-irradiated Aqueous Spheres
abstract: A calorimetric approach is used to obtain evidence for internal morphology-dependent resonances in hydrogel spheres at microwave oven frequencies, confirming a first-order magnetic dipole mode for (grape-sized) spheres with diameters of 1.35 cm.

articleTitle: Cost-benefit analysis of orbital and ground station aperture choices for satellite based QKD
abstract: Crucial to the realization of global quantum key distribution network, this work considers use of small satellites in low altitude orbits and small optical ground stations to study the impact on high rate quantum secured communication.

articleTitle: Highly non-degenerate, heralded single photon source on a PPKTP-PIC integrated system
abstract: We present a novel, highly non-degenerate, heralded visible-telecom photon-pair source using an integrated system of nonlinear waveguides and photonic circuits. Thermo-optic modulation of the telecom single-photon-state is demonstrated for deployable quantum communication/networking systems.

articleTitle: Multilayer structures enhance passive upconversion
abstract: We demonstrate the use of dielectric thin-film stacks to increase the external quantum efficiency of passive upconverting films based on Y6/rubrene for imaging in trans-mission mode.

articleTitle: Generating Programmable Coherent Supercontinuum Sources based on Electro-optic Optical Frequency Combs
abstract: We demonstrate flat-topped supercontinuum laser sources based on electro-optic optical frequency combs, which enable to cover C-, L-, and S-band. We also clarify the coherence of supercontinuum sources by implementing the phase noise measurement.

articleTitle: Probing Nanoscale Carrier Dynamics in Silicon Nanowires
abstract: We report a visible-near-infrared pump-probe nanoscopy to probe nanoscale carrier dynamics in silicon nanostructures.

articleTitle: High-harmonic generation in graphene heterostructures
abstract: Graphene has a large optical nonlinearity and supports electrically-tunable and long-lived plasmons. We present an experimental study of harmonic generation in graphene heterostructures, which enhance the nonlinearity and allow plasmons to mediate the non-linear response.

articleTitle: Control of THz Emission in Exchange-Coupled Spintronic Emitters
abstract: Optically triggered THz transient intensity can be precisely controlled by the interlayer exchange coupling between two closely spaced spin emitters. We ascribe this excellent tunability to the constructive and destructive interference of the THz signal generated by the individual spin emitters.

articleTitle: Wafer Level Fabrication of Evacuated Alkali Vapor Cells
abstract: We describe a wafer level fabrication process for evacuated Rb vapor cells. By etching channels on the wafer surface around the cell positions, we demonstrate wafers of cells with residual gas pressures below 5 mbar.

articleTitle: Curved Airy-Like Beams for Terahertz Wireless Communications
abstract: We study curved Airy-like beams for terahertz wireless communications. We show how to generate arbitrary convex trajectories using caustics. We verify with simulations and experiments that bending beams can be generated.

articleTitle: Tunable opto-electronic synthesizer at 10 GHz with ultralow phase noise
abstract: We introduce partial optical frequency division to generate 10 GHz microwaves with -147 dBc/Hz phase noise at 20 kHz offset. Electronic tuning covers the 8-12 GHz frequency range, while preserving low phase noise.

articleTitle: Highly Sensitive Concentration Sensing Using Silicon Double-Slot Waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate refractive index measurement using a double-slot silicon waveguide-based Mach-Zehnder interferometer. A maximum sensitivity of 700 nm/RIU is experimentally achieved with a limit of detection of 7.142X10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup> RIU.

articleTitle: LOS and NFT Enabled the Characterization of Various Bound State Optical Solitons
abstract: We use the linear optical sampling with ultra-high equivalent sampling rate to achieve characterization of dual, triple and quadruple bound state optical solitons. The spectral and temporal resolution are both better than conventional measurement devices.

articleTitle: Tailoring a narrow phasematching bandwidth with a resonant quantum pulse gate
abstract: The performance of the quantum pulse gate (QPG) is limited by its phase-matching bandwidth (PM-BW). We propose a resonant QPG comprised of coupled cavities, which exhibits MHz PM-BW and yields improved resolution in metrology applications.

articleTitle: Laser-pumped Rb clock for the space sector
abstract: We report the recent characterization of a Rb microwave clock based on pulsed laser pumping and detection. The laser pulses were generated by means of a mixed analog-digital controller that stabilizes the pulses amplitude and reduces the laser intensity noise (RIN). The physics package was developed by Leonardo S.p.A. using space-graded components, weighting less than 4 kg and occupying only a 4-liters volume.State-of-the-art short- and mid-term stability is obtained with this system, reaching σ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</inf>(40000s) = 5 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−16</sup> for a 200000 s run.

articleTitle: Generation of isolated-attosecond pulses driven by a post-compressed Yb laser
abstract: We introduce a new post-compression, cascaded focus and compression, to achieve 50-fold compression of millijoule-level pulses at 1030 nm from 157 fs to 3.1 fs, with an output pulse energy of 0.98 mJ and an overall efficiency of 73%. When driving high-harmonic generation, these single-cycle pulses enable the creation of a carrier-envelope-phase-dependent extreme ultraviolet continuum with energies extending up to 180 eV, providing isolated ≈ 290-attosecond pulses at the output.

articleTitle: Power cooling and low-temperature spectroscopy of ytterbium doped silica
abstract: We laser cooled ytterbium doped silica to 255 K. Temperature-dependent spectroscopy measurements reveal cooling to 150 K is possible. We also report the observation of site-selective excitation in Yb, Al co-doped silica.

articleTitle: Enabling second harmonic generation in pseudo-Landau quantized graphene through sublattice polarization
abstract: We enable second harmonic generation in pseudo-Landau quantized graphene that achieves strong strain-induced sublattice polarization. A strong temperature-dependent behavior of the observed second harmonic generation is attributed to resonant optical transitions between discrete pseudo-Landau levels.

articleTitle: Optically heralded microwave photons
abstract: Interconnecting distant superconducting quantum processors requires optical links. Here, we demonstrate a transducer that generates entangled pairs of microwave and optical photons, achieving a heralding rate of 15 Hz with two added noise photons.

articleTitle: Two-photon Interference at a Single Input Port of a Beam-Splitter
abstract: We present experimental evidence for two-photon interference (TPI) in a variation of the Hong-Ou-Mandel experiment in which photons with different polarizations enter only one of the beam-splitter input ports.

articleTitle: On-Chip Optical Power Monitoring of GaN-on-Si LEDs
abstract: The reliability of GaN-on-Si LEDs is of concern. A p–i–n photodiode loop surrounding the LED was fabricated to monitor the LED output power by detecting some of the downward emitting light propagating through the n-GaN layer. The monitoring responsivities were approximately 52 and 66 mA/W at biases of 0 and -3 V, respectively.

articleTitle: An optical polarization demultiplexing in 10-km 112-Gbaud PDM-16-QAM simplified MIMO-free coherent system
abstract: Optical polarization demultiplexing only by an opto-electric module in a 10-km 112-Gbaud-PDM-16QAM simplified MIMO-free coherent system is demonstrated, realizing up to 10-krad/s SOP three hours endless tracking with PCR>20 dB and BER<3.0 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>.

articleTitle: Engineering quantum states of light using superradiance
abstract: We present a protocol for the generation of many-photon quantum states such as NOON and Schrodinger-cat states. We rely on a novel superradiance-type phenomenon existing in ensembles of quantum emitters with degenerate ground states.

articleTitle: Physics-inspired End-to-End Deep Learning for High-Performance Optical Fiber Transmission Links
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the performance improvements obtained through End-to-End Deep Learning in noise and chromatic dispersion compensation of optical fiber transmission links when incorporating a physics-inspired activation function compared to state-of-the-art ReLU configurations.

articleTitle: Bragg Grating Based Frequency Reference Module for Operation in Quantum Technology Applications
abstract: We present the design of a novel Bragg grating based frequency reference with an expected frequency accuracy of 50MHz and a tuning range of more than 20GHz optimized for potassium-based quantum technology applications.

articleTitle: Dispersive Photonic Time Crystals: Causality-Induced Limitations and Opportunities
abstract: The unique characteristics of the temporal dimension in photonic time crystals introduce both limitations and valuable opportunities. Here, we focus on several aspects, including limits on the modulation strength and opportunities related to light absorption.

articleTitle: Identification of abnormal noise point in optical fiber link using nonlinear Fourier transform
abstract: We propose a novel sensing method to detect an abnormal noise point using the nonlinear Fourier transform. High estimation accuracy of the proposed method within 0.1 km is demonstrated by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Generation of circularly polarized THz dual pulses
