abstract: Circularly polarized THz dual pulses were generated by polarization-twisting optical dual pulses via a modified Michelson interferometer with the turnability of frequency, helicity, and time interval between two pulses.

articleTitle: Enhanced generation of μJ-level broadband terahertz pulses in BNA enabled by a hollow-core fiber compressor
abstract: We demonstrate enhanced and broadband terahertz generation in a collinearly pumped BNA organic crystal. Suitably compressed ytterbium laser pulses yield a 75% increase in conversion efficiency and a spectral coverage up to 12 THz.

articleTitle: Bidirectional transport of nanoparticles by micro capillaries with bowtie cores
abstract: A new fiber optic capillary structure for single-end-controlled nanoparticle transport was proposed by adjusting incident wavelengths. Two bowtie cores combined with the capillary allow for the confinement of light intensity inside an ultrasmall area.

articleTitle: Metasurface-Assisted Polarization Dichroic Cavities
abstract: We present our experimental demonstration of a polarization dichroic confocal cavity using a pair of vertically-mounted bi-layer dielectric metasurfaces consisting of a polarization-selective photonic-crystal mirror and a dielectric dichroic metalens.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact Forward-Biased PIN Silicon Mach-Zehnder Modulator with Thermal Tuning
abstract: A forward-biased integrated silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator with a 50μm active phase-shifter length is presented. Using thermal tuning, a 29 dB extinction ratio enables 5 Gb/s transmission speed with a modulation efficiency (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>L) of 0.019 V.cm.

articleTitle: Metagrating Design based on Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We demonstrate an algorithm based on reinforcement learning to realize high efficiency multifunctional metagrating devices without the requirement of a training dataset.

articleTitle: Opto-Thermocapillary Chemical Machining
abstract: We report Opto-Thermocapillary Chemical Machining (OTCCM) for selective etching of light-absorbing thin films. A programmable laser beam inscribes site-selective patterns on demand on thin films at extremely low etchant concentrations and power

articleTitle: Femtosecond Laser-Assisted 4D Printing of a Miniaturized Organo-Arsenic Sensor
abstract: We report the 4D printing of a miniaturized organo-arsenic sensor by femtosecond laser-assisted two-photon lithography. Fluorescence turn-on detection of organo-arsenic species was achieved at ppb levels.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Laser Inscribed Helical Long-Period Fiber Grating for Multiple-Order OAM Mode Generation
abstract: We demonstrate the inscription of helical long-period gratings (HLPGs) in a few-mode fiber using femtosecond laser. The first-, second-, and third-order orbital angular momentum (OAM) modes can be directly generated using the HLPGs.

articleTitle: Integrated, Compact, and Tunable Band-Interleaving of a Kerr Comb Source
abstract: We demonstrate band-interleaving of a Kerr comb via a wide-FSR dual-ring RAMZI filter. A sharp filter roll-off of 63.6dB/nm is measured with a total functional bandwidth >36nm with broadband crosstalk suppression ≥14dB.

articleTitle: Photonic Chern and Weyl Systems in Multilayer Structures via Dimensional Extension
abstract: We explore topological physics and boundary states of Chern and Weyl systems experimentally using one-dimensional photonic multilayer structures endowed with additional artificial dimensions.

articleTitle: Photonic integrated circuit with multiple waveguide layers for broadband high-efficient 3-D OPA
abstract: We demonstrated a 3-D optical phased array device, based on multi-layer Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> stacks. The multi-waveguide-layer configuration allows utilizing edge couplers at both the input and the emitting ends to achieve broadband high efficiency.

articleTitle: High-speed Optical Sampling with an Optically Injected Mode-locked Laser Diode
abstract: We demonstrate a novel method for high-speed optical sampling by cavity tuning (OSCAT), with an optically injected mode-locked quantum-dot laser. We achieved the highest reported scan rate (20MHz), with acquisition times of tens of nanoseconds.

articleTitle: Soliton glasses in Fabry-Perot resonators
abstract: We study novel soliton glass frequency combs to a modified Lugiato-Lefever Equation (LLE) that include cross-phase modulation within a Fabry-Perot resonator. Soliton glasses are characterized by stable, spatially locked, phase-locked, and randomly spaced soliton pulses.

articleTitle: Artificial synthesis of non-Abelian lattice gauge fields in the photonic synthetic frequency dimension
abstract: Non-Abelian gauge fields enable a wide variety of nontrivial topological physics. We develop a scheme to create arbitrary SU(2) lattice gauge fields for photons in the synthetic frequency dimension using an array of modulated resonators.

articleTitle: Status of the ZEUS laser user facility
abstract: The Zettawatt Equivalent Ultrashort pulse laser System (ZEUS) is a 3-Petawatt user facility funded by the National Science Foundation and is due to be commissioned in late 2023. The facility will explore high-field science and applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Thermo-Optic Tuning in Low-Loss Silicon Nitride Photonic Integrated Circuits
abstract: We modify a recently developed low-loss silicon nitride foundry platform using high-thermooptic-coefficient cladding materials. The large cladding modal overlap enables a measured five-fold improvement in the thermo-optic tuning efficiency.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously Integrated InGaAs DFB Laser on Tantalum Pentoxide
abstract: We present a heterogeneously integrated distributed feedback (DFB) diode laser with tantalum pentoxide waveguide on a silicon substrate, with a maximum output power of 5 mW per facet at 1020 nm wavelength and a side mode suppression ratio of 22 dB.

articleTitle: A Calibration-Free Water-Cut Laser Sensor
abstract: A laser sensor is developed for calibration-free water-cut sensing in oil-water flow. The sensor is based on three DFB lasers emitting near 1.4 µm. TDLAS and a novel algorithm were employed to enable calibration-free measurements.

articleTitle: Non-Hermitian Chirality and Topological Properties of Graphene-loaded Photonic Crystals
abstract: Using the symmetry control of graphene-loaded non-Hermitian photonic crystals, we demonstrate non-Hermitian chirality of polarization conversion originating from exceptional points. Theoretical and experimental results clarify momentum-space dynamics of non-Hermitian chirality and topological properties.

articleTitle: Micro-Raman Spectroscopy Identification of Hydroxyapatite in Dental Pulp Stem Cells
abstract: Cell differentiation using calcium phosphate nanoparticles was studied. The hydroxyapatite was internalized in human dental pulp stem cells and characterized by Raman spectroscopy. Raman spectra showed the hydroxyapatite distribution in nanoparticles nodules in the cells.

articleTitle: Optically 3D µ-printed directional-emission WGM microlasers for on-chip integrated sensing
abstract: An optical 3D micro-printing method is presented to directly print polymer whispering-gallery mode (WGM) microlaser with deformed microcavity. It can rapidly and precisely tailor the geometry of optical WMG microcavities for on-chip integrated sensing applications.

articleTitle: Non-classical correlation between mode-entangled pairs of surface plasmon polaritons
abstract: We observe non-classical correlations between single photons outcoupled from surface plasmon modes carrying a superposition of angular momenta. The spatial distribution of the correlation indicates entanglement of surface plasmon pairs in the mode basis.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Image Enhancement for Nonlinear Optical Microscopy with Scarce Samples
abstract: We present an unsupervised model without any assumptions to enhance images in nonlinear optical microscopy. It only takes 30 training images and can be generalized to unseen samples. Qualitative and quantitative results show significant improvement.

articleTitle: Temporal Shaping of Light at the Nanoscale with Photonic Funnels
abstract: Photonic funnels have been demonstrated as a flexible platform to confine light to deep subwavelength spatial areas. Here we consider the utility of this platform to provide temporal, as well as spatial, light shaping.

articleTitle: Distribution of Time-Bin Entangled Photons through a 7.7 km Hollow-Core Fiber
abstract: We distribute entangled time-bin qubits, separated by 200 picoseconds, through a low-latency 7.7 km hollow-core fiber. Due to dispersion, these time bins cannot be resolved when sent through commercial silica fiber of the same length.

articleTitle: Carbon Quantum Initiator Enabled Two-photon Polymerization of Optically Active Functional Microstructures
abstract: Carbon quantum dots have been implemented as two-photon initiators, and rapid prototyping of optically active micro/nanostructures has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: All-optical digital processing in Carbon Disulfide liquid-core optical fiber
abstract: We implement ultrafast, power-efficient, all-optical logic gates based on a liquid-core optical fiber platform. We present, theoretically and experimentally, the unique nonlinear interactions driving each logic operation, implemented using only standard telecom components.

articleTitle: Ultralow-noise 22-GHz microwave generation from a fiber delayline-stabilized silica micro-comb
abstract: We demonstrate a compact fiber delayline-locked 22-GHz silica microcomb. The generated 22-GHz microwave signal has phase noise of –110 dBc/Hz at 1 kHz offset frequency and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-13</sup>-level frequency instability within 1-s.

articleTitle: Deterministic device integration of separate quantum dots for scalable on-chip photonics quantum circuits
abstract: We report on a prototype quantum photonic integrated circuit consisting of two quantum dots deterministically integrated into nanobeam cavities at the input ports of a 2×2 multimode interference beam-splitter featuring high single-photon purity and indistinguishability.

articleTitle: Versatile power-efficient octave-spanning soliton crystals with high conversion in a Si3N4 microresonator
abstract: We demonstrate various octave-spanning soliton crystals in a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microresonator. The conversion efficiency can reach above 50% and the repetition rate (f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rep</inf>) can be tuned from 6 to 8 THz.

articleTitle: All-optical Nonlinear Activator for Optical Neural Network with Low Threshold Power and Ultrafast Response Speed
abstract: We proposed a novel all-optical nonlinear activator based on the hybrid integration of graphene and silicon/metallic double slot structure, which exhibits low threshold power and ultrafast response speed.

articleTitle: Photon-counting detection of microwave signals via coherent transduction enabled by Rydberg atoms
abstract: We present a room-temperature atomic system used as a microwave-to-optical transducer operating in the single-photon regime. Coherence of the phase-matched conversion and photon-counting detection of microwave blackbody radiation are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generating MeV Electrons using Radially Polarized Modes
abstract: Relativistic electron beams exceeding 1 MeV are generated by direct laser acceleration in a low-density gas using radial polarization. A clear dependence on ionization dynamics is revealed by varying the laser intensity and gas species.

articleTitle: Low-loss SiN 2×2 MMI 50/50 Couplers for Monolithically Integrated Silicon Photonics
abstract: We report two low-loss SiN 2×2 MMI 50/50 couplers for monolithically integrated silicon photonics. Both couplers achieve measured ILs of 0.07 dB at 1310 nm and below 0.25 dB over the O-band.

articleTitle: Impedance Peaking in Silicon Traveling Wave Mach-Zehnder Modulators
abstract: We experimentally study silicon photonic traveling-wave modulators with different on-chip terminating resistors for impedance peaking. A 63.5 GHz bandwidth is achieved for a single-segment silicon modulator.

articleTitle: Passive mode-locking without a saturable absorber using a coupled microresonator
abstract: Mode-locking usually requires saturable absorption or active modulation to trigger and build short pulses. We show through calculations that self-starting mode-locking may be achieved simply by coupling active and passive microresonators without a saturable absorber.

articleTitle: Topological defects and textures of photonic spin
abstract: We introduce a type of point defects in electromagnetic waves: topological spin defect, and provide examples of them. Such defect points have nontrivial topological spin textures surrounding them therefore have quantized topological charges.

articleTitle: Maximizing the Signal in Nonlinear Beam-Deflection
abstract: We calculate how the Beam-Deflection signal for determining nonlinear refraction is maximized at a specific spatial displacement between probe and excitation beams while varying their spot size ratio.

articleTitle: Back-Propagation-Free Photonic Deep Learning with Random Nonlinear Projection
abstract: We demonstrate back-propagation-free photonic deep learning by extending a biologically inspired training called direct feedback alignment. The potential for accelerated computation with competitive performance was confirmed through numerical simulation and optoelectric hardware implementation.

articleTitle: All-optical, reconfigurable mode switcher integrated in multicore fibers with a counter-propagating configuration
abstract: We present an all-optical mode switcher in multicore fibers driven by an intense backward control beam and demonstrate the reconfigurable mode conversion in an in-house fabricated dual core fiber.

articleTitle: Low Reflection Loss Dispersion Compensation Scheme for Broadly Tunable sub-ps Solid State Lasers
abstract: Combination of high (R>99.9%) reflection from an ion-beam sputtered ultrabroadband chirped mirror and Fresnel reflection from a wedged fused silica substrate forming a Gires-Tournois interferometer provides a wavelength independent, adjustable dispersion compensation for broadly tunable sub-ps lasers such as Ti:sapphire.

articleTitle: Rapid Thermal Annealing of InAlGaAs/GaAs Quantum Dot Lasers for Sub-900 nm Emission
abstract: Molecular beam epitaxy-grown InAlGaAs/GaAs quantum dot lasers were grown, fabricated, and characterized for sub-900 emission. Rapid thermal annealing improves the optoelectronic properties of the lasers, leading to small reverse-leakage current and low threshold current density.

articleTitle: Cryogenic optical spectroscopy of color-centers in Si for quantum information processing
abstract: We study environmental effects and ensemble behavior of the silicon T-center and 0.56 meV-split doublet luminescence center at 1313 nm by cryogenic photoluminescence spectroscopy for quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Tunable multicolor X-rays from free-electron-driven van der Waals heterostructures
abstract: We experimentally show that van der Waals heterostructures are a versatile platform for bespoke, multicolor, compact X-ray sources whose spectra can be tailored via atomic design.

articleTitle: Universal quantum computing with anharmonic photonic cavities and free-electron ancillas
abstract: We propose and analyze a new paradigm for optical quantum computation using anharmonic photonic cavity qubits and free-electron ancillas. Our approach enables deterministic, high-fidelity quantum gates and preparation of cluster states between remote cavities.

articleTitle: Electro-Optic Cavities for Quantum Transducers
abstract: We explore resonant cavity electro-optic transduction systems, where the electromagnetic field of a small mode volume, high dielectric microwave resonator interacts with a Fabry-Pérot optical cavity filled with LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> to interconvert microwave and optical photons.

articleTitle: Compact Low-loss S-bends Designed by CMA-ES
abstract: Based on a design method by CMA-ES, we experimentally demonstrated an ultra-compact S-bend with an insertion loss of 0.011 dB, which is the lowest value in the footprint range smaller than around 30 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: 2D THz Measurement of Magnon-Phonon Coupling in Multiferroic BiFeO3
abstract: With 2D THz spectroscopy we directly measure magnon-phonon coupling in multiferroic BiFeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. Using theoretical modeling, we are able to decipher different types of coupling that appear in 2D spectral features.

articleTitle: Pillar-Based High-Yield Heterogeneous Integration of Lithium Niobate and Gallium Phosphide Thin Films
abstract: Several established photonic platforms lack a nonzero Pockels and nonlinear coefficient. We developed a micro-transfer printing method to heterogeneously integrate thin-film lithium niobate and gallium phosphide with an experimentally shown transfer yield of near-unity.

articleTitle: Optomechanical microgear cavity
abstract: We propose a ring-like optomechanical cavity using a single-etch phononic mirror. Radiation-limited Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">opt(mech)</inf> are both over 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> for a 4.5 GHz mechanical mode. Optomechanical coupling deviates around 15% from the ideal floating ring.

articleTitle: Incorporation of As to InP Quantum Dot Material for Near-Infrared Semiconductor Laser Diode
abstract: We demonstrate the effect of arsenic composition percentage on inhomogeneous broadening, lasing wavelength and room temperature threshold current density. Lasing wavelength peak shows a red shift whereas inhomogeneous broadening became wider as As composition increased.

articleTitle: Precision Optical Weed Removal Evaluation with Laser
abstract: We propose a novel optical weed removal evaluation method using laser. The Cascade RCNN deep learning method achieves 95% of localization accuracy and 80% of classification accuracy for the effectiveness of optical weed removal.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Polarization Rotation-Based Spectral Peaking Mode Filtering from Molecular Gas Absorption Spectra in Femtosecond Lasers
abstract: We proposed mode-filtering technique of spectral peaks using nonlinear polarization rotation in optical fiber. Intense, narrow multiple spectral peaks with ~20 dB background ratio were successfully generated with CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> gas cell and nonlinear fiber.

articleTitle: Optothermal Manipulation at Fluid Interfaces
abstract: Optothermal manipulation of particles at fluid interfaces was studied with a film of gold nanoparticles assembled at aqueous/oil interfaces. The unique optothermal behaviors of particles and fluid interfaces under optical heating were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Benchmarking Machine Learning-Derived W State Witnesses on NISQ Hardware
abstract: We find that our W state witnesses derived with a Support Vector Machine have comparable noise tolerance while requiring fewer measurements than the fidelity method; this result is physically verified on an IBM Quantum Processor.

articleTitle: Accelerated Brillouin Frequency Shift Estimation Algorithm
abstract: We propose an efficient Brillouin frequency shift (BFS) estimation algorithm assisted by ternary search (TS), experimentally demonstrating a 4.39-fold estimation accuracy improvement over TS-BOTDA and 70% scanned frequency number reduction over conventional BOTDA.

articleTitle: In Situ Characterization of Photo-induced Ion Migration in Hybrid Perovskites
abstract: We characterize photo-induced ion migration in hybrid perovskites using in situ laser illumination inside an SEM. We observed long-range migration of halide ions and elucidated the transport pathways of various ions.

articleTitle: Large scale Si3N4 Integrated Circuit for High-resolution Interferometric imaging
abstract: We design, fabricate and characterize a 4-layer 110mm×44mm Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> PIC with long routing waveguides and arrayed waveguides gratings based on a wafer-scale integration process for a high-resolution interferometric imager with 1200nm~1600nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Wide-field multipass spectral-scanning 3D imaging LiDAR using an echelle grating
abstract: We employ an echelle grating and a multipass configuration to achieve wide-field beam-steering in spectral-scanning LiDAR system within a narrow tuning bandwidth. FOV of 8 ° × 17.3 ° and mm-level depth resolution are achieved.

articleTitle: Impact ionization and intervalley scattering induced by intense few-cycle THz pulses in undoped InSb thin films
abstract: We study the interaction of intense THz pulses with undoped (100) InSb thin film at room temperature using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy. We explain the changes in THz transmission as a balance between absorption bleaching and impact ionization.

articleTitle: Optical Beam Steering and Stabilisation for High Altitude Platforms
abstract: We present the proof-of-concept pointing, acquisition and tracking system designed for steering and stabilising an optical beam from a high altitude platform to an optical ground station. We demonstrate the performance on a rotating platform.

articleTitle: Deterministic Access of High-Power, Normal-GVD Kerr-Comb States
abstract: We demonstrate a deterministic and repeatable pathway to access single and multi-free-spectral range states with normal-GVD Kerr combs. A key component to stabilizing the high-power comb states is implementation of a drop port on the auxiliary resonator.

articleTitle: Frequency-angular resolving LiDAR using chip-scale acousto-optic beam steering
abstract: We report a new beam steering technique and the LiDAR system it enables, based on acousto-optic beam steering (AOBS) integrated on a chip to scatter light from a planar waveguide into free space.

articleTitle: Magnetic Anapole In An All-Graphene Metasurface
abstract: An all-graphene anapole metasurface with a gap surface plasmon structure has been proposed. In the long-wavelength infrared region, the dominant electric dipole scattering can be suppressed, along with the destructive interference of magnetic and magnetic toroidal dipole.

articleTitle: Conservative Solitons and Reversibility in Time-Delayed models for Optical Micro-Cavities
abstract: We discuss the existence of reversible conservative time-delayed systems in a dispersive microcavity with a Kerr medium coupled to an external mirror. At low energies, the equivalence with the nonlinear Schrödinger equation is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Learning-based Analysis of Speckle Patterns for Distributed Optical Fiber Sensing
abstract: We achieve distributed sensing by classifying the speckle patterns from a multimode fiber into the load positions along the fiber. Our method, named Learning-based Analysis of Speckle Patterns (L-ASP), exhibits the results for 8 distributed locations in 5 m fibers with 75% accuracy.

articleTitle: Raman Wavelength Conversions in Ionic Liquids
abstract: We explore the use of room-temperature ionic liquids as Raman wavelength converters.

articleTitle: Shot-Noise-Limited Near-Ultraviolet Dual-Comb Spectroscopy
abstract: Dual-comb spectroscopy is implemented in light-starved conditions at optical powers of a few tens of picowatts. Quantum-limited sensitivity is demonstrated for comb-line-resolved spectra of Doppler-broadened transitions in the ultraviolet 770-THz region.

articleTitle: Continuous-Variable Nonclassicality Detection under Coarse-Grained Measurement
abstract: We experimentally detect the nonclassicality of continuous-variable quantum states under coarse-grained measurement. Furthermore, we show that the coarse-grained measurement generally outperforms the ideal fine-grained measurement in nonclassicality detection.

articleTitle: Optimizing the enhancement of nonlinear effects with spectrally periodic solitons
abstract: We study the enhancement of the nonlinear effects through linear dispersion engineering. The amplitudes of the J frequency components follow a simple relation, from which we can derive that the enhancement factor increases as 0.687J.

articleTitle: Nonlocality detection in photonic triangle networks
abstract: We implement triangle causal structures in photonics platforms and detect different forms of nonlocality. In particular, we focused on the Genuine Multipartite Non-locality and on the nonlocality exhibited in a network without freedom of choice.

articleTitle: Compton Scattering Driven by Quantum Light
abstract: We solve the non-perturbative interaction of free electrons with arbitrary intense quantum electromagnetic fields and exemplify it by predicting extended spectra in Compton scattering driven by non-classical photon statistics.

articleTitle: UV photonic integrated circuits for robust quantitative phase imaging
abstract: Photonic integrated circuits have been demonstrated to benefit super-resolved fluorescence microscopy. Here, we propose a UV PIC-based quantitative phase imaging based on Kramers-Kronig relationships, achieving robust and high-resolution phase image retrieval in a low-cost and compact way.

articleTitle: Analysis of Non-Saturable Absorption for Optimization of L-Band EDF Performance
abstract: Non-saturable absorption is revisited to characterize L-band EDFs, co-doped with either Yttrium or Ytterbium as de-clustering agents. Measurements in the C-band allow to evaluate erbium pair content that correlates with measured and simulated amplifier performance.

articleTitle: Gallium Oxide as Photonic Integrated Platforms in the UV–Visible Spectra
abstract: We report the Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> as photonic integrated platforms and its nonlinear optical effects in the UV–visible spectra. A low propagation loss of 3.7 dB/cm and second-order susceptibility of χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>=4.89×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> pm/V were obtained.

articleTitle: Self-injection Locked Microcombs in Photonic Crystal Microresonators
abstract: Self-injection locking to a photonic crystal ring-microresonator with tailored back-reflection is demonstrated for the first time. The chip-integrated system does not rely on random imperfection-based backscattering and permits deterministic and robust generation of single-soliton microcombs.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal Electron Microscopy of Phonon Polaritons in MoO3
abstract: We present the first observation of phonon-polaritons in a planar-anisotropic 2D material using ultrafast transmission electron microscopy, revealing their spatiotemporal dynamics.

articleTitle: Reshaping a simple lattice into nontrivial topological phase by Floquet on-site drives
abstract: We demonstrate an on-site driving protocol to reshape a simple photonic lattice into Floquet topological phase. Our approach can be extended to endow topological properties to a host of materials trivial in the static regime.

articleTitle: Circular Dichroism Induced by Spin Momentum Locking Detected in Optical Rectification
abstract: With an inversion-symmetric structure, circular dichroism is detected in optical rectification. The effect is attributed to symmetry breaking and extrinsic chirality arising from the spin-momentum locking between surface plasmon polariton and the circularly polarized light.

articleTitle: Accurate Measurement and Assignment of High Rotational Energy Levels of the 3ν3 ← ν3 Band of Methane
abstract: We use optical-optical double-resonance spectroscopy with a high-power continuous wave pump and a cavity-enhanced comb probe to expand sub-Doppler measurements of the 3ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>←ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> band of CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> to higher rotational levels. We assign the final states using combination differences, i.e., by reaching the same state using different pump/probe combinations.

articleTitle: Spectral Analysis of Surface-adsorbed Chemical Absorption in an On-chip Mid-IR Microresonator
abstract: We spectrally analyze the optical loss coming from surface-adsorbed chemicals in a midIR microresonator. Hydrocarbon and hydroxyl absorption proportional to surface E-field intensity dominate the Q-factor over the 3-4 μm wavelength.

articleTitle: Carrier Injection Micro-ring Modulator with a High Drop Signal ON-OFF Ratio Fabricated in AIM Photonics Technology
abstract: A carrier injection micro-ring modulator with a high drop signal ON-OFF ratio of 19 dB and a large wavelength modulation of 2.5nm at 1.1V is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Burst Consecutive Errors Suppression with Precoding for MLSE Based 201-Gb/s IM-DD Transmission Systems
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate that the precoding can break consecutive errors from MLSE in a 201-Gb/s PAM-8 IM-DD system. We find the maximum length of burst consecutive errors is reduced from 16 to 2.

articleTitle: Overcoming the Rate-Loss Limit without Global Phase Tracking
abstract: We achieve a finite-size key rate of 42.64bps over 508km fibers, breaking the fundamental rate-loss limit of point-point quantum key distribution (QKD), via implementing an innovative measurement-device-independent QKD through asynchronous coincidence pairing.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocal convective flow induced by plasmonic nanostructures
abstract: Nonreciprocal manipulation of thermal convection flow is achieved using plasmonic dual-layered asymmetric nanostructures with asymmetric heat transfer paths.

articleTitle: Extreme Metaphotonics with Ultra High-Index Topological Insulators
abstract: We experimentally measure the complex dielectric constant of Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> topological insulators, revealing record high refractive index values peaking at n≈11. We further demonstrate deep-subwavelength metasurfaces with unit cell sizes smaller than λ/10, that simultaneously support large magnetic and electric field enhancements.

articleTitle: Low Repetition Rate Mode-Locked Laser on a Commercial Foundry Low-Index Photonic Platform
abstract: We demonstrate a heterogeneously integrated III-V-on-silicon-nitride mode-locked laser with 710 MHz repetition rate. A versatile two-step micro-transfer printing approach is employed to enable low-loss integration on a commercial foundry low-index photonic platform.

articleTitle: Discovery of a Graphene Sibling: The Photonic Topological Quadratic-Node Semimetal
abstract: We report the experimental discovery of the topological quadratic-node semimetal in a photonic microring lattice with a robust second-order nodal point at the Brillouin zone center and two Dirac points at the Brillouin zone boundary.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Nonlocal Metasurfaces Using Augmented Partial Factorization
abstract: Topology optimization of nonlocal metasurfaces requires the objective-function gradient considering all angles of interest. We generalize the recent "augmented partial factorization" method to compute such gradient efficiently and inverse design a broad-angle metasurface beam splitter.

articleTitle: Generalized Conditional Displacement
abstract: We present a generalization of the conditional displacement operator, conditioned on a qudit ancilla, and discuss possible implementations. This generalization provides a building block for quantum computation with grid states, allowing efficient error correction protocols.

articleTitle: Black-box optimization in quantum information protocols
abstract: We used a black-box approach in quantum information protocols. This allows us to optimize an engineering protocol compensating for experimental imperfections and to optimize the nonclassicality of an unknown system reinforcing the device-independent paradigm.

articleTitle: Design of an on-chip Vanadium Dioxide driven Plasmonic Modulator Based on Hybrid Orthogonal Junctions on Silicon-on-Insulator
abstract: We present a plasmonic modulator using a hybrid orthogonal coupling geometry with vanadium dioxide as the modulation material on a silicon-on-insulator platform. The presented device is compact with a nanoscale modulating area and takes advantage of the first order insulator to metal transition of vanadium dioxide to achieve a high modulation depth of 46.89dB/μm. The device has applications in integrated high speed communications systems which require a high modulation depth as well as small device sizes.

articleTitle: Coherent EUV - Soft X-ray Light with Continuous Red and Blue Wavelength Tunability
abstract: We demonstrate bright, narrow-bandwidth, well-spaced (5 eV), high-order harmonics, continuously tunable towards higher and lower EUV – X-ray photon energies (>120 eV), ideal for resonant, ultrafast, coherent diffractive imaging at the absorption edges of ferromagnetic materials.

articleTitle: Vector-vortex beams with spatio-temporal couplings
abstract: Vector-vortex beams with space-time couplings will be discussed along with their interesting and useful properties for light-matter interaction.

articleTitle: Spontaneous Parametric Down-Conversion Beaming from a Lithium Niobate Nanostructured Resonator
abstract: We report the design and fabrication of lithium niobate nanostructured resonators for directional beaming of spontaneous parametric down-conversion. Preliminary measurements achieved photon-pair production rates up to 300 Hz/W at telecom wavelengths.

articleTitle: Tunable single photons from an artificial atom in silicon photonics
abstract: We characterize coherence of single photons emitted from a G center in a silicon waveguide. We present progress towards lifetime-limited and frequency-tunable single photon emission via electrical tuning.

articleTitle: Tunable Fiber Source of Entangled Ultraviolet and Infrared Photons
abstract: We report a novel tunable biphoton source, with one photon in the ultraviolet and its entangled partner in the infrared spectral range, based on four-wave mixing in a xenon-filled single-ring fiber.

articleTitle: Progress of High-speed VCSELs and VCSEL-based Co-Packaging for Short Reach Communications
abstract: This paper covers the recent developments of high speed, ≥ 100Gb/s, VCSELs and VCSEL-based transceivers that are designed for co-packaging on a first level package with ASICs, such as CPUs, GPUs, and data center switches.

articleTitle: A Quantum Photonic Chip for Binary Classification
abstract: On the silicon photonic chip, we apply Mach Zehnder Interferometer (MZI) and optical network to manipulate the phase difference and amplitude distribution of the input light. The two or three-dimensional input data is encoded in the light amplitude distribution and the genetic algorithm is applied to update the angle parameters of the MZIs to improve the classification result.

articleTitle: Two-frequency pulse compounds in waveguides with single zero-dispersion and zero-nonlinearity points
abstract: We study propagation dynamics of incoherently coupled two-frequency pulse compounds in waveguides with single zero-dispersion and zero-nonlinearity points. We demonstrate nonlinear-photonics meta-atoms and molecule-like bound-states of pulses that persist in presence of the Raman effect.

articleTitle: Structured synthetic chiral light with topological properties for robust and highly sensitive chiral discrimination
abstract: Combining tailored multicolor beams we create light that displays chirality in the dipole approximation with spatially-varying handedness, leading to efficient, robust and highly sensitive chiro-optical responses with topological properties in chiral molecules.

articleTitle: Cross-talk analysis in chalcogenide triangular lattice fibers with three sublattices for high-resolution mid-infrared image transport
abstract: We propose triangular lattice fibers ( TLFs) with three sublattices made of chalcogenide glasses and reveal the core diameters and the core separation of the TLFs by numerical simulation of cross-talk for high-resolution mid-infrared image transport.

articleTitle: Topologically Protected Entangled Biphoton States in High-order Topological Insulators
abstract: We demonstrate different structures of high-order topological insulators supporting topologically protected biphoton states and theoretically explained that the photon pairs generated from the four-wave mixing (FWM) process are continuous frequency entangled.

articleTitle: Optical nanotweezing with exotic light: from plasmons to supercavity modes [Invited]
abstract: We report the next generation optical nanotweezer approaches employing plasmonic cavities and optical anapole states for the high throughput trapping and dynamic manipulation of nanoscale objects and biomolecules with single particle resolution.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength InP lasers selectively grown on SOI
abstract: We report sub-wavelength InP lasers selectively grown on (001) silicon-on-insulator (SOI) wafers. Detailed characterizations were performed to study the effect of different laser cavities. The sub-wavelength laser features a low lasing threshold of 120 μJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and a spontaneous emission factor of around 0.7.

articleTitle: Blind Dynamic Residual Skew Estimation Algorithm in Digital Multiband Coherent System
abstract: We propose a power efficient tracking algorithm for residual skew between in-phase and quadrature phase tributaries in a complex modulated signal at the optical coherent receiver in a digital multiband system.

articleTitle: Observing interaction-induced topological doublon states
abstract: We present the first observation of propagating topologically protected doublon states in an anomalous Floquet driven 1D array. Using dimensional mapping, the two interacting particles in 1D were observed in 2D laser-written waveguide lattices.

articleTitle: Regression Approach for the Reconstruction of Orbital Angular Momentum States
abstract: We addressed the problem of decoding the information stored in Orbital Angular Momentum endowed beams with a machine-learning approach, extracting the coefficients of arbitrary superpositions via the combined use of dimensional reduction and regression algorithms.

articleTitle: Photostabilization of Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons via Hexagonal Boron Nitride: A Platform For Long-Lived Single-Photon Sources
abstract: Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons are popular quantum emitters but suffer photonic instability such as photobleaching. Substrates composed of hexagonal Boron Nitride offer an exciting solution to this problem, observed via cryogenic and room-temperature fluorescence spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Low-altitude Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Detection and Localization based on Distributed Acoustic Sensing
abstract: We demonstrate a low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle detection method based on distributed acoustic sensing, in which the localization estimation is achieved assisted with time difference of arrival algorithm in the field test.

articleTitle: Energy scaling of the single-cycle pulse generation based on DC-OPA
abstract: Based on the dual-chirped optical parametric amplification scheme, a 61 mJ, over one-octave bandwidth, 10 Hz, carrier-to-envelope phase (CEP) stable laser pulses centered at 2.3 μm is achieved by employing BiB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> crystals and MgO:LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> crystals. After compression, the output pulse duration is down to 8.7 fs (1.1 cycles @ 2.3 μm), which results in a peak power of 7 TW.

articleTitle: Hypothermal optothermal tweezers for versatile manipulation of colloids in native solutions
abstract: Present optothermal tweezers suffer from thermal damage and are limited to only thermophilic objects. We developed hypothermal optothermal tweezers that simultaneously reduce thermal damage and enhance the thermophilicity of different objects in diverse solutions.

articleTitle: Broadband longwave-IR dual-comb spectroscopy at video rate with 240,000 comb-mode resolved data points
abstract: We report fast (0.1-12 s per spectrum) acquisition of molecular spectra using dual frequency-comb spectroscopy with a pair of broadband (6.6-11.4μm) combs produced via intra-pulse difference frequency generation using sub-three-cycle 2.4-μm pulses as a pump.

articleTitle: Fully Integrated High-resolution Speckle Spectrometer Using Linear Coherent Network of Random Resonators
abstract: A monolithic spectrometer is formed by a compact linear coherent network of random resonators. The spectrometer is integrated with on-chip photodetector for direct signal readout and has 40-pm spectral resolution and 8-nm working bandwidth.

articleTitle: A High-Resolution Photonic Integrated High Q Microresonator Based Accelerometer
abstract: We demonstrated a packaged optomechanical accelerometer with resolution of 850ng. The resonance of a 4 million Q Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microring resonator is modulated by the stress in springs of a released milligram proof mass upon acceleration.

articleTitle: Multifunction Photonic Integrated Circuit Chip for Photon-Pair Generation and Manipulation
abstract: A highly integrated photonic circuit comprising two type-0 spontaneous parametric down-converters and two electro-optic modulators for manipulating the generated photon pairs is developed. Demonstrated results show its great application potential for photonic quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Moderate-Refractive-Index Mie Resonators for Versatile Modulation of Two-Dimensional Excitons
abstract: By coupling well-designed moderate-refractive-index Mie resonators to monolayer semiconductors, we have demonstrated efficient modulation of two-dimensional excitons in multiple dimensions: far-field excitonic radiation patterns, intrinsic excitonic quantum dynamics, and bosonic exciton-polariton emission lines.

articleTitle: Low-noise meta-mirrors in optical cavities - current status and prospects
abstract: The precision of many applications in high-precision metrology involving optical cavities is limited by the Brownian thermal noise of mirror coatings. Meta-mirrors are promising to overcome current noise limitations. In this contribution, we demonstrate a meta-etalon combining a meta-mirror with a conventional multilayer mirror to enhance the maximum reflectivity of the meta-mirror while maintaining low thermal noise. By this, we achieve a cavity finesse of 11.500, more than a factor of 10 larger than the maximum achieved with standalone meta-mirrors.

articleTitle: An Investigation of a Colloidal Quantum Dot Based Color Conversion Layer with Fine Pixel and High Efficiency
abstract: We demonstrated a semiconductor process based procedure to fabricate a high resolution colloidal quantum dot array. The color conversion efficiency can be as high as 17.9% and further enhanced 1.64 times by an additional DBR mirror. The vacuum storage time is projected to be 3523 hours.

articleTitle: Precision Frequency Comb Spectroscopy in the 8 μm Range
abstract: We use Fourier transform spectroscopy based on a compact difference frequency generation comb source emitting around 8 μm to record broadband high-resolution spectra of molecules relevant to astrophysics and environmental monitoring. From the spectra we obtain line lists with sub-MHz accuracy, an order of magnitude better than previously available, and use them to refine theoretical models of these molecules. Here we report results for formaldehyde, for which the 8 μm range is missing in HITRAN.

articleTitle: Hardware Realization of Nonlinear Activation Functions for NN-based Optical Equalizers
abstract: To reduce the complexity of the hardware implementation of neural network-based optical channel equalizers, we demonstrate that the performance of the biLSTM equalizer with approximated activation functions is close to that of the original model.

articleTitle: Integrated lithium niobate microwave photonics for high-speed analog signal processing
abstract: We report an on-chip lithium niobate microwave signal processing system that could perform temporal integration and differentiation operations for high-speed analog signals up to 92 GSa/s, enabling applications including photonic-assisted edge-feature detection of images.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Nonlinear Propagation of Incoherent Laser Pulses
abstract: The nonlinear propagation of incoherent pulses is studied using a normalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation. The range of coherence times for mitigation of intensity modulations in the plane-wave regime and mitigation of spatial self-focusing is identified.

articleTitle: Prediction of Optical Scattering from Plasmonic Nanostructures using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: Deep Learning is used for predicting scattered fields from arbitrarily-shaped individual plasmonic nanoparticles using the multipole expansion

articleTitle: A Fiber-cavity Quantum Memory with an Integrated Photon Source
abstract: We propose a fiber quantum memory with an integrated spontaneous four-wave mixing photon pair source. We demonstrate retrieval of signal photons with non-classical statistics.

articleTitle: Non-Hermitian Band Structure of Photonic Temporal Crystals
abstract: We experimentally confirm the non-Hermitian band structures of a photonic temporal crystal in the microwave. These non-Hermitian band structures are shown to be two measurable distinct subsets of complex eigenfrequency surfaces defined in complex momentum space.

articleTitle: Artificial-Intelligence Empowered Universal Metrology Optical Camera
abstract: We introduce a metrology platform that employs artificial intelligence in hardware through optical metasurfaces. We experimentally demonstrate the measurement of thin film thickness and refractive index maps with nanometer accuracy using this platform.

articleTitle: Highly efficient blue and green VCSELs with AlInN/GaN bottom DBRs
abstract: We report milliwatt-class nitride blue and green VCSELs with hybrid DBR structure. The wall-plug efficiency of 18.5% and 3.7% were achieved for the blue and green VCSELs, respectively. Highly reliable operation was also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Programmable All-Optical Talbot Amplifier Using XPM-Based Discrete Multilevel Time-Lens
abstract: We propose a programmable XPM-based Talbot amplifier where the gain factor is optically reconfigurable. The general equations of phase modulation and dispersion allow us to achieve different gain factors with a fixed dispersive medium.

articleTitle: Microwave Time Quasicrystals
abstract: We experimentally observe the discrete time-quasicrystalline phase in microwave temporal crystals. In addition, it was confirmed that the microwave time quasicrystal is robust against spatial defects to a certain degree.

articleTitle: ‘Sawfish’ Spin-Photon Interface for Near-Unity Emitter-to-Waveguide Coupling
abstract: Interfacing spin-active solid-state quantum emitters or memories with photons remains a challenging task due to photon losses. We propose and demonstrate the ‘Sawfish’ photonic crystal cavity to eliminate photon losses at spin-photon interfaces.

articleTitle: Reversible Tuning of Nanowire Quantum Dot to Cesium D1 line
abstract: We report local reversible tuning of nanowire quantum dot emission to cesium D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> line (~ 894.6 nm) and demonstrate slow light and resonant absorption of single photons in hot cesium vapor.

articleTitle: 5G NR Fiber-Wireless Systems with Dual-Polarization Scheme and Single-Carrier Optical Modulation
abstract: A 5G NR fiber-wireless system with dual-polarization scheme and single-carrier optical modulation is successfully constructed. It is a potential one for 5G NR communication towards MMW and sub-THz band with high and flexible transmission capacity.

articleTitle: Wavelength-to-Angle Conversion of Optical Frequency Comb for Dual-Comb Spectroscopy of Angular-Interrogation Surface Plasmon Resonance
abstract: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) is used for refractive-index sensing and biosensing due to high sensitivity. We proposed the wavelength-to-angle conversion optical comb to enhance the sensing performance of angular-interrogation SPR by combing with dual-comb spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Quantum Emission from Spin Defects in Hexagonal Boron Nitride with a Plasmonic Nanocavity
abstract: We report a 250-fold photoluminescence enhancement of ${{\text{V}}_{{{\text{B}}^ - }}}$ spin-defects in hBN by coupling them to nanopatch antennas (NPA). Considering the relative size of the NPAs and laser-spot, an actual enhancement of 1695 times is determined.

articleTitle: Towards kHz optical linewidth, millisecond spin coherence erbium telecom qubits in epitaxial thin films
abstract: Erbium telecom qubits in C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3i</inf> centrosymmetric site in epitaxial yttrium oxide thin films are coupled to optical and microwave resonators, demonstrating millisecond spin coherence and kHz optical linewidths approaching the radiative limit.

articleTitle: Generation of Multiple Obstruction-Free Channels for Free Space Optical Communication
abstract: Plasma filaments generated by ultrafast beams with orbital angular momentum can simultaneously clear two cylindrical transmission channels, within which an annular beam can propagate free of obstructions.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonic Sigmoid Activation Function at 10 Gbaud/s for Photonic Neural Networks
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an optoelectronic assembly of a monolithic SOA/UTC-PD chip interconnected to a TIA and realizing a 10 Gbaud/s photonic sigmoid activation function with adjustable steepness slope.

articleTitle: Integrated Plasmonics
abstract: Plasmonic is an alternative to photonics. It’s effects are increasingly employed to build ultrafast devices. In this tutorial talk we will review progress on modulators, detectors and sensors with bandwidths in excess of 500 GHz.

articleTitle: Stimulated Brillouin-like Optomechanics with Surface Acoustic Wave Cavities
abstract: Stimulated Brillouin-like optomechanical coupling to Gaussian surface acoustic wave (SAW) cavity modes with record-low losses, is predicted and observed, enabling contact-free optical control of SAW cavities for a wide range of frequencies and material platforms.

articleTitle: Aluminum Nitride Nanophotonic Phased Array on an 8-inch Silicon Wafer
abstract: A nanophotonic phased array is demonstrated on aluminum nitride photonics platform developed on an 8-inch silicon wafer. A beam spot at 1550 nm is clearly observed. Total power loss of 11.4 dB is also reported.

articleTitle: Permanent Trimming of Large-Scale Photonic Circuits with a Focused Silicon Ion Beam
abstract: We present a novel approach for scalable, permanent trimming of silicon nitride ring resonators with Si ion implantation. Using this approach, we tune ring resonators in a low-loss photonic crossbar array for matrix-vector multiplications.

articleTitle: Enhanced Band Filling Effect and Broadband Multi-wavelength Lasing in Plasmonic Nanocavities
abstract: We demonstrate size-confinement enhanced band filling effect to tune bandgap with low pump energy of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> fJ/meV and large bandgap tunability of 263 meV. Broadband multi-wavelength lasing covering communication band is realized using plasmonic nanocavities.

articleTitle: Fractal superconducting nanowire single-photon detector at 1540 nm with 91% system detection efficiency
abstract: We demonstrate a fiber-coupled f ractal s uperconducting n anowire single-photon detector working in dual bands, with 91% system detection efficiency (SDE) at the wavelength of 1540 nm and with 61% SDE at 520 nm.

articleTitle: Self-Cleaning Effect in Synthetic-Space Photonic Topological Insulators
abstract: We present a topological structure performing a self-cleaning effect in synthetic space, controlled by a homogeneous gain medium in real space, producing a ground-state in both synthetic space and real space.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Modulation of Polarization in Spintronic THz Emitters Enhanced by Field Induced Spin Reorientation Transition
abstract: We demonstrate an efficient and simple modulation of the polarization in Spin-tronic Terahertz Emitters, by rapid switching of the magnetization using high-frequency magnetic field, enhanced by field induced Spin Reorientation Transition (SRT). The instability of the magnetic layer at the transition allows for a higher sensitivity of the magne-tization and an efficient switching at lower power of the polarization at frequencies up to 100kHz.

articleTitle: Multimode Strong Coupling of Thermal Radiation for Graphene/hBN Atomic System
abstract: We demonstrate the Graphene/hBN atomic system to manipulate strong coupling of thermal radiation between plasmons and phonons, which explores quantitative understanding of energy exchange, mode evolution and coupling strength in three hybridized branches.

articleTitle: Directional Control of Thermal Emission Across Both Polarizations With Mu-Near-Zero Metamaterials
abstract: Conventional strategies for enabling directional thermal emission only control p polarization emissivity which limits directional control to half the available thermal radiance. Here we show that mu-near-zero metamaterials enable directional thermal emission across both polarizations.

articleTitle: Modelocked InGaSb-MIXSEL at 2.04 µm
abstract: We present the first modelocked, backside-cooled InGaSb-MIXSEL operating at 2035 nm, producing fundamentally modelocked pulses of 1.5 ps with average output power up to 27 mW at 3.9 GHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Broadband Heterogeneous Silicon-Nitride Photonics
abstract: We present some recent results related to extending the wavelength range of heterogeneous silicon nitride photonic platform by integrating indium-phosphide and gallium-arsenide based active components in a wafer scale process.

articleTitle: Time-Domain Travelling-Wave Analysis of Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers based on Chirped Quantum Dot Materials
abstract: We numerically study a tapered chirped Quantum Dot Semiconductor Optical Amplifier operating in the 1100 nm-1350 nm wavelength range, showing good agreement with experiments in terms of pulse amplification in both the single- and double-pass setups.

articleTitle: Processing single-photons from a quantum dot using high-speed integrated photonic circuits on the thin film lithium-niobate-on-insulator platform
abstract: We develop high-speed and low-loss lithium-niobate-on-insulator circuits and interface them with a quantum-dot-based deterministic single-photon source. We demonstrate key functionalities required for general-purpose quantum computing, including active photon routing and multimode quantum interference [1].

articleTitle: Wavelength-tunable GHz harmonic mode-locked fiber laser by an over-coupled long period fiber grating based saturable absorber
abstract: We demonstrated a harmonic mode-locked fiber laser by using saturable absorber based on interaction of over-coupled long period fiber grating and carbon nanotubes. Maximum repetition rate of 5.38 GHz was obtained with 24.15 mW output. Wavelength tuning range of 8 nm is also realized by modifying the saturable absorber operation temperature.

articleTitle: A Programmable Single-Qubit Quantum Gate
abstract: We present a design for an integrated single-qubit quantum gate based on the third order nonlinear process of difference frequency generation. A theoretical model is presented for the transformation of the qubit with device-external parameters.

articleTitle: Ultra-Stable Optical Substrates for High-Average-Power Applications
abstract: Sub-aperture tests and modeling of a "flow-cell" substrate demonstrated <30-s stabilization time. At full-aperture, 2.6-W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> absorbed power density, COMSOL predicts >160× improvement in average-power handling and 150× reduction in warmup time versus passively cooled silica.

articleTitle: Vortex soliton microcombs
abstract: We correlate the dimensions of frequency and orbital angular momentum (OAM) by forming soliton microcombs in an integrated microresonator vortex emitter. One-to-one correspondence between the OAM and frequency is confirmed on 14 distinct comb lines.

articleTitle: Doubly-resonant metal-free aluminum nitride electro-optic modulator
abstract: Here we use the near field of a dielectric resonant antenna to modulate an on-chip aluminum nitride ring resonator. Using this device we demonstrate entirely metal-free electro-optic modulation at 15.1 GHz.

articleTitle: Coherent Spin Control of a Tin Vacancy Center in Diamond
abstract: We demonstrate coherent spin physics of a single tin vacancy center (SnV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>) in diamond pillars including coherent population trapping and Rabi oscillations. This work constitutes progress towards scalable quantum networks using SnV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup> centers.

articleTitle: Fano resonant, bi-directional colorimetric sensor with spectral line-shape control for sensitive chromatic response
abstract: We present a bi-directional Fano resonator, which is capable of spectral shape control by adjusting the continuum state. By addressing the reflection phase, we demonstrate sensitive-chromatic response for color control with viral-particle sensing ability (SARS-COV-2).

articleTitle: Misalignment-free, Kerr-lens-modelocked Yb:Y2O3 2.2-GHz Oscillator, Amplified by a Semiconductor Optical Amplifier
abstract: We present a fully bonded misalignment-free single-diode-pumped Yb:ceramic laser producing 190-fs pulses at 2.2 GHz. Chirped-pulse amplification in a semiconductor optical amplifier yielded an average power of 69 mW and pulse energies of 32 pJ.

articleTitle: Room-Temperature Optically Detected Magnetic Resonance of GaN Defect Single-Photon Emitters
abstract: We report the first observation of optically detected magnetic resonance in defect-based single-photon emitters in GaN.

articleTitle: Design of a Spatially Distributed Trans-Oceanic Link with Reduced Number of Repeaters
abstract: We analytically, numerically and experimentally demonstrate a novel optimization method for number of repeaters in trans-oceanic links by distributing the data capacity in spatial channels showing as much as 33% reduction in number of amplifiers.

articleTitle: Observation of bound-state pulse mode-locked by all-PM NPR in the all anomalous dispersion regime
abstract: For the first time in the soliton regime, we demonstrated a bound-state pulse generated in an Erbium-doped mode-locked fiber ring laser based on all polarization-maintaining nonlinear polarization rotation.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable microresonators created by touching straight and bent optical fibers
abstract: We demonstrate a new type of reconfigurable high Q-factor optical whispering gallery mode microresonators created along the submillimeter coupling length of coplanar straight and bent optical fibers touching each other.

articleTitle: High-order vector modes activated intra-mode forward stimulated Brillouin scattering in few-mode fibers
abstract: The intra-mode forward stimulated Brillouin scattering activated by an interplay between high-order vector optical modes and transverse acoustic waves in few-mode fibers is theoretically and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Deep Unsupervised Learning for Biomedical Image Translation from Harmonic Generation Microscopy Image to H&E-stained Image
abstract: This work proposes an unsupervised deep learning-based image translation from Harmonic generation microscopy (HGM) to widely used H&E-stained images. The proposed methodology is promising and hopefully will facilitate adopting HGM in clinical workflows.

articleTitle: Near-Field Mapping of THz Polaritons Propagation in Quantum Materials
abstract: Near-field imaging is applied to investigate the terahertz collective excitations of thin films of topological insulators and black phosphorus. The experimentally observed THz polaritons support tunable and strongly confined electromagnetic modes with intriguing application perspectives.

articleTitle: Suspended Triangular Waveguides and Serrated Photonic Crystal Nanobeam Cavities
abstract: Development of integrated nanophotonic cavities in optically active materials will enable efficient, small footprint optoelectronic devices. In this work, we show how to achieve a nanobeam cavity with Quality-factor(Q)~ 20,000,000 through apodization.

articleTitle: Quantum Enhanced Probes of Spontaneous Time-Reversal Symmetry Breaking
abstract: We describe a theoretical framework and initial experimental evidence for quantumenhanced magneto-optical microscopies capable of probing spontaneous time-reversal symmetry breaking in topological materials with $10\,{\text{nrad}}/\sqrt {{\text{Hz}}} $ sensitivity at temperatures down to 83 mK.

articleTitle: Integration of Phase Change Material with Commercial 45nm Monolithic Silicon Photonics
abstract: State-of-the-art commercial silicon photonics can be transformed by adding non-volatile optical reconfigurability, which can be enabled using phase change materials (PCM). We present the first-ever integration of PCM with a commercial-foundry 45nm monolithic silicon photonic process.

articleTitle: High-throughput testing of the nanophotonic devices
abstract: The proposed Resonance Scattering Spectroscopy (RSS) technique is fully automated, non-invasive, and high throughput wafer scale characterization system. In the RSS technique, a laser broadband light source of fixed polarisation is tightly focused on the device under test. Light with a wavelength matching that of the device’s resonance wavelength is scattered into the orthogonal polarisation giving a signal that is characteristic of the resonator which can be rapidly acquired. Using this prototype, several Photonic Crystal L3 cavities have been studied and we achieved a Q-factor of the order of tens of thousands for an optimised L3 cavity, which compares well with the design and simulation results.

articleTitle: Ground-based Sounding of Hydrogen Fluoride (HF) as a Proxy for Stratospheric Methane (CH4)
abstract: Full atmospheric column measurements of methane (CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) are complicated by concentration decreases above the tropopause due to CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> reaction with F atoms. We offer a practical method for using HF as a CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> surrogate.

articleTitle: Neural network-based virtual staining of defocused autofluorescence images of label-free tissue
abstract: We present a virtual staining framework to rapidly stain defocused autofluorescence images of label-free tissue. This technique saves image acquisition time by lowering the autofocusing precision of a microscope without sacrificing the virtual staining quality.

articleTitle: Attoclocked Many-Body Correlations in Quantum Materials
abstract: Theory–experiment advancements are demonstrated to resolve many-body correlations of quantum materials at attosecond time scales. Our theoretical analysis provides an exact view into the microscopic many-body dynamics presented intuitively via a Wigner-function analysis.

articleTitle: All-optical Leaky-Integrate-and-Fire Neuron Based Cascaded Microrings with Power-tunable Auxiliary Light
abstract: We demonstrated an all-optical Leaky-Integrate-and-Fire neuron based cascaded microrings with power-tunable auxiliary light. The compact LIF neuron enables flexibly realizing synaptic weighting operation due to synaptic plasticity of a single microring, and generating layer-individual spikes.

articleTitle: Cascaded Adiabatic Frequency Conversion in Coupled Lithium Niobate Microring Resonators
abstract: We propose and analyze cascaded electrooptical adiabatic frequency conversion in coupled thin-film lithium niobate rings. We use time-domain coupled-mode theory to optimize the conversion process and examine the convergence of its efficiency.

articleTitle: High Energy, 10 Hz Repetition Rate, Petawatt Laser for the Matter in Extreme Conditions Upgrade
abstract: The design and status of the diode-pumped 10 Hz, 150 J, 150 fs, 1 PW laser system under development for the Matter in Extreme Conditions Upgrade (MEC-U) project will be presented.

articleTitle: Modelling Nonlinear Propagation of Periodic Waveforms in Optical Fibre with a Neural Network
abstract: We deploy a neural network to predict the spectro-temporal evolution of a periodic waveform upon nonlinear fibre propagation and demonstrate efficient probing of the input-parameter space for on-demand comb generation or significant spectral/temporal focusing occurrence.

articleTitle: Manipulation of Entangled Photon Pairs in Sandwich Valley Photonic Crystals
abstract: We propose a sandwich valley photonic crystal implementing the generation and topological transport of continuous frequency entangled biphotons. These extended valley kink states propagating in the sandwich domain show more tolerance for disorders.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Wideband Dual Electro-Optic Comb Spectroscopy Enabled by Tunable Optical Source
abstract: A high-resolution dual electro-optic comb spectroscopy working in quasi-integer-ratio mode is proposed. By stepwise tuning the light source wavelength, a spectral measurement with 120-kHz resolution and 24-GHz bandwidth is demonstrated in 1.25 ms.

articleTitle: Observation of the thermal Rashba effect: custom polarization sorting in thermal emission
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate symmetry-driven metasurfaces thermally emitting to custom orthogonal polarization states, generalizing the phenomenon of spin-split dispersion to arbitrary polarizations.

articleTitle: Generating Knotted and Linked Gaussian Dots from Bessel-Beams
abstract: We have generated linked, frequency doubled Bessel-type vector beams with a spatial polarization, that are knotted as they oscillate along the optical axis, when propagating in the laboratory environment.

articleTitle: Ion-based high-order harmonic generation for 1.6-keV X-ray driven by wavelength 405 nm pulse
abstract: A scheme for ion-based HHG of 1.6-keV X-ray based on the transverse selective-zoning method of quasi-phase-matching was proposed. The calculated conversion efficiency reached about 14% of the perfect phase-matching condition.

articleTitle: Dual Wavelength DFB Laser Array Based on Four Phase Shifted Sampled Bragg Gratings for THz Generation
abstract: Based on four-phase shifted sampled Bragg gratings, a stable dual-wavelength DFB laser array is reported with frequency separations of 240 GHz, 320 GHz, 640 GHz, 800 GHz, and 1000 GHz.

articleTitle: Evaluation of a compact butterfly-style photonic-electronic neural chip on complicated deep learning tasks
abstract: We deploy a compact butterfly-style photonic-electronic neural chip on ResNet-20 and achieve > 85% measured accuracy on the CIFAR-10 dataset with only 3-bit weight programming resolutions, showing its practicality in implementing complicated deep learning tasks.

articleTitle: Terahertz Beamsteering with Curved Metasurfaces
abstract: We experimentally and numerically analyze the minimal change in beam direction of a terahertz metasurface as a function of radius of curvature. The metasurface is fabricated via hotstamping and has applications in wireless communications.

articleTitle: Ge-implantation-enhanced defect-state absorption in C-band silicon waveguide photodiode monitors
abstract: We demonstrate Ge-implantation-enhanced defect-state absorption in the C-band in a 225-μm-long silicon waveguide photodiode, with a responsivity of ~54.8 mA/W/mm and a 1 nA dark current upon -3 V bias after a 10-minute 350°C annealing.

articleTitle: Optical Transport of a Metallic Particle using an All-fiber Airy-like Beam Generator
abstract: A Gaussian beam was transformed into an Airy-like beam in an all-fiber platform by a vertically aligned cylindrical lens. Furthermore, we experimentally demonstrated this beam could optically transport the metallic particle in an aqueous environment.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Wavefront Characterization of a High-Energy Focusing Beam Using a Phase-Diversity Grating
abstract: A single-shot wavefront characterization scheme using a 2-D holographic grating was demonstrated on the OMEGA laser. A phase-retrieval algorithm using multiple defocused spots cropped from a single frame returns a unique wavefront solution.

articleTitle: Complete Optical Pulse Metrology by Phase-Preserving Nonlinear Autocorrelation
abstract: We present a novel nonlinear interferometric autocorrelation technique with unbalanced intensity, which preserves spectral phase information in the autocorrelation signal and enables the complete characterization of ultrafast optical fields without requiring any spectrally resolved measurements.

articleTitle: Stimulated Generation of Indistinguishable Single Photons from a Quantum Ladder System
abstract: Single photons play a key role for applications in photonic quantum technologies. Here we propose, model and demonstrate a scheme that enables the generation of high purity indistinguishable single photons from a quantum ladder system.

articleTitle: Nanoantenna Electro-Optical-Transducer Utilizing Monolayer WSe2
abstract: We realize a nanoscale electro-optical transducer by combining single plasmonic antennas with monolayer WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. We demonstrate light detection and emission from a single device and discuss different excitation strategies for the emission.

articleTitle: Single-ended Distributed Vibration Sensing Using Forward Polarization Detection of CW Light Based on (1+8) Multi-core Fiber
abstract: A single-ended distributed vibration sensing system based on 3km 1+8 MCF is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The vibration is located by calculating the time delay between the two cores by cross-correlation algorithm.

articleTitle: Entangling X-rays through high harmonic down conversion
abstract: We present a method to produce entangled photon pairs in the extreme ultraviolet (EUV) and X-ray regime, using a new highly nonperturbative nonlinear optical process which we term "high harmonic down conversion" (HHDC).

articleTitle: Deterministic single-photon generation by strong coupling of slow free electrons and an optical cavity
abstract: We show that single photons can be deterministically generated by slow free-electrons experiencing large quantum recoil. The free-electron–photon interaction can then be described by an effective Jaynes-Cummings model in a strong coupling regime.

articleTitle: High-sensitivity characterization of relative timing jitter in a bidirectional dual-comb fiber laser
abstract: The relative timing jitter of a high-coherence bidirectional dual-comb fiber laser was evaluated to be 100 fs (1-kHz to 10-MHz) with a measurement limit of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> fs<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Hz using phase measurements of carrier-envelope-offsets and optical beat-notes.

articleTitle: Periodic Shadowing for Improved Temporal Resolution in Streak Cameras
abstract: Streak cameras are central to measurements across the sciences. By spatially modulating the entrance slit, we show a more than 20% increase in temporal resolution opening up for sub-picosecond measurements with standard streak camera systems.

articleTitle: Squeezed light generation and analysis using a sub-threshold optical parametric oscillator on integrated thin-film lithium niobate photonic circuit
abstract: We present our recent effort towards building an integrated photonic circuitry on thin-film lithium niobate platform for squeezed state of light generation from an optical parametric oscillator.

articleTitle: Experimental Phase Retrieval of Matter Waves
abstract: We present algorithmic reconstruction of the phase imprinted on the wavefunction of 2D Bose gas from experimental in-situ and time-of-flight measurements of atom density, without interferometry.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Photonic Crystal Nanolaser with sub-µA Threshold Current
abstract: We demonstrate a photonic crystal laser exhibiting an ultra-low threshold of 732 nA. This is the lowest room-temperature value reported for any laser. Furthermore, the measured bandwidth shows that the laser facilitates low-energy on-chip links.

articleTitle: Single GaAs Nanowires for Near-Infrared Spontaneous Parametric Down-Conversion
abstract: We report 60 GHz/Wm photon pair generation via type-0 spontaneous parametric down-conversion at 1550 nm from individual free-standing GaAs nanowires with sub-450 nm diameter and lengths up to 5 μm.

articleTitle: Resonant Spectroscopy of Blue Quantum Emitters in Hexagonal Boron Nitride
abstract: A site-specific fabrication technique was used to produce arrays of blue quantum emitters in hBN for a cryogenic spectroscopy study. We characterise temperature dependent linewidth, identify processes that limit emitter coherence, and observe Rabi oscillations.

articleTitle: Dispersion engineering with coupled microresonators for extended soliton microcomb control
abstract: We investigate coupled-resonator dispersion engineering capabilities for con-trolling the shape of the soliton microcomb in real time.

articleTitle: Complementary Raman and IR spectroscopies for Rapid Diagnosis of Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome
abstract: Aqueous lipid solutions were analyzed by mid-IR and Raman spectroscopies to establish a diagnosis approach for neonatal respiratory distress syndrome. We show the ability to predict lipid ratios around the diagnostic cutoff of 2.2.

articleTitle: Single-shot Measurement of Optical Frequency Comb Synthesizing Ultrafast Arbitrary Waveforms using Novel Technique of Frequency Domain Optical Correlation
abstract: A novel frequency-domain optical correlation system is proposed for ultrafast arbitrary optical waveform analysis. Single-shot waveforms with a time resolution of 4 ps were experimentally observed.

articleTitle: Overcoming the Imaging Limits of High-Energy Particle Detection via Nanophotonic Inverse-Design
abstract: We present inverse-designed multilayer nanophotonic scintillators with optimal efficiency, directionality, and point-spread function, for applications in x-ray imaging.

articleTitle: Pushing the Limits of Photonics in the Visible Spectrum
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-low loss (down to 3.62 dB/m) SiN platform for visible wavelengths where ultra-high Q (up to 2.07 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>) microresonators probe the limits of absorption and scattering losses.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Optoelectronic Filter-Array for Intelligent Glare Reduction
abstract: We integrate two-dimensional transparent photodetectors with liquid crystal modulators to form a nonlinear filter-array, allowing self-amplitude-modulation of light at low-intensity levels (<100 mW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). We fabricated 10,000 devices over 1 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to demonstrate glare reduction.

articleTitle: Optical Phase Noise and Polarization Fluctuation Measurement with Delay Interferometer
abstract: In this paper, we report experimental results that a delay interferometer can measure the signal light's optical phase noise and polarization fluctuation in the single-mode fibers with reasonable accuracy.

articleTitle: Topological Polarization Singularities for Full Polarization Control of High-Q Modes
abstract: We present a design paradigm based on topological charge splitting for creating nearly-degenerate, high-quality factor (Q) states with arbitrary polarization states in all-dielectric metasurfaces.

articleTitle: Towards an Alignment-Free, Impedance-Matched Cavity Quantum Memory in a Thulium-Doped Crystal
abstract: Here, we discuss our experimental efforts toward building an alignment-free, long-lived, and efficient cavity-enhanced quantum m emory in a thulium-doped crystal. A significant step forward for creating efficient quantum memories with long optical storage times.
