articleTitle: Super-Resolution Imaging Using Optical Two-Dimensional Metacrystals
abstract: Structured illumination microscopy using optical two-dimensional metacrystals that leverage efficient coupling between the far-field and hyperbolic modes on sub-wavelength nanoridges is demonstrated. The super-resolution enhancement matches analytic models.

articleTitle: Passive frequency-conversion imaging from the near-infrared to the visible
abstract: We demonstrate a passive frequency-conversion imaging system that converts near-infrared images into visible images, enabling near-infrared imaging with the naked eye or a conventional visible camera.

articleTitle: Degradation Processes and Aging in Quantum Dot Lasers on Silicon
abstract: We discuss the physical processes for the degradation of quantum-dot lasers epitaxially grown on silicon. Through combined electro-optical measurements and deep-level transient spectroscopy, we conclude a pathway to obtain significant improvement in device lifetime.

articleTitle: Dual-Level Silicon Grating Coupler with a Record -0.8 dB Coupling Efficiency
abstract: We report the design, fabrication and experimental characterization of a dual-level grating coupler for a 220 nm thick silicon photonics platform with a record coupling efficiency of -0.8 dB without the use of any back-reflector.

articleTitle: Navigation-grade resonant-fiber optic gyroscope with a broadband source
abstract: We report a broadband source-driven resonant-fiber optic gyroscope with 0.0029°/h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> angle random walk and 0.0063°/h bias stability when using a 100-meter-long fiber-optic ring resonator of 7.6 cm diameter.

articleTitle: Tunable Sub-megahertz Optical Feature in a Resonator-free Twisted Gain Medium (Invited)
abstract: We use the interplay between polarization-dependent gain and frequency-dependent polarization eigenmodes of a twisted (elliptically-birefringent) medium and demonstrate a tunable sub-megahertz optical feature at room temperature without resonators or loss.

articleTitle: Vertically Stacked Passive Silicon Photonic Chiplet by µ-Transfer Printing
abstract: We device double-layer stacked silicon photonic MMIs by µ-Transfer Printing. A 900×100-µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-size chiplet consisting of a 220/60-nm-thick silicon core/slab structure is transferred twice onto thermal- and TEOS-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> under-cladding layers.

articleTitle: Quantum Multiparameter Estimation Model of Cascaded Phases in Optical Fiber
abstract: We present a new architecture for quantum-enhanced multiparameter estimation, where measured phases are cascaded along a single optical fiber. Embedded reflectors separate these phases, enabling novel fiber-based quantum distributed sensing of temperature and strain.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal Dynamics in a Limaçon-shaped Microlaser
abstract: We experimentally investigate the lasing dynamics in a Limaçon-shaped microcavity that has chaotic ray dynamics. The laser emission intensity fluctuations reveal multiple spatio-temporal processes of distinct origins, each featuring different spatial and temporal scales.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Large-Aperture, Multi-kW Gas-Cooled Faraday Rotator
abstract: We demonstrate a large-aperture gas-cooled Faraday rotator designed to mitigate stress-induced depolarization in high-energy, high-power laser systems. Compensating for a surrogate depolarization plate at 3.3 kW, the rotator reduces the relative depolarized energy from 36% to 1%.

articleTitle: ASE Noise Source-based BPSK Terrestrial Free-space Optical LPI Communication with Adaptive Optics
abstract: In this paper we are presenting results from our one-mile-long free-space optical LPI communication link at University of Arizona for an ASE noise source based 5 Gb/s BPSK signal. We are reporting improvements in the BERs from using the adaptive optics to compensate for wavefront distortions in medium atmospheric turbulence.

articleTitle: High-Frequency Dissipative Optomechanics
abstract: We demonstrate dissipative optomechanical transduction and backaction in coupled nanobeams. Compared to previous demonstrations, our system corresponds to a hundredfold increase in mechanical frequency and displays a record-high dissipative optomechanical coupling.

articleTitle: Rapid and robust quantum logic gates using inertial STIRAP
abstract: We present an inertial protocol for STIRAP-based single- and two-qubit quantum logic gates. Our protocol achieves an order-of-magnitude lower infidelity compared to existing protocols. A similar approach can be used to improve any adiabatic protocol.

articleTitle: Temperature Dependent Photoionization of the Nitrogen–Vacancy Diamond Singlet State Manifold
abstract: By applying wavelength-tuned spin-selective photoionization, the energies of the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>E and $^1{A_1}$ nitrogen – vacancy (NV) singlet states relative to the diamond band gap edges are determined as a function of temperature.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet Dual-comb Spectroscopy Utilizing Intra-cavity High Harmonic Generation
abstract: We demonstrate ultraviolet dual-comb spectroscopy utilizing intra-cavity high-harmonic generation from femtosecond enhancement cavities. The approach paves the way for vacuum ultraviolet to extreme ultraviolet dual-comb spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Towards Electrically-Pumped AlGaN UV-A Lasers with Transparent Tunnel Junctions
abstract: Molecular beam epitaxy-grown GaN/AlGaN-based active regions were optimized by varying quantum-well widths to yield increased photoluminescence intensity at UV-A wavelengths. The optimized gain medium was then used in electrically-pumped laser structures with transparent tunnel junctions.

articleTitle: Toward Optical Authentication with Laser-induced Periodic Surface Structures on Metals
abstract: By constructing structurally colorized images on metals with femtosecond laser-induced periodic structures (fs-LIPSSs), we demonstrate the color variations of fs-LIPSSs with a broad angular range of illumination incidence can be used for optical authentication.

articleTitle: Role of Order and Layers on the Polarimetric Response of Self-assembled, Metaphotonic Films
abstract: The polarized diffraction from conducting-polymer nanofibrous hollow spheres is varied with film doping, layering, and multiple scales of order (fiber, grain, and crystal). We characterize the metaphotonic response of varied structures for future information-processing applications.

articleTitle: Single-mode Distributed Feedback Lasers for 85Rb Two-Photon Quantum Technology Systems
abstract: Distributed feedback lasers at 778.1 nm wavelength demonstrate 48 mW output, 20.5° vertical divergence, –150 dBc/Hz intensity noise, and 3.67 kHz Lorentzian linewidth. Such devices successfully resolved the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">85</sup>Rb two-photon hyperfine levels in free-running conditions.

articleTitle: Analytical Models for QoT Estimations in Super-C and Super-C + L Bands Optical Transmission Systems
abstract: We propose a novel physical model-based QoT estimation with achieved OSNR estimation error ≤ 1.5 dB in primary paths and OSNR prediction error ≤ 1.76 dB in unestablished lightpaths for both super-C bands and super-C+L bands for the first time.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal sampling of near-petahertz vortex fields
abstract: We describe the emergence of macroscopic currents in photoconductive field sampling and implemented spatio-temporal sampling of near-petahertz fields, enabling full vectorial field characterization of light beams with orbital angular momentum.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic Resonator Design for On-chip Quantum Memories
abstract: We present nanophotonic designs for on-chip Er:Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> quantum memories with high coupling efficiency between waveguide mode and erbium ensembles, allowing AFC efficiencies up to 75 % under current material, setup and fabrication limitations.

articleTitle: Wigner distribution of partially coherent light generated by optical vortices
abstract: We developed analytical expressions for the Wigner distribution function of partially coherent fields generated by the scattering of structured beams. Specific properties identified for different types of optical vortices can guide their use in communications in turbulent media.

articleTitle: Interferometric measurements of the focal velocity and effective pulse duration of an ultrafast ‘flying focus’
abstract: An ultrabroadband ‘flying focus’ laser pulse was produced using an axiparabola and radially-stepped echelons. The focal velocities and effective temporal pulse durations were directly measured using spectral interferometry.

articleTitle: Chip-based Auxiliary Interferometer to Compensate Optical Coherence Tomography Phase Errors
abstract: A 8890-μm delayed Mach-Zehnder-based auxiliary interferometer on the silicon-on-insulator platform demonstrates 22-μm axial resolution through the zero-crossing resampling. We believe that this is the first time to illustrate the SS-OCT through a chip-based auxiliary interferometer.

articleTitle: Barium Titanate Electro-Optic Modulators for Silicon Photonics Grown by Off-Axis Sputtering
abstract: Barium titanate thin films with have been epitaxially integrated on silicon-on-insulator wafers. They exhibit excellent structural quality with effective Pockels coefficient >180 pm/V and intrinsic propagation loss <2 dB/cm. Hybrid waveguide modulators based on this material exhibit Vπ-length of 0.42 V-cm.

articleTitle: Realization of bound states in the continuum in anti-PT-symmetric optical systems: a proposal and analysis
abstract: We propose a parallel-cascaded-resonator system where bound states in the continuum and anti-PT symmetry can be achieved simultaneously under the condition of the phase shift between the adjacent resonators being an integer multiple of π.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Femtosecond Time-bin Photon Echo from Quantum Dot Ensemble using Frequency Up-conversion Technique
abstract: We have succeeded in femtosecond time-bin pulses storage/retrieval by a photon echo method with a quantum dot ensemble. Moreover, we have developed an up-conversion single-photon detector and evaluated the ultraweak femtosecond time-bin echo signal.

articleTitle: Simple and High-Speed Fiber–Terahertz–Fiber Bridge System in 355-GHz Band using Photonics-Enabled Receiver
abstract: We demonstrate a simple fiber–terahertz–fiber system in the 355-GHz band using a stable optical frequency comb generation and photonics-enabled receiver. We successfully transmitted a 16-QAM OFDM signal with a line rate of 60 Gb/s over the system.

articleTitle: Improved Terahertz Output from Layered Organic Crystal Structures
abstract: We have improved the THz output and damage threshold of yellow organic THz generation crystals by fusing them to sapphire and using liquid crystals as index matching fluid to reduce reflective losses.

articleTitle: Space-Time Modulated Metasurfaces for Steering of Frequency-Shifted Beams
abstract: We demonstrate steering of frequency-shifted beams at telecom wavelengths using ITO-based metasurfaces. Driving wavefronts up to 10 MHz are superimposed with spatial phase gradients to control the spectrum and propagation direction of the scattered light.

articleTitle: Cavity-Enhanced Dual-Comb Spectroscopy in the Fingerprint Region with Quantum Cascade Lasers
abstract: A quantum cascade frequency comb operating near 9.5 μm (1050 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) is coupled to a high finesse optical cavity. We demonstrate cavity-enhanced spectroscopy of methanol vapor via dual-comb detection of the cavity transmission.

articleTitle: Massively degenerate coherent perfect absorption in flatband meta-optics
abstract: The flatband dispersion of particular guided-mode resonance on silicon meta-optics can provide consistent coherent perfect absorption in the degenerate momentum space. This optics can provide perfect absorption regardless of the input spatial mode.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible high energy passively Q-switched laser
abstract: We demonstrate CMOS-compatible, integrated, high energy Q-switched lasers in the eye-safe window (1.9 µm), with an on-chip output pulse energy of 80 nanojoules at a repetition rate of <1 MHz with single fundamental mode operation in a compact footprint.

articleTitle: Frequency agile photonic integrated external cavity laser
abstract: We demonstrate a Vernier ring laser with linear frequency tuning of 1.5 GHz at 100 kHz chirp rate and wavelength switching with 7 ns rise time and 75 nW power consumption using Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> photonic chip with integrated PZT actuators.

articleTitle: Photoacoustic gas sensing employing an improved radial resonator
abstract: We present a novel configuration for photoacoustic gas sensing demonstrating QEPAS state-of-the-art sensitivity, while allowing coupling with possibly divergent or multipoint sources. This configuration was simulated and characterised experimentally.

articleTitle: Picosecond optical-to-x-ray (Cd,Mg)Te radiation detectors
abstract: We developed a dual optical/x-ray ultrafast photodetector based on in-house grown Cd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.97</inf> Mg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.03</inf>Te single crystals. The detector is characterized by ~200 ps full-width-at-half-maximum, readout-electronics limited photoresponse, <5 nA dark current, and 22-mA/W responsivity.

articleTitle: Carrier Conversion from 100-GHz THz Wave to Dual-Wavelength Optical Carrier Injection-Locked to Optical Comb Modes Using Electro-Optical Polymer Modulator for Photonic THz Detection
abstract: Photonic THz detection is a key in next-generation wireless communication (6G) to go beyond the upper frequency limit of existing wireless electronics. We present THz-to-optical carrier conversion, enabling photonic THz detection of 6G wireless carrier.

articleTitle: Low-Noise Frequency Synthesis Based on Microcomb at a Few Gigahertz
abstract: We present soliton microcombs generation for low-noise optical frequency synthesis at a few gigahertz. The microcomb source is based on a monolithic fiber Fabry-Perot (FFP) resonator directly pumped by a distributed feedback (DFB) laser.

articleTitle: Stimulated generation of platicon frequency microcombs and their nonlinear dynamical evolution
abstract: We generate a square platicon with a 17 ps pulse width and 21% pump-to-comb conversion efficiency in the normal dispersion regime. A 2 ps platicon pulse width can be accessed with auxiliary-laser-assisted thermal stabilization.

articleTitle: Soliton Microcomb Generation in a Gallium Phosphide Photonic Crystal Cavity
abstract: We report broadband bright soliton microcomb generation in the emerging platform gallium phosphide on insulator. We demonstrate a broadband dispersion-engineered photonic-crystal Fabry-Perot resonator with record-high quality factors.

articleTitle: Soft glass optical fiber characterization with X-ray computed microtomography
abstract: We propose and demonstrate that absorption contrast X-ray computed microtomography is a valuable tool for the characterization of the optical properties of soft glass fibers.

articleTitle: NIR Ring Mirror Laser Utilizing Low Loss Silicon Nitride Photonic Platform
abstract: Low loss silicon nitride ring resonator reflectors provide feedback to a III/V gain chip, achieving single-mode lasing at 772nm. The Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> is fabricated in a CMOS foundry compatible process that achieves loss values of 0.036dB/cm.

articleTitle: Surface Potentials Measured by Light-Induced Atomic Desorption (LIAD) in Alkali Vapor Cells
abstract: We assess the utility of non-resonant light for rapidly controlling vapor density in glass cells and discuss the diffusion processes involved, revealing the pertinent potentials experienced by atoms moving between the adsorbed and vapor phases.

articleTitle: Reflectionless Scattering in Disordered Media
abstract: Reflectionless (RL) states enable reflectionless coupling of light to a scattering sample. Here, we first observe exceptional points of RL states obtained by tuning the scattering strength in symmetric scattering samples. We then show that we can design anti-reflection structures to get perfect transmission even for disordered samples.

articleTitle: High-density lithium niobate integrated photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a strip waveguide-based LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> photonic integrated circuit fabricated with a novel hard mask, diamond-like-carbon (DLC). The steep sidewall configuration exhibits tight optical confinement and dispersion control while preserving ultra-low loss of < 4 dB/m. In the meantime, a low noise self-injection locked laser is achieved with our chips.

articleTitle: Atmosphere-Driven Surface Chemical Reactions on Femtosecond Laser Processed Silver
abstract: The contact angle and surface chemistry of femtosecond laser processed silver evolves at an accelerated rate compared to other metals. The transient state of the surface chemistry after laser processing is analyzed with electron spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Asynchronous upconversion sampling of frequency modulated combs
abstract: We demonstrate an asynchronous optical sampling technique for the temporal characterization of frequency modulated combs. On the basis of a mid-infrared quantum cascade laser frequency comb, we measure both its instantaneous intensity and optical frequency.

articleTitle: Stable and Efficient Coherent Pulse Stacking Amplification of 81 Pulses with Four Channel Coherent Spatial Combining at 7mJ/Fiber
abstract: An integrated CPSA and CBC femtosecond fiber laser system temporally combines 81 pulses and spatially combines 4 amplifiers, achieving efficient amplifier energy extraction at 7mJ/fiber and 25mJ total, a record high energy per fiber.

articleTitle: An attosecond precision balanced timing detector using single photodetector
abstract: An attosecond-precision balanced timing detector using a single photodetector is demonstrated. The electronic noise during photodetection is well suppressed and a detection floor of 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> fs<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Hz is achieved with 1.4 mW input power.

articleTitle: High-speed Electro-optic Modulation in Silicon Nitride
abstract: We demonstrate electro-optic modulation up to 15GHz (3dB bandwidth) in a silicon nitride ring resonator by electrically poling the silicon nitride at a high temperature to engineer an electro-optic effect.

articleTitle: Secure OFDM-PON Bandwidth-limited System Precoded by Chaotic Frank Sequence-Based Circulant Matrix
abstract: We propose chaotic frank sequence-based circulant matrixes with ∼10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">88</sup> key space. Encryption of 21.67-Gb/s-20km bandwidth-limited OFDM-PON has been experimentally demonstrated, which confirms the superior performance of the proposed scheme over the chaotic-DFT and chaotic-DHT.

articleTitle: High-efficiency Mid-Infrared InGaAs/InP Arrayed Waveguide Gratings
abstract: We report the fabrication of InGaAs/InP based arrayed waveguide gratings featuring low insertion loss and non-uniformity. This device can be integrated monolithically with on-chip III-V lasers to make compact high-power mid-infrared sources.

articleTitle: High-Yield Large-Scale Optical Phased Array with Flip-Chip CMOS ASIC
abstract: We present >99% yield and consistent beam forming performance across ten optical phased array modules each with a 1024-element array, flip-chip assembled CMOS ASIC, and interfacing microcontroller, enabling robust performance in applications such as LiDAR.

articleTitle: Integrated active lithium niobate photonic devices
abstract: We demonstrate integrated active lithium niobate photonic devices including high-gain waveguide amplifiers and electro-optically tunable single-frequency micro-lasers fabricated using photolithography assisted chemo-mechanical etching technique.

articleTitle: Propagation of azimuthally non-symmetric vortices in non-Kolmogorov turbulence
abstract: Propagation through turbulent media leads to a symmetric broadening of orbital angular momenta spectra of vortex beams. We demonstrate that this is not the case for a class of initially asymmetric perfect vortex beams.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of a novel phase mask to inscribe fiber Bragg gratings for astronomical applications
abstract: A novel phase mask (PM) consisting of overlapped regions of more than one uniform pitch is fabricated using e-beam lithography. Design, fabrication of PMs, and filter characteristics are presented.

articleTitle: Probing Tunnel Ionization in Curved Waveguide
abstract: Probing the wavefunction of an electron under the ‘forbidden zone’ during tunnel ionization is of paramount importance to answer open questions related to it. We used a curved waveguide to simulate tunnel ionization.

articleTitle: Dual operation regime in the net anomalous dispersion all-polarization-maintaining Yb-doped fiber laser oscillator
abstract: We report a net anomalous dispersion Yb-doped fiber laser oscillator, which can operate in two different states. In particular, it can enter a subregime similar to the standard dissipative soliton allowing for further energy scaling.

articleTitle: Acoustic control of optical excitation of rare-earth ions
abstract: We investigated phonon-assisted optical excitation of erbium ions using surface acoustic waves. The results will pave the way to on-chip control of the energy transduction between telecom-photons and long-lived electron spins.

articleTitle: High resolution, low noise and full color single pixel imaging camera using cyclic patterns
abstract: We demonstrate a high resolution (1024 × 768 px), low noise, full color, and computationally simple single pixel imaging system using cyclic patterns that scroll down the digital micromirror device.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Self-injection Locking for All-Passive Laser Stabilization Beyond the Schawlow-Townes Limit
abstract: We propose a method for laser stabilization and phase-noise reduction using nonlinear feedback in which a gain-narrowed signal mode of a nonlinear oscillator is re-injected back into the pump laser. We show a proof-of-concept using Brillouin scattering.

articleTitle: Metasurface-Based InGaN/GaN Light-Emitting Diodes with Unidirectional Emission
abstract: We demonstrate a novel metasurface-based light-emitting diode (LED) composed of InGaN/GaN nanoribbons with embedded quantum-well emitters. We use nanolithography to fabricate metasurface beam deflectors and observe that we can successfully direct LED’s emission as desired.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution Terahertz Imaging Through a Plasmonic Photoconductive Focal-Plane Array
abstract: We utilize hyperspectral amplitude and phase information of imaged objects with a plasmonic photoconductive focal-plane array to resolve their structural information with an effective number of pixels exceeding 1-kilo-pixel using a pixel-super-resolution convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Waveguide-Integrated Thin-Film Lithium Niobate-Two-Dimensional Material Photodetectors
abstract: We report a waveguide-integrated lithium niobite on insulator (LNOI) two-dimensional material platform, demonstrating large bandwidth above 40 GHz LNOI-graphene PDs and ultrahigh responsivity of 7 A/W LNOI-Te PDs, to fill the photodetection gap on LNOI.

articleTitle: Following ultrafast Roaming Dissociation Dynamics with Coulomb Explosion Imaging
abstract: UV-photo-excitation of formaldehyde molecules will not only lead to conventional radical or molecular dissociation following the direct path. Additionally, a hindered dissociation, roaming, occurs which we observed directly and in real-time using Coulomb explosion imaging.

articleTitle: Multiemitter cavity quantum electrodynamics in 4H-silicon carbide-on-insulator photonics
abstract: We demonstrate small-ensemble (N ∼ 10 emitters) cavity quantum electrodynamics with silicon vacancy color centers in microresonators using the 4H-Silicon Carbide on Insulator photonics platform.

articleTitle: High Finesse, Air-Gap Optical Reference Cavity for Low Noise Microwave Generation
abstract: We lock two, 1.2 THz-spaced lasers to a million-finesse air-gap optical cavity, demonstrating 40 dB common-mode phase noise rejection and a path towards compact, low noise, optically derived microwaves without ultrahigh vacuum.

articleTitle: Nonlinear nano-optics and ultrafast nano-imaging of electronic coherence in monolayer WSe2
abstract: In four-wave mixing nano-imaging of WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> we resolve spatial heterogeneity in dephasing ranging from 5-45 fs at room temperature. An anti-correlation between FWM intensity and dephasing reveals a complex interplay between spatial coherence and disorder.

articleTitle: φ-OTDR for Low-Noise Distributed Seismic Sensing
abstract: A low-noise φ-OTDR system employing 2-stage preamplification is employed as a distributed acoustic sensor in a survey well in Cottessen, reaching strain noise levels below 1 nε for a 10 kHz sampling rate.

articleTitle: Two pulsed regions in a L-band dissipative-soliton fiber laser controlled by two pump injections
abstract: We propose a L-band Er-doped fiber laser with a dual-pump scheme. Wavelength-switchable dissipative solitons (DSs) with different optical characteristics have been obtained.

articleTitle: FWM-to-OPA Transition and Signal Power Increase in FWM
abstract: We examined the transition from four-wave mixing to parametric amplification. The signal intensity can be increased with smaller noise in four-wave mixing region than in optical parametric amplification.

articleTitle: Rate Adaptive Autoencoder-based Geometric Constellation Shaping
abstract: An autoencoder is used to optimize bit-to-symbol mappings for geometric constellation shaping. The mappings allow for net rate adaptivity without additional hardware complexity, while achieving up to 300km of transmission distance compared to uniform QAM.

articleTitle: Gain Flattened Wideband YDFA for 1 μm Data Transmission
abstract: We report a wideband gain-flattened ytterbium-doped fiber amplifier operating at 1025-1075 nm in a dual-stage configuration. It provides a 20 dB average gain with <1 dB gain variation and a noise figure of <5.7 dB.

articleTitle: Record High Throughput using Electronic 2×2 MIMO with OAM Multiplexing
abstract: We recover twelve channels (three OAM orders) at 1.3 km with electronic 2×2 MIMO. Per trials on three 50 GHz slots swept across the C-band, using 96 slots would achieve 65.5 Tb/s net rate.

articleTitle: Dual-Polarization Hermite-Gaussian NFDM Transmission with a Single Parameter Equalizer
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, a high-capacity DP-NFDM transmission based on HG wave-carriers, enhanced by a single parameter equalizer, to achieve a record high spectral efficiency of 5.8 bits/s/Hz/pol for NFDM systems.

articleTitle: Symbol Rate Tolerance of Geometric Parameter Extraction-based Receiver IQ imbalance Correction
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate the symbol rate tolerance of Geometric Parameter Extraction-based receiver IQ imbalance correction for PM-16QAM signals. Through experiments, we show that the algorithm can tolerate a wide range of imbalance values for data rates upto 640 Gbps.

articleTitle: Self-Injection-Locked Kerr Soliton Microcombs With Photonic Wire Bonds For Use in Terahertz Communications
abstract: We demonstrate single-soliton Kerr-comb generators, exploiting photonic wire bonds to connect Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> resonators and self-injection-locked InP pump lasers. The assembly is used to generate a 0.302 THz carrier for 160 Gbit/s wireless transmission over 55 m.

articleTitle: High-Rate Quantum Key Distribution Exploiting Integrated Photonics and Multi-Pixel Superconducting Nanowire Detectors
abstract: We report a quantum key distribution system that is able to generate key at a record high key rate of 115.8 Mb/s over 10-km fibre. This attributes to a high-efficiency multi-pixel superconducting nanowire detector, a low-error integrated transmitter, and a fast post-processing algorithm.

articleTitle: Computational optical sensor with a paper-based peptide panel assay for point-of-care testing of Lyme disease
abstract: We present a computational paper-based optical sensor for point-of-care serodiagnosis of Lyme disease. Using blindly tested human serum samples, we achieved 91.7% sensitivity and 100% specificity against two-tier serology without cross-reactivity from other diseases.

articleTitle: Surface-Normal Dual-Polarization Coherent Receiver Using Dielectric Metasurface
abstract: Spatially scalable surface-incidence dual-polarization (DP) coherent receiver with a dielectric metasurface and photodetector array is proposed. The designed metasurface is fabricated on a silicon-on-quartz chip to demonstrate ideal wave-mixing functionalities required for DP coherent detection.

articleTitle: 100-km Polarization-Orthogonal Self-Homodyne Coherent WDM Transmission Using Nonlinearity Suppressed SOA
abstract: We propose an SOA enabled polarization-orthogonal SHC WDM transmission scheme utilizing multiple-wavelength orthogonal LOs for nonlinearity suppression. Successful 800Gb/s 4-channel WDM transmission is demonstrated over 100km SSMFs.

articleTitle: Fulfilling entanglement’s optimal advantage via converting correlation to coherence
abstract: Entanglement boosts performance limits in sensing and communication even in noisy environments. We propose a conversion module to transform quantum correlation to coherent quadrature displacement, fulfilling the optimal receiver for quantum illumination and entanglement-assisted communication. [1]

articleTitle: Attosecond timing jitter from an all-PM Er:fiber laser on "optical cubes"
abstract: We demonstrate a mode-locked 100 MHz Er:fiber laser on "optical cubes", with which the repetition rate of the laser drifts within 300 Hz over 20 hrs. The measured timing jitter with BOC was 98.4 as.

articleTitle: How can (TD-)DFT improve multi-scale optical simulations of novel nano-materials and devices?
abstract: T-matrices of molecular materials, expressing their scattering properties, can be constructed from precise quantum-chemical calculations, enabling the use of efficient Maxwell solvers for multi-scale simulations of optical devices built from new materials.

articleTitle: Wavefront Characterization of a Gaussian Beam after Propagation through Optical Turbulence Generated by Rayleigh-Bénard Convection
abstract: A Gaussian beam is propagated through a water tank containing Rayleigh-Bénard convection. The beam wavefront is measured using a Shack-Hartmann sensor to obtain optical wavefront statistics for characterization of the random phase perturbations.

articleTitle: Low-channel-crosstalk and low-return-loss wavelength (de)multiplexer based on grating-assisted cascaded MZIs
abstract: Connecting cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometers with apodized grating assisted Michelson interferometers enables a wavelength (de)multiplexer with -37 dB optical channel crosstalk, -2 dB optical insertion loss, and -25 dB optical return loss on silicon-on-insulator.

articleTitle: Time-Domain Terahertz Video Captured with a Plasmonic Photoconductive Focal-Plane Array
abstract: We demonstrate a time-domain terahertz video captured at 16 fps using a plasmonic photoconductive terahertz focal-plane array that provides hyperspectral and spatial amplitude and phase information of the imaged object simultaneously.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional plasmonic perovskite particle laser
abstract: Surface plasmon polariton (SPP) lasers have so far relied on metallic substrates. Here, we report a three-dimensional (3D) plasmonic particle laser using gold coating on lead halide perovskite crystals as small as 620 nm in size. Upon optical pumping, SPP modes are strongly confined along the particle edges with high Purcell enhancement in room conditions. Lasing of metal-coated plasmonic laser particles in live cells is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Single Frequency DPSS Nd:YVO4 Laser for Length Metrology
abstract: Solid-state lasers are used in length metrology because it has narrow linewidth, single mode and wavelength stability. A simple method uses Nd:YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> laser to obtain single mode with stability 1.9 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup> at 1 second.

articleTitle: Experimental High-dimensional One-way Quantum Computation on a Very-large-scale Photonic Chip
abstract: We report a very-large-scale silicon photonic quantum chip, on which we prepare various four-level four-qudit graph states and use them to demonstrate high-dimensional one-way quantum computation and measurement-based quantum algorithm.

articleTitle: Multispectral imaging using a diffractive network
abstract: We present and experimentally demonstrate diffractive network-based snapshot multispectral imaging, and perform coherent imaging over a broad spectrum while simultaneously routing distinct spectral bands onto unique sets of pixels to form virtual filter arrays.

articleTitle: TaAs Wely semimetal single-unit multi-port integrated polarimeter
abstract: We demonstrate a single-unit polarimeter based on a TaAs Weyl semimetal thin film which produces unique current responses to any polarization state on the Poincaré sphere in the near infrared band. This design opens up a new paradigm in integrated polarimeters.

articleTitle: All-dielectric, visible wavelength focusing metalens with planar surface for mechanical robustness
abstract: We present a path to truly ‘flat’, all-oxide metalenses working at visible wavelength comprising high-aspect ratio TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanopillars infused into fused silica substrate. We show both a proof-of-concept infused metalens using electron-beam lithography, and an example of mass-manufacturing using deep-ultraviolet projection lithography.

articleTitle: Integrated Quantum Memories at 1.3 K with Tin-Vacancy Centers and Photonic Circuits
abstract: We present an efficient microwave and optical interface for quantum memories at 1.3 K based on tin-vacancy color centers in diamond and scalable integrated photonics.

articleTitle: Coherent Temporal Stacking of Tens-of-fs Laser Pulses
abstract: We theoretically prove coherent pulse stacking can accommodate tens-of-fs pulse lengths when stacking large number of pulses. Experimental validation shows high-efficiency stacking of nine, 50fs bandwidth pulses with four Gires-Tournois Interferometric (GTI) cavities.

articleTitle: Optical 90° Hybrid Based on Cascaded Deformed MMI Couplers with Low Loss and High Balance
abstract: We present an optical 90° hybrid based on cascaded deformed multi-mode interference couplers. The fabricated hybrid demonstrated the common-mode rejection-ratio >25dB, excess-loss ~1dB, and phase deviation less than ±5° within the wavelength range over 45nm.

articleTitle: Inverse-designed linear coherent photonic networks for high-resolution spectral reconstruction
abstract: We proposed and demonstrated integrated photonic networks composed of inverse-designed components for spectral reconstruction. We reconstructed spectral lines separated by 100 pm and continuous spectra from a device with an ultracompact footprint of 88×300 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Non-Gaussian State Generation Using A Photon Detector With Finite Timing Jitter
abstract: We formulate for the first time the effect of photon detector’s timing jitter on non-Gaussian state generation. As a result, we obtain the quantitative relation between the jitter and the fidelity of the generated state.

articleTitle: Silicon Nitride Waveguide Crossings for Photonic Quantum Computing based on an Adiabatic Coupler Design
abstract: We developed a waveguide crossing in our silicon nitride integrated photonics platform based on an adiabatic coupler design. It shows low-loss, large spectral range and high fidelity for use as quantum NOT-gate.

articleTitle: Spontaneous symmetry breaking of Kerr solitons in Fabry Perot Resonators
abstract: Symmetry breaking of vector temporal cavity solitons in Fabry–Perot resonators is presented. This work can improve the generation of frequency combs through its control of the number of cavity solitons in a round trip.

articleTitle: FRET-mediated collective blinking of self-assembled stacks of semiconducting nanoplatelets
abstract: We use micro-photoluminescence to demonstrate collective blinking of self-assembled stacks of around 70 semiconducting nanoplatelets. This effect is explained and modelled as Förster-resonant energy tranfer (FRET) funneling all the excitons from a chain portion to a single blinking quencher.

articleTitle: Anyonic two-photon coincidence statistics in birefringent waveguide circuits
abstract: We synthesize fractional coincidence statistics for photon pairs in laser-written waveguide networks. To this end, we show that arbitrary exchange phases can be created by tailoring waveguides birefringence and an appropriate choice of input polarizations.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet spatiotemporal optical vortices via sum-frequency generation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the generation of ultraviolet spatiotemporal orbital angular momentum (ST-OAM) femtosecond pulses based on infrared-visible sum frequency generation.

articleTitle: Effect of Quantum-Well Number on the Current Gain of Heterojunction Bipolar Light-Emitting Transistors
abstract: We report the current gain decreases with adding the multiple-quantum-well (MQW) in the base of the heterojunction bipolar light-emitting transistors (HBLETs). The simulation result is consistent with experimental I-V characteristics for single-quantum-well (1QW) HBLET.

articleTitle: Electrochemically Modulated Metasurfaces
abstract: Electrochemical intercalation of lithium in titanium dioxide and silicon-based metasurfaces is used to initiate phase changes in a continuously tunable, reversible, and bi-stable manner for dynamic control over structural color.

articleTitle: High-fidelity super-resolution imaging with deconvolution by pixel reassignment (DPR)
abstract: We demonstrated a novel super-resolution analytical approach, deconvolution by pixel reassignment (DPR), which can enhance the spatial resolution in fluorescence microscopy beyond the diffraction limit with high fidelity and the capability of more general imaging.

articleTitle: Correlative Conjugated Detection Scheme for Laser-Phase-Noise-Tolerant Coherent Detection
abstract: We propose a correlative conjugated detection for laser-phase-noise-tolerant coherent detection. Carrier phase is recovered from the spectral correlation taken from phase-conjugated twin signals. Numerically demonstrated is successful demodulation of QPSK signals having significant phase noise.

articleTitle: A Universal Approach to Nanophotonic Inverse Design through Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We present a novel method to perform universal black-box optimization of pixel-discrete nanophotonic devices based on reinforcement learning. We demonstrate the capabilities of our method for a silicon-on-insulator waveguide-mode converter with > 95% conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Towards a Strontium Optical Clock System with Metasurface Optics and Integrated Nonlinear Photonics
abstract: We report on a strontium optical clock built with integrated photonics. We implement free-space laser beam control of positioning, pointing, shaping, polarization, and integration with metasurface optics, and laser-frequency absolute stabilization with waveguide supercontinuum generators.

articleTitle: Versatile Polarization Control with Bilayer Metasurfaces
abstract: We investigate bi-layer metasurfaces for realizing arbitrary Jones matrix transformations that are not achievable with single-layer metasurfaces and we provide a set of criteria under which the intra-layer coupling can be neglected, simplifying the metasurface design.

articleTitle: Fundamental Scaling Laws for Tunable X-ray Smith-Purcell Radiation in Van der Waals Structures
abstract: We theoretically obtain and experimentally verify photon flux scaling laws for free electron-driven van der Waals structures. Our experiments confirm our unprecedented, truly predictive theoretical framework, which combines first-principles electromagnetism with Monte Carlo scattering simulations.

articleTitle: Radiation tolerant fiber comb for space applications
abstract: A radiation tolerant Erbium doped fiber comb has been demonstrated. Signals of the comb’s fundamental frequencies did not degrade after Gamma radiation with an accumulated dose of 1 kGy, comparable to a decade of operation in a Mid-Earth Orbit.

articleTitle: Low-optical-pumping-threshold InGaAs/GaAs Nano-ridge Laser Monolithically Grown on 300 mm Silicon Substrate
abstract: Amorphous-silicon-grating-on-top DFB-InGaAs/GaAs-laser directly grown on silicon substrate by nano-ridge engineering technique exhibits 2.5 kW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> lasing threshold, 10 times smaller than nano-ridge laser with etched grating, due to avoiding introducing carrier loss path at GaAs-air surface.

articleTitle: Self-injection Locked Second-Harmonic Generation in Optically Poled Silicon Nitride Microresonators
abstract: We present a narrow-linewidth second-harmonic source based on a laser diode injection locked to an optically poled silicon nitride microresonator. The device is a compact, highly-coherent dual-wavelength source, with high conversion efficiency up to 280%/W.

articleTitle: InAs based Nonlinear Dielectric Metasurface for Binary Phase Terahertz Generation
abstract: We demonstrate an InAs-based nonlinear dielectric metasurface, which can generate terahertz (THz) pulses with opposite phase in comparison to an unpatterned InAs layer. It enables binary phase THz metasurfaces for generation and focusing of THz pulses.

articleTitle: Direct Shear Force Measurement by a GaN Nanopillar LED Based Tactile Sensor
abstract: The response of a GaN nanopillar based tactile sensor to a shear force is investigated. Two different materials were used to apply the force to understand how the tactile sensor responds to different slipping conditions.

articleTitle: High-efficiency optical parametric amplifier for generating intense narrowband THz pulses
abstract: We demonstrate an effective method to generate high-energy narrowband THz pulses by super-Gaussian laser pulses produced from the high-efficiency (over 55%) optical parametric amplifier (OPA).

articleTitle: Compact Mueller matrix Microscope based on chip integrated full-Stokes polarimetric imaging sensor
abstract: We report a compact, dual-color Mueller matrix microscope based on a chip-integrated CMOS polarization imaging sensor. Our system provides high accuracy polarization imaging and Mueller matrix imaging.

articleTitle: Hybrid SESAM Mode-Locked VECSEL
abstract: A mode-locked VECSEL employing a novel hybrid semiconductor saturable absorber/dielectric output coupler is reported. The linear cavity laser emits 410 femtosecond pulses at a repetition rate of 4.2 GHz operating at λ ≈ 1030 nm.

articleTitle: 240 Gbps Quantum Random Number Generator with Photonic Integrated Chip
abstract: A pure resistor is used as a transimpedance device in this work to maximize the operating bandwidth of an on-chip integrated homodyne setup, resulting in a 240 GBits/s quantum random number generator.

articleTitle: Supermode Evolution in Dual Element Coupled VCSEL Arrays
abstract: We show the experimental evolution for the spectra and far-field profile of supermodes from a coherent dual-element VCSEL array. Under coherent operation, the far-field beam profile is related to the relative amplitudes of the supermodes.

articleTitle: Scalable on-chip lasers grown on 300 mm Si wafers
abstract: We report the first electrically pumped InAs quantum-dot lasers grown on Si within narrow oxide pockets for monolithic on-chip light sources. High performance devices are achieved at 300 mm wafer scale with high yields.

articleTitle: Hyperdimensional spin-orbit microlaser
abstract: Despite the rapid development of photonic devices and systems, on-chip information technologies are mostly limited to two-level systems due to the lack of sufficient reconfigurability. Here, we demonstrate a high-dimensional, spin-orbit microlaser for chip-scale flexible generation and manipulation of arbitrary four-level states. Two microcavities coupled through a non-Hermitian synthetic gauge field are designed to emit spin-orbit-coupled states of light with six degrees of freedom (DOFs). The vectorial state of the emitted laser beam in free space can be mapped on a Bloch hypersphere defining an SU(4) symmetry, demonstrating dynamical generation and reconfiguration of high-dimensional superposition states with high fidelity.

articleTitle: Single-pass femtosecond parametric process towards continuous variables quantum networks
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of 21 squeezed spectral modes at 156 MHz, combining frequency- and time- multiplexing in multimode squeezing. This paves the way to the implementation of scalable and fully reconfigurable multipartite entangled states.

articleTitle: Integrated Programmable Microwave Photonic Bandpass Filter with Symmetric Rejection
abstract: We propose an integrated optical design of cascaded microring resonators to achieve tunable microwave bandpass filter with a programmable bandwidth of 500-1100MHz and symmetrical rejection of 50dB at ±5GHz. A proof-of-concept experimental result is presented.

articleTitle: Heterodyne quantum light detection using free electrons
abstract: We show that free electrons can be used for heterodyne light detection and are sensitive to quantum-optical properties of light, including off-diagonal elements of the photonic density matrix.

articleTitle: Flexible, Refractive Fresnel Liquid-Crystal (RFLC) Lens for Low-Power Autofocusing Smart Contact Lens Systems
abstract: We demonstrate fabrication of tunable flexible refractive Fresnel liquid-crystal lens using PET for Smart Contact Lens System. We show focus tunability of 1.9D at 1.1V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">RMS</inf> using voltage and pulse width modulation lens tuning techniques.

articleTitle: Stark Tuning and Resonant Excitation of Hybrid Integrated Telecom Single-Photon Sources
abstract: We introduce hybrid integrated telecom single-photon sources on a commercial foundry multilayer silicon photonic chip. We show above-band and resonant waveguide-coupled single-photon emission tunable via the DC Stark shift.

articleTitle: Half-integer angular momentum and multi-defect localization in photonic crystal microring resonators
abstract: We demonstrate half-integer angular momentum light in a high-quality-factor photonic crystal ring with good waveguide coupling and reduced group velocity. Additionally, multiple modes can be localized to small volumes within the ring, and their orientation can be well-controlled.

articleTitle: Spectral Phase Dispersion Measurements in Frequency Comb Generating Linear Microresonators
abstract: We present measurements of the spectral phase in a waveguide Bragg reflector using a Michelson interferometer. When compared with theory, these measurements support the dispersion engineering in novel linear Bragg grating frequency comb microresonators.

articleTitle: Online Inspection of Microbial with an Opto-Microfluidic Chip
abstract: One automatic on-line inspection system with the key element of laser opto-micro-chip detection is presented. The optics is optimized for the channel. With physical fingerprints, targeted waterborne microbial can be identified in real-time and label-free manner.

articleTitle: Microwave Photonic Harmonic Down-Conversion Based on Four-Wave Mixing in a silicon waveguide with reverse-biased p-i-n junction
abstract: We propose a wideband photonic-assisted method based on four-wave mixing in a silicon waveguide with reverse-biased p-i-n junction to realize microwave down-conversion with a low-frequency electrical local oscillator (LO).

articleTitle: Self-Heating Based Locking of a Laser to a High-Q Si3N4 Microcavity
abstract: We demonstrate locking of a laser to an external silicon nitride microcavity resonance without the use of a photodiode. This is achieved by indirectly measuring changes in microcavity temperature that occur during resonant power buildup.

articleTitle: Performance-boosted N-polar AlGaN deep ultraviolet light-emitting diodes by a top tunnel junction
abstract: An N-polar AlGaN-based DUV LED incorporating a tunnel junction, named N-TJ-LED, was proposed. Compared with the regular N-polar LEDs, the N-TJ-LEDs exhibited enhanced internal quantum efficiency, higher light output power, and dramatically reduced turn-on voltage.

articleTitle: Ten-Mode Erbium-Doped Fiber Amplifier with Extended Gain Bandwidth of 43 nm
abstract: We design and fabricate a ten-mode erbium-doped fiber with an extended 15-dB gain bandwidth of 43 nm using Er and Al co-doping, which enables both space- and wavelength-division multiplexing to further scale fiber capacity.

articleTitle: Superconducting Single-Photon Counting Pixels
abstract: We present single-photon counting pixels realized by the monolithic integration of superconducting-nanowire single-photon detectors with Josephson electronics. These pixels are scalable to large-format sensor arrays and are compatible with CMOS array readout architecture.

articleTitle: Effect of Split ring resonator on transmission characteristics of Dipole Metacavities
abstract: We have experimentally and numerically demonstrated the coupling between the dipole cavity and SRR. The coupling between them results in the excitation of a new resonance and increases the Q-factor of the existing resonance.

articleTitle: Dynamic Distance Measurement with nm-Level Precision and MHz Acquisition Rate Using a Frequency Comb-Based Combined Method
abstract: We demonstrate a dynamic distance measurement method that combines electro-optic sampling-based timing detection and microwave phase detection. At 1-MHz (4.55-Hz) acquisition rate, a 300-mm non-ambiguity range and 49-nm (0.99-nm) precision are attained.

articleTitle: Plasmonic "Rainbow" for Super-Resolution Displacement Spectroscopic Analysis and Surface Biosensing
abstract: We report a plasmonic "rainbow" trapping metasurface for on-chip spectrometers and sensors. By extracting the numerical centroid of the trapped surface plasmon waves, a miniaturized imager-based platform was demonstrated for super-resolution displacement spectroscopic sensing.

articleTitle: Optical DPS-QKD Protocol Synthesis with Chirp-Pulsed and Phase Stabilized Laser Carrier under Injection-Locking
abstract: A below-threshold biased laser diode under modulated injection-locking with binary and triangular sequenced DPSK-QKD protocols with allowable phase-stabilized decoding up to 100Gbits in 12-min is successfully synthesized by using its leading-edge chirped pulse carrier.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband spectral combining of three pulse-shaped fiber amplifiers with 42fs compressed pulses
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-broadband spectral combining of three fiber chirped-pulse amplifiers using two coherently-spectrally synthesized pulse shapers. The combined pulses are compressed to 42fs, the shortest from a spectrally-combined fiber system at one-micron wavelength.

articleTitle: Phase Noise Characteristics of Supercontinnum Source based on 50-GHz Electro-optic Optical Frequency Comb Using Modified Self-heterodyne Method
abstract: We generated a supercontinuum source based on a 50-GHz electro-optic optical frequency comb. Furthermore, we investigated the phase noise characteristics to evaluate the frequency stability of EO-OFC-based supercontinuum using the proposed modified self-heterodyne method.

articleTitle: Quantum-Cascade-Laser Dual-Comb Spectroscopy for Probing Fuel-Rich Oxidation of 1,3-Butadiene at High-Temperature
abstract: We demonstrate using quantum-cascade-laser dual-comb spectroscopy (QCL-DCS) to measure 1,3-butadiene's mole fraction time history (spectral range of 1590-1650 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) at high temperatures inside shock tube in the range of 1100 – 1400 K near 1 atm.

articleTitle: On-Chip Terahertz Spectrometer based on Magnetoelectric Coupling in Metasurface
abstract: We theoretically propose a metasurface-based room-temperature on-chip terahertz spectrometer. Based on magnetoelectric coupling in metasurface, direct photoelectric conversion with selective frequency response can be achieved, leading to the capability of terahertz spectral analysis.

articleTitle: Design of a Digital PID with High Bandwidth for Locking DFB Laser to an Absorption line of CH4
abstract: Analog PID controllers, although offering higher bandwidth than digital PIDs, generally suffer from a lack of features such as variable parameter tuning. We report on enhancing bandwidth of digital PID and their application in methane absorption line stability.

articleTitle: Arbitrary Electro-Optic Bandwidth and Frequency Control in Lithium Niobate Optical Resonators
abstract: We achieve 20x in-situ tuning contrast of bandwidth and resonant frequency in lithium niobate optical resonators. We present a general model to obtain the detuning and bandwidth of optical frequencies in this photonic system.

articleTitle: Active photonic molecules based on ring quantum cascade lasers
abstract: Photonic molecules are the optical analog of chemical molecules: two or more strongly coupled optical resonators. Here, we present a new class of active photonic molecules based on ring quantum cascade lasers.

articleTitle: Long Wavelength Infrared Few-Cycle Pulse Generation Seeded by Self-Phase Modulation Enabled Spectral Selection in Single-Mode Fiber
abstract: We demonstrate few-cycle optical parametric amplifier tunable from 7.8 - 9.9 μm, seeded by self-phase modulation enabled spectral selection in single-mode HI1060 fiber. The system produces idler energy of 5 nJ with M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of 1.6.

articleTitle: Investigating and Scale-up of Programmable On-chip Photonic Convolution Neural Networks Based on Joint Transform Correlator
abstract: We design, fabricate and investigate programmable on-chip photonic convolution neural networks based on the joint transform correlator. Its scale-up prospect is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Equilibrium dynamics of multiple interacting waves with signed analogous masses
abstract: We report the first experimental realization of equilibrium dynamics of multiple interacting waves with signed analogous masses in optical fiber. The mutually confined pulses show a robust feature upon certain collisions.

articleTitle: Real-Time Blind Source Separation with Integrated Photonics for Wireless Signals
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, real-time blind source separation of interfering GHz transmitters using photonic weights controlled by an RF-System-on-Chip FPGA. This analog system achieves multi-antenna signal separation with millisecond execution latency.

articleTitle: Multi-Gated Photon Counting Optical Time-Domain Reflectometry
abstract: A multi-gated photon counting optical time-domain reflectometry is demonstrated. In our experiment, a 70-m-long fiber link is tested which tolerates a Fresnel reflection with 35.3 dB greater than the back scattering of Rayleigh.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of local area entanglement distribution between two distant nodes, coexisting with classical synchronization
abstract: We successfully demonstrated polarization entanglement distribution and classical time synchronization using a high-accuracy precision time protocol between two quantum nodes located ~250 meters apart using a single fiber simultaneously carrying both quantum and classical data.

articleTitle: Parallel processing of frequency-bin entangled photons from a 21 GHz SOI micro-resonator for fully-connected networks
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a proof of concept o f a frequency-domain fully-connected network using parallel frequency-domain measurements applied to frequency-entangled photon pairs from 21 GHz Silicon On Insulator (SOI) micro-resonator.

articleTitle: How to Build a Useful Quantum Computer using Light in a Scalable Photonic Platform
abstract: The development of a practical quantum computer requires quantum error correction on a large scale. PsiQuantum aims to achieve this by using photons, on a silicon photonic platform. In this invited talk, I will outline the architecture of PsiQuantum’s quantum machine and discuss the progress we have made and the challenges we have encountered in recent years.

articleTitle: Temperature-driven, Symmetry-broken Nonlinear Polarization Evolution Method for Environmentally-stable, Sub-100-fs Mode-locked Fiber Oscillators
abstract: We demonstrate a 96-fs, all-polarization-maintaining ytterbium fiber oscillator mode-locked with a temperature-driven, symmetry-broken nonlinear polarization evolution method. The central wavelength and output pulse energy were 1030 nm and 33.7 mW at 18.31 MHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Bubble-induced Turbulence Compensation Employing NHS-PWC in PolMux-UOWC
abstract: We propose a non-Hermitian symmetric pairwise coding scheme to compensate for the impairments of bubble-induced turbulence in underwater optical wireless communication, and experimentally demonstrate an 8.58 Gbps system combined with polarization multiplexing.

articleTitle: High-efficiency tunable Raman lasers in compact multimode silicon racetrack resonators
abstract: We demonstrated a widely tunable silicon Raman laser with threshold of 0.2 mW and slope-efficiency of 27.5%. The adiabatic Euler bends maintained average loaded Q > 2.2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> throughout the 157 nm tuning range.

articleTitle: Dual wavelength optofluidic distributed feedback dye laser on a single PDMS chip
abstract: We demonstrate two liquid-core distributed feedback (DFB) lasers operating side-by-side simultaneously at two different wavelengths with sub-mW thresholds from Rhodamine 6G dissolved in ethylene glycol and 4-(Dicyanomethylene)-2-methyl-6-(4-dimethylaminostyryl)-4H-pyran in dimethyl sulfoxide on a single polydimethylsiloxane device.

articleTitle: Low Loss Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Modulator with T-Rail Electrodes on Quartz Substrate Fabricated by Photolithography
abstract: We fabricated high-performance thin-film lithium niobate modulators with T-rail electrodes through photolithography. The 10-mm-long device shows a half-wave voltage of 2.2 V, fiber-to-fiber insertion loss of 3.9 dB, 2-dB EO bandwidth of 67 GHz.

articleTitle: Tunable Terahertz Nonlinearities in Graphene
abstract: Among all the materials we know, graphene exhibits the largest optical nonlinearity, especially at the THz frequencies. This nonlinearity can be efficiently controlled and widely tuned via electrical gating with only a few volts.

articleTitle: Observing a Luminescence of Dissolved Oxygen Under Direct Laser Excitation
abstract: A multimode diode laser at 1270 nm is used to excite oxygen molecules dissolved in 1,1,2-Trichloro-1,2,2-trifluoroethane. A subsequent luminescence of singlet oxygen is detected using a photodiode with 1 mm diameter of active area.

articleTitle: Characterization of Kerr Microcombs for Quantum Technology
abstract: Quantum microcombs allow for the efficient generation of twin-photons via spontaneous four-wave mixing in resonantly pumped microresonators. We here develop a frequency-bin theoretical framework that permits to determine their density operator.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Light Evolution in a Photonic Thouless Pump
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a nonlinear photonic Thouless pump and show that the Kerr effect in discrete waveguide arrangements enables the topological transport of excitations initially placed in the topologically trivial band for sufficient excitation powers.

articleTitle: Ionic Liquid-assisted Cavitation for Ultrafast Laser Micromachining
abstract: We study the effects of cavitation-assisted ultrafast laser micromachining under ionic liquids, rather than traditional water immersion. Ionic liquids may serve to localize damage more precisely because their low vapor pressures inhibit cavitation.

articleTitle: Time-bin Entanglement Based on Integrated 3C-SiC-on-insulator Photon-pair Sources
abstract: We characterize the photon-pairs generated from an elliptical-shape microring resonator based on a 3C-SiC-on-insulator platform through spontaneous parametric down-conversion. We demonstrate the time-bin entanglement using a Franson interferometer based on this SiC photon pair source.

articleTitle: High-concentration F-doped ZnO thin films prepared via femtosecond-laser hyperdoping
abstract: High-concentration F-doped ZnO thin films with an atomic dopant percentage of 8.3 at.% were prepared for the first time using the femtosecond-laser hyperdoping technique.

articleTitle: Resonance-Enhanced Entangled Photon Pair Generation Using Topological Floquet Defect Mode Resonance
abstract: We demonstrate a 300-times enhancement in the second-order cross correlation of entangled photon pairs generated by spontaneous four-wave mixing on a robust silicon topological photonics platform using compact, high-Q Floquet defect mode resonance.

articleTitle: Mode-Mismatch-Robust Squeezed Light from a Self-Imaging Optical Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We show that the multimode squeezed light from a self-imaging optical parametric oscillator has the robustness of maintaining the squeezing level to spatial mode mismatch. This light outperforms single-mode infinitely squeezed light against massive mode-mismatch.

articleTitle: Hong-Ou-Mandel Interference in LNOI
abstract: We design, fabricate, and characterise a balanced directional coupler in lithium niobate on insulator (LNOI) and use it to demonstrate Hong-Ou-Mandel interference of telecom photons with a raw visibility of (93.5±0.7) %.

articleTitle: Detecting relative phase of photon frequency superposition states using three-level atom coupled to waveguide
abstract: We show that the scattering of a single photon in a superposition of two frequencies with a single three-level Λ atom depends on the relative phase between the photon frequency superposition states.

articleTitle: Breather Dynamics in Ultrafast Fibre Lasers and Their Intelligent Control
abstract: We review our recent work on the dynamics of breathing solitons in fibre lasers, including single breathers, breather molecular complexes, breather explosions and breather frequency locking at Farey fractions, and their control by genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: Light transport beyond diffusion in correlated scattering media
abstract: We demonstrate that direct measurements of photon pathlengths reveal extended ranges of sub-diffusive transport in 3D random media. This anomalous transport is associated to the hyperuniform structure generated by the Coulomb interaction between core-shell particles.

articleTitle: Coherent and incoherent trapped-ion quantum control in structured lightfields
abstract: Spatially structured lightfields enable enhanced laser cooling and quantum coherent control of trapped ions as compared to simple plane waves. Integrated photonics offers a route to stable delivery, facilitating application in quantum computing and metrology.

articleTitle: Photonic Indistinguishability of the Tin-Vacancy Center in Diamond
abstract: Tin-vacancy centres in diamond are spin-photon interfaces with intrinsic environmental noise insensitivity. We reveal their high optical coherence in a nanostructured environment and generate single photons with a 99.7% purity and an indistinguishability of 63(9)%. [1]

articleTitle: Dual comb ranging: methodologies, systems and applications
abstract: Dual-comb ranging is a powerful tool for absolute distance measurement. Here, we introduce dual-comb ranging’s principle, noise suppression technologies, and applications in measuring space camera deformation and satellite antenna.

articleTitle: Image Sensors Based on Nonlinear Optical Neural Networks
abstract: We use a multilayer, nonlinear optical neural network as a pre-processor for machine vision. On tasks including identification of real objects illuminated by broadband incoherent light, we show that nonlinear optical pre-processing outperforms linear pre-processing.

articleTitle: Efficient coupling modulation of silicon racetrack ring resonators at 2 μm waveband
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated 30 Gbit/s coupling modulation based on silicon racetrack ring resonator operating at 2 μm waveband. The modulator has EO bandwidth beyond 18 GHz and modulation efficiency of 0.75 V•cm.

articleTitle: High Pulse Energy and High Average Power All-Fiber Amplifier with Diffraction-Limited Beam Quality
abstract: We demonstrate record high energy (1.2 mJ) nanosecond pulses with peak power of >200 kW and average power of 620 W, in a fiber amplifier using a novel 25 µm mode-field diameter Yb-doped gain fiber. The TMI threshold for this fiber was measured to be 1.8 kW. This is achieved at a diffraction limited beam quality of M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=1.08.

articleTitle: Propagation Losses of Sputtered Oxide Waveguides in the Visible Range
abstract: Sputtered oxide films show an exciting future with photonic integrated circuits due to their wide transparency range. We show propagation losses in niobium-tantalum oxide (NbTaOx) and tantalum pentoxide (Ta<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>) with visible wavelengths in fabricated waveguides.

articleTitle: Parallel chaotic sources based on microcombs
abstract: Massively parallel optical chaotic sources with large bandwidth are demonstrated based on chaotic microcombs in the AlGaAsOI platform. 30-channel parallel random bit generation with 30 Gbit/s per channel is realized based on the chaotic source.

articleTitle: Photothermal evanescent-field gas detection using all-fiber acousto-optic heterodyne interferometry
abstract: A compact photothermal evanescent-field NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> detection with detection limit of 32 ppm and response time less than 30 seconds is experimentally achieved in a tapered nanofiber at communication band via all-fiber acousto-optic heterodyne interferometry.

articleTitle: FMCW LiDAR Distance Measurement through Phase Error Correction
abstract: Compared with the auxiliary interferometer, the direct resampling on main interferograms through the Hilbert transform could correct the optical-source phase error and demonstrate the excellent frequency spectrum, precise distance, and repeatability for compact LiDAR systems.

articleTitle: Building Directionally Intelligent Terahertz Leaky-Wave Antennas with Deep Learning
abstract: We propose a solution to the terahertz free-space path loss problem by proposing and experimentally validating a deep-learning model which can output leaky-wave antenna designs that emit multidirectional beam with a user-specified far-field pattern.

articleTitle: V-Shape PSF for 3D Wide Field Microscopy
abstract: We propose a V-shape PSF generated from double axicon lenses in the collection path of wide-field microscopes for 3D high-resolution imaging with an extended depth of field.

articleTitle: Highly efficient wide-angle blazed gratings enabled by metasurfaces
abstract: We experimentally realize a wide-angle blazed grating based on metasurfaces, with an average efficiency of 64% over a very large incident angle range from -80° to 45°, which is unique for wide-angle functionalities.

articleTitle: Ultrasensitive biodetection by a Functionalized terahertz plasmonic metasensor
abstract: An ultra-sensitive THz plasmonic biometasensor enabled by the quasi-BIC MD resonance combining with the functional colloidal AuNPs was reported, which is critical in research of non-destructive and rapid quantitative detection of extremely diluted (pM) solutions.

articleTitle: Hybrid Electro-Optic Crossbar Array for Matrix-Vector Multiplications
abstract: Photonic processors exploiting in-memory computing and wavelength multiplexing excel in calculating matrix-vector multiplications but are limited to small vector dimensions. We present a hybrid electro-optic crossbar array design which virtually increases the processable vector size.

articleTitle: Fluctuations of scattered intensity reveal shape information under structured illumination
abstract: We show that space-polarization structured fields provide means for tuning the sensitivity to particles anisotropy. The model is demonstrated experimentally using a novel technique for enforcing and controlling non-Gaussian scattering regimes.

articleTitle: Coherently driven active resonator frequency combs in the mid-infrared
abstract: Passive Kerr resonators enable agile frequency comb generators in the visible and the near-infrared. We demonstrate coherently driven integrated active ring resonators with an effective Kerr nonlinearity arising from gain saturation, paving the way to reconfigurable frequency combs in the mid-infrared.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocal transmission through metasurfaces with phase transition materials
abstract: We demonstrate nonreciprocal one-way transmission through a half-a-micron-thick nonlinear silicon-VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> metasurface for low-power CW excitation. Reciprocity is broken by optically self-induced phase transition of VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> occurring at different intensities for the opposite directions of illumination.

articleTitle: Waveguided sources of consistent, single-temporal-mode squeezed light: the good, the bad, and the ugly
abstract: We study how variations in pump brightness, for identical profiles, affect the temporal-mode structure of squeezed states generated by three different waveguided sources. Double-pass structures give optimal results in terms of indistinguishability and spectral purity.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade laser frequency comb tuning dynamics with rf-injection
abstract: We demonstrate precise control of quantum cascade laser frequency comb repetition rate through rf-injection. The observed optical frequency tuning of comb modes indicates completely different comb dynamics with rf-injection as compared to conventional current/thermal tuning.

articleTitle: Gate-Tuning Silicon Microring Resonator Filters for On-chip Wavelength Division Multiplexing
abstract: We demonstrated efficient gate-tuning on-chip wavelength division multiplexing filters using a silicon microring resonator array driven by high-mobility titanium-doped indium oxide gates. It shows extensive wavelength coverage for entire channel spacing over 5 nm.

articleTitle: Near-Zero-Index Conducting Oxides for Nonlinear Photonics
abstract: When used within the wavelength range of vanishing permittivity, transparent conducting oxides exhibit unprecedented optical nonlinearities. These untapped optical properties are potentially disruptive for a broad plethora of applications in both integrated and quantum photonics.

articleTitle: Photothermal nonlinearity in photocatalysis
abstract: We study the importance of nonlinear photothermal effects in plasmon-assisted photocatalysis and show that any claim for dominance of non-thermal electrons in plasmonassisted photocatalysis must account for this photothermal nonlinear mechanism.

articleTitle: High-Bandwidth Fourier-Transform Spectrometer Monolithically Integrated on Thin Film Lithium Niobate
abstract: We present a stationary-wave Fourier-transform spectrometer monolithically integrated on lithium niobate-on-insulator photonic circuits, with a resolution of 2.53 nm and an optical bandwidth limited solely by the waveguide single-mode condition.

articleTitle: Self-aligning Mach-Zehnder Interferometer based filter for intra-cavity tuning of InP integrated lasers
abstract: We demonstrate an automated routine steering an InP tunable filter over its free spectral range of 10nm. The routine is tested on a 8-arm Mach-Zehnder Interferometer, but can be conveniently extended to different tunable devices.

articleTitle: Cavity-Enhanced 2D Quantum Emitters Deterministically Integrated with Silicon Nitride Microresonators
abstract: A new platform for position and polarization aligned 2D single-photon emitter integration within background-free silicon-nitride microring resonator is presented. Emitters achieve a cavity-enhanced coupling efficiency of 46±4%, exceeding previous demonstration by over an order-of-magnitude.

Author Keywords: OCIS codes: (350.4238) Nanophotonics and photonic crystals

articleTitle: Modern Diode Pumped Solid State Lasers
abstract: A brief review of the advances in diode-pumped, Neodymium-doped, high-efficiency lasers is presented, showing how different configurations were able to achieve extremely elevated slope efficiencies, close to the quantum limit, while demonstrating excellent beam quality.

articleTitle: On Target Optimisation of the ELI-NP High Power Laser System
abstract: We report on the method used to tune the 10 PW High Power Laser System parameters for optimized laser-target interaction at the ELI-NP showing the possibility to reach the 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> irradiance level.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonics Optimized for High-capacity Transmission
abstract: Silicon photonics modulators are versatile, low-cost solutions for high-speed transmission. We must, however, look beyond standard metrics and focus on regimes where system performance can gain the most from digital signal processing.

articleTitle: Nanoscale Optical Mode Imaging and Spectroscopy of Dielectric Metasurfaces Based on the Bound State in Continuum
abstract: We use photoemission electron microscopy for hyperspectral imaging of electromagnetic field localization in broken-symmetry III-V semiconductor metasurfaces with high selectivity to characterize complex resonant mode profiles, determine coherent interaction lengths, and corroborate FDTD simulations.

articleTitle: Inter-vortex forward Brillouin scattering by chiral flexural phonons in twisted photonic crystal fibre
abstract: We report forward stimulated Brillouin scattering between orthogonal circularly polarized vortex modes in chiral photonic crystal fibre. The interaction is mediated by cork-screw-like flexural phonons, which provide both linear and orbital angular momentum.

articleTitle: Miniaturized and Thin Microscope with Learnable Real-time Reconstruction
abstract: We demonstrate a miniaturized and thin microscope using custom designed doublet microlens array and a deep learning based multi-stage reconstruction model. The microscope is capable of real-time fluorescent imaging at a large field of view.

articleTitle: 3D Nano-printed Coupler with Parabolic Reflectors
abstract: We show a low-loss, broadband self-aligning structure designed for coupling standard SMF28-fibre to chip with a 50µm aligning tolerance. A coupling loss of as low as 1.6dB is measured from fiber to the polymeric structure.

articleTitle: Cascaded-Mode Resonators
abstract: We introduce cascaded mode resonators. These are optical resonators where different transverse modes are coupled via a specific cascade to form a longitudinal super-mode with remarkable propagation properties and a modified resonance spectrum.

articleTitle: Geometric Surface Reconstruction Using Optical Coherence Tomography and Dynamic Trajectories
abstract: We use optical coherence tomography to reconstruct surface models of centimetre-scale objects using a geometric reconstruction technique with 12 micron resolution. Optimised scanning trajectories are generated automatically using visual hulls.

articleTitle: PT-symmetric AlGaAs Coupled DFB Lasers for Tunable THz Wave Generation
abstract: We report the design and fabrication of a PT-symmetric AlGaAs coupled DFB laser for THz beat frequency generation. The THz beat signal can be tuned by varying the gain contrast between the two DFB lasers.

articleTitle: 133 fs Pulses generated in Colliding-Pulse Mode-Locking, Enable Record χ2 Frequency Conversion
abstract: We demonstrate a colliding-pulse mode-locked Bragg reflection laser. Record short pulse widths of 133 femtoseconds exhibit high peak power of ~240 mW; thus enables a record difference frequency generation conversion efficiency of -38 dB.

articleTitle: Plasmonic Photochemical Process for Preparation of Metallic Nanopore Arrays
