abstract: We report a process for fabricating sub-10 nm nanopores via photocatalysis caused by electromagnetic field enhancement in plasmonic structures, which immersed in metallic salt solutions triggers hotspots for metallic deposition causing pore diameter shrinkage.

articleTitle: Neural Networks for Fiber Amplifier Design Optimization using Experimental Training Sets
abstract: We use a neural network trained from experimental cut-back measurements of a doped fiber. With fast, accurate predictions of noise figure and gain, we find optimal fiber length and pumping strategy for an amplified link.

articleTitle: SiP based Hybrid Digital and Analog RoF mmWave 5G Transmission for Converged Optical Access Networks
abstract: We demonstrate hybrid optical-access by transmission of a signal constituting baseband PAM-8, 10GHz WiGig and 27GHz 5GNR waveforms over a 10km RoF link and observe lowest BER of 1.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>(PAM-8) and EVMs of 6.5%(WiGig) and 5.1%(5GNR).

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal observation and manipulation of nonlinear optical waves in single-shot using a recirculating fiber loop
abstract: We present experiments realized in a synchronously phase-modulated recirculating fiber loop demonstrating the possibility to manipulate the spatiotemporal dynamics of nonlinear waves. Temporal quadratic phase modulations are shown to either expulse or trap solitons.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast Germanium Photodiodes (invited)
abstract: A Ge-fin photodetector with unprecedented opto-electrical 3-dB bandwidths up to 265 GHz is demonstrated. Here, we review our work on ultra-fast Ge photodiodes and the versatility of our novel Ge-fin device concept.

articleTitle: Entire Transmission Matrix retrieval through multimode fiber in a reference-less optical system
abstract: We experimentally combine Generalized Gerchberg-Saxton algorithm with Scanning Focused Output method to retrieve entire transmission matrix of a multimode fiber in one-shot without the use of a reference-arm. Using the transmission matrix, we perform applications such as multi-focus and pattern projection.

articleTitle: Efficient Collection and Detection of Color Center Emission in Triangular Nanophotonic Geometry of Silicon Carbide
abstract: Angle-etching fabrication produces state-of-the-art color center triangular nanophotonic devices. We uncover how the photonic band gap is formed in the triangular geometry and utilized for efficient detection from SiC waveguide into overlaid NbTiN detectors.

articleTitle: Non-monotonic Wavelength Sweep Method of a Sampled Grating Distributed Bragg Reflector Laser for Use in Low-Cost Swept-Source Interferometry
abstract: A method of non-monotonically tuning the wavelength of a sampled grating distributed Bragg reflector laser enabling higher speed modulation is proposed. Significant improvements in sweep resolution and stability over a monotonic sweep are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical Ramsey Spectroscopy on a Single Organic Molecule
abstract: We implement optical Ramsey spectroscopy to investigate the properties of single molecule coherence under cryogenic conditions. Our Ramsey method allows for research on a single molecule even under frequency-detuned conditions.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Hyperspectral Microscopy with Broadband 1-GHz Dual-Comb Spectroscopy
abstract: We utilize a 1-GHz mid-infrared dual comb spectrometer for high speed and broadband hyperspectral imaging. The system covers 1000 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> at λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> = 3.4 μm with 13.47 kHz acquisition rate and 4 μm spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable RF Frequency Sniffer Using Tunable Micro Ring Resonator
abstract: A power-efficient, silicon photonic-based sniffer chip with tunable cascaded ring resonators is used for real-time spectrum sensing of millimeter-wave carrier signals, enabling reconfigurable temporal discrimination using peak group delay and frequency-to-time mapping.

articleTitle: Coulomb-Enhanced Multi-Photon Processes in Quantum Materials
abstract: Theory for multi-photon processes is presented to determine extreme nonlinear effects in quantum materials. Our systematic quantum theory predicts that Coulombic many-body effects massively enhance high harmonics and multi-photon absorption.

articleTitle: Using online polarized Raman spectroscopy and extinction for quantitative and qualitative measurements of mini-CAST soot
abstract: Online Raman scattering and in situ extinction measurement were combined in this work for qualitative and quantitative evaluations of various soot in the aerosol phase with different organic compounds.

articleTitle: Low Volume Gas Sensing using Hollow-core Fiber for Detection of Methane and Ammonia with Supercontinuum Source
abstract: Hollow-core fiber based detection of C H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and N H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> is demonstrated using a broadband supercontinuum laser source. The system provided a minimum detection limit of 0.49 % and 0.22 % for CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> in 1.6 µm and 2µm wavelength ranges, respectively.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Coupling of Light to Plasmons through Engineered Dipolar Scatterers
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate high coupling of light to surface polaritons by means of an optimized scatterer placed at a suitable distance from a polariton-supporting surface. Specifically, we consider poorly-absorbing gold disks acting as nearly-perfect resonant scatterers, which we separate from a gold film by means of a dielectric silica spacer. This configuration leads to resonant coupling between externally incident light and plasmon polaritons in the film with associated cross sections that approach and surpass the fundamental limit ~λ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> imposed by the light wavelength λ. Our method introduces a disruptive, efficient way to solve the in/out-coupling problem in nanophotonics.

articleTitle: Plasmonic Phase-Gradient Image Sensors
abstract: We report plasmonic metasurface photodetectors featuring a strong asymmetric angular response around normal incidence that can visualize transparent phase objects with high sensitivity in a simple and compact imaging setup.

articleTitle: Laser Integration on Photonic Integrated Circuit for High Bandwidth Data Transmission
abstract: The progress of laser integration on integrated photonics is reported with high vertical alignment precision and enhanced horizontal misalignment tolerance. Also, photonic architecture for high data rate transmission on tera bits per second is presented.

articleTitle: High-order mode frequency-shifted feedback laser based on acoustically-induced fiber grating
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a high-order mode fiber laser of mode-locking based on frequency-shifted feedback mechanism in which frequency shift and mode conversion are achieved by using an acoustically-induced fiber grating.

articleTitle: Dispersion control with integrated plasmonic metasurfaces
abstract: We present a miniaturized pulse shaping device that creates an arbitrary dispersion through the interaction of multiple metasurfaces on less than 2 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> volume. For this, a metalens and a grating-metasurface between two silver mirrors are fabricated. The grating contains further phase information to achieve the device's pulse shaping functionality.

articleTitle: Efficient Intermodal Four-Wave Mixing in AlGaAs-on-Insulator Waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate cross-polarized four-wave mixing with a conversion efficiency of -31.5 dB in a 2.5-mm-long AlGaAs-on-insulator waveguide with 80-mW pumping. We report the highest effective nonlinearity (278 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>) for intermodal four-wave mixing in integrated waveguides.

articleTitle: Topological guidance of vortices by disclination
abstract: We report the first experimental realization of topological guidance of optical vortices by disclination in a photonic topological crystalline insulator. Both singly- and doubly-charged vortex beams remain robust during propagation, manifesting protected zero-energy modes.

articleTitle: Four-Wave-Mixing controlled by Self-Phase-Modulation of chirped pulses
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate how a concatenation of standard and microstructure fiber segments permits to shift the Four-Wave-Mixing sidebands when changing the chirp of the input pulsed pump. The blue shifted sideband can span over 200nm.

articleTitle: High-quality Integrated Chalcogenide Microring Resonators for Efficient Brillouin lasers
abstract: We report an integrated GeSbS microring resonator with intrinsic quality factors of more than 5 million, first demonstrating a Brillouin laser with fundamental linewidth of 143 Hz and an output power up to 1 mW.

articleTitle: Compact RF photonic notch filter based on heterogeneous integration of As2S3 with active silicon photonic circuits
abstract: We heterogeneously integrate As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> Brillouin waveguides and Si modulators, enabling a compact chip-based RF photonic filter with 50 dB rejection. This level of photonic integration facilitates novel on-chip processing, increasing RF gain by 16 dB.

articleTitle: A Simplified Soft-output MLSE Concatenated with LDPC Decoding in 112-Gb/s PAM-4 Transmissions
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a simplified soft-output MLSE and LDPC decoding in a 112-Gb/s PAM-4 signal transmission over 2-km SSMF. We achieve almost the same performance as conventional soft-output MLSE with 49.6% complexity reduce.

articleTitle: Photon Bunching in Cathodoluminescence Induced by Indirect Electron Excitation
abstract: We report substantial changes in cathodoluminescence photon bunching with aloof or plasmon-mediated electron-excitation pathways. This result is critical to the interpretation of g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(τ) cathodoluminescence microscopies and to the near-field optical characterization of beam-sensitive materials.

articleTitle: Two-photon absorption of squeezed light by rubidium atoms: Will Doppler do us in?
abstract: We calculate the two-photon absorption of squeezed light by rubidium atoms. In the region of large enhancement, Doppler broadening significantly decreases the effectiveness of photon correlations, leading to the prediction of unspectacular fluorescence counts.

articleTitle: Bandwidth enhancement with high nonlinear effect in Silicon Photonics Micro-ring Modulator
abstract: A highly nonlinear effect in high optical power excitation for high-speed operation has been found in a small footprint Si photonic ring modulator. The -3dB bandwidth of 21GHz at linear region can be improved to above 40GHz and >50Gb/s by power-dependent chirp.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable high-contrast optical modulator based on the phase transition of vanadium dioxide
abstract: We designed and demonstrated an electrically controllable optical switch enabled by the phase transition of thin-film vanadium dioxide integrated with metallic aperture antennas that serve as both a frequency-selective surface and a microheater.

articleTitle: Circulator-free Thin-film Lithium Niobate Dispersion Compensator Using Chirped Bragg Grating
abstract: We demonstrate an on-chip lithium niobate dispersion compensator based on chirped Bragg grating and multimode interferometer structure, featuring a dispersion value of 390 ps/nm/ m in a length of 0.54 mm, covering a 45 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Ranging Using Soliton Microcombs with Tunable Repetition Rate
abstract: We propose a method of tuning the repetition rate of soliton microcombs by temperature. The tunable range reaches 12 MHz. The trade-off between acquisition rate and precision of ranging systems is overcome without additional barrier.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal laser on thin film erbium-doped lithium niobate
abstract: We fabricated a photonic crystal nanobeam cavity with dual resonance on erbium-doped thin film lithium niobate by FIB, which supports on-chip photonic crystal laser at 1540 nm when pumped by a 1460 nm laser.

articleTitle: Integrated Software Model for Design, Optimization, and Reverse Engineering of High-Power Laser Systems
abstract: Modeling chirped-pulse amplification (CPA)- and nonlinear optics (NLO)-based systems is crucial to advance CPA+NLO design and optimization. We present a modular and expandable start-to-end model for engineering and reverse engineering CPA+NLO systems.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of a Shallow Ridge InP Traveling-Wave MZI Modulator for 200 Gb/s Data Transmission
abstract: We propose a shallow ridge InP-based traveling-wave Mach-Zehnder modulator with optimized electrode and gradient-doped cladding layer for high-speed performance, capable of 200 Gb/s data transmission with simplified fabrication process and improved reliability.

articleTitle: Quantum nondemolition measurements with optical parametric amplifiers for ultrafast quantum information processing
abstract: We show that quantum nondemolition measurements using an optical parametric amplifier can be a universal tool for ultrafast quantum information processing, enabling, photon-number-resolving measurements and deterministic generation of Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) states.

articleTitle: Multimode nonlinear optical fiber calorimetry
abstract: We show that the thermodynamic approach is able to predict the nonlinear interaction forces among different, orthogonally polarized photon gases in optical fibers. Calorimetry experiments demonstrate the validity of the second principle of thermodynamics.

articleTitle: Unipolar pulse generation from heterostructure charging dynamics
abstract: General charging theory is presented for quantum heterostructures and terahertz emission. Theory–experiment demonstration of 0.45 cycle pulse yields record unipolarity, 4:1 ratio between positive and negative half-cycles.

articleTitle: Terabit Ultra-high-speed NFDM Transmission over G.654E Fiber with 103Gbaud Probabilistic Shaped 64QAM Signals
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a record ultra-high-speed 1.004 Tb/s dual-polarization NFDM transmission system over 300 km G.654E fiber with probabilistic shaped 64QAM signals, achieving a spectral efficiency at 7.65 b/s/Hz by employing continuous nonlinear spectrum.

articleTitle: Quantum imaging using entangled photon pairs from nonlinear metasurfaces
abstract: We present a combined quantum ghost and scanning imaging protocol allowing 2D imaging with 1D detector array, enabled by strong spatial correlations and tunable emission angle of entangled photon pairs emitted from ultrathin nonlinear metasurfaces.

articleTitle: Laser frequency microcombs for discrete-wavelength optical coherence tomography
abstract: We examine frequency comb states for their viability as a discrete-wavelength light source for optical coherence tomography systems. We compare resulting tomograms and with the quality factor and mTCI tomogram parameters.

articleTitle: Novel structural temperature sensor base on microfiber coil resonator modified by MXene Nb2C
abstract: We report a spatial structure all-fiber temperature sensor based on MXene Nb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>C modified microfiber coil resonator with a free spectral range of 0.391 nm and a sensitivity of 123.2 pm/°C. We highlight the potential of space-structured all-fiber devices in the field of sensors.

articleTitle: Single-cavity dual-comb modelocking and applications
abstract: We show that dual-comb laser sources with two optical frequency combs with different comb spacings are of high interest for many applications. Our group pioneered single-cavity dual-comb modelocking with polarization or spatial multiplexing which enabled record low-noise performance with high average power from diode-pumped Yb-doped solid-state lasers and optically pumped semiconductor lasers.

articleTitle: Single-photon path entanglement based on integrated silicon photonics
abstract: A silicon photonic platform with high-speed single-photon entanglement generation and detection is demonstrated using decoy state source and homodyne detection. A CHSH Bell violation test is performed on-chip, showing a violation lower bound of 2.59.

articleTitle: Deflection of Ultrashort Pulse Laser (USPL) Supercontinuum Generation by USPL-Generated Surface Craters on Fused Silica
abstract: Laser-induced damage practically limits supercontinuum generation in transparent solids with ultrashort pulse lasers (USPL). We investigate how supercontinuum light from fused silica changes as the incident intensity increases through the ablation threshold.

articleTitle: Thermally insensitive Kerr microresonator soliton comb
abstract: We numerally demonstrate a thermally insensitive Kerr microresonator soliton comb via the control of the avoided mode crossing, in which the thermo-refractive effect, self-Raman frequency shift, higher-order dispersion, and avoided-mode crossing are balanced.

articleTitle: Dual-pumped degenerate optical parametric oscillation in triple-state photonic molecules
abstract: We demonstrate degenerate optical parametric oscillation in a triple-state silicon nitride photonic molecule. DOPO is generated with a phase-coherent dual-tone pump scheme, and the phase-matching conditions are optimized by tuning the resonances with microheaters.

articleTitle: Non-planar growth of high Al-mole-fraction AlGaN heterostructures on patterned GaN substrates for UV LEDs and Laser Diodes
abstract: Non-planar growth of thick AlGaN layers on patterned GaN substrates was investigated to suppress cracking of III-Nitride heterostructures. Preliminary devices with promising characteristics for achieving high-performance UV LEDs and laser diodes were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Feedback Enhanced Phonon Lasing in Cavity Optomechanics
abstract: We demonstrate an enhanced phonon lasing using measurement-based feedback. Our scheme results in a ~50% increase in phonons for a GHz frequency diamond microdisk and expands the toolbox for spin-optomechanics with solid-state defect qubits.

articleTitle: Mid-Wave Infrared Black Phosphorus Photodetector Enhanced by an Integrated Metasurface Grating
abstract: We designed, fabricated, and characterized mid-wave infrared black phosphorus photodetectors with integrated metal-insulator-metal metasurface gratings. We show that our metasurface grating increases responsivity by ~7 times at room temperature.

articleTitle: Advancing Kerr Microresonator Optical Parametric Oscillators for Chip-based Laser Systems Across the Visible and Near-infrared
abstract: We report chip-integrated Kerr optical parametric oscillators with emission wavelengths between 590 nm and 1150 nm and conversion efficiencies reaching 15%. We further demonstrate photonic-crystal-mediated devices with >99.7% as-fabricated output wavelength accuracy.

articleTitle: Passive On-Chip Nonlinear Optical Isolator
abstract: We demonstrate fully passive optical isolators in silicon nitride nanophotonics using the intrinsic Kerr nonlinearity. These devices achieve up to 35dB isolation and can serve to both stabilize and isolate on-chip lasers.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared dual-comb spectroscopy for high-speed chemical kinetics measurements in a shock tube
abstract: We report high-speed measurements of chemical kinetics reactions inside a shock tube using a 1-GHz repetition rate mid-infrared dual-comb spectrometer. We show formation of formaldehyde and sub-sequent decomposition to carbon-monoxide with 17.5 μs time resolution.

articleTitle: Lithium-ion Battery Electrolyte Leakage Detection via ZIF-8 Functionalized Microfiber
abstract: We proposed a microfiber with ZIF-8 coatings for lithium-ion battery electrolyte leakage detection at ppm level, with a sensitivity of 4.5 pm/ppm and a detection limit of 43 ppm in the 0-800 ppm range.

articleTitle: Bosonic Interference in a Three-Level System
abstract: We demonstrate two-photon interference of three frequency modes via three-pump Bragg-scattering four-wave mixing in analogy to a three-level system. Correlated photon input pairs display distinct behavior from that of coherent-state input fields.

articleTitle: Upper Bounds on Reflective Metasurfaces
abstract: Universal bounds for maximal reflected power from planar structures are identified for any direction and polarization. Examples are given of the implications of these results for the design of ultra-thin reflectors and metasurface-based reflective gratings.

articleTitle: Non-local quantum metrology with entangled photons and geometric phase
abstract: We demonstrate a new protocol of non-local quantum metrology in which the sample displacement is measured with entangled photon pairs by manipulating the geometric phase of the photon that has never interacted with the sample.

articleTitle: Supersymmetric Compactification and Higher-Dimensional Rearrangement of Photonic Lattices
abstract: Self-imaging photonic lattices enable perfect transfer of quantum and classical states, yet are challenging to implement at scale. We harness supersymmetry to engineer compacted two-dimensional systems exhibiting equivalent characteristics and experimentally investigate their dynamics.

articleTitle: Broadband Infrared Emission from Single-Mode Silicon Waveguides
abstract: We describe the first observation of electrically-pumped infrared emission in single-mode silicon waveguides. Recombination in a p-i-n diode generates broadband emission, which is sufficiently bright for photonic integrated circuit spectroscopy and sensing.

articleTitle: Experimental symmetric private information retrieval with measurement-device-independent quantum network
abstract: We report the first realisation of a provably-secure symmetric private information retrieval (SPIR) scheme supported by a quantum-secure key-exchange network, offering secure retrieval of fingerprint data from a database with 800 entries.

articleTitle: High-secure and Wide-range Access Networks Based on Asymmetric Sending-or-not-sending Quantum Key Distribution over Multicore Fiber
abstract: We design a high-secure and wide-range access network combining asymmetric sending-or-not-sending quantum key distribution over multicore fiber. Channel allocation schemes are proposed to balance overall performance and fairness among optical network units.

articleTitle: Nanophotonics Beyond Passivity Limitations Using Complex Frequency Excitations
abstract: Non-monochromatic excitations oscillating at complex frequencies can overcome the limits imposed by passivity. We discuss a few examples in which this approach can be successfully implemented in nanophotonic platforms.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Carrier-Envelope Phase Detection in PHz Electronic Networks
abstract: We report single-shot detection of the carrier-envelope phase of few-cycle mid-infrared waveforms using petahertz electronic networks. Leveraging large-area networks, we demonstrate a charge amplitude of 2,500 electrons per shot, enabling the detection at the full laser repetition rate of 50 kHz.

articleTitle: An integrated Si3N4 Row Decoder Circuit for Addressable Optical RAM Banks
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally an integrated Si3N4 photonic 2x4 Row Decoder that utilizes a MRR-based wavelength filtering bank for successfully addressing one out of four RAM rows within an optical RAM bank architecture.

articleTitle: Ultra-bright non-classical light sources based on single InAs/GaAs quantum dot embedded in a hybrid plasmonic nanopillar cavity
abstract: We demonstrate a Purcell-enhanced single photon source based on individual InAs/GaAs quantum dots embedded in a hybrid plasmonic-GaAs nanopillar cavity.

articleTitle: Fully Epitaxial AlN on Si using Molecular Beam Epitaxy Grown Nanowires for Ultraviolet Photonics
abstract: This work focuses on the development of high quality fully epitaxial AlN on Si template using MBE grown nanowires. Vertical AlGaN deep UV LED devices are also demonstrated as an example application of the template.

articleTitle: Photonic Spatial-Euler Ising Machine for Solving 20000-vertex Max-cut Problem
abstract: We propose a novel quadrature photonic spatial-Euler Ising machine to realize flexible spin-interaction configuration and spin-flip in a single SLM. A 20000-vertex max-cut problem is experimentally solved, showing 80% improvement compared to simulation results and 49% over heuristic algorithm.

articleTitle: Direct Imaging of Band Structure in Twisted Bilayer Photonic Crystal Slabs
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication of a twisted bilayer photonic crystal and direct imaging of its photonic band structure across the telecom band. The experimental results are in good agreement with theory.

articleTitle: Lithium Niobite on Silicon High Speed Spatial Light Modulator
abstract: We present a device of thin film lithium niobite integrated on a CMOS backplane, enhanced by a high quality factor guided mode resonance. The device offers GHz speed and megapixel degrees-of-freedom spatial light modulation.

articleTitle: Dissipative light bullet attractor in a passive coherently driven multimode Kerr cavity
abstract: We show the existence of stable light bullets and breathers in a coherently driven, passive multimode Kerr cavity with a three-dimensional potential. Bullet stabilisation is possible due to the temporal component of the potential.

articleTitle: Electrically Tunable Single Photon Brightness and Purity in Multilayer GaSe
abstract: We control the purity, lifetime, and brightness of strain-localized GaSe single photon emitters with electrostatic doping. At the charge neutrality point, these parameters are improved by 50%, 21%, and 43% respectively compared to ungated emitters.

articleTitle: Characterization of femtosecond laser-written waveguides in silicon
abstract: We characterize laser-written waveguides in silicon versus the inscription parameters such as scanning speed and pulse energy. The analysis is carried out at different wavelengths and polarization states. Finally, the silicon sample is annealed to investigate the possible mechanism that leads to positive refractive index changes.

articleTitle: Topologically protected polarization singularities in four dimensions
abstract: We design and experimentally demonstrate a new type of topologically protected polarization singularity using metasurfaces. The singularity is placed in the four-dimensional space formed by the three Cartesian spatial dimensions and the wavelength of light.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact Bimodal Interferometric Plasmonic Sensor Integrated on a Polymeric Photonic Waveguide Platform
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-compact bimodal interferometric plasmonic refractive index sensor co-integrated for the first time on a SU-8 photonic waveguide platform. After optimization process the proposed sensor exhibited an experimental sensitivity of 4464 nm/RIU.

articleTitle: Tamm Mode-Aided Amplified Spontaneous Emission in One-Dimensional Photonic Crystal Super-Tamm Structure
abstract: The optical Tamm mode-aided amplified spontaneous emission in a super-Tamm structure consisting of a silver (Ag) thin film deposited on dye-doped polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) layer coated on a SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> one-dimensional photonic crystal structure is presented.

articleTitle: Fluorescence Excitation of Quantum Dots by Entangled Two-Photon Absorption
abstract: A photon pair source based on nonlinear waveguides was used to investigate fluorescence excitation of quantum dots. We present a comprehensive study of entangled absorption behavior by varying experimental quantities and following latest theoretical insights.

articleTitle: Engineering dimensionality of collective dipole-dipole interactions using a nanophotonic environment
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate reduced dimensionality in a interacting ensemble of emitters. The well-known stretched exponential decay dynamics, I(t)/I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> = exp(−γ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</inf>t)exp(−αt<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">β</sup>) with β = 0.5 in 3D geometries, is strikingly modified in a nanophotonic environment that supports long-range interaction to β ∼ 0.3

articleTitle: Direct observation of dynamics of photonic bound states
abstract: We observe strong interaction between individual optical photons mediated by a single quantum dot. The nonlinear interaction results in dispersion for single-photon states and two-photon states.

articleTitle: Large Dispersion Silicon Bragg Grating with Integrated Phase Shifter Array
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon photonic Bragg grating waveguide with a large dispersion of ‑146 ps/nm and 171 GHz bandwidth. Using an integrated phase shifter array, the grating is tuned to reduce ripple nearly threefold.

articleTitle: Data-driven Broadband Achromatic Metalens via First-principle End-to-end Inverse Design
abstract: We present a first-principle end-to-end design framework for metalens corrected at 20 equispaced frequencies in the visible range (380 ~ 700 nm), with a record-value of image reconstruction error of 1.1 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>5.

articleTitle: Sensing air-water interfaces using perfect optical vortices
abstract: Upon interaction with inhomogeneous media, high-order optical vortices divide into canonical ones. We demonstrate experimentally that this phenomenon can be used to characterize dynamic air-water interfaces.

articleTitle: Non-Hermiticity-Governed Active Photonic Resonances
abstract: We depart from the notion of passive photonic resonance to study unique quantization conditions for non-Hermitian systems that lead to a novel type of resonance whose frequency shifts over wide ranges as optical gain increases.

articleTitle: A heterogeneously integrated lithium niobate-on-silicon nitride photonic platform
abstract: We present a LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> integrated photonic platform with wafer-scale bonding to a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> photonic circuit. The platform exhibits <0.1 dB/cm propagation loss and <2.5 dB/facet fiber-chip coupling loss. We demonstrate phase shifters, frequency-agile lasers, optical splitters, and other devices.

articleTitle: Breakdown of the Einstein relation in 1D excitonic guides
abstract: Drift-diffusion dynamics of a 1D excitonic guide is investigated at room temperature. We demonstrate an unexpected and massive deviation from the Einstein relation and correlate it with the exciton capture processes at defects in tungsten diselenide monolayer.

articleTitle: Non-local optical response in quantum materials
abstract: The optical response of quantum materials under low-intensity illumination is interesting and remains unexplored. We had shown nonlinear effects in 1T-TaS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, a charge-ordered material. Here, we extend our model to include nonlocal optical effects.

articleTitle: Dynamic Single-Cavity Dual-Comb Fiber Laser for Rapid Nonlinear Metrology
abstract: We demonstrate a dynamic single-cavity dual-comb fiber laser for rapid time-domain metrology. By dynamically modulating repetition rate difference using pump power, measurement speed has been enhanced by hundreds of times without sacrificing the measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing terahertz quantum cascade laser emission by breaking the dipole approximation
abstract: We show that transitions in quantum cascade lasers (QCLs) can achieve substantial beyond-dipole enhancements, which we quantify using macroscopic quantum electrodynamics for specially designed cavities and graphene waveguides.

articleTitle: A New Optoelectronic Switch using the Coupling between Two Lasers Assisted by a Capacitor Voltage
abstract: The superposition of two coherent cw-TEM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</inf> laser beams on glass surface can lock the weak beam on vibratory dipoles. A voltage set across the dielectric can be a switch ON/OFF for releasing the weak beam.

articleTitle: Möbius strip microlasers: Quantum chaos on curved surfaces
abstract: Möbius strip microlasers are fabricated by direct laser writing. Experiments and 3D FDTD numerical simulations evidence that laser modes propagate along periodic geodesics, a geodesic being the shortest path between two points on a surface.

articleTitle: Synthesizing ultrashort wave packets with broadband topological-spectral correlations
abstract: We introduce shaping and characterization methods for femtosecond space-time beams with broadband correlations between their topological charges (up to ℓ = 80) and spectral frequencies (covering nearly 50% of the visible spectrum).

articleTitle: A Selective Benzene, Acetylene, and Carbon Dioxide Sensor near 14.84 μm
abstract: A laser sensor is developed for selective sensing of benzene, acetylene, and carbon dioxide, based on a newly developed QCL near 14.84 μm. TDLAS and multidimensional linear regression were employed to enable interference-free measurements.

articleTitle: Out-Of-Equilibrium Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy
abstract: We develop the general formalism that describes the inelastic scattering of free electrons by out-of-equilibrium materials. Utilizing modulated electrons further reveals previously inaccessible information and enables direct imaging of quantum wavefunctions.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Attachment with Displacement to Bend Transducer
abstract: We propose optical fiber attachment with displacement to bend transducers towards mechanical sensing applications exploiting bend loss. Our prototype in 18 x 8 x 5 mm is successfully reported to convert 1.0 mm displacement into 31 dB bending loss.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Three Types Subcarrier for Nonlinear Frequency Division Multiplexing System
abstract: We compare the performance of Hermite-Gaussian, root-raised-cosine and sinc-based carriers in NFDM systems. Results show that sinc-based carriers and HG subcarriers are more suitable for broadband and narrowband systems respectively.

articleTitle: Robust laser diagnostics of internal combustion exhaust gases for application directly behind the exhaust turbo system
abstract: Stronger regulatory emission requirements of the recent years have led to a wave of hybridization in the automotive sector, aiming to reduce harmful emissions by load balancing the internal combustion engine during real driving scenarios. In this work we present a robust multispecies measurement system, capable of quantitatively measuring selected gas species behind the exhaust turbo with high temporal resolution, thus able to identify critical operation points for the hybrid drive train. The application of the TDLAS (tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopy) based sensor head will be shown and subsequently discussed regarding the performance and robustness of the system.

articleTitle: Singly-Resonant Mid-IR Optical Parametric Oscillator in Lithium Niobate Nanophotonics
abstract: We demonstrate a singly-resonant optical parametric oscillator pumped near 1 µm that generates telecom signal light and mid-infrared idler light near 3 µm using thin-film lithium niobate-on-sapphire integrated photonics.

articleTitle: Microring-based programmable coherent optical neural networks
abstract: We design, simulate, and train a coherent optical neural network fully based on microring resonators including the linear multiplication and the reconfigurable nonlinear activation components, which shows advantages in terms of device footprint and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: 1D Photonic-Crystal Laser with Laterally-Current-Injected Ultrasmall Buried Active Region on SiO2/Si Substrate
abstract: One-dimensional photonic-crystal lasers with 2.5-μm-long buried active regions are fabricated on SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si substrate. The rib-shaped structure enables lateral-current-injection, high-Q cavity, and strong optical confinement. The device exhibits 13.0-μA threshold current and 28.0% external differential-quantum-efficiency.

articleTitle: Crystallinity investigation of poorly soluble drugs dispersed in paper using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
abstract: We use terahertz time-domain spectroscopy for non-destructive crystallinity investigation of poorly soluble drugs loaded into paper. Our results underline the great potential of terahertz spectroscopy as an analytical tool to study pharmaceutical formulations.

articleTitle: Scalable Optical Control for Atomic System using Integrated Acousto-Optic Beam Steering
abstract: We demonstrate a scalable integrated acousto-optic beam steering (AOBS) technique on the lithium niobate on insulator (LNOI) platform, realizing visible-light continuous beam steering with a single microwave drive.

articleTitle: Multispectral Routers for Snapshot Spectral Imaging
abstract: We introduce multispectral routers for snapshot spectral imaging. Multispectral routers, unlike filters, do not reject light to select spectral content and can achieve ideal spectral selectivity without loss of photons within a wavelength size footprint.

articleTitle: MXene-deposited elliptical microfiber knot resonator for temperature sensing
abstract: We demonstrate an all-fiber temperature sensor based on an MXene-deposited elliptical microfiber knot resonator, showing a large free spectral range of 8.8 nm and a high sensitivity of 3.5 dB/°C. Our work highlights the potential of MXene-based elliptical microfiber knot resonator for sensing.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Nanofabrication of Large-scale Indium Tin Oxide (ITO) Optical Devices
abstract: The ITO film patterning rate is largely limited by traditional single-point scanning. In this work, we used a DMD-based multi-focus nanofabrication system, which realized high-speed flexible large-scale ITO surface patterning to manufacture optical devices.

articleTitle: Large-area InP laterally grown on SOI for Micro-lasers and Fabry-Perot lasers
abstract: Tuning the initial growth conditions of the low-temperature-InP (LT-InP) nucleation layer, we grew large-area InP laterally on SOI wafers using lateral aspect ratio trapping (LART) with high crystalline quality, on which small micro-lasers and large Fabry-Perot (FP) lasers with low lasing thresholds were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Uncooled Silicon-based Terahertz Metamaterial Photodetectors with Ultrafast Response
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an ultrafast terahertz detector based on n-type doped silicon at room temperature, based on the enhanced response from metamaterials. This strategy opens new possibilities in the development of integrated terahertz devices.

articleTitle: From quantum matter to quantum light in strongly driven many-body systems
abstract: We build a quantum optical theory of strongly-driven many-body systems. We find that quantum correlated emitters result in strongly nonclassical emission, opening a new path towards generating quantum light and characterizing quantum correlated matter.

articleTitle: Substrate-Independent Technique of III-V Heterogeneous Integration of Focal Plane Arrays and Lasers
abstract: We report on a two-step technique for post-bond III-V substrate removal involving precision mechanical milling and selective chemical etching. We show results on GaAs, GaSb, InP, and InAs substrates and from mm-scale chips to wafers.

articleTitle: Fast and Sensitive THz Detection by an Asymmetric-Dual-Grating-Gate Epitaxial-Graphene-Channel FET Due to Plasmonic and Photothermoelectric Rectification Effects
abstract: We experimentally investigate an epitaxial-graphene-channel FET THz detector demonstrated a 10-ps-order fast response time and a high responsivity of 0.3 mA/W at room temperature. We also identify coexisting of both plasmonic and photothermoelectric rectification effects.

articleTitle: Low-Loss High-Density Inverse-Designed Structures for High Power Signal Routing on Integrated Silicon Photonics Foundry Platforms
abstract: We present inverse-designed compact multi-mode structures (bend, mode converter, and taper) for single-mode operation to enable low-loss, high power, and high-density signal routing with a demonstrated bend insertion loss of 0.48 dB on commercial foundry platforms.

articleTitle: Observation of Spectral Reorganization of Space-time Wavepackets in Dispersive Materials
abstract: We observe for the first time, the rich structural spatio-temporal dynamics of propagation invariant space-time wave packets which exist in normal and anomalous dispersive mediums.

articleTitle: Field Effect Modulation using Transparent Conductive Oxides and Multilayer Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
abstract: External optical modulators with surface normal geometry using transition metal dichalcogenides and transparent conductive oxides are being developed in this work based on exciton physics and charge accumulation property respectively upon application of electrical bias.

articleTitle: High Spatial Resolution Terahertz Time-Domain Imaging of Murine Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Tissues
abstract: We developed a terahertz time-domain spectroscopy system to generate high-resolution 2-dimensional images of paraffin-embedded murine pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma tissues using the refractive index and absorption coefficient as imaging markers and compared them with histopathological images.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics in a high-index sputtered oxide
abstract: We present niobium tantalum oxide as a material for nonlinear integrated photonics. Propagation losses of 0.47 dB/cm are extracted from high-Q resonators. The nonlinear performance is demonstrated through optical parametric oscillation and supercontinuum generation.

articleTitle: Synchronization of Pulsating Optical Soliton Molecules
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the synchronization of regularly vibrating soliton molecules by means of an injected modulated signal. We also unveil the existence of chaotic intramolecular vibrations, to which we successfully apply a similar control strategy.

articleTitle: 40-Pulse Time-Multiplexed Nanophotonic Optical Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We implement a 40-pulse, time-multiplexed optical parametric oscillator in thin-film lithium niobate nanophotonics and demonstrate the independent phase behavior of the pulses in the degenerate and non-degenerate regimes, enabling scalable optical computers and complex simulators.

articleTitle: Programmable Photonic Crystal Multimode Cavities using Electromechanical Tuning
abstract: We propose a new design concept for programmable multimode cavities based on a transfer matrix approach. Our numerical results predict tunable energy-matched four-wave-mixing over several nanometers of bandwidth with practical design parameters.

articleTitle: Perfect Waveguide Coupler Using Transformation Optics
abstract: We propose a perfect waveguide coupler in the PEC waveguide based on transformation optics and universal impedance matching theory. The coupler shows no reflection independent of frequency, mode, tapering length, and shape of cross-sections.

articleTitle: Rapid Multiplex Ultrafast Nonlinear Microscopy for Advanced Material Characterization
abstract: We demonstrate rapid four-wave mixing (FWM) imaging to assess the quality of emerging optical and electronic materials. We show that FWM intensity, dephasing times, and excited state lifetimes are accurate sample quality indicators.

articleTitle: Multi-Octave, Multi-Mode Deep-Strong Light-Matter Interaction
abstract: Coupling multiple, highly non-resonant cavity and electronic modes, we reach unprecedented coupling strengths equivalent to Ω<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">R</inf>/ω<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf>=3.19. The new regime features over 10 polaritons spanning 6 octaves and vacuum ground state populations exceeding 1 photon.

articleTitle: Broadband Sensing with Undetected Photons with Strong Parametric Amplification
abstract: We develop an SU(1,1) interferometer with an aperiodically-poled LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> crystal in the high-parametric-gain regime to demonstrate Fourier-transform spectroscopy and optical coherence tomography with undetected photons.

articleTitle: Broadband Quantum Memory in Atomic Barium Vapor with 95% Storage Efficiency
abstract: We measure 95.6±0.3% storage efficiency of ultrafast photons in a collisionally broadened barium vapor quantum memory. We measure 31±1% total efficiency, limited by control field power, and a 0.515(6) ns lifetime, limited by motional dephasing.

articleTitle: A Programmable Qudit-based Quantum Processor
abstract: We designed, fabricated, and characterized a programmable qudit-based quantum processor on silicon. We implemented several quantum algorithms with qudits, showing the logarithmic speed-up, photon detection rate enhancement and accuracy improvement in the qudit-based quantum information processing.

articleTitle: High Brightness Broadband Photon-Pairs at 2 µm in Lithium Niobate Nanophotonics
abstract: We present a photon-pair source at 2 µm with more than 45 THz bandwidth and a generation rate of 122 GHz/mW in lithium niobate nanophotonics, opening up many opportunities in mid-infrared quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Dispersion-managed Hong-Ou-Mandel revival via a biphoton frequency comb
abstract: We demonstrated the dispersion cancellation on two-photon Hong-Ou-Mandel interference revival via a biphoton frequency comb for the first time. The temporal spacing between Hong-Ou-Mandel interference dips can be modified by applying dispersion.

articleTitle: Experimental Proposal for Validation of W-state Protocol for Qubits and Qudits
abstract: This paper presents an experimental scheme to validate W-state encoding, a passive linear optics error-correction scheme for qubits and qudits. We use the orbital angular momentum of photons to realize qubits and qudits.

articleTitle: A standing-wave approach to mapping key photonic microwave resonances in aqueous spheroids
abstract: We show that scalar standing-wave solutions accurately predict certain fundamental microwave Mie resonances in high-index aqueous oblate and prolate spheroids. We compare this simplified method with results obtained using multipole expansion and finite element methods.

articleTitle: Spectral Narrowing of a Non-Resonant PPKTP Optical Parametric Oscillator using a VBG
abstract: A non-resonant optical parametric oscillator based on 5-mm-thick Rb-doped periodically-poled KTiOPO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> (PPKTP) generates narrow-band (<l-nm) idler pulses of 5.84-mJ energy at ~2382 nm and 100 Hz using a volume Bragg grating for the signal wave.

articleTitle: Polarization-entangled source for flex-grid C+L-band quantum networks
abstract: We demonstrate an ultrabroadband polarization-entangled source integrating both C- and L-band wavelength-selective switches for spectral routing and allocation in a single fiberized setup, verifying high fidelity through tomography of all 150 pairs of 25 GHz-wide channels.

articleTitle: Fiber-based Frequency Combs with Quantum-limited Linewidths
abstract: Exploiting the interplay between cavity dispersion and pump power, we minimize the phase noise in mode-locked laser systems. Free-running femtosecond frequency combs with few-to sub-kHz linewidths over their entire ultrabroadband spectrum are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Direct Down-sampled Full-field Coherence Scanning Interferometry Using a Femtosecond Laser
abstract: A down-sampled coherence scanning interferometer is realized by using a repetition frequency scanning femtosecond laser. With the fast stepwise scanning mechanism, it can realize full-field three-dimensional measurement with high signal-to-noise ratio in a few frames.

articleTitle: Quantum interference with interlayer excitons in moiré MoSe2 homobilayers
abstract: Quantum interference is observed between direct interlayer excitons and highlying conduction band excitons in MoSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> homobilayers. Good agreement is found with quantum optical simulations suggesting state dressing of these excitonic species.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocal vortex conversion and frequency shifting using light-driven chiral flexural waves
abstract: We report nonreciprocal vortex conversion and frequency shifting via cork-screw-like chiral flexural phonons induced by forward Brillouin scattering in chiral photonic crystal fibre. A nonreciprocity factor greater than >13 dB is achieved.

articleTitle: Low threshold lasing based on a hybrid Si/III-V cavity with quantum dots
abstract: Here, we present a low threshold nanolaser design based on an alignment-free heterogeneous Si-GaAs photonic crystal cavity where the cavity design is only in silicon and GaAs is a wider slab. © 2023 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Quadrature-Resolved Dissipative Optomechanical Measurement
abstract: We present a homodyne detection scheme to reliably measure the dissipative coupling in optomechanical systems. Our method is validated on silicon devices yielding ${G_{{\kappa _e}}}/{G_\omega } = - 0.007 \pm 0.001$.

articleTitle: Radial Displacement Measurement Method by Using a Grating-Corner-Cube Sensor Based on Dual-Comb Spectroscopy
abstract: We present a method to measure radial displacement based on dual-comb spectroscopy by using a grating-corner-cube sensor, which can reach a repeatability precision of 2.77 μm, along with ~1.1 kHz repetition rate difference.

articleTitle: Intra-Cavity Frequency-Doubled VECSEL for Narrow Linewidth Rydberg EIT Spectroscopy
abstract: We characterize a VECSEL with intra-cavity frequency conversion and use it to demonstrate 3.5 MHz FWHM Rydberg spectroscopy. The laser emits 690 mW at λ = 475 nm and we measure a pre-doubled linewidth of 2π × 23(2) kHz.

articleTitle: High-resolution meta-displays leveraging low-loss nonvolatile phase-change chalcogenides
abstract: Electrically switchable dual-view meta-displays with high-resolution, wide-gamut, and high-saturation features for dynamic image encryption and encoding are demonstrated by leveraging less-explored classes of low-loss optical phase-change chalcogenides, i.e., Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>.

articleTitle: Multispectral snapshot high-speed imaging using periodic shadowing multiplexing
abstract: We present a light-efficient multiplexed imaging setup that can be used with any monochrome camera and combine it with a high-speed camera to achieve high-speed multispectral imaging with no loss in capture rate or FOV.

articleTitle: Demodulation system for WDM/TDM-based UWFBG array employed a compact fiber grating spectrometer
abstract: We have proposed an UWFBG array demodulation system based on compact fiber grating spectrometer which has a resolution of 3 pm. The demodulation system can realize the demodulation of hundreds of FBGs.

articleTitle: From Non-Scattering to Super-Scattering States with the Topology of Light and Matter
abstract: We demonstrate the existence of a hybrid anapole state in an all-dielectric cuboid particle and discuss how such a non-scattering state can be changed to super-scattering mode by modifying the topology of light and matter.

articleTitle: Wavelength-modulation heterodyne phase-sensitive dispersion spectroscopy in a hollow-core antiresonant fiber
abstract: We develop the wavelength-modulation heterodyne phase-sensitive dispersion spectroscopy in a tellurite hollow-core antiresonasnt fiber, which shows an improved sensitivity by a factor of 8.3 compared with conventional heterodyne phase-sensitive dispersion spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Visible-Spectrum Wavelength-Selective Metalenses Based on Quasi-Bound States in the Continuum
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate Si-rich SiN nonlocal metalenses that operate across the entire visible spectrum. These devices shape the wavefront at spectrally narrowband resonances but otherwise act like unpatterned substrates.

articleTitle: Metasurface-integrated optofluidic sensing enabled by artificial vision intelligence for identifying liquid chemicals
abstract: The currently used liquid identification techniques are costly, cumbersome, and spectrometer-reliant. In this study, a compact, accurate, and cost-effective method for identifying liquids was presented using visual intelligence algorithms and a metasurface-incorporated optofluidic device incorporated.

articleTitle: Widely Tunable and Repetition-Rate-Fixed Fiber Optical Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We present a fiber optical parametric oscillator incorporating wavelength-tunable pump pulses and an intracavity optical filter. A wide tuning range of 90 nm is achieved while keeping the repetition rate constant.

articleTitle: X-Ray Spectroscopy With End-to-End Optimized Nanophotonic Scintillators
abstract: We present a method for x-ray spectroscopy, combining nanophotonic scintillator inverse design with an image reconstruction algorithm. We demonstrate our pipeline on 3-energy x-ray spectroscopy, achieving 8% reconstruction error under 1% Gaussian noise

articleTitle: Spectroscopy and Mode-locked Laser Operation of a Disordered Yb:Gd2SrAl2O7 Crystal
abstract: We report on spectroscopy and mode-locked laser operation of a disordered aluminate crystal, Yb:Gd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SrAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>. 34-fs soliton pulses are generated at 1084.6 nm via soft-aperture Kerr-lens mode-locking with an average output power of 115 mW.

articleTitle: Tm-doped Chirped-pulse-amplification Fiber Laser System at 1.9 µm
abstract: We report a high-energy Tm-doped chirped-pulse-amplification fiber laser system seeded by dissipative solitons at 1902 nm. The system provides output pulses with a pulse energy of 120 nJ and a pulse duration of 940 fs.

articleTitle: Generation of Low-Frequency Kerr Combs in Highly Compact Photonic Structures
abstract: We demonstrate on-chip single and multi-soliton generation in a 16-GHz free-spectral range compact spiral microresonator with a total area of 1 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. We measure the phase noise of states with different soliton numbers, which can be used for low-noise high-power microwave generation.

articleTitle: Thermalization and Entanglement of Quantum Light in a Nonlinear Multimode System
abstract: We study how thermodynamic behavior in classical nonlinear optical multimode systems presents itself in quantum many-body settings, and find multimode entanglement arising in the thermalization process.

articleTitle: Demonstrated InP-Based Optical Phase Arrays with Low-Power Consumption
abstract: The 32 channels low-power consumption InP-based optical phase arrays was demonstrated, achieving a steering angle of 30°, power consumption of OPA is less than 7.6mW.

articleTitle: Single-Photon Emitters in Aluminum Nitride by Zr ion Implantation
abstract: We report on the generation of single-photon emitters in aluminum nitride films through Zr-ion implantation, which was predicted to form optically addressable spin defects. We studied implantation conditions, post-implantation procedures, and properties of resulting emitters.

articleTitle: Rigorous coupled-wave analysis for the bound states in the continuum and the guided modes below the light cone
abstract: We extend the rigorous coupled-wave analysis to the simulation of bound states in the continuum and the fully guided modes. This is achieved by using non-physical evanescent waves as input channels, analytic continuation of the scattering matrix to the full complex frequency plane, and analytic continuation of incident angles to complex numbers.

articleTitle: Referenceless, Low-Coherence, Multimode Fiber Characterization
abstract: We demonstrate spatial and polarization control of low coherence light through a multimode fiber, and retrieve its broadest-band mode transmission matrix without the need for an external reference using high dimensional spatial state tomography of light.

articleTitle: Observations of dual-dispersive soliton microcombs with deterministic azimuthal angle control
abstract: We demonstrate a novel method of dual-soliton generation with fixed azimuthal angle in a dual-pumped microresonator. A relationship between the pump detuning from an avoided mode crossing on the azimuthal angle is studied.

articleTitle: Modeling Ultrafast Anharmonic Energy Flow With a Multi-THz Pump Bandwidth
abstract: First-principles calculations were used to model multi-THz excitation and ultrafast coherent energy flow between vibrational degrees of freedom in gas-phase fluorobenzene. We determined the importance of anharmonic coupling and mode symmetry in intramolecular energy transfer.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Propagation of High-Intensity Pulsed Light: First-principles Calculations
abstract: Light propagation of high-intensity pulsed light is calculated by first-principles computational method based on time-dependent density functional theory. Transition of optical response at surface with light intensity, from linear response to plasma reflection, is investigated.

articleTitle: Backaction Evasion in Optical Lever Detection
abstract: We experimentally and theoretically investigate how measurement backaction from optical force noise can be evaded in an optical lever detection system probing a high Q membrane mechanical resonator.

articleTitle: Quantum Meta-Photonics
abstract: I will discuss our research effort on engineering solid-state quantum emitters in material platforms for integrated photonics and applying plasmonic metamaterials for light-matter interaction enhancement and achieving quantum coherence at non-cryogenic temperatures.

articleTitle: Designing large scale quantum networks
abstract: In this presentation we explore the core design concepts required for building large scale quantum networks and a future quantum internet. Our focus will include both the quantum and classical resources required.

articleTitle: Dual-microcombs generation with a single-pumped Si3N4 microresonator for tunable microwave oscillation
abstract: Dynamic dual-microcombs are demonstrated in a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microresonator using a single pump, yielding the microwave signals at ~23.4, ~28.9, and ~34.6 GHz. The results are of interest for the applications in integrated microwave photonics.

articleTitle: Efficient Simulation of Supercontinua from Mixed and Cascaded Nonlinearities
abstract: On-chip nonlinear waveguides can simultaneously exhibit quadratic and cubic nonlinearities and enable supercontinua across multiple-octaves. An efficient, open-source numeric approach for simulating ultra-broadband spectra from mixed and cascaded (quadratic and cubic) nonlinear processes is presented.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning-Based Model for Characterizing Stationary-and-Dynamic Behavior of VCSEL
abstract: We propose a machine learning-based framework to acquire parameters that de¬fine stationary-and-dynamic behavior of VCSEL. Circuit-level simulations of light-current and S21 are used to train the model. In terms of relative-prediction-error promising results are achieved.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Plexcitonic Metasurfaces for Broadband Nonlinear Frequency Conversion
abstract: Using inverse design, we demonstrate a plexcitonic metasurface of monolayer WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> strongly coupled to gold nanoantennas. Broadband third-harmonic generation is attained over the entire plexcitonic frequencies. We discuss optimization strategies and implications for nonlinear photonics.

articleTitle: Quantum-Dot Single-Photon Sources Processed on Silicon-Nitride Integrated Circuits
abstract: We couple single photons from a quantum dot source to Silicon Nitride integrated photonic circuits and show several applications: multiphoton interfence, entanglement generation and quantum error mitigation. The results open new paths for heterogeneous integrated quantum photonics at scale.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh-resolution fiber-optic sensing system with an ultra-simple system and broadband light
abstract: An ultra-simple fiber-optic sensing system is proposed. The resolution reached $99.6{\text{f}}\varepsilon /\sqrt {{\text{Hz}}} $ at 1kHz with an enhanced Sagnac interferometer, which is the highest resolution level of the white light system to our best knowledge.

articleTitle: Breakdown of THz Kerr-Effect in Diamond Observed with 2D Spectroscopy
abstract: We investigate the breakdown of the well-known electric-field-squared dependence of the terahertz Kerr effect in diamond. Using two-dimensional (2D) terahertz spectroscopy we show that higher order effects occur at high fields.

articleTitle: Long and crack-free holes in glass by top-down drilling with femtosecond laser GHz-bursts
abstract: We report on extremely long, high quality, and crack-free holes in sodalime and fused silica by laser drilling with femtosecond GHz-bursts, where aspect ratios exceeding 30 and even 70 have been obtained, respectively.

articleTitle: THz optical solitons in quantum cascade double ring lasers
abstract: We report THz optical soliton formation in defect-less ring QCL featuring anomalous dispersion. Free-running spectra with sech<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> envelopes are presented together with SWIFT measurement showing ~12 ps pulses in the reconstructed emission time-profile.

articleTitle: Ultralow Dissipation Mechanical Resonators for Cavity-Free Quantum Control
abstract: We fabricate nanomechanical resonators with Q > 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> at room temperature and show efficient optical readout of their motion. With an improved interferometer, these devices can be cooled close to the ground state without a cavity.

articleTitle: μ-Transfer printing of GaSb-based gain elements for integrated external cavity lasers at 2 μm range
abstract: Micro transfer printing of GaSb-based gain elements transferred to silicon photonics platform is reported for the first time. Using a distributed Bragg reflector fabricated utilizing silicon-on-insulator technology and the GaSb integrated gain chip, a single frequency external cavity laser emitting at around 1.96 μm is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Scanning-free Brillouin optical time domain analyzer with single-end access
abstract: We propose a scanning-free BOTDA system with single-end access by employing the Rayleigh backscattering lightwave of a linear frequency modulated optical pulse as the probe wave to simplify the system and increase the measurement speed.

articleTitle: Non-Reciprocity-Based Integrated Biosensing In PT Symmetric Coupled Resonators
abstract: We propose an EP-based biosensor which uses non reciprocal transmission measurements in PT-symmetric microring resonators. This approach only requires a single frequency probe and provides tunable dynamic range.

articleTitle: Deterministic inverse design of spectral line shapes using thin-film-based Fano resonators
abstract: We present an inverse design approach for spectral line shapes using thin-film-based Fano resonators. Stochastic gradient descent (SGD)-based learning provides CMOS-compatible process parameters for spectral line shapes with four different Fano q parameters.

articleTitle: Carrier Non-pinning at Stripe Edges and Widened Far field in Broad-Area Lasers due to Longitudinal Temperature Variation
abstract: 2D-in-plane spontaneous emission studies reveal lateral carrier-non-pinning linked to longitudinal temperature variation in 9xx-nm broad-area-lasers. Front-side non-pinning at the stripe edges broadens far-field, eliminated with short pulses (no heat) or high front-facet reflectivity (flat optical profile).

articleTitle: Identification of Brillouin Lasing Modes in Silica Microspheres
abstract: We explore a gated spectral measurement technique that, combined with group velocity dispersion measurements, enables the identification of the optical modes involved in Brillouin lasing in high optical mode density silica microspheres.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal cavities for enhancing the response of large-area scintillators
abstract: We show that photonic crystal cavities can tailor the intrinsic emission spectrum of large-area scintillators via the Purcell effect, enhancing the overall photodetector signal by over 200% from improved overlap with the detector response.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Spectroscopy in the Long-Wavelength Mid-Infrared Region
abstract: An in-house built difference-frequency-generation laser is used to probe the long-wave mid-infrared region. Wide tunability (11.58 – 15 μm) and high resolution of the developed system are showcased in molecular fingerprinting of several species.

articleTitle: Sub-200 ps Quantum Network Node Synchronization over a 128 km Link White Rabbit Architecture
abstract: We show sub-200 ps synchronization between quantum networks nodes that are separated by two 64 km deployed fiber links, providing a 128 km link architecture. The architecture employs one grandmaster and two boundary White Rabbit system clocks and shows promise for metropolitan-scale quantum network node synchronization.

articleTitle: Real-time Nonlinear Pulse Evolution Dynamics in a Tm-doped Fiber Laser
abstract: We investigate the nonlinear pulse evolution dynamics in a Tm-doped fiber laser in real-time with a modified dispersive Fourier transform technique. Coherence degradation and recovery processes are analyzed with spectral intensity correlation maps.

articleTitle: Ultra-miniaturized Optical Spectrometers with a Highly Tunable van der Waals Junction
abstract: We report ultra-miniaturized (~10×20 µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) spectrometers with electrically modulated van der Waals junctions in conjunction with a reconstruction algorithm, achieving spectral reconstruction with a spectral resolution of ~3-nm over a broad operation bandwidth for spectral imaging.

articleTitle: Wafer-Scale Atomic-Layer-Deposition of Er3+- and Yb3+- Doped Gain Materials for Integrated Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate highly-doped Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> doped gain media on SiN waveguides by plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition, showing great potential for integrated lasers and amplifiers.

articleTitle: Spin-waves propagation as a basis for adaptive magnonic networks
abstract: We present the experimental propagation of spin waves. Varying the excitation parameters, we can create basis for the implementation of nano-scale magnonic networks to be used for complex non-traditional data-processing schemes, including neuromorphic computing.

articleTitle: Towards optimum phase noise compensation for CV-QKD systems
abstract: We experimentally examine the performance of a machine learning based phase estimation and compensation framework for Gaussian modulated continuous variable quantum key distribution relative to a transmitted local oscillator and ideal phase compensation.

articleTitle: Sub-30 fs Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:SrLaAlO4 laser
abstract: We report on 25-fs soliton pulse generation from a Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:SrLaAlO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> laser at 1090 nm with an average power of 149 mW at a pulse repetition rate of ~80 MHz.

articleTitle: A compact 90-degree bending waveguide constructed using an intelligent inverse design algorithm
abstract: A 90-degree bending silicon-on-insulator waveguide is constructed using a self-developed inverse design optimization algorithm. The measured insertion loss is about 1.7 dB at 1550 nm with a footprint of only 1.5μm×1.5μm.

articleTitle: Long-range polarization transport in indirect excitons in MoSe2/WSe2 heterostructure
abstract: We observed the long-range polarization transport in a system of indirect excitons in van der Waals MoSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> heterostructure. The polarization transport decay distance reaches and exceeds 100 microns and diverges at the resonant excitation.

articleTitle: 3D Laser Printing of Form Birefringent Polymeric Structures
abstract: We report on the fabrication of form birefringent structures using 3D laser printing technique and describe optical properties of the fabricated samples. By employing 3D periodic structures instead of the simple 1D gratings that are typically used, we were able to realize mechanically robust form birefringent structures whose thickness and optical length of the birefringent region can be increased without loss of the mechanical stability, and achieve the quarter- and half-wave phase retardation levels needed in many applications. In the future, similar structures may become useful as the building blocks of polymeric photonic devices.

articleTitle: Compact Echelle Grating Filter for Monolithic Silicon Photonics
abstract: We present a miniaturized Echelle grating multiplexer in the O-band. The device was fabricated using GlobalFoundries-45CLO-process. Statistical analysis verifies the device manufacturability with a stable channel-center (standard deviation< 0.72nm), and crosstalk (<-20dB over 3dB-bandwidth).

articleTitle: WDM Transmission via High-Power Fully-Integrated Kerr Frequency Combs
abstract: We demonstrate high-power, fully-integrated Kerr frequency combs by self-injection locking multimode gain chips with silicon-nitride resonators. We demonstrate 25 comb lines > 100 μW with 200 kHz linewidth, and OOK modulation at 12.5 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Low-loss heterogeneously integrated barium-titanate-on-silicon-nitride photonics
abstract: We present a hybrid barium titanate photonics platform exhibiting exceptionally low losses of 0.7 dB/cm and realize ring resonators with intrinsic quality factors exceeding 6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>. Measurement of V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> L = 0.56 V•cm in electro-optic modulation experiments demonstrates the platform’s potential.

articleTitle: Rewritable Photonic Integrated Circuit with Phase Change Materials
abstract: We propose a low loss (Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>: 28.7 dB/mm and Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>: 1.20 dB/mm) rewriteable photonic integrated circuit using phase change materials that is written by nanosecond laser pulses.

articleTitle: Accelerated Adjoint Shape Optimization via Automatic Differentiation
abstract: We use automatic differentiation to enhance shape optimization approaches to photonic inverse design, resulting in over two orders-of-magnitude improvement in the gradient calculation time of our grating coupler proof-of-concept.

articleTitle: Towards spliced SMF to hollow core fiber connection with low loss and low back-reflection
abstract: We propose a new solid-core to hollow-core fiber connection where an SMF is offset-spliced with an angle-cleaved graded index mode field adapter. We show through simulations and an initial experiment that this results in simultaneous low-loss and low backreflection.

articleTitle: All-optical phase recovery: Quantitative phase imaging using diffractive optical networks
abstract: We demonstrate diffractive networks that perform all-optical phase recovery and synthesize the quantitative phase images of input objects by converting the input phase information into quantitative intensity variations at their output.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 100-km Long O-band WDM Amplified Coherent Transmission
abstract: O-band WDM 100-Gb/sλ. dual-polarization quadrature phase shift keying transmission is demonstrated over a 100-km link, with gain provided by bismuth-doped fiber amplifiers. Two different channel spacings are studied: 0.6nm and 10nm.

articleTitle: Accuracy Self-Estimation in an 8-Dimensional Quantum State Identification at a Telecom Wavelength
abstract: We experimentally obtain single-shot confidences of a state estimation measurement with M=8 arbitrary sets of non-orthogonal states. The 8-dimensional vector of confidences represents the best knowledge of the input state for each individual quantum measurement.

articleTitle: Variety of mode-locking patterns in Figure-9 lasers: a view from the parameter space
abstract: We proposed an approach to visualize the mode-locking pattern of a Figure-9 lasers. The parameter space of several configurations was probed and a variety of mode-locking patterns of great differences were obtained.

articleTitle: Cavity-based Diamond Spin-Photon Interface in Photonic Integrated Circuits
abstract: We demonstrate heterogeneous integration of solid-state nanophotonic cavities into a scalable photonic platform as an efficient optical interface for quantum memories based on diamond color centers.

articleTitle: Broadband continuous supersymmetric transformation: a new paradigm for transformation optics
abstract: Supersymmetry provides a new paradigm for transformation optics. We experimentally demonstrate broadband continuous supersymmetric transformation by designing a novel metamaterial on a Si platform for advanced control of the spatial characteristics of light.

articleTitle: Low-voltage Dynamic Light Manipulation with Slot Silicon-organic Metasurfaces
abstract: Fast-tunable metasurfaces would provide reconfigurable optical wavefronts. We show the integration of slot resonance metasurfaces with electro-optic polymers that will enable large and fast modulation under low voltages.

articleTitle: Lithium-ion Battery Tomography Based on Highly Sensitive Fiber Optic Ultrasound Sensor
abstract: The sensor possesses high sensitivity of 0.226V/kPa and low noise equivalent pressure of 29.7mPa/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup>, which enables the imaging system to investigate the inner changes of lithiumion batteries (LIBs) with high resolution.

articleTitle: Optical waveguide generated in air through femtosecond filamentation of optical vortices
abstract: The evolution of filament array produces by optical vortices in air is studied. Vortex beams generate filaments organized in a cylinder that evolve into a tubular neutral gas column similar to a step index fiber.

articleTitle: Slice optimisation for high-speed Gaussian coherent state continuous variable quantum key distribution
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, slice reconciliation with optimised guard bands on Gaussian modulated continuous variable quantum key distribution. We produce a record 5Mb/s key rate after 25 km transmission distance with multilevel slicing.

articleTitle: Titanium:sapphire-on-insulator microresonator laser
abstract: We develop a titanium:sapphire-on-insulator integrated photonic platform and demonstrate a thin-film chip-integrated microdisk laser. The microresonators feature optical quality factors exceeding 1 million, enabling a sub-milliwatt lasing threshold. These results pave the way for low-cost, compact, chip-integrated titanium:sapphire lasers.

articleTitle: On-Chip Photonic Frequency Divider for Dual-Wavelength Optical Signal
abstract: An integrated photonic frequency divider for dual-wavelength optical signal is proposed and demonstrated based on an optoelectronic oscillating loop. A 1/2-scaled photonic frequency divider with a frequency interval ranging from 22-30 GHz is realized.

articleTitle: Controlling ultrafast laser writing with pulse temporal contrast
abstract: The effect of temporal contrast of femtosecond laser pulses on nanostructuring of silica glass is demonstrated.
