Nanopore-based modifications are created with a contrast of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>, while stronger birefringence is observed with reduced contrast of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Silicon Ring Modulator Based Optical Phase Shifter
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon ring modulator-based phase shifter that combines the through and drop ports to achieve ~2π phase shift with a transmission variation of <0.97 dB in the wavelength range 1482-1500 nm.

articleTitle: Flatband-type edge states arising from nontrivial topological winding in photonic graphene
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a new type of edge states in photonic graphene. Such edge states appear across the entire Brillouin zone, extended or compact localized, and are topologically characterized by the winding number.

articleTitle: Electro-Optically Switchable, Cross-Polarized Dual-Line Nd:YLF laser Based on Aperiodically Poled Lithium Niobate
abstract: We report an electro-optically (EO) switchable source based on a domain-engineered LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> operating in a closely lying, cross-polarized dual-line Nd:YLF laser. Simultaneous EO spectral switching and Q-switching has been realized in such a novel system.

articleTitle: Overcoming Spectral Diffusion for Enhanced Spin-Photon Entanglement using NV Defect Centers in Diamond Nanostructures
abstract: Optically coherent NV defect centers in diamond nanostructures are demonstrated using a combination of methods that mitigate spectral diffusion, including sample choice, fabrication, and experimental control. Entanglement rates enhanced by orders of magnitude are proposed.

articleTitle: Parametric Study of a Diode-Side-Pumped Bonded Laser Rod for Thermal Effects Reduction
abstract: This present work outlines a parametric study of a diode side-pumped bonded laser rod. Both material combination and geometry of the samples are discussed using simulations and experiments to reduce the pump-induced thermal effects.

articleTitle: Resonant Metalenses Formulated from Quasi-Bound States in the Continuum for Visible Light
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a nonlocal, wavefront-shaping metasurface that focuses a narrowband of green light but behaves like a transparent substrate over a broad visible spectrum.

articleTitle: MMI-Based Power Combiner for Trident Edge Couplers on Thin Film Lithium Niobate for Nonlinear Applications
abstract: We present an MMI-based power combiner that can be used with trident edge couplers to achieve high efficiency for both the fundamental and second harmonics in on-chip nonlinear processes which span a large bandwidth.

articleTitle: Comb Emission of a THz-QCL Characterized by Fourier Transform Analysis Over Different Current Regimes
abstract: The Fourier-transform Analysis of Comb Emission (FACE) is here exploited to asses the coherence level of the comb emission of a novel QCL heterostructure lasing at THz frequencies in different driven current regimes.

articleTitle: Ultrafast switching of topological invariants by light-driven interlayer vibrations
abstract: We investigate the high-speed topological phase transition driven by photoinduced interlayer vibrations at ambient conditions (room temperature and normal pressure). By employing ultrafast optical and THz spectroscopy, which enables us possible to study interlayer vibrations through photoelastic effects and topological surface state leading to low-energy conductivity in topological insulator Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, we found that the interlayer vibrational mode, which originated from the confinement of photoinduced longitudinal strain waves, can drive the topological phase switching from topological insulator toward normal insulator. Our observations provide fundamental insights into nanomechanical interaction between lattice-topological phase for possible optoelectronic and spintronic applications based on all-optical topological phase switching at ultrafast timescales.

articleTitle: Label-free bio-aerosol detection and classification using a virtual impactor, holography and deep learning
abstract: We present a computational mobile imaging device that captures in-line holograms of bioaerosols flying through a virtual impactor. Using deep neural networks, this cost-effective system can perform long-term air quality monitoring, automatically identifying/counting various allergens.

articleTitle: Biological and Environmental Sensors Based on Lensfree Microscopes
abstract: Lensfree microscopes offer an ultra-large field of view together with high resolution and cost-effective, compact hardware. This makes them well suited for the COVID-19 and airborne nanoparticulate matter sensing applications we present here.

articleTitle: Two Color Ionization Seeded Laser Wakefield Accelerator
abstract: We report on an experimental realization of a two-color ionization seeded laser wakefield accelerator with a long wave infrared drive laser and a transverse, tightly focused, near infrared injector laser.

articleTitle: Label-free Cytometry Based on Multi-wavelength Multi-direction Laser Light Scattering from Single Cells
abstract: A multi-wavelength and multi-direction study of light scattering patterns from surface roughness and mitochondria content of cell models is shown for development of a label-free cytometry technique. Experiments with biological specimens are anticipated.

articleTitle: Attosecond Electron Microscopy
abstract: We advance transmission electron microscopy to attosecond time resolution and probe the electromagnetic near-fields of nanostructures in space and time.

articleTitle: Adaptively Controlled Sub-100 fs Yb Fiber Chirped Pulse Amplification System
abstract: Bandwidth limited 92 fs 10 µJ pulses are generated using an adaptive fiber Bragg grating stretcher for group delay and an adjus table Lyot filter for bandwidth control, and compressed to 12 fs in a hollow-core fiber.

articleTitle: Complexities in calibration of THz streaking based photoelectron arrival time tool at X-ray free electron lasers
abstract: Use of THz photoelectron streaking as an arrival time-tool is presented. Complexities in calibration of the THz field as well as high fidelity, single shot photoelectron spectra giving rise to sources of errors is discussed.

articleTitle: Manipulating the Refractive Index of a Fabry-Perot Nanocavity Comprising Thin Semiconductor and Metal Films Using an External Electric Potential
abstract: Reflectance of multilayer thin-film can be calculated using the refractive index and layer thickness by transfer matrix method. We show the effects of electric potential on the refractive index of multilayer thin-film made of Au-pInSb-TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-Au.

articleTitle: Label-Free Near Infrared Plasmonic Sensors for High-Resolution Biomolecular Detection
abstract: We demonstrated a plasmonic interferometry-free biosensor with a near-infrared excitation wavelength of 988 nm. The Q factor has been improved by 1.75 times compared to 633 nm for 1 nM BSA molecule detection.

articleTitle: Coupling monolayer transition metal dichalcogenide to a strain-tunable photonic crystal cavity
abstract: We demonstrate a large in-situ strain tuning of cavity coupled photoluminescence of nanofabricated optical cavities integrated with a monolayer WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> using a piezo-strain device capable of operating at cryogenic temperatures.

articleTitle: Robust Wavelength Control of Microresonator Parametric Oscillation with Nanophotonic Bandgaps
abstract: We demonstrate beyond-octave-span laser wavelength conversion from a 1060 nm pump via optical parametric oscillation in tantala microresonators. Robust control of phase-matching at near-zero-GVD by use of a nanophotonic bandgap enables realization of target wavelengths.

articleTitle: Large Aperture Full Color Meta-Optic Camera
abstract: We demonstrate full color in the wild imaging with a 1 cm, f/2 aperture meta-optic, directly integrated with a camera. We use a computational end-to-end design approach to derive a suitable meta-optic, which in combination with a computational backend truthfully recovers visible full color image scenes.

articleTitle: Organic Molecules for Photonic Quantum Technologies: an Insight into Two-Photon Interference from Distinct Emitters
abstract: The time trace of two-photon interference from distinct molecular emitters in the solid-state is analyzed to extract their spectral difference without resorting to fitting. This opens the path towards robust on-line monitoring of quantum emitters.

articleTitle: Frequency-Conversion via Intermodal Bragg-Scattering in a Few Moded Fiber
abstract: We demonstrate a process for frequency-conversion via intermodal Bragg-scattering capable of converting between a signal and idler separated by >600 nm. Pumps separation was tuned from 0-20 nm with conversion efficiency up to -23dB.

articleTitle: Image Restoration Using Optoelectronic Coherent Ising Machine
abstract: We propose an optoelectronic Coherent Ising Machine implemented using off-the-shelf optical telecommunications devices for image denoising for the first time. Our hardware implementation yields clean images with a pixel error rate of 3%.

articleTitle: Self-referenced Single-shot Stokes Polarimeter
abstract: We demonstrate a compact interferometric polarimeter using a corner-cube retroreflector and an adjustable mirror to create the necessary transformations targeted states of polarization. The Stokes vector can be found using two alternative recovery procedures.

articleTitle: Inverse design of optical switch with meta-learning
abstract: We introduce a novel way of designing active structure based on bi-level optimization, in analogy to meta-learning. We demonstrate our method with an example of compact optical switch design and discuss its broader applications.

articleTitle: Upper Pulse Energy Limit of Narrowband THz Generation
abstract: We generate tunable narrowband THz radiation using BNA bonded to sapphire in tandem with a chirp and delay technique. Using a Ti:Sapphire laser, we test the limits of intense THz generation (0.1 to 5 THz).

articleTitle: Multicenter and multiple elastic rescattering in CO2 molecules studied by carrier-envelope phase mapping
abstract: We measure carrier-envelope phase (CEP)-dependent photoelectron momentum distributions (PEMDs) of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> with linearly-polarized sub-two-cycle near-infrared laser pulses, to discuss multicenter and multiple rescattering in a molecule.

articleTitle: Optical Control of Coherence Phase in Monolayer Tungsten Disulphide
abstract: Floquet-engineering offers ultrafast control of non-equilibrium phenomena. Here we demonstrate ultrafast optical manipulation of the amplitude and phase of a coherent superposition in monolayer WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, directly measuring an induced phase shift of π in a pump-MDCS measurement.

articleTitle: An Economical Single-Pulse Picker without Nonlinear Effect and Dispersion
abstract: A robust single-shot pulse picker without dispersion, nonlinear effect and optical wavelength limitation is presented and applied to a commercial high-energy femtosecond laser with a 12-mm laser beam diameter and pulse energy > 2 mJ.

articleTitle: Terahertz Imaging Through Fog
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that broadband THz imaging can provide virtually unimpaired visibility through dense fog that would otherwise result in zero visibility under conventional optical imaging.

articleTitle: Two-photon Lithography of Microresonators and Their Application in Heavy Metal Ion Sensing
abstract: We report the fabrication of functionalized microresonator in a single step by using two-photon lithography. Surface-engineered carbon quantum dots have been used as a sensing material in the microresonators, exhibiting affinity towards the heavy metal ion.

articleTitle: Microscale Sol-Gel Optical Devices Printed by Two-Photon Polymerization and Direct Laser Writing
abstract: The synthesis of a sol-gel based photoresist for high precision 3D printing with two photon polymerization direct laser writing is described. The design and fabrication of a photonic lantern operating at 1550um are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Radial Vibration Measurement Based on Slope-assisted BOCDA Enabled by Multi-core Fiber
abstract: We propose a novel SA-BOCDA sensor based on multicore fiber. By subtracting the output probe powers of two symmetrical outer cores, response enhanced vibration detection is realized without frequency scanning.

articleTitle: Synthetic frequency dimension state coupling in modulated LNOI ring cavity devices
abstract: We created a modulator-equipped thin-film lithium niobate integrated ring resonator simulating a synthetic frequency dimension tight-binding model. It produces frequency states spaced over a 600 GHz bandwidth. Reconfigurable coupling enables simulation of disparate two-dimensional interactions.

articleTitle: Tuning Strategy for a Monolithically Integrated Unidirectional Vernier Dual-Ring InP Laser
abstract: Wavelength mapping and calibration for a widely tunable laser utilizing Vernier micro-ring resonators are investigated. The laser achieves quasi-continuous tuning through reverse biasing the electro-optic phase sections.

articleTitle: Euler-Elastica Variational Model for Pulsed Terahertz 3D Imaging
abstract: The variational Euler-Elastica model is developed for high-precision terahertz 3D tomographic applications. Our method provides a new approach to mitigate diffraction-limited terahertz reconstructed images with noises and demonstrates the efficient practicality with limited THz datasets.

articleTitle: Wafer-level fabrication of Fabry- Pérot resonators with finesse exceeding one million
abstract: We demonstrate a wafer-level fabrication technique for high-finesse Fabry-Pérot optical resonators based on reflow and optical contact bonding. These resonators have finesse exceeding one million at 1550 nm and can be readily used as reference cavities.

articleTitle: All-fiber triple frequency comb light source
abstract: We present a triple-comb, frequency agile, all-fiber light source. We show that mutual coherence is preserved by using a triple-core fiber and that 1ps transform-limited pulses can be obtained.

articleTitle: High-order-mode Brillouin Random Fiber Laser via Long Period Fiber Grating and distributed Rayleigh scattering
abstract: A high-order-mode Brillouin Random fiber laser with high purity and broadband tunability based on a long-period fib1er grating and distributed Rayleigh scattering in optical fibers was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhanced Bioimaging with Nano Photonics
abstract: We review enhanced bioimaging approaches that utilize nano photonic devices to measure attachment of biomaterials. A couple of examples of nano photonic sensors, including photonic crystals and ring resonators, have been summarized with varieties of applications.

articleTitle: Integrated tunable twisted single photon source
abstract: Twisted single photons, carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) as an unbounded dimension, could address the growing demand for high-dimensional quantum information encoding and transmission. By hybrid integration of two-dimensional semiconductor WSe2 with a spin-orbit-coupled microring resonator, we demonstrate an integrated tunable twisted single photon source with the ability to precisely define and switch between highly pure spin-OAM states.

articleTitle: Machine-learning-assisted inverse design for wide-FOV dual-layer multi-level diffractive lens integration
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an inverse-designed monochromatic compact dual-layer multi-level diffractive lens integration with wide field-of-view over 100°, ultra-thin (70um total thickness), super-light (< 1 gram) and high resolution, providing new applications for lightweight camera designs.

articleTitle: Independent phase and amplitude control of second harmonic generation from electrically tunable nonlinear polaritonic metasurfaces
abstract: We present electrically tunable nonlinear polaritonic metasurfaces for second harmonic generation with independently controllable effective nonlinear susceptibility in the range of 0 to 160 nm/V in magnitude and 0 to 2π in phase, respectively.

articleTitle: Few-cycle, high power, high repetition rate Yb laser source based on multidimensional solitary states in hollow-core fibers
abstract: We demonstrate pulse compression from 300 fs down to 17 fs up to 20 kHz using multidimensional solitary states in a hollow-core fiber filled with molecular gas in differential pressure to mitigate thermal effects.

articleTitle: Label-free and quantitative detection of respiratory viruses in saliva using surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy and machine learning algorithms
abstract: We report a label-free diagnostic platform that combines surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) and machine learning for the rapid and accurate detection of eleven respiratory viruses. Utilizing SVM-based regression, quantitative detection has been achieved.

articleTitle: A Gaussian Boson Sampling for Graph Computation
abstract: A gaussian boson sampling microprocessor for graph applications, such as solving task assignment, Boolean satisfiability, graph clique, max cut, vertex cover problems, is demonstrated and achieved. It manifests the ability of photonic quantum computing to realize practical applications for conventionally intractable computations.

articleTitle: Parallel microLED-based optical links with record data rates and low power consumption
abstract: We demonstrate low-energy complete optical links, down to 0.7pJ/bit using a custom 32-channel microLED-based ASIC with integrated drivers, photodetectors, and TIAs. Each channel is modulated at 2Gb/s and data transferred either using highly multicore fiber or free-space. Individually, with equalization, the LEDs give clear 13.2Gb/s eyes.

articleTitle: Multipole Lattice Resonances in Lossy Material
abstract: We report on an observation of the generalized lattice Kerker effect in a nickel nanoparticle array and show that collective coupling can substantially enhance the electric dipole and quadrupole resonances.

articleTitle: An Integrated Fiber Laser Amplifier Control System for Laser Phased Arrays
abstract: We demonstrate a compact and inexpensive microcontroller based YDFA control system built around a PyBoard V1.1 and programmed in MicroPython. We demonstrate power ramping, housekeeping and shutdown in case of SBS induced back-reflections.

articleTitle: A Modified Data Augmentation Integration Method for Intrusion Recognition Assisted with Fiber Optic DAS System
abstract: A modified data augmentation integration (MDAI) method for intrusion recognition assisted with fiber optic DAS system is proposed. Compared with the method without data augmentation (w/o-DA), the accuracy of MDAI is increased by 48.6% under the conditions of low-SNR, input-shift and events-mixing.

articleTitle: 3D Polymer Fiber-to-Chip Coupler Design for Visible Wavelengths
abstract: We propose a 3D polymer fiber-to-chip coupler design for visible wavelengths that does not require any change to the fiber or chip fabrication. We show micron-scale fabrication tolerances and 30 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Detection Of several Microorganism Using Terahertz Metamaterial Perfect Absorber
abstract: we propose a novel metamaterial Perfect absorber at terahertz frequency for fast and non-destructive detection of microorganisms. The sensor provides possibilities for obtaining dielectric information of microorganisms, which are of great potential for future biomedical applications.

articleTitle: Dimension Reduction for Photonic Processing Using Tailored Disorder
abstract: Integrated optical processing networks enable high computation speeds combined with low energy consumption. We present here a scheme for dimension reduction for optical neural networks, by orders of magnitudes, while still reaching high classification accuracies.

articleTitle: Integrating Nearly-Indistinguishable Quantum Emitters onto a Photonic Interposer
abstract: Current challenges for quantum repeaters using solid-state emitters include incorporating (1) multiple nearly-indistinguishable emitters (2) into an interposer with photonic processing capabilities. We develop a process flow that targets both of these tasks.

articleTitle: Measuring Propagation Loss in Slow-light Valley-Hall Photonic Topological Waveguides
abstract: We measure the propagation loss in trivial and topological slow-light guided interface modes of a valley-Hall photonic topological insulator indicating that there is no topological protection from fabrication-induced disorder.

articleTitle: Ultra-low power 256 channels optical phased-array based on low-doped carrier-depletion modulators
abstract: We report a 256 channels 1D optical phased-array (OPA) based on plasma-dispersion effect. This system exhibits ultra-low power consumption (~1mW) revealing the potential of carrier-depletion scheme at low doping dose for solid-state LiDARs applications.

articleTitle: A High-Quality-Factor Chiral Metasurface for Valley-Polarized Emission and Chiral Exciton-Polaritons
abstract: A high-quality-factor chiral metasurface is designed and fabricated to be interfaced with monolayer tungsten diselenide (WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) for valley-polarized emission and creating chiral exciton-polaritons.

articleTitle: High-Speed and High-Precision Ranging System for Non-Cooperative Targets based on Optical Frequency Comb
abstract: We propose an asynchronous sampling ranging method of electric pulse based on optical frequency comb for non-cooperative targets. It can achieve a precision of 53 μm at an update rate of 500 kHz.

articleTitle: Generation and propagation of an OAM-carrying beamlet array through an underwater turbulent environment
abstract: Gaussian beamlets are generated simultaneously around a perfect vortex envelope, each with a unique frequency corresponding to its specific location around the envelope with an overall OAM encoded across the array. These beams are propagated through a turbulent underwater environment, providing information between the interaction of these beams with this environment to understand the spatial and temporal properties of the water channel.

articleTitle: Spectral Broadening of 150 mJ From a Yb-Doped Thin-Disk Amplifier at 5 kHz Using a Gas-Filled Multipass Cell
abstract: We report nonlinear spectral broadening of 150 mJ from a Yb-doped thin-disk amplifier at 5 kHz repetition rate using a Herriott-type multipass cell and show its compressibility, close to the Fourier-transform limit, to 37 fs.

articleTitle: Lorentz Reciprocity’s Constraints on Reflection
abstract: We reveal Lorentz reciprocity’s constraints on reflection. We determine all attainable reflection coefficients of n-port scattering matrices with prescribed singular values, with and without assuming reciprocity. Their difference establishes the reciprocity constraints.

articleTitle: Optical data transmission using inverse-designed silicon multimode photonic circuits and spectrally flattened microcombs
abstract: We demonstrate a 1.12-Tbps error-free data transmission throughout inverse-designed multimode photonic circuits using spectrally flattened microcombs as a multi-wavelength laser source.

articleTitle: Optical Control of One-Dimensional Topological End States via Soliton Formation
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical active control of topological states in evanescently-coupled waveguide arrays. Soliton formation optically induces a linear topological end state in the bulk of a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice that we observe via a pump-probe technique.

articleTitle: Direct-Laser-Written Polymer Nanowires for Broadband Single Photon Collection from Epitaxially-Grown Quantum Dots
abstract: Polymer nanowires are fabricated using direct laser writing to collect single photons from epitaxially-grown InAs/GaAs quantum dots, providing broadband out-of-plane waveguiding, emission control, and improved collection efficiency, with limited adverse effect on the underlying devices.

articleTitle: Multimode fiber microcomb and beyond
abstract: We demonstrate spatiotemporally mode-locked and phase-independent turnkey Kerr soliton microcomb through backward Brillouin effect, as well as coexisting forward Brillouin lasers with squeezed phase noise, based on an ultrahigh-quality-factor Fabry-Perot microresonator made of multimode fiber.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Excitation of Xenon in Tight and Loose Focusing Configurations
abstract: We report the spectral signatures induced by ultrafast laser excitation of Xe. There is no significant difference in the number of observable Xe transitions regardless of the focusing condition, suggesting the possibility for filamentation-based remote sensing of Xe.

articleTitle: Fully passive logic using 1-GHz in-fibre phase filters
abstract: We report realization of an integrated (all-pass) phase-only filter with a record frequency resolution of 1 GHz (at least 10× improvement compared to a waveshaper) using Bragg grating technology in an all-fibre platform. The phase filter is utilized to realize high-speed fully-passive NOT and XNOR logic operations in a cm-long structure.

articleTitle: Free Electron Interaction with Nonlinear Optical States
abstract: We couple free electrons with nonlinear optical states and frequency combs in photonic chip-based microresonators. Intracavity nonlinear dissipative structures including optical solitons imprint unique fingerprints in electron spectra and their Ramsey interference patterns.

articleTitle: 40-GHz resonant-cavity 2-D photodetector array using InP/InGaAs DH structure for advanced optical wireless communications
abstract: We present a resonant cavity 4×4 photodetector array operated at up to 40 GHz. It enables the separation of wavelengths in the WDM-FSO beam and simultaneously increases the aperture size against the optical alignment issue.

articleTitle: Investigations on Amplification of Feedback in Single-Mode Ridge Waveguide Optical Amplifiers at 767nm
abstract: We present an experimental setup to investigate the sensitivity of ridge waveguide semiconductor optical amplifiers to optical feedback. We determine the amplification in forward and backward directions at 767nm at varying seed and feedback powers.

articleTitle: Wideband Transmission of Topologically Confined Modes with Record Low Crosstalk in Fibers
abstract: We demonstrate record low crosstalk < −40 dB/km for ~35 modes over a km-length fiber with bandwidth exceeding 130 nm covering the S+C+L telecom bands, owing to fundamental mode-mixing resistance offered by the phenomenon of topological confinement.

articleTitle: Tunable Silicon Ring Resonator with Wavelength-scale Radius at 2-µm Waveband
abstract: A tunable silicon photonic microring resonator with radius of 2 µm is demonstrated at 2-µm waveband. Ultra-large free spectral range of 75.312 nm and extinction ratio of 23.93 dB are achieved.

articleTitle: Numerical experiments for exploring propagation effects in high-harmonic generation from dielectric thin films
abstract: First-principles calculations for nonlinear light propagation in laser-irradiated silicon thin films unveiled physical mechanisms determining properties of HHG in reflected and transmitted waves. Frequency-resolved analysis of light pulses identified regions in the film generating high-order harmonics.

articleTitle: Wide-range Angle-sensitive Plasmonic Color Printing with a Lossy Resonator
abstract: We demonstrate a wide gamut of color generation by large-scale, lithography-free, and environment-friendly plasmonic structures with a resolution of 100 µm for macroscopic color printing by utilizing femtosecond laser photomodification of multi-functional optical elements.

articleTitle: Cavity-enhanced second- and third-harmonic generation from a diamond microdisk
abstract: We demonstrate cavity-enhanced second- and third-harmonic generation from a diamond microdisk containing nitrogen-vacancy centers. The photon emission follows a clear dependency with detuning of both the pump and emission modes, indicating a doubly-resonant configuration.

articleTitle: Scanless terahertz time-domain imaging
abstract: Through diffraction, we combine a single-pixel imaging approach and a single-shot detection technique to achieve scanless time-domain imaging at terahertz frequencies. We also apply compressive sensing to further reduce the acquisition time.

articleTitle: Dual-soliton-microcombs based coherent fiber-optic distributed acoustic sensing
abstract: We report the concept of a coherently-parallel fiber-optic distributed-acoustic-sensing, based on integrated dual-soliton-microcombs. It enables linear superposition of acoustic responses scaling with the comb-line number. Leveraging 10-line soliton pairs, a world-class detection limit 560 fε/√Hz@1kHz is achieved.

articleTitle: Revealing the single-shot pulse evolution dynamics in a CW-seeded femtosecond optical parametric generator
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time the round-trip pulse evolutions dynamics in a CW-seeded femtosecond optical parametric generator utilizing the dispersive temporal interferometer technique.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Laser Induced Site-specific Reduction of Silver Salt and Graphene Oxide Films
abstract: Simultaneous silver salt reduction and deposition at specific sites of graphene oxide films by femtosecond laser irradiation is achieved and Raman analysis corresponding to varying concentration of silver salt loading is investigated.

articleTitle: 400 kHz repetition rate THz-TDS with 24 mW of average power driven by a compact industrial Yb-laser
abstract: We demonstrate a 24 mW average power THz-TDS at 400 kHz repetition rate, based on optical rectification in lithium niobate, driven directly by a compact commercial fs-laser. We study repetition rate effects between 40 and 400 kHz, showing thermal effects do not affect the generated THz pulse train in this average power regime.

articleTitle: Widely Tunable, Low-Threshold Raman Laser Based on Dispersion-Managed Lithium Niobate Microresonator
abstract: We achieve sub-milliwatt-threshold Raman lasing in a high-Q thin-film lithium niobate microresonator and demonstrate a tuning range of about 300 nm by sweeping the pump wavelength only within the telecom C- and L-band.

articleTitle: Toward Single Photon Detection using Nanophotonic Parametric Amplifiers
abstract: Ultra-intense parametric amplification can be used for amplifying single photons to macroscopic levels. We experimentally detected coherent states with 〈N〉 = 4.86 with 17% efficiency and 2.5% dark count probability.

articleTitle: Integrated Parallel Chaos driven LiDAR System with High Interference Tolerance
abstract: We introduce a chaotic microcomb based high interference-tolerance parallel LiDAR. Parallel chaos with record-high noise spectra beyond 7 GHz leads to sub-cm-level ranging accuracy. The intrinsic orthogonality permits single-pixel detection, greatly simplifying the system architecture.

articleTitle: Generation and characterization of CEP controllable, sub-cycle optical vortex pulses
abstract: We introduce the generation and pulse characterization of carrier-envelope-phase controllable, sub-cycle optical vortex pulses in the short-wave infrared regime.

articleTitle: Massively-Parallel Broadband Diffractive Processor for All-Optical Computation of a Large Set of Linear Transformations
abstract: We design a massively-parallel broadband diffractive processor for all-optical computation of a large number (N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</inf> > 180) of arbitrarily-selected, complex-valued linear transformations by encoding the input/output of each transformation using a unique wavelength.

articleTitle: Optical Arbitrary Waveform Generation and Measurement (OAWG/OAWM) Enabling 320 GBd 32QAM Transmission
abstract: We demonstrate optical arbitrary waveform generation at a record-high bandwidth of 325 GHz by phase-stabilized superimposing of four tributary signals. In a proof-of-concept experiment, we use the scheme to generate 320 GBd 32QAM data signals, which are transmitted over 87 km and received by an optical arbitrary waveform measurement system.

articleTitle: Artificial vision systems inspired by the eyes of aquatic animals
abstract: We present our recent advances in the building of artificial vision systems inspired by the eyes of aquatic animals, including fishes, cephalopods, and crabs. The complete set of bioinspired eyes shows exceptional imaging capabilities.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Ablation of Monolayer Hexagonal Boron Nitride
abstract: We report the first experiment on single-shot femtosecond laser ablation of monolayer hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). The observed intrinsic ablation threshold fluence is nearly 660 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, which is at least 10× higher than all other two-dimensional materials. Our work indicates the feasibility of hBN for femtosecond laser patterning.

articleTitle: Temporal trapping: an all-optical route to strong coupling and quantum information processing
abstract: We propose a novel confinement method of photons, temporal trapping, to circumvent the tradeoff between optical confinement and loss in nonlinear photonics, showing a potential route to all-optical strong coupling and deterministic optical quantum computation.

articleTitle: Real-Time Observation of the Buildup Dynamics of Spatiotemporal Mode-Locking in Spatial Domain
abstract: The beam profile dynamics in the buildup of spatiotemporal mode-locked lasers are real-time observed, by use of an array of spatial samplings. The observations reveal the complex spatiotemporal dynamics of the self-organization of high-dimensional soliton.

articleTitle: Continuously Tunable All-Polarization-Maintaining Fiber Laser Based on a Compact Lyot-Filter/SA Hybrid
abstract: A compact Lyot-filter/SA hybrid that offers extra tunable degrees of freedom is proposed to support continuous wavelength tuning and dual-wavelength mode-locking with low free-running wavelength shift in an all-polarization-maintaining fiber laser.

articleTitle: Taming mid-IR resonances with naturally hyperbolic hBN
abstract: We study theoretically and experimentally light interaction with naturally hyperbolic material, hexagonal boron nitride, in the vicinity of TO phonon polariton resonances and find multiple strong resonances can be sustained across a broad wavelength band.

articleTitle: Interband Cascade Light Emitting Diodes Centered at 5.8 µm for on-site Detection of Food Contaminants
abstract: Mid infrared spectroscopy is a useful tool for quality control in the food production chain. We present Interband Cascade Light Emitting Diodes centered at 5.8 µm that enable cost effective and portable testing of food and feed commodities.

articleTitle: All-Optical Kerr Synchronization of a Dissipative Kerr Soliton Microcomb to an Optical Reference for Clockwork Operation
abstract: We demonstrate Kerr-mediated all-optical synchronization of a dissipative Kerr solition with an external reference laser in a single microring resonator. It enables passive stability transfer and frequency division for optical clock metrology applications.

articleTitle: Miniature solid-state laser for space applications
abstract: A miniature solid-state laser was developed using radiation-hardened components for space-based applications. The volume is 60 c.c., and the weight is 160 g. It can produce 6, 3 and 1 mJ at 1064, 532 and 266 nm respectively at 1-50 Hz.

articleTitle: Power Scaling in N2O-filled Hollow-core Fiber with Helium Buffer Gas
abstract: Spectral narrowing and power reduction, resulting from the thermal effect of nonlinear molecules at high repletion rate, can be mitigated by adding helium buffer-gas in N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O-filled hollow-core fiber without changing the spectral phase.

articleTitle: Strong quantum mechanical squeezing based on nonlinear dispersive loss in semiconductor lasers
abstract: We predict that a combination of frequency-dependent outcoupling and optical nonlinearity in semiconductor lasers can create sharply intensity-dependent loss that squeezes intensity noise far below the shot noise limit.

articleTitle: Orbital angular momentum emission from a high quality factor photonic crystal ring
abstract: We provide quantitative understanding of orbital angular momentum (OAM) emission for whispering gallery modes in a microring, and achieve high-Q (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>), high ejection efficiency (up to 90 %), and highOAM number (up to 60).

articleTitle: Ultranarrow-Linewidth Stimulated Intermodal Forward Brillouin Scattering
abstract: We demonstrate strong (~ 300 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>) and ultranarrow linewidth (~100 kHz) stimulated intermodal forward Brillouin scattering in a homogeneous few-mode optical fiber taper. This unique combination of parameters can enable record performance Brillouin-based microwave-photonic devices.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic Control of High Energy Light-Materials Interaction
abstract: We study experimentally and theoretically the effects of intense laser beams interaction with metallic nanostructures in the ablation regime. Specifically, at high laser beam fluences we create ablation plasmas and study their spatio-temporal evolution as a function of the underlying metallic nanostructure. Our work hints the possibility of controlling ablation plasmas with properly selected systems structured at the nanoscale, offering new opportunities for a range of applications from compact accelerators and light sources to advanced manufacturing to plasma medicine.

articleTitle: Computational Spectroscopy via Large Aperture Meta-Optics
abstract: We demonstrate the concept of a meta-optic based computational spectrometer, combining a meta-optic, which encodes the spectrum of transmitted light into a spatial intensity pattern, that is retrievable through a computational backend.

articleTitle: Low-loss SH-propagation in nanoscale AlGaAs-on-insulator waveguides for nonlinear quantum light sources operating with telecom wavelengths
abstract: We report unprecedentedly low second harmonic band propagation losses in highly nonlinear AlGaAs-on-insulator waveguides pumped in the telecom L-band. These findings pave the way towards para metric nonlinearities at single photon-level.

articleTitle: Yellow-Green Micro-LEDs with Nanoporous Distributed Bragg Reflectors
abstract: Yellow-green InGaN/GaN micro-LEDs with nanoporous distributed Bragg reflectors emits stable wavelength of 547 nm at high current density and exhibits the highest modulation bandwidth of 442 MHz with a measured transmission rate of 800 Mbit/s.

articleTitle: Quantifying Methane Production at a Cattle Grazing Site using Open-Path Dual-Comb Spectroscopy
abstract: To better quantify methane emissions resulting from grazing cattle, a controlled methane release at an agricultural site is performed using dual comb spectroscopy. The achieved methane concentration precision is below 10 nmol/mol.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength Raman Random Fiber Laser Using a Microfiber Knot Resonator
abstract: We report a novel 1650 nm multi-wavelength Raman random fiber laser using a microfiber knot resonator. Up to 44 wavelength channels within 3 dB bandwidth are achieved.

articleTitle: On-chip Bragg grating inscription in As2Se3 rib waveguides via photosensitivity at 1550 nm
abstract: We present the experimental observation of 1550 nm laser-induced Hill-type gratings in As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> rib waveguides. Such gratings exhibit narrow reflection bandwidth and highly tailorable resonant wavelengths, allowing versatile functionalities in nonlinear integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Optomechanical ring resonator on hybrid piezo-optomechanical platform
abstract: We demonstrate the first co-propagating wave optomechanical ring resonator based on a hybrid piezo-optomechanical platform of zinc-oxide and boron-doped gallium phosphide where highly confined phonons and photons circulate and resonate simultaneously, leading to significantly enhanced optomechanical interaction.

articleTitle: Quantum-Coherent X-rays from Crystals
abstract: We present a quantum analysis of X-ray radiation generated from free electrons interacting with crystalline materials, revealing the role of the electron’s quantum-wave nature and of the radiation’s quantum-particle nature.

articleTitle: Meta-optic accelerators for object classifier
abstract: A meta-optic platform for accelerating object classification is demonstrated. End-to-end design is used to co-optimize the optical and digital systems resulting in a high-speed and robust classifier with 93.1% accuracy in classifying handwritten digits.

articleTitle: Annihilation of k-gap Solitons in Photonic Time Crystals
abstract: We study interaction between two k-gap solitons in Photonic-Time-Crystals. We show that they always annihilate each other, regardless of initial power, phase, and direction. The residuals of interaction strongly affect proceeding solitons as cascaded collision.

articleTitle: Quantum Dot Single-Photon Collection Increased by Metallic Nano-Rings
abstract: By depositing metallic nano-rings on the surface of GaAs chips containing single InAs quantum dots, we show that single-photon extraction is increased, reaching fluxes as high as 7M photons/s, in a broadband, scalable device.

articleTitle: Non-Hermitian metasurface for asymmetric thermal emission
abstract: Non-Hermitian optics provides a unique platform to take advantage of absorption losses in materials and control radiative properties. We demonstrate a non-Hermitian metasurface that exhibit directional suppression of thermal radiation while maintaining transmission in mid-infrared.

articleTitle: Non-hermitian Physics in a Heterogenous Photonic Molecule
abstract: Previous work in non-hermitian photonics focused on homogeneous photonic molecules. Here, heterogeneous photonic molecules of nanobeam cavity coupled to a ring resonator are studied. Non-hermitian physics will be explored by using colloidal nanoplatelets.

articleTitle: Cavity-Enhanced Single-Photon Emission from Artificial Atoms in Silicon
abstract: We show enhanced single-photon emission from artificial atoms in silicon by coupling them to cavities with high quality factors and small mode volumes, thus enabling enhanced light-matter interactions which are crucial for quantum technologies.

articleTitle: Framework of Free-Electron Quantum Optics Using Photonic Integrated Circuits
abstract: We develop a framework of using photonic integrated circuits for free-electron quantum optics applications. We formulate the interaction using a three-dimensional QED quantization procedure, and discuss a few fundamental limitations and specific application scenarios.

articleTitle: Recovering quantum entanglement after its certification
abstract: While being a prerequisite for quantum applications, entanglement certification per se destroys the entanglement under investigation. We experimentally certify entanglement without its complete destruction by employing non-projective measurements and subsequently recover the original entanglement.

articleTitle: Large Field-of-View LWIR Imaging via Meta-Optics
abstract: Large Field-of-View (FoV) imaging is desirable for many applications. We demonstrate 80° FoV LWIR imaging with 1 cm entrance aperture using a meta-optic under broadband thermal emission.

articleTitle: Effect of O/E Front-end Frequency Response on Carrier-less Phase Retrieval Receiver and its Compensation
abstract: We investigate the effect of the opto-electronic front-end frequency response on carrier-less phase retrieval receivers. System performance improvement is verified by employing an adaptive equalizer preceding a modified Gerchberg–Saxton phase retrieval algorithm.

articleTitle: X-Ray-Driven Photon Bunching
abstract: We measure the second-order coherence function g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> for X-ray-driven light emission (scintillation), observing that it is bunched (g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> >1), and can achieve extreme bunching values (g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>~97) in perovskite nano-crystals.

articleTitle: Realizing Tight-binding Hamiltonians using Site-controlled Coupled Cavity Arrays
abstract: Using a cavity array made up of high Q nanocavities equipped with specially designed thermo-optic island heaters for independent control, we demonstrate a programmable device implementing tight-binding Hamiltonians with access to the full eigen-energy spectrum.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Reconfigurable Imaginary Gauged Laser Array
abstract: We demonstrate the first integrated two-dimensional laser array with a reconfigurable synthetic imaginary gauge field. The point-gap topology in this non-Hermitian system manifests as skin modes, which enable persistent phase locking compatible with mode shaping.

articleTitle: Plasmonic BICs as Biosensors with Better Detectivity
abstract: Plasmonic sensors exhibit high sensitivity due to enhanced local fields. But, their detectivity is poor because of their poor Q-factors. Using a plasmonic BIC, we experimentally demonstrate enhanced Q-factors in a plasmonic antimouse IgG sensor.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Frequency Comb from a Single Dual-Pumped Microring Dissipative Kerr Soliton
abstract: We present a two-dimensional frequency comb, with distinct fixed repetition-rates in both the azimuthal mode dimension and an orthogonal dimension parametrized by the angular phase-velocity. We experimental demonstrate it using a single integrated microring bichromatically pumped.

articleTitle: Towards superradiant spontaneous four wave mixing in an array of silicon microresonators
abstract: We demonstrate cooperative spontaneous four wave mixing in an array of silicon resonators, in which the photon pair generation rate is enhanced with respect to the incoherent sum of the rates of the individual emitters.

articleTitle: Low-loss, fine resolution wavelength-selective switch realized at a silicon photonics foundry
abstract: We report a demonstration of a 3-channel wavelength-selective switch with individual channel bandwidths of 2 GHz and drop port loss below 1 dB, paving the way for efficient spectrum utilization in quantum networking applications.

articleTitle: Ab initio Theory for Exceptional-Point Lasers and Periodic-Inversion Lasers
abstract: We show that lasers near exceptional points have an oscillating population inversion that generates a frequency comb. We develop an ab-initio theory describing all steady-state properties of such lasers and validate it with FDTD.

articleTitle: Electrically Reconfigurable Index Tuning Metasurface
abstract: We are reporting electrically tunable metasurface working in the range covering C-band to O-band. ENZ condition is enabled at/around optical telecommunications wavelength, which permits the design of new optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal surface emitting lasers operating near 2 µm.
abstract: Room temperature continuous wave operation of 2 µm photonic crystal surface emitting lasers (PCSELs) is reported. The GaSb-based PCSELs fabricated using highly uniform air-pocket retaining regrowth technology demonstrated threshold current densities of 500 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and generated tens of mW of output power at 20 °C.

articleTitle: An Efficient Deep Learning-Based Electromagnetic Response Prediction Model for Coding Grid Meta-atoms
abstract: We proposed an efficient deep learning-based ElectroMagnetic (EM) response prediction model for coding grid meta-atoms. Prediction errors are less than 3° and 1.5% in phase and reflectivity.

articleTitle: Stepped-Frequency THz-wave Signal Generation from a dissipative Kerr microresonator soliton comb
abstract: A stepped-frequency 290-GHz signal is generated from two comb modes of a Kerr microresonator soliton comb, in which one of the comb modes is frequency-shifted by an optical recirculating loop.

articleTitle: Enhanced Two-Photon Absorption Effect of a Fano Resonant Silicon Metasurface
abstract: We demonstrate that two-photon absorption effect of a silicon metasurface can be boosted, with β=173.2 cm/MW and I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sat</inf>=93 MW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, due to local-field enhancement by tailored high-Q Fano resonance.

articleTitle: Fabrication Process to Minimize Physical Volume of Surface Plasmon Nanolasers
abstract: This study used a lift-off process to minimize a surface plasmon laser composed of ZnO nanowires and aluminum. We successfully achieved lasing of a substrate-free nanolaser and reduced the device thickness to 200 nm.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Optical Absorption by Oxygen Plasma Treatment in Carbon Nanotube-based Black Paint Coating
abstract: The effect of oxygen (O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) plasma treatment on the reflectance properties and surface morphology of carbon nanotube-based paint was investigated. We demonstrate a hemispherical reflectance of less than 2.5% throughout the UV-Vis-NIR range.

articleTitle: Distributed phase sensing using two-mode squeezed states in a truncated SU(1,1) interferometer
abstract: We demonstrate distributed phase sensing with a truncated SU(1,1) interferometer through the measurement of a linear combination of two phases distributed between the two beams of a two-mode squeezed state. We theoretically analyze the sensitivity enhancement with respect to the corresponding classical strategy and experimentally demonstrate a 2 dB quantum noise reduction in the measurement of a linear combination of two phases.

articleTitle: Broadband programmable metasurface for multifunctional control of THz waves
abstract: We report a multifunctional terahertz (THz) programmable metasurface integrated vanadium dioxide (VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), which can achieve dynamic beam steering from 0.735 THz to 0.965 THz and efficient polarization conversion from 0.84 THz to 1.3 THz.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Design of a Fast All-Optical Single-Photon Switch with Pre-Emphasis Pump Scheme
abstract: Fast and ultralow-loss switching is crucial for optical quantum communication and computation. All-optical switches with gigahertz bandwidths that can be fabricated in a scalable foundry-based photonic integration platform are optimized for energy-efficient operation.

articleTitle: Interferometric Photonic Crystal Modulators with Lithium Niobate
abstract: We demonstrate a photonic crystal cavity interferometric modulator in thin-film lithium niobate on insulator with 6 GHz bandwidth, 35 dB extinction, 2π ×1.27 GHz/V DC-tuning, and a 40-by-200 micron square footprint.

articleTitle: Coupling Effects in Transition Metal Dichalcogenide Homojunctions with Linear and Nonlinear Optical Spectroscopies
abstract: We investigate artificially stacked few-layer MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> homojunctions with linear and nonlinear optical spectroscopies, observing various coupling effects in the layers.

articleTitle: Control of Photopolymerization of BITh Thin Films with Plasmonic Metal/Dielectric Substrates
abstract: We studied effects of metal-dielectric substrates on photopolymerization of BITh monomer. We found that the rate of photopolymerization is getting higher if the monomer film is deposited on top of silver, gold, and lamellar structures.

articleTitle: Quantum memory induces anomalous far off-resonant absorption suppression
abstract: Far off-resonance linear absorption in bulk gallium nitride is anomalous by orders of magnitude with respect to a Lorentzian model. Theoretical analysis shows that the suppression originates from a quantum-memory effect.

articleTitle: Photon Dynamics in Chip-Scale High-Peak-Power Semiconductor/Solid-state Vertically Integrated Laser
abstract: We experimentally verified the temporal dynamics of photons during passively Q-switched oscillation in semiconductor/solid-state vertically integrated laser cavities, which agrees well with the results predicted theoretically by a simultaneous rate equations model.

articleTitle: Fast Trapped-ion Laser Cooling in Structured Light Fields
abstract: We simulate trapped ion laser cooling from outside the Lamb-Dicke limit, predicting 3 − 5× speed up for practical experimental parameters using standing waves as compared to running waves. Prospects for similar techniques in ground-state-cooling are discussed.

articleTitle: Ultrafast long–wavelength excitation of coherent optical phonons in bismuth
abstract: We present femtosecond x-ray diffraction experiments performed on single crystal bismuth excited by 5 µm laser pulses, and nonlinear THz experiments. Our results point to a new excitation quantum pathway at longer excitation wavelengths allowing for coherent phonon excitation at the X point in the Brillouin zone.

articleTitle: Waveguide-Integrated Superconducting Nanowire Arrays for Single Photon Detection with Number-Resolution
abstract: We fabricated and characterized waveguide-integrated photon number resolving superconducting nanowire single photon detectors with up to 16 detector elements obtaining a high timing resolution of 10.4 ps.

articleTitle: III-V-on-Silicon-Nitride Mode-Locked Lasers
abstract: Here, we will discuss the latest results on the integration of mode-locked lasers on a silicon nitride platform.

articleTitle: Niobium Nitride Superconducting Nanowire Single Photon Detector on 4H-Silicon Carbide
abstract: We fabricated and characterized U-shaped NbN SNSPDs on bulk crystal 4H-c-cut SiC. They exhibit uniform photoresponses under perpendicular illumination, corresponding to a SDE of 0.02% at 775 nm and saturation at NIR wavelength range.

articleTitle: Enhanced self-phase modulation and supercontinuum generation in silicon nitride waveguides with graphene oxide films
abstract: We demonstrate enhanced self-phase modulation and supercontinuum generation with short optical pulses at high peak powers in silicon nitride waveguides integrated with two-dimensional (2D) layered graphene oxide films.

articleTitle: Detection of Ethanol in Gasoline with a Mid-Infrared Microspectrometer Based on Metallic Metasurface Filters
abstract: A microspectrometer comprising of sub-wavelength metallic micro-hole array filters in combination with a reverse-lens mid-infrared thermal camera is demonstrated. A Peltier module provides temperature stabilization. Results show determination of low ethanol content in unleaded gasoline.

articleTitle: Highly Sensitive Photodetector Based on Inorganic-Organic Heterojunction Phototransistor
abstract: We propose a high-performance inorganic-organic phototransistor based on planner IGZO-ADT heterojunction. The device exhibits superior photosensitivity to visible light and excellent stability at ambient conditions.

articleTitle: Combining Surface Acoustic Waves with Gated Quantum Dots
abstract: We demonstrate InAs quantum dots (QDs) with near-transform-limited optical linewidths using a gated structure. This gate structure is shown to be compatible with surface acoustic waves. This technological development may enable low-noise quantum transduction.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in SDM Transmission Using Standard Cladding Diameter Multicore Fibers
abstract: We describe recent efforts towards high capacity transmission using standard cladding diameter 4-core multicore fibers including 372.8 Tb/s, 213.3 km, unrepeatered transmission and 1 Pb/s transmission using 20 THz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Experimental Realization of an Extremely Low-cost Quadrature Optical Interferometer
abstract: We report on the construction and characterization of a quadrature-detected optical interferometer that can be assembled on a budget of less than US$500, and in which quadrature detection is achieved by means of polarization control.

articleTitle: Laser Sintering of Porous Aluminum Nitride for Environmental Applications
abstract: Aluminum nitride (AlN) is a high-bandgap, high-optical-refractive-index, electrical insulator with epsilon-near-zero behavior in the infrared atmospheric window. Towards binderless additive manufacturing of porous AlN, we demonstrate a 370% increase in hardness through laser sintering.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Wavemeter Using Minimum-Phase Mach-Zehnder Interferometer and Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: We present a wavemeter that meets the minimum-phase condition, allowing phase retrieval through the system magnitude. Wavelength measurement is done by polynomial regression resulting in increased robustness to phase errors (< 1 [pm] error).

articleTitle: Simulated Scattering of a Beam Carrying Orbital Angular Momentum from a Microparticle
abstract: We use multiphysics software COMSOL to simulate and evaluate interactions between structured light carrying orbital angular momentum and a single microparticles. We investigate the impact of particle location with respect to the structured light spatial intensity distribution.

articleTitle: Super-Mossian Dielectrics for Nanophotonics
abstract: Searching for high-index dielectrics, we identify materials that break the index upper bound set by Moss’ rule. We highlight the promise of such super-Mossian materials by demonstrating nanophotonic devices made of FeS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>.

articleTitle: Plasmonic-nanocavity boosted dark excitons for electrically tunable nanolight source
abstract: We demonstrate an electrically tunable nanolight source based on the integration of an h-BN-encapsulated WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> monolayer within an array of plasmonic cavities to access and drastically boost dark exciton emission.

articleTitle: Dynamical encircling of an exceptional point in anti-PT-symmetric integrated photonic systems
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated encircling of an exceptional point with a fixed loss rate in a compact anti-PT-symmetric integrated photonic system, where chiral transmission was achieved with a device length of only 70 μm.

articleTitle: Subwavelength Diamond Grating Metawaveguides for Ring Resonator Mode Volume Reduction
abstract: We demonstrate a nanostructured silicon photonic ring resonator configuration with diamond shape subwavelength gratings capable of reducing mode volume, V, by a factor of ~10x while maintaining high quality factors, Q > 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>.

articleTitle: High Resolution On-Chip Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Single-Photon Buffer
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a room-temperature, voltage controlled, short-term quantum photonics memory on a lithium niobate chip. Our chip is capable of resolving 100 ps time steps with 0.74 dB loss per round-trip.

articleTitle: Piezoelectric Programmable Optical Mode Conversion in a Photonic Integrated Circuit
abstract: Waveguide-based optical mode conversion requires wavelength-scale patterning of the waveguide’s optical properties. We implement a programmable version of this patterning with piezoelectrically actuated photonics.

articleTitle: Transferring the Timing Stability of a Mode-Locked Laser to a Microcomb Using the Electro-Optic Sampling-Based Timing Detector
abstract: We transferred the timing stability of a 2-GHz mode-locked laser to a 21.956-GHz microcomb with electro-optic sampling-based timing detection. The phase noise of the microcomb was suppressed by >40 dB at 1-Hz offset frequency.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum Generation in Si-SiO2-Si Horizontal Slot Waveguide Fabricated by µ-Transfer Printing
abstract: We fabricated a Si-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-Si horizontal slot waveguide using µ-Transfer Printing method. Supercontinuum generation ranging from 1.35 to 2.05 µm was demonstrated with a coupled energy of as low as 10 pJ.

articleTitle: Influence of Excitonic Correlations on the High Harmonic Generation in Monolayer TMDCs
abstract: Fully microscopic many-body models are used to show that excitonic correlations dramatically enhance the high harmonic generation in monolayer MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Especially near the bandgap the enhancement can be two orders of magnitude or more.

articleTitle: Burst-Mode Operation of Silicon Photonic Waveguide Integrated Germanium Avalanche Photodiodes
abstract: We demonstrate the operation of a waveguide integrated germanium avalanche photodiode on silicon for use in a burst-mode receiver. We have shown this device has error-free operation over 1e8 bits for data at 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: High Dose-Rate MeV Electron Beam from a Tightly-Focused Femtosecond IR Laser in Ambient Air: A Radiation Safety Issue
abstract: We present a straightforward method to generate MeV-ranged, high dose-rate electrons in ambient air by tightly focusing a mJ-class femtosecond laser. The ability to reach relativistic intensities in ambient conditions leads to significant radiation safety concerns.

articleTitle: Integrated DBR-based Pockels Laser
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated DBR-based external cavity laser with linear laser frequency detuning capability based on the Pockels electro-optic effect, with a wide tuning range up to 8 GHz.

articleTitle: Methodology for Device, Circuit and Architecture Level Co-design and Optimization of Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing Links
abstract: We present a Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM) statistical model for study and optimization of device, circuit, and link architecture parameters. Using the model, we explore the rich space of DWDM parameters and some fundamental tradeoffs in design of such systems, as well as the often-neglected interdependence between low level device behavior and the link performance.

articleTitle: Photonic Space-Time Topological Edge States
abstract: We introduce topological edge states in photonic space-time crystals. We show that photonic space-time crystals support propagating edge states and find a unique edge state that grows exponentially in energy whilst following the spatio-temporal edge.

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Asynchronous Electro-Optic Sampling Technique for High-speed Optoelectronic Devices
abstract: A dual-comb asynchronous electro-optic sampling (DC-AEOS) system is built for characterizing the response of high-speed optoelectronic devices. Utilizing DC-AEOS, a 40 GHz photodiode is characterized with short acquisition time, and high signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Smart Snapshot spectropolarimetric imaging enabled by optical metasurfaces and deep learning
abstract: We present broadband full-stokes spectropolarimetry using a chiral metasurface, which can retrieve spatially distributed wavelength information and full-stokes polarization states in a single shot.

articleTitle: Picosecond-spaced time-entangled photonic qudits on chip and their use for quantum communications
abstract: We present a platform for the generation and processing of picosecond-spaced time entangled photonic qudits, based on on-chip interferometers and a spiral waveguide. We apply these states to implement quantum communications over fiber telecom networks.

articleTitle: Optical Tweezers for 3D Assembly and Enhancement of Optical Chemosensors
abstract: We use automated optical tweezers to assemble 3D micro- and nano-structured systems out of hundreds of building blocks of various materials. In particular, microtoroid chemosensors can be augmented with particles for improved optical coupling.

articleTitle: Intermodal Brillouin Gain Spectra in Few Mode Optical Fibers
abstract: We model the Brillouin gain spectra between optical and acoustic LP modes in a few mode graded index fiber. We find good agreement when comparing to measurements.

articleTitle: Silicon-Nanowire-Based Polarization Diversified CWDM Optical DeMUX Based on Delayed Interferometric Filters
abstract: We demonstrate a Si-wire polarization-diversified Coarse WDM DeMUX for high- density optical interconnects. The device consists of a hybrid mode conversion-type polarization splitter rotator and delayed interferometric DeMUX. The fabricated device exhibited low loss and polarization-dependent loss of <1.0 dB, suppressing crosstalk (<−20 dB).

articleTitle: Second-harmonic conformal transformation for visible and in-situ detection of infrared optical vortices
abstract: Conformal transformation provides an effective way to detect optical orbital angular momentum (OAM). We demonstrate here a second-harmonic spiral transformation that enables infrared-visible detection of OAM states with a low energy loss. Remarkably, we predict and observe a record-high optical finesse, indicating improved separation efficiency enabled by this method.

articleTitle: Disentanglement of Electronic and Structure Orders in Photoinduced Phase Transition of VO2
abstract: Using a dual-probe setting to simultaneously obtain the structural and electronic responses upon photo-excitations we reveal a new many-body physics mechanism responsible for the insulator-metal phase transitions of VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>.

articleTitle: Full-field spectral-temporal analysis unveils isomeric dynamics of soliton quintet complexes
abstract: Soliton compounds present versatile and sophisticated intra-molecule assemblies. Here, we experimentally characterize manifold isomeric scenarios of soliton quintets, intensively paving a novel route for full-field reconstruction and further manipulation of soliton complexes.

articleTitle: Towards Continuous Fiber Birefringence Compensation with Single-Photon-Level Light
abstract: We propose a method for continuously compensating for the polarization state change of photons propagating in fibers. This technique operates at a single-photon-level intensity and therefore imposes minimal noise on the quantum channel.

articleTitle: Fourier-transform mid-IR hyperspectral imaging with undetected photons
abstract: Quantum imaging with undetected photons allows measuring mid-infrared information with visible or near-infrared silicon-based light detection. We demonstrate a combination of quantum imaging and Fourier-transform spectral analysis for broadband high-resolution mid-infrared hyperspectral imaging.

articleTitle: Photonic Time Quasi-Crystals
abstract: We study light propagation of electromagnetic waves in a medium with a homogeneous refractive index varying quasi-periodically in time. We study two types of time-varying quasi-crystals: Andrey Aubrey and Fibonacci sequence.

articleTitle: Scalable Laser Integration on Thin-film Lithium Niobate Platform
abstract: We demonstrate a technique allowing scalable integration of III-V lasers on thin-film lithium niobate platform. Our method relies on an unconventional growth of the III-V epitaxial layer such that the n-layer ends on the top.

articleTitle: High-resolution Dual Comb Spectroscopy to Validate High-temperature H2O Absorption Models
abstract: We present broadband dual frequency comb measurements of high-temperature water vapor from 1.3-1.5 μm (6660-7700 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) under controlled conditions up to 1300 K. This data is used to validate recently proposed high-temperature absorption models.

articleTitle: Near-Infrared Lab-on-a-Chip Optical Biosensor with Micro Ring Resonator and Fourier Transform Spectrometer on SOI platform
abstract: We demonstrated the design and experimental results of the near-infrared lab-on-a-chip optical biosensor platform that monolithically integrates the micro-ring-resonator and the on-chip spectrometer on the SOI wafer with the limit of detection of 0.042 RIU.

articleTitle: Artificial neural networks applied in fast-designing forces in silicon subwavelength grating waveguides
abstract: We propose a subwavelength grating waveguide designed by artificial neural networks and predict the optical force generated when the Bloch mode propagates along it for trapping 50 nm nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Image Sensors with Metaphotonic Color-Routing Nanostructures and the Rapid Resolution-Restoring Demosaic Algorithm
abstract: We simulate characteristics of colour-routing image sensors revealing higher peak-SNR and color fidelity with slightly degraded spatial resolutions compared to those of conventional sensors. To compensate, we propose the rapid resolution-restoring demosaic algorithm for colour-routers.

articleTitle: Structured light analogy of quantum squeezed states
abstract: We demonstrate novel structured light as an analogy of quantum squeezed states, transferring quantum squeezing concepts to characterize optical spatial modes, providing flexible control of deep-subwavelength features breaking the spatial diffraction limit over ~λ/1000.

articleTitle: Electrically driven lasing of a topological defect in a vertical cavity laser array
abstract: We present electrically driven lasing from a topological defect in a vertical cavity laser array, realizing a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Hamiltonian. We investigate the threshold behavior and demonstrate a roadmap towards efficient topological laser devices.

articleTitle: Designing Structured Light Fields
abstract: We present a new optimization technique for designing three-dimensional profiles of optical fields in homogeneous and linear medium. Both theoretical and experimental results are reported.

articleTitle: Gradient-based Quantum Neural Network Using Quantum Computing Chips
abstract: An analytic gradient algorithm for training neural networks in an 8-mode quantum photonic chip is proposed. The algorithm shows 4x faster-training speed and 3% accuracy rate enhancement than existing approaches in solving two classification tasks.

articleTitle: Visible to Mid-infrared Supercontinuum Generation in 4H-Silicon-Carbide Nanophotonic Waveguides
abstract: Dispersion-engineered silicon-carbide waveguides generate dispersive waves at visible and mid-infrared wavelengths as long as 4 µm. The energy of the seed 70-fs pulses centered at 1.5-µm can be as low as 200 pJ.

articleTitle: Soliton Gas: optical fiber experiments and theory
abstract: We report recent theoretical and experimental studies of soliton gases. In particular we measure the spectral parameters distribution (inverse scattering transform) of the soliton gas induced by the modulation instability in optical fibers.

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Platform for Compressive Sampling
abstract: We present compressive sampling in a dual-comb platform using time-programmable frequency combs and achieving compression factors in excess of 155 while maintaining bandwidth and resolution.

articleTitle: Robust GHz Repetition Rate Optical Frequency Combs
abstract: We phase stabilize a 1 GHz optical frequency comb with a residual phase noise of <270 mrad [1kHz to 1MHz] on both the carrier-envelope offset frequency and the repetition rate, respectively. The SNR of the offset beat signal is 56 dB (100 kHz RBW).

articleTitle: A Data Processing Method Based on Improved KNN Algorithm for Double-peak Spectrum of BOTDR
abstract: We propose a method using improved KNN to classify double-peak spectrum data of BOTDR. It significantly improves both the sensing accuracy and the spatial resolution in the transition section of temperature change or strain events.

articleTitle: Chaotic Coherent Perfect Absorption in Optical Microresonators
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate chaotic coherent perfect absorption states, as well as their non-Hermitian degeneracies in a chaotic optical microresonator supporting more than 1000 optical modes.

articleTitle: Coherent mid-infrared supercontinuum generation in a cascade of silica, fluoride, and chalcogenide fibers
abstract: We present a supercontinuum spanning 1.8 μm to 3.2 μm from a passive cascade of anomalous silica fiber, anomalous ZBLAN fiber, and all-normal chalcogenide fiber taper. The resulting supercontinuum preserve coherence despite the cascaded architecture.

articleTitle: Flexible Metasurface-Based Wraps for Improving Magnetic Field Enhancement in 1.5T MRI
abstract: We design a flexible metasurface comprising interconnected copper spirals on polyimide substrate for boosting radio-frequency magnetic field in the region-of-interest for 1.5T MRI. The ultra-thin, body-conformal structure is implementable as "add-ons" inside body-specific transceiver coils.

articleTitle: Giant Nonresonant Nonlinearity in Bulk Tellurium Pumped with a Femtosecond 10µm Laser
abstract: We measure Tellurium’s ꭓ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> nonlinear response in its optical transparency window using z-scan and SPM methods. n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2,eff</inf> is found to be 5x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/W (>100x larger than GaAs), enabling future ultrathin photonic devices.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of a cryogenic Silicon Organic Hybrid (SOH) Mach-Zehnder Modulator with a Sub-1V π-Voltage
abstract: We report on a cryogenic silicon-organic hybrid (SOH) Mach-Zehnder modulator (MZM) featuring a record-low π-voltage of U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> = 0.92 V. We demonstrate PAM4 transmission at a symbol rate of 70 GBd, the highest value so far achieved for semiconductor-based cryogenic MZM.

articleTitle: Distributed entanglement and teleportation on a quantum network
abstract: We report on the realization of a multi-node quantum network. Using the network, we have demonstrated three protocols; generation of a entangled state shared by all nodes, entanglement swapping and quantum teleportation between non-neighboring nodes.

articleTitle: Dynamically controlled time-bin entanglement source for quantum key distribution
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple protocol to upgrade a time-bin entanglement resource with access-control through binary phase randomization at the optical pump. The enhanced source can effectively control all users at a negligible cost.

articleTitle: Compact Adiabatic Power Splitters with Polynomial Taper Profile Optimization
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate profile-optimized adiabatic Y-branch power splitters with losses of 0.16 dB (TE) and 0.17 dB (TM) at 1,550 nm for 14 μm long devices with balanced power splitting between 1,500 and 1,600 nm.

articleTitle: Accurate Underwater Optical Ranging Through Scattering Using Tunable Structured Light Carrying Two Modes for Coarse and Fine Approaches
abstract: We propose accurate underwater optical ranging using z-dependent rotation of tunable structured beams to achieve coarse and fine approaches. Simulation results show an average ranging error of <7 mm over 2 m through scattering (γ = 4 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>).

articleTitle: Quantum Ghost Imaging without an Optical Delay Line for Non-Destructive Imaging of Water Content in Plants
abstract: By using correlations between spatially entangled photons, Quantum Ghost Imaging allows for imaging plant water content without influencing light-dependent plant processes. A proprietary spatially and temporally resolved camera negates the need for optical delay lines.

articleTitle: Generating hypergraph states on a silicon-photonic chip
abstract: We experimentally create complete classes of twenty-nine four-qubit hypergraph states on a programmable silicon-photonic chip, and implement measurement-based protocols on hypergraph states, which provide an alternative resource for quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Monolithic PIC integrated Compact GHz ITO-Modulators
abstract: Here, we show our recent advances in ITO-based PIC-integrated modulators. We present a 100+GHz fast design and a 40GHz experimental demonstration device, all about 1000x more compact as compared to Silicon MZMs and LN devices.

articleTitle: Free-standing Metasurface-based Faraday Rotator
abstract: We simulated a free-standing metasurface-based Faraday rotator design. The device gives a high transmittance, large Faraday rotation angle, and figure of merit ~24 times higher than a conventional device at the wavelength of 755nm.

articleTitle: A Novel and Convenient Experimental Verification of Lasing in High-β Lasers
abstract: A Lorentzian-to-Gaussian lineshape transition is investigated in an InP-based silver-coated nanolaser with verified lasing operation. The effect stems from cavity eigenmodes extending into free space and serves as a convenient lasing indicator for high-β nanolasers.

articleTitle: Thermal Crosstalk Rejection for Scaling Quantum-Photonic Systems-on-Chip with Monolithically Integrated Electronics
