abstract: We demonstrate integrated feedback control of a C-band microring quantum-correlated photon-pair source fabricated in a monolithic electronics-photonics platform that maintains lock in the presence of nearby on-die thermal disturbances.

articleTitle: Full-time On-line Tide Monitoring based on Highly Sensitive Optic Fiber Distributed Acoustic Sensing
abstract: Tide observation is an important part of marine engineering survey. We propose and demonstrate a new-type on-line tide monitoring system based on fiber distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), whose field test has shown its great prospect.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Waveguides and Beamsplitters inside IG2 Inscribed by a Femtosecond Laser
abstract: We report the ultrafast laser inscription of waveguides inside the chalcogenide glass IG2 for mid-infrared operation. A 1×4 beamsplitter with excellent splitting-ratio uniformity is demonstrated at 4.55-µm.

articleTitle: Bandgap-detuned excitation regimes of microcombs in photonic-crystal resonators
abstract: We explore the formation of parametric oscillators and dark solitons by detuned excitation of a gapped microresonator. Un-pumped photonic crystals enable optimization of forward propagation and conversion efficiency without sacrificing spontaneous pattern and state generation.

articleTitle: Wavelength-Agile Dual-Comb Diagnostics of Pulsed Lasers
abstract: We show multi-kHz rate laser pulse diagnostics that rely on two-photon detection in a dual-comb configuration without mutual spectral overlap or polarization alignment between the sources. The technique enables us to probe soliton molecule dynamics.

articleTitle: Small-footprint photonic reservoir computing chip based on speckle patterns in a multimode waveguide
abstract: We propose Si-photonic reservoir computing based on speckle patterns in a 250 × 920 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-footprint snake-crawling-shaped multimode waveguide. Good performance of the NMSE as low as 0.048 for the Santa-Fe time-series prediction is experimentally obtained.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of polarization and mode division (de)multiplexing in silicon carbide integrated platforms
abstract: We monolithically integrate polarization and mode division (de)multiplexers in SiC integrated platforms, which can manipulate six TE and TM multimodes, simultaneously. We numerically and experimentally demonstrate the device with good performances.

articleTitle: Bound States in the Continuum in Rotationally Symmetric Periodic Waveguides
abstract: It is shown that in rotationally symmetric periodic waveguides with a reflection symmetry, bound states in the continuum with nonzero angular momentum are nonrobust, but they can be preserved by tuning one structural parameter.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Cathodoluminescence Imaging of Strain Localized Quantum Emitters in Multilayer GaSe
abstract: We reveal the effect of strain localization on GaSe single photon emitters using correlative cathodoluminescence, photoluminescence, and atomic force microscopies; together these measurements illustrate the nanoscale limits of strain control for integrated quantum photonics.

articleTitle: Direct laser speckle contrast imaging with sampling bias correction
abstract: Speckle contrast is generally calculated from localized window containing limited statistics, resulting a systematic bias in the estimation. We achieve sampling bias correction and demonstrate accurate quantitative laser speckle analysis without recourse to numerical fitting.

articleTitle: Efficient Power Transfer via Induced Virtual Critical Coupling in an Overcoupled Silicon Nitride Microresonator
abstract: We induce virtual critical coupling in an overcoupled photonic microresonator using complex-frequency pulses. We observe efficient cavity storage as an incident pulse of time constant 138 ps suppresses the resonant transmission from 0.58 to 0.11.

articleTitle: Long Live O-PCMs: Understanding Reliability Challenges of Optical Phase Change Materials
abstract: The endurance of optical phase change material-based devices for integrated and free-space applications is explored and improvements are proposed based on limiting PCM dewetting, protective layer delamination, and elemental migration towards stable phases.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable chiral phase change nanomaterials
abstract: We realize intrinsically chiral phase change material nano-helices that achieves the critical goal of demonstrating high-speed temporal control of opto-chirality over 50,000 cycles in Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of an Efficient, Purcell-enhanced, On-chip Path-entangled Photon-pair Source Based on Single Quantum Dots
abstract: We use inverse design to develop an optimized nanophotonic geometry for efficient, Purcell-enhanced, waveguide-coupled, path-entangled photon pair sources based on single embedded quantum dots.

articleTitle: Refractive Index Sensing With Laser-Induced Surface Waveguides
abstract: We fabricate surface waveguides in a-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> by direct laser writing. These waveguides can be used as refractive index sensors with extinction ratios as high as 5 dB/mm and sensitivities exceeding 1000 dB/RIU at 800 nm.

articleTitle: Perovskite quantum dot topological laser in the visible
abstract: Topological lasers often require complex designs and fabrication that hinder their realization at short wavelengths. Here we report a green-emitting perovskite quantum-dot topological laser and discuss the persistence of topological states in VCSELs.

articleTitle: Colloidal Quantum Dot LEDs Package with Porous Microcarrier
abstract: The porous structured microcarrier powders were mixed with CQD/PDMS packages to improve the dispersion of CQD particles. When the traditional package suffers seriously in efficiency at high CQD loading, the microcarrier ones sustain its performance and win out.

articleTitle: High Resolving Power Arrayed Waveguide Grating with Spiral Reusable Delay Lines (SRDL-AWG)
abstract: An arrayed waveguide grating with spiral reusable delay lines (SRDL-AWGs) with a resolving power of 111,330 is experimentally demonstrated. The device is over 100 times more compact than the traditional AWGs.

articleTitle: Achieving directional scattering through a phase difference in composite nanoparticles
abstract: We show that the scattering of light by a composite nanoparticle leads to directional scattering through the phase difference between the light scattered by each of the materials. The resulting scatter pattern is experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Optical Phase Insensitive Off-axis Operation of the Hybrid Opto-electronic Correlator for Ultra-fast Shift, Scale, and Rotation Invariant Target Recognition
abstract: We report on off-axis operation of the hybrid opto-electronic correlator whereby the scale, rotation and shift invariant image recognition process becomes insensitive to variations in optical path lengths, thus making it extremely robust against vibrations.

articleTitle: Boxcar gating for time-resolved mid-infrared photothermal imaging of axon-bundle water boundaries
abstract: Time-resolved mid-infrared photothermal imaging via boxcar gating is presented for the study of interface dynamics between axon bundles and the surrounding water.

articleTitle: Mirror-Enabled Tuning of Mid-Infrared Light Scattering by Dielectric Optical Resonators
abstract: Optically resonant particles with novel scattering behaviors are essential for developing nanophotonic devices. Here, we show that the multipolar Mie scattering of silicon microspheres can be modified by placing them on different reflective substrates.

articleTitle: High-Speed Lithium Niobate Modulator on Silicon Nitride using Micro-Transfer Printing
abstract: A high-speed modulator on silicon nitride is demonstrated using 2 mm-long micro-transfer printed lithium niobate coupons. This device has a 3-dB bandwidth >50GHz, and an insertion loss of 3.3 dB that allowed us to transmit 70 Gb/s.

articleTitle: A Bistable Binary Metaoptic for Passive Optical Switching
abstract: Fully-coupled nonlinear simulations enable passively-actuated telecom metaoptic design. It experiences optical bistability at a pulse intensity of 5 GW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and when configured as a binary-phase deflecting metaoptic, alters its diffraction efficiency by 68%.

articleTitle: Colossal Birefringence from Periodic Structural Modulations
abstract: We introduce structural modulation as a new mechanism for achieving colossal optical anisotropy. Modulated nonstoichiometric material Sr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9/8</inf>TiS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> is shown to have an extraordinary refractive index n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</inf>= 4.5 and ordinary refractive index n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</inf>= 2.4 in the mid-infrared range.

articleTitle: Characterization and compression of ultrashort pulses from mode-locked laser diodes using dispersion-scan
abstract: We present the first demonstration of d-scan to compress and characterize ultrashort pulses from a mode-locked laser diode, enabling sub-ps pulse durations and the detection of strong pulse asymmetries, as well as small pulse instabilities.

articleTitle: HfO2-based Platform for High Index Contrast Visible and UV Integrated Photonics
abstract: We study HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> composites for high-index visible/UV photonics, exhibiting material losses of < 3.0 dB/cm and n = 1.96 at λ = 405 nm. Single-mode waveguides losses are 15.3 ± 1.9 dB/cm for λ = 405 nm (2.3 0.1 dB/cm for λ = 730 nm), likely limited by sidewall roughness scattering.

articleTitle: Rotational mode competition in coupled mid-infrared quantum cascade ring lasers
abstract: Photonic molecules are promising platforms to study complex physical phenomena, yet they remain unexplored in the mid-infrared. We show (anti)correlation of counter-propagating modes in a mid-infrared photonic molecule comprised of coupled ring quantum cascade lasers.

articleTitle: Actively mode-locked laser in nanophotonic lithium niobate
abstract: We report an electrically pumped hybrid lithium niobate/III-V actively mode-locked laser. The laser emits 4.8 ps pulses at 10.17 GHz around 1065 nm with high peak power of ~ 1 W.

articleTitle: Coherent Light Emitters Using Quasi-Bound States in the Continuum
abstract: We introduce a new class of coherent light emitters in the mid-infrared (MIR) range using quasi-bound states in the continuum (Q-BICs). The emitter is fabricated on a phononic substrate and supports the Friedrich-Wintgen interfering resonances.

articleTitle: Observation of the Optical de Broglie-Mackinnon Wave Packet
abstract: We observe for the first time the de Broglie-Mackinnon wave packet through the use of spatio-temporally structured optical pulse propagating through a medium in its anomalous group-velocity dispersion regime.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Thomson Scattering Measured over Full Emission Sphere
abstract: We present first measurements of nonlinear Thomson scattering over the entire emission sphere. Inherent asymmetry in electron relativistic figure-8 motion gives different emission patterns in ‘northern’ and ‘southern’ hemispheres (with laser propagating along poles).

articleTitle: Parallel Random LiDAR
abstract: We realize parallel LiDAR using a highly multimode laser. Spatio-temporal beating of lasing modes generates multiple probe beams with distinct intensity fluctuations in time, enabling simultaneous ranging of targets. The robustness to interference is shown.

articleTitle: 100J-Level Energy Extraction in a Compact, Diode-Pumped Tm:YLF Amplifier
abstract: We report on 100J-level pulsed energy extraction from a diode-pumped Tm:YLF system. The table-top laser comprises a Tm:YLF-based oscillator that seeds a single amplifier to produce >21J in 20ns and 108J in long-pulse operation.

articleTitle: Bistable Fano Laser with Optical Feedback
abstract: We propose a bistable device based on a Fano laser with optical feedback. We show that the laser can perform flip-flop action with switch-on and switch-off speeds of 10 and 60 ps, respectively, and energy consumption down to 20 and 70 fJ/bit.

articleTitle: Assessing the Performance Limitations of Doppler Stabilized Optical Fiber Links
abstract: We employ a polarization-maintaining (PM) optical fiber link as a means to overcome the performance limits in traditional non-PM fiber links and achieve a 1-s fractional frequency instability near 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-18</sup> for a short 10 m link.

articleTitle: Bayesian Optimization for Nested Adversarial Variational Autoencoder in Tunable Nanophotonic Device Design
abstract: We propose a device design framework based on Bayesian optimization for efficient latent sampling of adversarial generative neural networks to expedite inverse design of tunable nanophotonic wavelength splitters. The resulting design operates at broadband telecomm-wavelengths and is electrically switchable via liquid crystal tuning.

articleTitle: Experimental Comparison of Strategies for Quantum State Overlap Estimation
abstract: We experimentally compare the performance of different quantum state overlap estimation strategies with photonic setups. The results show overlap-dependent estimation precision and inspire designs of experimentally efficient strategy for various quantum information processing applications.

articleTitle: Transverse Force Sensing for Large-scale Array Applications Based on Mode Coupling in FMF
abstract: We propose a transverse force sensing scheme for large-scale array applications based on linearly-polarized mode coupling in few-mode fibers, and experimentally demonstrate the feasibility for human sleeping postures monitoring with 16-cm spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Visible Lithium Niobate Integrated Modulators for Classical and Quantum Technologies
abstract: We demonstrate visible sub-1 V amplitude and phase modulators in thin-film lithium niobate. We use these devices to demonstrate EO frequency shifting of pulsed light over 7 times the intrinsic pulse bandwidth.

articleTitle: Demonstration of High Performance Single-Mode Surface-Emitting DFB Lasers
abstract: We present a novel single-mode surface-emitting DFB laser based on surface gratings. The fabricated laser demonstrated the threshold current of about 2mA, SMSR >40dB, relaxation oscillation frequency ~ 17GHz, and divergence angle of 26×°21°.

articleTitle: Guiding light at Lagrange points
abstract: By exploiting the exotic properties of Lagrange points, we here demonstrate an altogether new approach for guiding light. Unlike other methodologies, here light can be trapped even in defocusing bulk environments.

articleTitle: Electrically reconfigurable metasurfaces for optical switching and beam scanning
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an electrically reprogrammable metausrface by integrating a stand-alone microheater decoupled from an optically smart nonvolatile phase-change metasurface for optical modulation and beam scanning into different diffraction orders in the near-infrared spectral range.

articleTitle: AlGaAs soliton microcombs at room temperature
abstract: Soliton generation in AlGaAs microresonators at room temperation is reported for the first time. The destabilizing thermo-optic effect is shown to instead provide stability for high soliton repetition rates. The optical pump power is sub-milliWatt.

articleTitle: Interferometric phase stability using space-time wave packets
abstract: We explore interferometric phase stability using space-time (ST) wave packets. We find that the interferometer exhibits significantly more stability when using an ST wave packets in comparison to a generic wave packet.

articleTitle: Photonic Characteristics of U-shape Micro Light-Emitting Diodes and Their Integration with Colloidal Quantum Dots
abstract: An InGaN U-shape micro LED is fabricated and integrated with colloidal quantum dots. The extracted SRH coefficient showed a 3.2-time increase of surface recombination velocity, while the lifetime of the quantum dot layer is extended 16 fold due to less thermal stress.

articleTitle: Cavity Ringdown Spectroscopy for Radioisotope Detection with Glow-Discharge Plasma Cell
abstract: The measurement of radioactive isotopes in the environment are crucial for the safe operation and decommissioning of nuclear facilities. We propose a cavity ringdown spectrometer with a glow discharge hollow-cathode plasma cell toward radioisotope detections.

articleTitle: Comparison of Soft and Hard Mask for Fabrication of High Q SiN Microring Resonators
abstract: This work reports two robust methods for fabrication of high-quality factor (Q) SiN resonators using a polymer-based mask and a metallic mask. We compare the etch uniformity, sidewall quality, and quality factors of the fabricated waveguides and resonators.

articleTitle: High-efficiency fiber coupling from laser-written waveguides using partially overlapping multi-pass inscription
abstract: We shape the mode field of femtosecond laser-written waveguides in fused silica via the partial overlap of multiple inscription passes. Judicious tuning of exposure parameters facilitates near-unity mode overlap and coupling to standard single-mode fibers.

articleTitle: Fractionally Quantized Topological Nonlinear Thouless Pumping of Solitons
abstract: We theoretically predict and experimentally observe that nonlinearity can act to fractionally quantize the motion of solitons in photonic Thouless pumps. Such fractionalization is unique to the nonlinear regime.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic metasurfaces with expanded eye boxes for augmented reality
abstract: Through careful engineering of the incoming beam, we can position the eyebox at different coordinates and expand the eyebox of our nanophotonic metasurfaces. This method overcomes the critical limitation of Maxwellian view augmented reality displays.

articleTitle: Probing the OAM Spectrum of Atmospheric Turbulence at Short Time Scales with OAM-Based Wavelets
abstract: Experimental results for the OAM spectrum of a beam after propagating through a three-dimensional turbulent volume are obtained by probing with OAM-based wavelets. The turbulence appears frozen during the probing sequence, giving new insight into the OAM spectrum of turbulence at short time scales.

articleTitle: Fermi edge singularity in neutral cold electron-hole system
abstract: We studied the Fermi edge singularity due to Cooper-pair-like excitons at the Fermi energy in the photoluminescence spectra of neutral dense ultracold electron-hole plasma and a crossover from BEC to BCS-like exciton condensate with density.

articleTitle: Field Demonstration of Low-Latency Massively Parallel Communication with Microresonator Frequency Comb
abstract: We demonstrated low-latency optical transmission with a microresonator frequency comb using a 9-km optical fiber in a metropolitan area. The delay time of the entire system, excluding the transmission fiber, was only 3.1 μs.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonics using Transparent Conductive Oxides
abstract: This paper reviews recent research progress of photonic integrated circuits using transparent conductive oxides. Especially, the heterogeneous integration of transparent conductive oxides with silicon photonics shows great potential for energy-efficient optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Line-shape study of CO perturbed by N2 with mid-infrared frequency comb spectroscopy
abstract: We applied a mid-infrared frequency comb-based Fourier-transform spectroscopy to line-shape study of fundamental vibrational band of CO perturbed by N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Our frequency comb-based spectrometer enables to provide precise spectroscopic parameters in mid-infrared region.

articleTitle: Structural and spin-momentum locking chiralities in topological insulators by photocurrent nanoimaging
abstract: Direct nanoimaging of helicity-dependent photocurrents is important to understand light-matter interaction in topological materials. Here we report visualization of circular polarization dependent surface currents and their distribution on plain and artificially nanostructured topological insulators.

articleTitle: Kramers-Kronig relation in ultrafast XUV transient absorption spectroscopy
abstract: We study the validity of the Kramers-Kronig relation (KKR) in attosecond transient absorption spectroscopy, which is enabled by a new phase-resolved technique dubbed Complex Attosecond Transient-absorption Spectroscopy (CATS). Our results provide a solid basis for KKR application in a broad range of attosecond experiments.

articleTitle: High-Accuracy Measurement of Mid-IR Refractive Indices in GaAs/AlGaAs Thin-Film Heterostructures
abstract: We report a method to simultaneously measure the refractive index of two materials in as-deposited heterostructures by analysis of FTIR spectra and extraction of layer thicknesses via SEM, yielding excellent results for a GaAs/AlGaAs DBR.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic-Elliptical Lens Pairs for Fast THz-TDS Single-Pixel, Phase-Front Matched Imaging of Spherical Targets with an Extended Field of View
abstract: Single-pixel reflection imaging of curved surfaces requires normal incidence and phase-front matching over a large FOV. Hyperbolic-Elliptical lenses were designed for a collocated THz-TDS setup to achieve imaging of samples such as the cornea in under 2 seconds.

articleTitle: In situ Training of Silicon Photonic Neural Networks: from Classical to Quantum
abstract: Photonic neural networks perform ultrafast inference operations but are trained on slow computers. We highlight on-chip network training enabled by silicon photonics. We introduce quantum photonic neural networks and discuss the role of weak nonlinearities.

articleTitle: Spectroscopic characterization of an on-chip squeezed quantum optical frequency comb
abstract: We experimentally characterized the spectrum of 40 quantum modes in an on-chip squeezed quantum optical frequency comb. A theoretical model is developed to explain the effect of dispersion on squeezing level and frequency shift.

articleTitle: Mie Resonance-based Meta-atom Design with Machine Learning Method
abstract: Forward prediction machine learning models were developed to predict the scattering behaviors and electromagnetic field of meta-atoms, while an inverse design model was built for reconstructing meta-atoms under the guidance of multipole expansion theory.

articleTitle: Frequency-Agile Self-Injection-Locked Lasers With sub-100 Hz Linewidth based on In-Package Photonic Wire Bonds
abstract: We demonstrate frequency-agile self-injection-locked lasers that exploit photonic wire bonds for connecting piezo-tunable Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microresonators to DFB lasers. Our devices offer intrinsic linewidths below 100Hz along with highly linear frequency sweeping over more than 1GHz.

articleTitle: Ultra-High-Q substrate-mode coupled resonances in complementary THz metamaterial
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally and numerically a complementary metallic disk-hole array utilizing the coupling between lattice resonances and Fabry-Pérot resonances, and features in-substrate modes with experimentally obtained record breaking Q factors of ~750 in the THz.

articleTitle: Spectroscopy and 2.8 µm Laser Operation of Disordered Er3+:CLNGG Crystals
abstract: We report on spectroscopy and laser operation on the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11/2</inf>→<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13/2</inf> transition of erbium-doped disordered CLNGG crystals with broadband emission properties. A 41.4 at. % Er:CLNGG laser generated 292 mW at 2.80 µm with 22.6% slope efficiency.

articleTitle: Photonic Microwave Oscillator based on Fiber Delay Stabilization using a Waveguide Balanced Cross-Correlator
abstract: A compact, all-optical, repetition rate stabilized femtosecond laser and photonic microwave generator with phase-noise -100, -140 and < -160 dBc/Hz at 100 Hz, 10 kHz and > 100 kHz, respectively, and integrated timing-jitter < 3-fs.

articleTitle: Ultrafast laser writing in different grades of silica glass
abstract: The dependence of ultrafast laser induced modifications in silica glass on the method of its manufacturing is observed. Direct writing of geometric phase elements and 5D optical storage with nanopore structures require different silica grades.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared 2-D Aperiodic Optical Phased Array in an InP-based Platform
abstract: We fabricate a 2-D aperiodic high-resolution optical phased array, which includes a multi-mode interferometer light-splitting tree, thermally isolated thermo-optic phase shifters, and total internal reflection mirror emitters in an InGaAs/InP platform for 2-D beam steering.

articleTitle: Broadband Optical Add-Drop Filters Enabled by Silicon Photonic Sub-wavelength-grating-assisted Waveguides
abstract: We present the design of silicon optical add-drop filters made using sub-wavelength-grating-assisted, contra-directional couplers. We demonstrate that such devices can have broad bandwidths, up to 45 nm, while maintaining low losses and high out-of-band isolations.

articleTitle: Stabilization of SiN Kerr Solitons for the calibration of astronomical spectrographs
abstract: We demonstrate a stabilization scheme for dissipative Kerr solitons in SiN-resonators achieving high comb stability and long-term operation. Measuring 10Hz level absolute Kerr comb line stability (at 1 second) close to the pump, resulting in kHz level stability in the spectral domain of NIR astronomical spectrographs.

articleTitle: Engineered Raman-Kerr Microcomb in integrated chalcogenide microresonators
abstract: We first propose and experimentally demonstrate the engineered Raman-Kerr microcomb by adjusting the gains between Raman and Kerr effects in an integrated chalcogenide microresonator, leading to controllable approaches for optical frequency synthesizers.

articleTitle: Raman Conversion in Calcite Crystals for Seeding CO2 Lasers
abstract: We report the use of Raman conversion in calcite crystals to generate wave-lengths suitable for seeding sub-picosecond LWIR CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> lasers after subsequent difference frequency generation.

articleTitle: Generation of High-Order Harmonics by Stimulated Inverse Bremsstrahlung Process in Non-Metal Nanostructures
abstract: We theoretically analyze a novel mechanism of high-order harmonic generation by stimulated inverse bremsstrahlung driven by time-dependent electric field of ultrashort laser pulses in dielectric or semiconductor nanostructures. It is compared with electron-hole recombination mechanisms.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Microcavity Based Integrated Spectrometer at the 2 μm Wavelength Band
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a photonic crystal based on-chip spectrometer at the 2 μm waveband. It consists of 16 photonic crystal microcavities and achieves better than 1nm resolution at a 100 nm spectral range with specific reconstruction algorithms.

articleTitle: Resolving Single Molecules in Flow Cytometer in Presence of Fluorescent Bursts via an Optical Quantum Measurement
abstract: We prove high signal-to-noise (SNR>6) in single-biomarker detection with a quantum-enabled flow cytometer. We observe the nonclassical signal from single biomarkers and differentiate it from the spurious detection of "bright" classical particles based on experimentally characterized statistical properties and quantum measurement.

articleTitle: Thermal engineering of local group velocity dispersion in triple-state photonic molecules
abstract: We present the dispersion engineering of a threemicroring photonic molecule via thermo-optic effects. Despite the overall normal GVD, local regimes of normal and anomalous dispersion are tailored by fine-tuning the microcavities’ supermode frequencies.

articleTitle: Underwater Optical Wireless Communications using Ince Gaussian Beams
abstract: Generation of Ince Gaussian beams can be performed through the nonlinear process. Controlling the phase matching condition of the nonlinear process allows the mode spectrum of the decomposition to be carefully controlled. This beam can be used for constant envelope communication through underwater turbid environments.

articleTitle: Unidirectional perfect reflection and radiation in double-lattice photonic crystals
abstract: We propose unique unidirectional phenomena in a double-lattice photonic-crystal waveguide, where perfect radiation can be achieved for light incident from one side, while perfect reflection can be achieved for light incident from the opposite side.

articleTitle: Zero-Index Metamaterials for Extreme Optics
abstract: Nanotechnology has enabled the development of nanostructured composite materials (metamaterials) having an effective refractive index of zero in the optical regime. We will review some of the exotic physics of these zero-index metamaterials.

articleTitle: Wafer-scale Manufacturing of Ultra-low Loss, High-density Si3N4 Photonic Integrated Circuits
abstract: We demonstrate Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> photonic integrated circuits featuring ultra-low propagation loss and tight optical confinement, fabricated with a subtractive process. We report an increase in propagation loss in Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> waveguides after exposure to ultraviolet (UV) irradiation, and loss recovery following a rapid thermal anneal (RTA). We show an intrinsic quality factor as high as 20×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> at 1.55 µm across a 100 mm wafer.

articleTitle: Fermi edge singularity in photoluminescence excitation spectra of neutral ultracold electron-hole system
abstract: We observed a strong enhancement of spatially direct absorption at the Fermi energy of ultracold electron-hole system in separated electron and hole layers, evidencing Fermi-energy excitons. Absorption was probed by photoluminescence excitation spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Extending Dual-Comb Spectroscopy Path Length to 14.5 km by Separating Receiver from Transmitter
abstract: We present dual-comb spectroscopy across a 14.5-km path using remote receiver and data acquisition. This configuration results in lower link losses compared to open-path configurations with co-located transmitter and receiver.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal characterization of structured few-cycle waveforms in the mid-infrared
abstract: We demonstrate that multiphoton excitation in a CMOS image sensor can be used as a sub-cycle temporal gate, allowing the measurement of the full space, time, and polarization state of structured mid-infrared laser waveforms.

articleTitle: Development of a Compact Measurement System of the Flow Rate of Cerebrospinal Fluid in a Shunt Tube for Hydrocephalus Using a Laser Diode
abstract: We developed a compact system for measuring the flow rate of cerebrospinal fluid in a shunt tube using the laser-two-focus velocimeter with air lumps injected. The range of 3 to 60 ml/h was successfully measured.

articleTitle: Transfer-Printed Single-Photon Detectors on Arbitrary Photonic Substrates
abstract: We demonstrate the integration of superconducting single-photon detectors onto arbitrary photonic substrates via transfer printing. Using this method, we show single-photon detection in a lithium niobate on insulator photonic circuit.

articleTitle: Influence of the laser-induced strain on the ultrafast magnetization dynamics of nickel
abstract: The influence of the laser-induced quasi-static surface strain on magnetization dynamics has been revealed in a Nikel film. The temperature-dependent anisotropy and surface deformation lead to nonlinear variations of the magnetization precession phase and demagnetization time.

articleTitle: Properties of GaSb-based 1.5 µm Quantum Dot Emitters
abstract: Epitaxial fabrication, energy structure, and emission properties of GaSb quantum dots formed by filling droplet-etched nanoholes are presented. These quantum-photonics building blocks emit at 1.5 µm enabling wavelength compatibility with fiber optics and Si-photonics.

articleTitle: Fluorescence Lifetime Measurements Using Entangled-Photon Coincidences
abstract: We have utilized entangled photon pair coincidences to measure the fluorescence lifetime of the organic dye Rhodamine 6G, allowing lifetime measurements to be conducted at low intensities with a CW laser and without ultrafast pulsed lasers.

articleTitle: Photothermal evanescent-field gas detection using all-fiber acousto-optic heterodyne interferometry
abstract: A compact photothermal evanescent-field NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> detection with detection limit of 32 ppm and response time less than 30 seconds is experimentally achieved in a tapered nanofiber at communication band via all-fiber acousto-optic heterodyne interferometry.

articleTitle: Piezo-optomechanical Control of Silicon Photonic Resonator with CMOS Compatibility
abstract: We demonstrate piezo-optomechanical phase control in a c-band silicon-photonic resonator using CMOS-compatible AlN microactuators. We achieve a frequency tuning response of 26.91 ± 0.77 MHz/V DC, operating at picowatt to nanowatt power levels.

articleTitle: Intra-Pulse Intensity Noise Shaping by Saturable Absorbers
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast intra-pulse intensity noise shaping performed by saturable absorbers using chirped pulses. The resulting intra-pulse noise distributions are characterized experimentally and utilized for 12.5 dB noise suppression down to the shot-noise limit.

articleTitle: Coherent coupling of a metamaterial resonator with acceptor impurities in Si
abstract: We investigate the coherent coupling of metamaterial resonators with hydrogen-like boron acceptors in doped Si at cryogenic temperature. When the resonance frequency of the metamaterial superimposes a transition frequency of the acceptors, Rabi splitting is observed. The splitting shows a square-root dependence on the density of the acceptors.

articleTitle: All-order PMD Compensation Using Digital Subcarrier Multiplexing in High-speed Communication System
abstract: We propose and verify that the digital subcarrier multiplexing system provide us easy compensation for all-order polarization mode dispersion just using ordinary constant modulus algorithm in a high baud-rate optical fiber communication system.

articleTitle: Purcell-Enhanced Single-Photon Emitter Exploiting Extreme Dielectric Confinement
abstract: We propose an extreme dielectric confinement bullseye microcavity for single-photon emission and theoretically show the nanometer-scale light confinement enables a Purcell factor of 87, which is four times larger than that of standard bullseye microcavities.

articleTitle: Multi-speciation using a tunable laser and deep neural networks
abstract: Selective and simultaneous multi-speciation during high-temperature fuel pyrolysis was achieved with a single 3.3 μm DFB-ICL. The approach is based on wavelength tuning and deep denoising autoencoders (DDAEs) to distinguish the broadband absorbance spectra of evolving species during fuel pyrolysis in a shock tube.

articleTitle: Bipartite Dirac solitons in vernier-coupled microresonators
abstract: Femtosecond pulse pairs are formed in coupled-resonators featuring normal dispersion. The pairs collectively obey the optical Dirac equation and through their coherent interaction induce net round-trip anomalous dispersion. The asymmetrical Dirac comb spectrum is observed.

articleTitle: Hybrid Integration of Hook-shaped Traveling-wave Semiconductor Optical Amplifier and Taiji Ring Resonator for Unidirectional Lasing
abstract: We demonstrate a unidirectional ring hybrid diode laser based on integration of a hook-shaped traveling-wave semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) and Taiji ring resonator. The additional crossover bending waveguide inside the silicon nitride Taiji ring introduces a nonreciprocal loss in the laser cavity while the gain is provided by a multiple depth etched hook-shaped SOA.

articleTitle: Intracavity single-cycle THz generation inside a modelocked thin-disk laser
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of single-cycle THz pulses intracavity of a modelocked thin-disk laser using a simple and cost-efficient 50-µm thin LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> plate, reaching 1.2 mW THz average power from a compact and efficient setup.

articleTitle: A Chiral One-dimensional Atom Using a Quantum Dot in an Open Microcavity
abstract: We realize an optical equivalent of a diode that simultaneously shows nonlinear and non-reciprocal behavior. Using a quantum dot in a microcavity, we show that photon transmission is one order of magnitude larger in the forward direction compared to the backward direction. The system shows a strong nonlinearity with an onset at 100pW.

articleTitle: Generation of galaxy-shaped surface relief in azo-polymers with Laguerre-Gaussian beams
abstract: We present the first demonstration of vortex surface reliefs with 2-, 4- and 6-spiral arms in azopolymers, herein termed a ‘galaxy-shaped surface relief’ by employing petal-like modes, formed of the positive and negative Laguerre-Gaussian modes.

articleTitle: Observation of Coexistent Dual-Comb Soliton Molecules
abstract: We report the first demonstration of stably coexistent dual-wavelength bound states, where the temporal distributions of soliton molecules at two lasing wavelength components can be changed among different intra- and inter-molecule structures independently.

articleTitle: Single-cycle Optical Control of Valence Electrons in a Solid and Free Electrons in a Beam
abstract: We review our recent results on single-cycle-driven high-order harmonic generation from electrons in a crystal lacking inversion symmetry and the production of an isolated attosecond peak in a sub-relativistic electron beam with a single-cycle waveform.

articleTitle: Novel Technique for High-Frequency Carrier Envelope Offset Frequency Detection using Vernier Microcombs
abstract: We demonstrate a novel Vernier dual-comb based method for the detection and division of a microcomb's carrier envelope offset frequency that is beyond the bandwidth of typical commercial detection electronics.

articleTitle: Traffic Vibration Localizing and Analyzing Using Urban Fiber Network
abstract: Urban fiber cable is explored as a sensing network to monitor the traffic flow on Beijing Ring Road. Different traffic patterns (including 2022 Winter Olympics) of heavy and light vehicles are observed and analyzed.

articleTitle: Dispersion Engineering and Low-Loss Optimization of Footprint-Efficient and Rotationally Asymmetric Resonators
abstract: We present a new method to effectively design any arbitrary bent resonator using different conformal transformation optics. We highlight our method by demonstrating optimized racetrack microresonators for both preventing avoided mode-crossing dispersion and achieving low-loss.

articleTitle: Photonic quadrupole topological insulator using orbital-induced synthetic flux
abstract: We demonstrate that mixing different orbitals can induce synthetic π-flux threading the lattice. As an experimental demonstration of such a concept, we realize a quadrupole topological insulator in a photonic lattice.

articleTitle: Femtosecond spin-to-charge current conversion in FeCo/graphene nanobilayer excited by femtosecond optical laser pulse
abstract: The generation of THz transients in a FeCo/graphene nanobilayer, excited by femtosecond optical laser pulses is demonstrated. We assign the mechanism of the THz radiation to the inverse Rashba-Edelstein effect in graphene with λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">REE</inf> on the order of 0.001 nm.

articleTitle: Dot-based Generation of Orbital Angular Momentum Entangled States
abstract: The on-demand generation of orbital angular momentum entangled states is a pivotal task in quantum information. Here, we investigated it both in the inter- and intra-particle regime producing single photons via a quantum dot source.

articleTitle: Characterization of Millimeter-Wave Superconducting Circuits With an Optically-Driven Cryogenic Source
abstract: We demonstrate a cryogenic optically-driven millimeter-wave source generating signals at the 4 K stage of a dilution refrigerator with a high-speed photodiode.

articleTitle: Spatial Coherence of Chaotic-Cavity Surface-Emitting Lasers
abstract: The intentional reduction of spatial coherence of vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers by employing chaotic cavities is demonstrated. The design doubled the number of modes and increased the efficiency, enabling communication, sensing, and imaging with low-speckle illumination.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Orbital Angular Momentum Multiplexed Free-Space Optical Chaos-based Communications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate and characterize the performance of two orbital angular momentum modes multiplexed free-space optical communications based on all-optical chaotic modulation. High-quality chaos synchronization and transmission capacity of 12-Gbit/s secure communications are successfully achieved.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Electronic Spectroscopy of Strong Exciton-Surface Plasmon Polariton Coupling
abstract: Strong exciton-plasmon-couplings are investigated using two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy, revealing Rabi oscillations of polariton cross-peaks and accessing two-quantum excitations. Coherent population oscillations between excitons that are strongly and weakly coupled to the plasmonic field are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Data class-specific imaging using diffractive computing
abstract: We present a privacy-preserving camera design that performs class-specific imaging of input objects only from the desired data class(es) while all-optically and instantaneously erasing the objects from the other data classes.

articleTitle: Vibration based Dynamic Ghost Imaging via Coherent Detection
abstract: By discriminating the amplitude and frequency of vibration, we experimentally demonstrate independent and simultaneous optical imaging of two targets with different vibrating states in the same filed of view, based on coherent detection GISC lidar.

articleTitle: Application of Coherent Laser Ranging to Characterize Object Geometry Changes in Large Fires
abstract: Coherent laser detection and ranging is applied to capture 3D images of objects placed in or behind large fires. A ranging precision of 300 µm through natural gas flame at a 6-meter standoff is achieved.

articleTitle: Miniature on-chip diffractive optical neural network design
abstract: A miniature on-chip diffractive optical neural network (DONN) with a footprint of 1.35 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is designed through the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm, yielding an accuracy of 93.3% in simulation on the Iris plants dataset.

articleTitle: Quantum random number generation with uncharacterised homodyne detection
abstract: We propose, design and experimentally demonstrate a quantum random number generator (QRNG) that completely removes the calibration requirement for the measurement device. The QRNG features a simple implementation and readily implementable on integrated photonic platforms.

articleTitle: Topological Flatband States in Corbino-shaped Decorated Honeycomb Lattices
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate photonic decorated honeycomb lattices that exhibit two singular flat bands, thereby observing two distinct robust boundary modes in finite-sized lattices in Corbino-geometry which manifest topological noncontractible loop states of an infinite system.

articleTitle: Effects of imbalanced modulation in continuous-variable quantum key distribution
abstract: We experimentally investigate the impact of non-optimal state preparation on a Gaussian-modulated coherent state CVQKD system. We show that modulation with imbalanced strength in the amplitude and phase quadratures reduces the optimal key rate over certain distance.

articleTitle: Single Telecom Photons from a Diamond Silicon Vacancy Center via Quantum Frequency Conversion§
abstract: We perform low noise conversion of single photons from a diamond silicon vacancy color center to the telecom O-band. We demonstrate preservation of the photonic quantum properties, enabling their usage in deployed quantum networking applications.

articleTitle: Fast Phase Retrieval: Unique and Stable Complex Object Recovery in O(NLogN) Time
abstract: We present a novel Phase Retrieval algorithm that is able to uniquely recover a complex object from its noise-corrupted Fourier magnitudes in an arbitrary number of dimensions while running in O(N Log N) time.

articleTitle: All-optical object classification through unknown phase diffusers using a single-pixel diffractive machine vision system
abstract: We present an all-optical inference method to directly classify unknown objects through random phase diffusers using a single-pixel spectrally-encoded broadband diffractive network.

articleTitle: Accelerating Deep Learning in Reconstructive Spectroscopy Using Synthetic Data
abstract: A deep learning prototype for a reconstructive spectrometer was developed using an experimentally determined spectrometer response and synthetic data generated from the response matrix. Benchmarking with synthetic and experimental data was performed.

articleTitle: Truncation dependency of PT phase transition behaviors of edge states in a two-dimensional non-Hermitian lattice
abstract: We find that in a two-dimensional PT-symmetric non-Hermitian system, different PT phase transition behaviors of the edge states can be achieved by varying the symmetries of the lattice truncation.

articleTitle: Sub-two-cycle Pulse Synthesizer Based on Multidimensional Solitary States in N2O-filled Hollow-core Fiber
abstract: Octave-spanning spectra centered at 1.4 µm are generated by Raman-enhanced spectral broadening of a Yb:KGW amplifier in N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O-filled hollow-core fiber and compressed to 1.5 cycles in a two-channel synthesizer using only bulk materials for compression.

articleTitle: Generation of High-order Harmonics with Tunable Helicity from Monolayer MoS2
abstract: We investigate the high-order harmonic generation from monolayer MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> through time-dependent functional theory calculations. Studies suggest that harmonics generated from monolayer MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> with linearly polarized pulses have tunable helicity by means of carrier-envelope phase dependence.

articleTitle: Edge state optical frequency combs in the microresonator based Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model
abstract: We demonstrate the first observation of optical frequency combs at the edge state of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model. We show soliton-induced edge-bulk interaction and edge-state hopping.

articleTitle: Fast and Multifunctional Superhydrophobic Light-driven Actuators based on the Marangoni Effect
abstract: Superhydrophobic light-driven actuators based on the Marangoni effect are demonstrated. A 1.5 W•cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> light-driven actuator yields a fast response time of 0.8 s, with its linear velocity approaching 10.1 mm•s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Rapid Design and Fabrication of Grating Chips for Magneto-Optical Trapping of Atoms
abstract: We present a framework to optimize the design of grating chips to maximize the atom number in a grating-based magneto-optical trap (MOT). We evaluate the robustness of a grating-MOT against experimental parameters such as magnetic fields, laser intensity, etc. We also demonstrate a fast fabrication process for grating chips using laser lithography.

articleTitle: A Continuity Equation for the Flow of Fisher Information in Electromagnetic Scattering
abstract: We demonstrate both theoretically and experimentally that one can define and measure the spatial flow of Fisher Information in electromagnetic scattering problems. This new information flow obeys a continuity equation in analogy to Poynting’s theorem.

articleTitle: The impact of time-skew on phase noise measurements using balanced coherent detection
abstract: We derive sufficient conditions on the path delay difference (time-skew) in balanced receivers such that its impact on phase noise is negligible. These conditions are confirmed in numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Orbital angular momentum control in topological laser arrays
abstract: We propose a method for chirality selection of edge modes in topological laser arrays by applying two-stage turn-on. Symmetry breaking is based on the nonlinearity of gain saturation which is always present in lasers.

articleTitle: All-optical Interconnects: Diffractive Permutation Networks
abstract: We present diffractive optical networks trained using deep learning to realize an arbitrary permutation operation with hundreds of thousands of connections. Addressing practical design challenges, we experimentally demonstrate a 625-interconnection system at terahertz spectrum.

articleTitle: Quantum Plasmonic Sensing Using Conditional Measurements
abstract: We introduce a protocol for quantum plasmonic sensing based on the conditional detection of plasmons. We demonstrate that conditional plasmon subtraction provides a new degree of freedom to control quantum fluctuations of plasmonic fields.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Optical Carrier Dynamics in Multi/Few-Layer MoS2 on a Microdisk Resonator
abstract: We employ a silicon nitride microdisk resonator to observe the transient dynamics of photoexcited carriers in multi-layer and few-layer MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> exfoliated flakes.

articleTitle: Programmable and Tunable Multi-band Microwave Photonic Filters based on Optical Frequency Comb Shaping
abstract: We present programmable and tunable multi-band microwave photonic filters based on carrier-suppressed single-sideband modulation of an optical frequency comb, and line-by-line optical spectral shaping in an interferometric configuration.

articleTitle: Novel 1300 nm InP monolithic active/passive integration platform: application to widely tunable lasers
abstract: We have realized an InP monolithically integration platform at 1300 nm with amplifiers, phase modulators and passive components. Single mode laser systems utilizing electro optic phase modulators with 30 nm tuning have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Precision hydrogen trace gas detection by ultralow-loss multipass cavity Raman scattering
abstract: Raman scattering with a feedback-assisted ultralow-loss multipass cavity was implemented for trace hydrogen sensing. A limit of detection (precision) of 40 (50) parts-per-billion was obtained at a pressure of 0.2 MPa in a 30-min exposure.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic trend in optimization of high-order harmonic generation in gases
abstract: We demonstrate, using analytic models, simulations and experiments, that efficient generation of high-order harmonics is possible across a large range of parameters, if the density and medium length follow a hyperbolic equation.

articleTitle: Single Shot Imaging of a Burst of Laser Short Pulses
abstract: Using a single-shot ptychographic microscope, we image the complex-valued spatial profiles of ultrashort pulses of an isolated laser pulse burst. It shows that this system can film ultrafast non-repetitive complex-valued events.

articleTitle: Two-photon emission and correlations from a superlattice-based superconducting light-emitting diode
abstract: We demonstrate evidence of two-photon emission and photon pair correlations, resulting from injected Cooper-pairs in superconductor-semiconductor structures. Such structures can be utilized for multiple applications including enhanced two-photon gain, electrically-driven entangled-photon generation and Bell-state analyzers.

articleTitle: Pockels Coefficients in Thin-Film Barium Titanate and Lithium Niobate up to 300 GHz
abstract: The Pockels coefficients in thin-film barium titanate (BTO) and lithium niobate (LN) have been measured for modulating frequencies up to 300 GHz. BTO’s effective nonlinearity is ~10 times larger than LN’s with a small frequency dependence.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Neural Network Accelerators: Opportunities and Challenges
abstract: Silicon photonic neural network accelerators (SPNNAs) offer chip-scale and light-speed computation and communication to boost AI inferencing and training performance. In this invited paper, we discuss some of the benefits and challenges of implementing SPNNAs.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Chirped-Pulse Kerr Resonator Solitons
abstract: Chirped-pulse solitons with femtosecond durations and record peak powers are demonstrated in passive fiber Kerr resonators featuring small-normal dispersion and a spectral filter. Design guidelines, drive control techniques, and related Kerr solitons are also investigated.

articleTitle: Beyond 2D imaging with Sparse Spatiotemporal Terahertz fields
abstract: Terahertz time-domain imaging aims at reconstructing the complete electromagnetic morphology. We elaborate our theoretical-experimental route to exploit sparse near-field spatio-temporal illumination to enable three-dimensional microscopy.

articleTitle: Chirality nonlinear optics with 2D layered materials
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast (<~130 fs) all-optical modulators, various logic gates and a half adder with chirality nonlinear optics in monolayer semiconductors (e.g., MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>).

articleTitle: Tensorized Optical Multimodal Fusion Network
abstract: We propose the first tensorized optical multimodal fusion network architecture with a self-attention mechanism and low-rank tensor fusion. Simulation results show 51.3× less hardware requirement and 3.7× 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup> MAC/J energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Deep Subwavelength Slotted Photonic Crystals Fabricated in a Monolithic Silicon Photonics Technology
abstract: We report deep subwavelength-engineered slotted photonic crystal nanobeams with minimum features < 70 nm fabricated using a 90 nm monolithic silicon photonics technology at GlobalFoundries. This work enables potential for scalable, advanced integrated photonics applications.

articleTitle: Doubly Phase Matched Wavelength Conversion in Thin-film Lithium Niobate Nanowaveguides
abstract: We demonstrate double-peak quasi-phasing matching for second-harmonic generation with high efficiency by engineering periodic poling. The results show the potential of multi-channel nonlinear optical processing on chip.

articleTitle: Exciton Coherence in Solution-Processed, Crystalline Octabutoxy-Phthalocyanine (H2OBPc) Thin Films
abstract: We investigate excitonic states in crystalline solution-processed small molecules thin films using ultrafast spectroscopy techniques. In transient absorption, we resolve the photoinduced absorption signature of short lived coherent excitonic state alongside long-lived Frenkel excitons.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact Optical Convolutional Accelerators Based on Polarization-Independent Metasurfaces
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an optical metasurface-based convolutional accelerator with ultracompact volume, low crosstalk, and polarization insensitivity. The optical accelerator computes convolutions in the optical domain for energy-efficient and ultrafast imaging processing.

articleTitle: Fluctuations in Optical Thermodynamics
abstract: In the context of optical thermodynamics of weakly nonlinear systems, we provide a fluctuation theory based on grand canonical ensemble. By employing non-equilibrium statistical mechanics we also study the out-of-equilibrium behaviour.

articleTitle: Self-starting, 3-element 1-GHz Kerr-lens Modelocked Ti:sapphire Laser Pumped by a Single Laser Diode
abstract: We report a 1-GHz Kerr-lens-modelocked Ti:sapphire laser oscillator consisting of three elements and producing 111-fs pulses with an average output power >100 mW using one 1 W multi-mode green pump diode.

articleTitle: All-silicon quantum light source by embedding an artificial atom in a nanophotonic cavity
abstract: Quantum optics in silicon is promising. We report the first all-silicon quantum light source, with a single atomic center embedded in a nanophotonic cavity, resulting in enhanced light-matter interaction.

articleTitle: Synchronized Limit Cycle Oscillation in Coupled Si Photonic Crystal Cavities
abstract: We demonstrate synchronized limit cycle oscillation in coupled Si photonic crystal (PhC) cavities by regarding the self-pulsing from a single PhC cavity as a limit cycle oscillator.

articleTitle: A Broadband RF/Microwave Field Sensor Based on Non-Resonant Field-Mixing in Rydberg Atoms
abstract: We present a self-calibrating broadband sensor, based on non-resonant field-mixing in Rydberg atoms in a room temperature cell, for measuring the spectral amplitude of electromagnetic fields at radio-frequency through the microwave frequencies.

articleTitle: Header Recognition Utilizing an All-Optical Reservoir with Delay-Bandwidth-Product-Maximized Double-Ring Resonators
abstract: The delay-bandwidth product in double-ring resonators (DRRs) is optimized using reinforcement learning. Then, the optimized DRRs are used to build an all-optical reservoir for optical packet header recognition, enabling a word-error rate as low as 9×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>.

articleTitle: Low-Loss GaAs/AlGaAs-On-Sapphire Waveguides for Sapphire Based Photonic Integrated Circuits
abstract: Group III-V materials on sapphire substrate opens a new avenue for photonics integrated circuits. GaAs/AlGaAs straight waveguides on sapphire substrate were numerically studied. The propagation loss, single-mode, and multi-mode operation conditions were reported.

articleTitle: On-chip Imaging Spectrometer using Multi-mode Interference Waveguides
abstract: A novel on-chip spectrometer based on top-down imaging of a multi-mode interference waveguide is introduced. Accurate wavelength identification with 0.5 nm resolution is demonstrated using a machine learning based, multi-point spectral reconstruction process.

articleTitle: Localization and isotropic gap formation in chip-scale Yukawa potential metastructures
abstract: Amorphous photonic structures generated using Yukawa-potentials are examined numerically and experimentally. Unique isotropic and asymmetric bandgaps are demonstrated. Urbach band tails are analyzed to prove Anderson-like localization in amorphous structures.

articleTitle: Fabry-Perot Interferometer in a Coreless Fiber Fabricated by a Fs Laser for High-Temperature Applications
abstract: An optical fiber in-line Fabry-Perot interferometer (FPI) fabricated in a no-core fiber using the direct femtosecond laser writing technique for high-temperature sensing applications is reported.

articleTitle: Creating Single Color Centers in Nanodiamonds with Ion Implantation
abstract: We report the first demonstration of single silicon vacancy center creation in 20 nm nanodiamonds using silicon ion implantation combined with thermal annealing. Room-temperature single photon emission with linewidth below 10 nm is observed.

articleTitle: Photon Pair Generation in OAM Modes at 780 and 1550 nm via Spontaneous Intermodal Four Wave Mixing
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of photon pairs at ~780 and ~1550 nm with a coincidence-to-accidental ratio of ~3200 via spontaneous intermodal four wave mixing mediated by a ring-core fiber stably guiding orbital angular momentum modes.

articleTitle: Cryogenic fiber-coupled waveguide probe co-integrated with electrical control lines
abstract: We present a fiber-coupled waveguide probe co-integrated with dc and microwave control lines for direct coupling to photonic resonators at cryogenic temperatures. Our device enables interfacing with multi-emitter quantum photonic devices.

articleTitle: Benchmarks for near-term photonic quantum processors
abstract: We present a framework to efficiently simulate noisy measurement-based photonic quantum processors and characterize their computing power in terms of well-known metrics such as the quantum volume. We present our results for the GKP cluster states.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic Circuitry for Superconducting Optoelectronic Networks
abstract: We present superconducting optoelectronic circuits optimized for neuromorphic computing and demonstrate integrated synaptic memories and dendritic computation. The circuits process single-photon presynaptic inputs with analog Josephson circuitry for extreme scalability.

articleTitle: Direct imaging of valley-polarized excitons in a van der Waals heterostructure
abstract: We directly image valley-polarized excitons in a WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> heterostructure using time- and angle-resolved micro photoemission spectroscopy, before and after interlayer exciton formation.

articleTitle: Statistical Characteristics of Distributed Modal Crosstalk for Weakly-Coupled FMF Transmission
abstract: We experimentally show that noise induced by the distributed modal crosstalk in weakly-coupled FMFs is well approximated by Gaussian distribution. Its impact on weakly-coupled MDM transmission systems is experimentally compared with ASE noise.

articleTitle: Electro-optic Modulator Based on Vanadium Dioxide Epsilon-Near-Zero Nanorods Embedded in Silicon Slot Waveguide
abstract: We present an electro-optic modulator exploiting a metamaterial made of an array of vanadium dioxide nanorods operating in epsilon near zero regime as the active switching material in a silicon waveguide. The modulator takes advantage of the insulator-to-metal transition of vanadium dioxide together with epsilon near zero to achieve a robust modulation depth of 20.35 dB over a broad range of wavelengths. Using simulations, we demonstrate how the effective permittivity of metamaterial can be tuned to a near-zero value by varying the nanorod geometry. The results provide insight into the design of ultra-compact epsilon-near-zero modulators with high operation frequencies and low insertion losses.

articleTitle: Integrated photonic-electronic in-memory computing platforms
abstract: We present our recent progress in integrating photonic in-memory computing platforms with electronics to provide easier controls and better computing performance, specifically by integrating tunable phase shifters and doped silicon microheaters into the platform.

articleTitle: High-accuracy Localization of Pipeline Microleakage by using Distributed Acoustic Sensor
abstract: A pipeline microleakage localization method based on the negative pressure wave propagation path fitting is proposed and demonstrated. Experimental results indicate that the location error is 3.85 cm for microleakage as small as 1.0 mm.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband Microwave Photonic Beamforming Based on Frequency Doubling and Dispersive Delay
abstract: We propose a photonic true-time-delay beamforming scheme that can achieve ultrawideband waveform generation and distortion-free delay simultaneously. The generation and beamforming performance of an 8-GHz wide linear-frequency-modulated waveform in the Ku band is evaluated.

articleTitle: A Maskless Lithography System Based on Digital Micromirror Devices (DMD) and Metalens Arrays
abstract: In a novel maskless lithography system, a metalens array focuses the light from assigned micromirrors to expose the photoresist. Arbitrary high-resolution patterning on the photoresist can be achieved.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal nonlinear phenomena in gas-filled capillary fibers
abstract: We show how gas-filled capillary fibers represent a unique platform to explore ultrafast spatiotemporal nonlinear dynamics. We review our recent results including extreme pulse compression, ultra-broad Raman red-shift, and few-cycle visible light generation.

articleTitle: Integrated Spectrometer Based on Arrayed Waveguide Grating and PbS Colloidal Quantum Dot Photodiode Array
abstract: An integrated spectrometer based on arrayed waveguide grating and PbS colloidal quantum dot photodiode array was demonstrated on the silicon nitride photonic platform, operating around 1300 nm, which might be an attractive low-cost integration routine.

articleTitle: Analysis of geometrical deformation effects in hollow-core Tube-Lattice Fibers
abstract: We have developed a numerical FEM approach for hollow-core Tube-Lattice Fibers to calculate losses due to geometrical deformation along the fiber axis and hereby provide scaling laws to gain insight and assist in design.

articleTitle: Fast Long-Wave Infrared Hyperspectral Imaging for Technical Art History
abstract: We demonstrate material classification of painted cultural heritage using a novel full-field, 700–1400-cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> Fourier-transform spectrometer, enabling fast, non-invasive imaging. Spectroscopic imaging is demonstrated of the painting ‘Uplands in Lorne’ from Glasgow University's Hunterian Collection.

articleTitle: Deep-ultraviolet Electroluminescence in van der Waals Heterostructures of Hexagonal Boron Nitride
abstract: Since hBN is a wide bandgap semiconductor(~5.96eV), electroluminescence has not been demonstrated at deep-ultraviolet frequencies. We report deep-ultraviolet electroluminescence from tunnel-injected charge carriers in hBN. Our work shows potentials for hBN based deep-ultraviolet light-emitting devices.

articleTitle: 1D-Plasmonic Metagrating based Wide Band Perfect Absorber for Near Infrared Communication Window
abstract: Simulation of a plasmonic metagrating based wide-band perfect absorber was performed for near-infrared (1050-1560nm) communication band with more than 96% absorbance. This study is useful for applications in fiber optic communications.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of a Graphene-Inserted Metal-Slot-Added Waveguide Electroabsorption Modulator
abstract: We experimentally investigate an intensity modulator based on a graphene-inserted metal-slot-added waveguide. We demonstrate that the modulator has a large extinction ratio of 3.92 dB when the waveguide is only 5 μm long.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution Photoacoustic Angiography Assisted by Images Forged from Hand-Drawn Graffiti
abstract: We have developed a diffusion model trained from 216 photoacoustic angiography images. The model can generate blood vessel images from simple graffiti, with superior performance to real images on training super-resolution photoacoustic angiography models.

articleTitle: On-chip Ytterbium based Microwave to Optical Transducer
abstract: Quantum transduction between microwave and optical photons is important for connecting remote superconducting quantum systems. We present preliminary microwave-to-optics transduction measurements using on-chip Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> with an integrated microwave resonator and optical waveguide.

articleTitle: Energy-time entangled and Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen steerable large-alphabet quantum key distribution
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated the violation of energy-time entanglement and Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen steering inequality, toward high-dimensional quantum key distribution with secure photon information efficiency of 3.68 bits/coincidences, and secure key rate of 1.77 Mbits/s.

articleTitle: 0.3 MW multicycle parametric source at 5.7 THz
abstract: We report the generation of 0.3-MW coherent radiation at 5.7 THz internal to the silicon coupler of a Raman-suppressed KTP parametric amplifier. The radiation consists of ~500 oscillation cycles in 83-ps pulse width.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength injection locking by single section QD comb lasers
abstract: We demonstrate the multi-wavelength feedback injection-locking effect for the first time. Feedback injection-locked single-section QD laser combs exhibit FSR tunability, narrowed linewidth~20 kHz and uniform energy distribution among sidebands.

articleTitle: A Self-Similar Sine-Cosine Fractal Architecture for Multiport Interferometers
abstract: We propose a novel architecture for multiport interferometers based on the Sine-Cosine fractal decomposition of unitary matrices. Our design is modular, resilient to hardware imperfections and enables systematically truncated for use in optical neural networks.

articleTitle: Simulation Framework of Laser Produced Tin Plasma Extreme Ultraviolet Light Emission Based on Quasi-Steady State Approach of Plasma Radiative Property
abstract: Enhancement of EUV emission from laser-produced plasma is a crucial issue for semiconductor manufacturing. One-dimensional simulation framework is developed with quasi-equilibrium assumption, which saves computational cost and has qualitative agreement with experiments.

articleTitle: A large field of view two- and three-photon microscope for high-resolution deep tissue imaging
abstract: We have developed a two- and three- photon microscope that enables high-resolution imaging with a large field-of-view of ~3.5 mm diameter at > 1 mm depth of mouse brains.

articleTitle: Tripartite Frequency-bin-encoded W States on a Chip
abstract: We introduce an integrated source of genuine tripartite frequency-bin-encoded W states with a predicted generation rate of ~10 kHz for milliwatt pump powers. We discuss the advantages of this approach compared to others.

articleTitle: 3D meta-optics: a platform for wavefront shaping and optical sensing
abstract: Ultrathin meta-optics has transformed recent photonic design. I will highlight a new 3D meta-optics platform with unleashed height degree of freedom for both wavefront engineering and ultrahigh-sensitivity molecular sensing. In this talk, I will discuss the design, 3D laser nanoprinting, and applications of various 3D metasurfaces.

articleTitle: Giant Deep-Ultraviolet Circular Dichroism in Synthetic Architectures of Ordered Carbon Nanotubes
abstract: We demonstrate tunable, giant, and structure-induced deep-ultraviolet circular dichroism in macroscopically chiral assemblies of racemic carbon nanotubes prepared using two approaches: mechanical-rotation-assisted vacuum filtration and chiral stacking of aligned carbon nanotubes.

articleTitle: Subspace tracking: a novel method for phase noise characterization of frequency combs
abstract: Subspace tracking, in combination with multi-heterodyne coherent detection, is proposed for independent phase noise sources identification, separation and measurement. The method is experimentally demonstrated for phase noise characterization of EO and FM-mode-locked optical frequency combs.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser written integrated photonics on sapphire
abstract: This paper presents the compact integration of photonics devices on a sapphire chip in the telecommunications waveband. The devices include waveguides, a waveguide array, a directional coupler and a splitter.

articleTitle: Proof-of-concept of a 90-port optical time reverser over 90nm bandwidth and two planes of phase manipulation
abstract: We characterize an experimental device that embodies a wavelength selective switch, a wavelength blocker and a multi plane light conversion in series, with the potential of controlling independently 90 spatial ports over 90nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Non-Gaussian state generation by multi-photon subtraction at the telecommunication wavelength
abstract: Non-Gaussian quantum states were generated by photon subtraction of up to four photons from a squeezed light at 1545.32 nm. The Wigner negativity and the parity change with the subtracted photon number were directly observed.

articleTitle: Dynamic range linearization for chip-scale laser optomechanical inertial sensing
abstract: Here we present an optomechanical inertial accelerometer with resonant frequency readout, where the transducer’s core photonic crystal has been designed to provide linear input-output dependence, which is further enhanced by our integrated linearization model.

articleTitle: High-speed plasmonic ITO modulators
abstract: Electro-optic modulators are critical building blocks for many signal processing systems which adhere to requirements given by both electrical and optical constraints. We present recently developed nanophotonic electro-optic devices enabling the next generation of electro-optic modulators featuring a significantly improved device performance regarding modulation efficiency (VπL < 1 Vmm), device footprint (< 1 mm2) and bandwidth (> 100 GHz). These novel high-performance nanophotonic electro-optic modulators and switches are based on transparent conducting oxides (ITO) which provide the critical material properties for practical deployment in future electro-optic modulation applications.

articleTitle: Fully Tunable Fabry-Pérot Cavity on Silicon Photonic MEMS with 10 nW Static Power Consumption
abstract: We report on a fully tunable Fabry-Pérot cavity on the silicon photonic MEMS having only 10nW static power. Its resonance wavelength is tunable over the full FSR, and its transmissivity is tunable up to 3.8dB.

articleTitle: Silicon nitride electro-optic modulators enabled by heterogeneous integration of barium titanate films
abstract: We demonstrate electro-optic modulators on a low-loss silicon nitride platform by heterogeneously integrating crystalline barium titanate membranes.

articleTitle: Single-shot ultrafast imaging with terahertz radiation
abstract: We demonstrate a single-shot ultrafast terahertz imaging system, by multiplexing an optical probe beam in both the time and spatial-frequency domains, which can capture multiple frames of an optically-opaque transient scene with sub-picosecond temporal resolutions.

articleTitle: Wafer-Scale Fabrication of Linear Variable Filter-based Reconstructive Micro-Spectrometer
abstract: We present a compact reconstructive micro-spectrometer based on a linear variable filter consisting of multi-layer stacks with random thicknesses in the spatial domain. A simple gradient deposition/rotation method enables wafer-scale random filters with an encryption function.

articleTitle: Noise Properties of Microresonator-Based Optical-Parametric Oscillators
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally investigate the noise properties of four-wave mixing-based optical-parametric oscillators (OPOs) in silicon nitride microresonators. Such OPOs can operate at ultralow-noise levels and serve as a dual-point source for optical-frequency division.

articleTitle: Site-controlled QD embedded coupled photonic crystal cavity waveguides for on-chip photon routing
abstract: We demonstrate the on-chip photon routing on a site-controlled quantum dots embedded W1 photonic crystal waveguides side coupled to a L3 cavity. Observed photon propagation through the device indicates the connectivity of all photonic elements.

articleTitle: In situ Thermal Refractive Index Trimming of Silicon Nitride Waveguides with Suspended Heaters
abstract: We demonstrate low-power thermal refractive index trimming of silicon nitride waveguides using suspended heaters. An average effective index change of -2.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> was achieved at a wavelength of 1550 nm with a power dissipation of 40mW after 1.5 hours.

articleTitle: Integrated Optoelectronic Memory Array with Enhanced Broadband Si-based Lines for Advanced Visual Systems
abstract: We present an innovative approach to optoelectronic memory that utilizes enhanced Si-based broadband lines integrated into an array to achieve stable synaptic functions, optical states and high recognition accuracy (99.64%) under near-infrared regions, paving the way for high-performance robot vision systems with advanced memory capabilities.

articleTitle: Fast and Coherent Optical Control with 256 Visible-Wavelength Channels
abstract: Individual control of hundreds of atomic qubits necessitates individual control of hundreds of optical channels. We implement 256 visible-light modulators in thin-film lithium niobate, actuated and stabilized in parallel by an FPGA-based architecture.

articleTitle: PolMux reception using a low-cost Heterodyne Receiver for Coherent PONs
