abstract: We present a PolMux coherent heterodyne receiver with digital signal processing for Passive Optical Networks. Sensitivity achieved is better than -28 dBm after propagating through 25 km of optical fiber for 32 Gbps MultiCAP PolMux signals.

articleTitle: Silicon four-quadrant photodetector working at the wavelength of 1550 nm
abstract: We fabricated a silicon four-quadrant photodetector that uses sub-bandgap optical absorption and operates at the 1550-nm telecommunication and the visible wavelengths, and applied it to the measurements of beam positions and deflection angles.

articleTitle: Monolithic electronics in Silicon Photonics for time-multiplexed sensing and control
abstract: We report on the monolithic cointegration of CMOS electronics in a commercial Silicon Photonics technology and show how this approach enables time-multiplexed feedback control of large-scale optical circuits using a limited number of electrical signals.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Structured Light Architectures from THz to X-rays
abstract: We will review recent advances in ultrashort light wavepackets – from THz to X-rays – exhibiting spatio-temporal structure to enable emerging frontiers in ultrafast multi-modal quantum electrodynamics and coupled time-resolved techniques with attosecond time accuracy.

articleTitle: High Harmonic Generation from Thin Film ZnO in Transmission Geometry
abstract: We study high-order harmonic generation from epitaxial ZnO films grown on Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> substrate. We observe a saturation of the harmonic intensity for a film thickness of 30 nm.

articleTitle: Monolithically-integrated femtosecond optical parametric oscillators
abstract: We demonstrate synchronously-pumped femtosecond optical parametric oscillators in integrated photonics. These monolithic 10-GHz cavities operate stably without active locking and exhibit many operating regimes observed in free-space OPOs: nondegenerate operation, box-pulsing, and quadratic bright-dark solitons.

articleTitle: Line-by-Line Inscription of Waveguide Bragg Gratings in Bulk Glass Using Femtosecond Laser
abstract: We demonstrate the first line-by-line waveguide Bragg grating written in bulk glass by femtosecond laser. The grating strength reaches 38 dB in a length of only 5 mm, the loss is less than 0.7 dB.

articleTitle: Optothermal multimodal manipulation of micro/nanoparticles
abstract: We report a new optical platform to achieve on-demand multimodal manipulation of micro/nanoparticles by a synergy of optical and thermal forces.

articleTitle: AlGaN Deep UV micro-LED Array Integrated Quantum Dots for Solar-Blind and Visible-Light Communication
abstract: To enable dual-wavelength emission by vertically integrating DUV micro-LED array and QDs applicable for both solar blind communication and visible light communication, exclusively for underwater communication, have been presented.

articleTitle: Adaptive Decision Threshold for Multipath Interference Impaired 40-Gb/s PAM4 IM/DD Optical Transmission
abstract: We proposed an adaptive decision threshold (ADT) scheme for PAM4 transmission system with multipath interference (MPI) noise, which obtains the signal-to-interference tolerance of beyond 4 dB for 40 Gb/s PAM4 signal for different laser linewidths.

articleTitle: Impact of Longitudinal Phase Mismatch in Three-Wave Nonlinear Mixing
abstract: Three-wave nonlinear mixing is simulated in the presence of longitudinal variations in phase-matching conditions, demonstrating their impact on the energy transfer between waves, with potential application to broadband optical parametric amplification in large crystals.

articleTitle: Sub-kHz linewidth, high power, frequency agile photonic integrated E-DBR laser
abstract: We demonstrate a novel class of lasers, based on the hybrid integration of an RSOA with an extended-distributed Bragg reflector (E-DBR) laser cavity implemented on a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> chip with microheaters. This enables us to reach sub-kHz laser linewidth with more than 30 mW output power and mode-hop free tuning range upto 62.4 GHz.

articleTitle: Integrated High-Extinction-Ratio 2.0-Meter Unbalanced MZI for Laser Frequency Noise Measurements
abstract: We report a 2.0-meter-long ultra-low loss Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> waveguide unbalanced MZI with a 96.6 MHz FSR and 37.5 dB extinction ratio. We demonstrate self-delayed homodyne laser frequency noise measurement.

articleTitle: Cavity Solitons Formation Above the Fundamental Limit Imposed by the Raman Self-frequency Shift
abstract: We report theoretically and experimentally on the formation of temporal cavity solitons shorter than the fundamental limit imposed by the stimulated Raman scattering in a fiber Kerr resonator that includes a phase modulator.

articleTitle: On-chip generation of non-diffracting space-time optical fields
abstract: We demonstrate the prospect for on-chip generation of diffraction-free space-time wave packets. This can be accomplished by entangling the spatial and temporal degrees of freedom on an integrated platform.

articleTitle: Surface acoustic microwave photonic filters on etchless lithium niobate integrated platform
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated high-performance surface acoustic microwave photonic filters on an etchless lithium niobate integrated platform, achieving acoustic time delays of 21–106 ns and passbands with bandwidth as narrow as 0.89 MHz.

articleTitle: A Photonic Deep Neural Network Processor on a Single Chip with Optically Accelerated Training
abstract: We report an end-to-end photonic deep neural network processor, fabricated in a commercial CMOS process, that integrates optical matrix algebra and nonlinear function units onto a single chip and implements all-optical DNN inference and training.

articleTitle: Design and resonator-assisted characterization of low-loss waveguide crossings on thin-film lithium niobate
abstract: We report thin-film lithium niobate waveguide crossings along three crystal-routing directions, which are precisely characterized by a novel resonator-based method, showing insertion loss of 0.070 dB and crosstalk of -50 dB at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Carrier Envelope Phase Dependence of High-Order Harmonic Generation from ZnO
abstract: We study the carrier-envelope phase (CEP) dependence of high-order harmonics generated in bulk ZnO crystals. The CEP dependence measured for laser polarization oriented parallel to and perpendicular to the c-axis exhibit different periodicities.

articleTitle: Dissipative Cavity Solitons at the Boundaries of a Topological Lattice
abstract: Abstract: We experimentally observe the formation of dissipative cavity solitons at the boundaries of a topological lattice. Our work reveals new opportunities to study both nonlinear topological photonics and dissipative cavity solitons in coupled resonator arrays.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Crystalline Supermirrors for Optical Cavities with 231 000 Finesse
abstract: We fabricate and characterize substrate-transferred single-crystal mirror coatings with 9.33 ± 0.17 ppm of transmittance and 4.27 ± 0.52 ppm of excess optical loss, corresponding to a transmission-loss dominated reflectance of 99.9986% at 4.45 μm.

articleTitle: Clocking Correlations between Bloch Electrons on the Attosecond Time Scale
abstract: Multi-terahertz fields force electron–hole pairs in semiconductors onto closed recollision paths. Precisely clocking these trajectories reveals first-ever attosecond signatures of many-body correlations between delocalized Bloch electrons, opening unprecedented views of quantum dynamics and phase transitions.

articleTitle: Improved Coherence of Mid-IR Quantum Cascade Laser Based Optical Frequency Combs via RF Injection
abstract: We present the performance improvement of mid-IR quantum cascade laser frequency combs by applying radio-frequency injection. The stability of combs has increased by an order of magnitude and comb coherence has also improved.

articleTitle: Active Tuning of the Microresonator Coupling Condition with Coupled Rings
abstract: We demonstrate a novel approach to actively and continuously tune the coupling condition of microresonators. Our approach allows for wavelength-dependent coupling and dispersion modification after fabrication.

articleTitle: Cascaded Stable Radio Frequency Dissemination over 960-km Fiber Link
abstract: We demonstrate a cascaded stable frequency dissemination over a 960-km fiber link and compare the frequency instability of different connectivity modes to explore the optimal cascaded mode for long-diatance frequency transmission.

articleTitle: Fingerprinting f-electron compounds using static and time-resolved extreme ultraviolet reflectance spectroscopy
abstract: Extreme ultraviolet reflectance spectroscopy is a powerful tool for distinguishing similar f-electron compounds through the shape of O- and N-edge absorption features. We demonstrate this with two cerium compounds working towards measurements on actinides.

articleTitle: Understanding Subsurface Behavior during Metal Laser Drilling Process via in-situ Synchrotron X-ray Imaging
abstract: For the first time, in-situ X-ray based imaging of the metal laser drilling is employed to elucidate the underpinnings of laser-matter interaction and the drill hole formation mechanisms to enhance the robustness and control of the manufacturing process.

articleTitle: Approaching the Quantum Noise Limit of Heterodyne between a Continuous Wave Laser and an Optical Frequency Comb
abstract: Frequency comb heterodyne underlies the highest precision measurements of frequency and time. While shot noise is typically considered the standard quantum limit,here we state where a new lower limit lies and show progress reaching this limit.

articleTitle: Momentum exchange in quantum two-electron photon interactions
abstract: We show that multiple electrons become correlated with each other through their interaction with light, even in the absence of Coulombic interactions, providing a way to realize largenumber Fock states on reasonable time scales.

articleTitle: InAs/GaAs Quantum Dot Lasers on CMOS-Compatible (001) Silicon by MOCVD Direct Heteroepitaxy
abstract: Quantum dot lasers have been demonstrated on CMOS-compatible (001) silicon by MOCVD direct heteroepitaxy. Lasers exhibit room temperature continuous-wave lasing with 46.8 mA threshold current and up to 16 mW single-facet output power.

articleTitle: Tuning Plasmonic Coupling from Touching to Near-touching Nanodimers via Nanometric Gap Size and Morphology
abstract: We observe large tunability of hybridized plasmon modes by controlling the gap size and the dimensionality of the gap regions. We present electron energy-loss spectroscopy measurements and detailed theory supporting our results.

articleTitle: Enhanced Inverse Faraday Effect in Nonmagnetic Plasmonic Monolayers of Nanodisks
abstract: With time-resolved measurements, we investigate the inverse Faraday effect of gold nanodisks in random monolayers. Order-of-magnitude enhancements are observed for 3.9% fill-factor samples (compared to gold film) which increases with proximity to the plasmonic resonance.

articleTitle: Zero-Change CMOS Nanophotonics: Converting Foundry Semiconductor Chips to Plasmonic Electro-optic Modulators
abstract: We create nanophotonic devices using CMOS foundry processes where the top metal layers exhibit a plasmonic resonance. By integrating liquid crystals and applying a bias, we measure a 20 nm resonance shift at ~700 nm.

articleTitle: Ultrafast ablation dynamics study of single crystal CaF2 using a Multi-channel Ultrabroadband probe
abstract: Ultrafast laser damage dynamics of CaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in a single-shot (1030 nm, 77fs) is captured using a spectrally-broadened chirped-probe to investigate temporal changes over 1.10 ps range, and a delay up to 5,500 ps.

articleTitle: Precision dual-comb spectroscopy using wavelength-converted frequency combs in the visible-wavelength region
abstract: We demonstrate dual-comb spectroscopy in the visible-wavelength region using wavelength-converted frequency combs with low repetition rates. In addition, we introduce a new data analysis method to avoid aliasing in the spectral analysis.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Gain Narrowing on Transfer Function Linewidth of Regenerative Amplifier Using FM-To-AM Conversion Phenomenon
abstract: This work deals with the establishment of a method based on FM-to-AM conversion measurement for the regenerative amplifier transfer function determination. We applied it to study the impact of gain narrowing on transfer function linewidth.

articleTitle: 2×2 Broadband Thermo-optic Polarization-insensitive Switch on the SOI Platform
abstract: We demonstrate a 2×2 CMOS-compactable, fabrication-tolerant, polarization-insensitive Mach-Zehnder switch based on thermo-optic engineering, with extinction ratios > 15 dB, insertion losses < 2.3 dB and polarization-dependent losses < 1 dB over a 100-nm wavelength range.

articleTitle: Machine-Learning Enabled Optimization for Robust Soliton Crystal Generation in Microring Resonators
abstract: We illustrate a novel strategy to robustly generate soliton states in Hydex microring resonators pumped with a continuous-wave laser source, by employing genetic algorithms to optimize the parameters required for coherent state generation.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic neural probe enabled light-sheet light-field fluorescence imaging microendoscope
abstract: We demonstrate a lensless volumetric imaging microendoscope for deep-brain fluorescence microscopy. It consists of a nanophotonic neural probe for light-sheet illumination and an image fiber bundle for light-field fluorescence collection.

articleTitle: Polarization Independent Quasi-BIC Resonances in Silicon Metasurfaces with Double Asymmetry
abstract: Design and experimental demonstration of polarization-independent quasi-BIC resonances at 3.5 μm wavelength in silicon metasurfaces with double-asymmetric unit-cells are presented. Polarization-independent wavelength conversion from mid infrared to visible using resonant four-wave mixing is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical Matrix Element of Hexagonal Ge
abstract: Hexagonal Ge has been predicted to have a long 20μs lifetime. A Lasher-Stern-Würfel fit of the photoluminescence spectrum provides an estimation for the lifetime and optical matrix element instead showing a nanosecond radiative lifetime.

articleTitle: Silk Fibroin Periodic Surface With Low Mid-Infrared Reflectivity Fabricated via Laser-Induced Forward Transfer
abstract: 2D periodic surfaces of silk-fibroin microstructures were fabricated via femtosecond Laser-Induced Forward Transfer, presenting low reflectivity at the mid-infrared region. Also, the low reflectivity feature was further enhanced by coating the structures with carbon.

articleTitle: The interplay of disorder and nonlinearity in topological slow-light waveguides
abstract: We study the robustness of a photonic Chern insulator (in both linear and nonlinear regimes) supporting multiple-winding slow light modes over a broad range of frequencies against fabrication disorder and nonlinearity by numerics and analytics.
