All-optical biasing and readout of a superconducting single photon detector
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical operation of an SNSPD. Using only cryogenic optoelectronic components and optical interconnects, we operate the SNSPD electrically decoupled from room temperature electronics and with a heatload of 75μW at 1K.

articleTitle: Existence of nested oscillators in soliton molecules revealed by Mode Decomposition
abstract: Mode decomposition techniques concomitantly reduce noise in data and classify dynamics in term of modes families. Applied to soliton molecules, it reveals that weak oscillators can nest into a principal one, and interact with it.

articleTitle: Programmable Mode/Wavelength DEMULTIPLEXER using Inverse-designed Low-loss Phase-change Material
abstract: We demonstrate a non-volatile optically programmable inverse-designed demultiplexer based on low-loss phase change material Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> integrated MMI that can be reconfigured both as mode and wavelength demultiplexers.

articleTitle: Ultratunable Quantum Frequency Conversion in Photonic Crystal Fiber
abstract: We achieve ultrabroad quantum frequency conversion in a photonic crystal fiber, converting a 1,551 nm heralded single photon to one with wavelengths spanning the range 1,226 - 1,483 nm. We confirm non-classical timing correlations with the herald photon, and for conversion to 1,300 nm we measure a g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(0)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t,t</inf> = 0.25(6).

articleTitle: Controlling the coherent response of arbitrarily shaped plasmonic nanoparticles
abstract: We utilize an ultra-broadband pulse-shaper to control the coherent electronic motion in arbitrarily shaped nanoparticles, steering the third-order nonlinear response from destructive to constructive interference. Our results outperform the transform-limited case by a 200% enhancement.

articleTitle: Rethinking Frequency Combs for Infrared Spectroscopy
abstract: Frequency combs (FC) underwent a significant miniaturization since the Ti:Sa passively mode-locked laser was introduced. Nowadays, a full FC re-design, e.g. based on ultracold-atoms simulation, can provide access to genuine quantum radiation.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Photonic Structures Using Automatic Differentiable Rigorous Diffraction Interface Theory
abstract: We present an automatic differentiable R-DIT for the fast inverse design of photonic structures. We demonstrated that the proposed method could achieve a 30% speedup per optimization on GPUs compared with the differentiable RCWA.

articleTitle: Improvement of Lifetime of Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers for BECCAL
abstract: Improved laser facet passivation suppresses catastrophic optical mirror damage in 1064 nm and 767 nm ridge waveguide amplifiers. Accelerated lifetests reveal a reliability of more than 99% over the mission time of 10,000 h.

articleTitle: Single-mode Integrated Out-of-plane Meta Beam Shaper for Optogenetics Neurostimulation
abstract: We designed and experimentally demonstrated a single-mode out-of-plane beam shaper that merges functionalities of a grating and a metasurface within a 240nm silicon nitride layer that focuses 473nm light into a nearly diffraction-limited spot.

articleTitle: Ultra-Efficient Foundry-Fabricated Resonant Modulators with Thermal Undercut
abstract: We demonstrate highly efficient vertical junction microdisk modulators with selective substrate undercut in a 300 mm CMOS foundry. The devices achieve record thermo-optic efficiency for sub-5 µm radius, enabling next-generation low-energy, highly-parallel DWDM links.

articleTitle: TDMA Frame Design and Demonstration of Encrypted Coherent Fronthaul with Flexible and Monitored Rate
abstract: We introduce a TDMA frame design scheme considering the flexible rate and physical layer security. A 225.39-Gbps to 281.62-Gbps net rate tuning with a step of 3.124 Gbps/pol./λ is achieved on a coherent optical transmission system.

articleTitle: Towards the Generation of Photon Pairs at 780 and 1560 nm in Periodically-Poled Silica Fiber
abstract: We show the Sum-Frequency Generation characteristics of our periodically-poled silica fiber source for spontaneous parametric downconversion at 780 and 1560 nm; efficiencies are on an order of 4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup> and photon bandwidths of ~489 GHz.

articleTitle: Zero crosstalk in anisotropic TM leaky mode with subwavelength grating metamaterials
abstract: We show that a TM leaky mode realized by subwavelength gratings (SWGs) can eliminate crosstalk between proximate waveguides. Oscillating fields i n t he SWGs allow coupling coefficient components to counteract each other, resulting in zero crosstalk.

articleTitle: Time-Refraction Optics at Single Cycle Modulation
abstract: We present an experimental study of optical time-refraction in single-cycle time-interfaces. Specifically, we study the propagation of a probe pulse through a sample undergoing large refractive index changes induced by an intense ultra-short modulator pulse.

articleTitle: Limits of Gain-Managed Nonlinear Fiber Amplifiers
abstract: We study the limitations of gain-managed nonlinear fiber amplifiers. The interaction between gain-management, polarization, and nonlinear-response are discussed in detail. An experimental, numerical, and theoretical framework is developed for the engineering of high-peak-power fiber amplifiers.

articleTitle: GaSb-Based SESAM Mode-Locked Upconversion-Pumped Thulium Laser at 2308 nm
abstract: A thulium laser operating on the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>→<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> transition with upconversion pumping by an ytterbium-fiber laser is passively mode-locked by an GaSb-based SESAM delivering 1.19 ps pulses at 2308 nm with 252 mW average output power.

articleTitle: Programmable large-scale simulation of lattices with photonic synthetic frequency dimensions
abstract: We present a programmable analog simulator with up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> lattice sites capable of simulating 2D and 3D lattices, as well as lattices with non-planar connectivity. We also demonstrate the injection of arbitrary lattice excitations.

articleTitle: Integrated SiN/InSe Waveguide Photodetector for O-band Applications
abstract: A waveguide-integrated InSe photodetector is demonstrated for telecom O-band applications. The transmission losses in the waveguide were measured before and after the integration. The measured photo responsivity and RF bandwidth are 0.03 mA/W and 5 MHZ, respectively.

articleTitle: Backward Rocket Propulsion of Particles Optically Trapped in Hollow-core Photonic Crystal Fiber
abstract: Single particles, optically levitated in the hollow core of a photonic crystal fiber, are impulsively propelled backwards at very high speed by the ablation jet created by incidence of a single femtosecond pulse.

articleTitle: Small Spectrometer with Extremely High-resolution (0.07 nm) Realized with an Improved Reconstruction Algorithm
abstract: Spectra are reconstructed by capturing wavelength-specific patterns of localized light in a photonic-crystal-waveguide. We show that real-time reconstruction at a wavelength resolution of 0.07 nm is possible by using low-rank approximation with singular-value-decomposition and regularized-least-squares.

articleTitle: Two-Octave Frequency Comb from a Nanophotonic Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate a synchronously pumped OPO in nanophotonic lithium nio-bate with a 4-ns-roundtrip cavity generating two octaves of continuous and coherent spec-trum from the visible to mid-IR with only 126 fJ of pump energy.

articleTitle: Rainbow dielectric metasurfaces for tunable resonant generation of high harmonics
abstract: We design high-Q metasurfaces with resonant wavelengths in mid-IR varying continuously along the sample. We demonstrate tunable rainbow generation of high harmonics as we vary the pump wavelength and the coordinate along the metasurface.

articleTitle: Bridging free-space and guided-wave space-time optics
abstract: An example of a beam with angular dispersion in its focus coupled to a graded-index fiber is used to demonstrate one way to merge free-space and waveguide space-time optics.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Optimization of Multiple Hidden Fluorescent Targets with Wavefront Shaping
abstract: We, for the first time, combine wavefront shaping together with thresholding based image segmentation and entropy of image to locate, optimize, and track signals from multiple targets hidden behind scattering media.

articleTitle: Frequency Translation Using Backward-Wave Spontaneous Parametric Downconversion
abstract: We experimentally investigate using backward-wave spontaneous parametric downconversion for frequency translation, where spectral characteristics of the pump wave are transferred to the signal wave.

articleTitle: Broadband Frequency Hopping Millimeter-Wave Generator Based on Photonic Spectrum Broadening
abstract: A W-band frequency hopping waveform generator is proposed based on photonic spectrum broadening using dual-drive Mach-Zehnder modulators. It operates at 89-105 GHz with 11 channels and a hopping bandwidth of 16 GHz.

articleTitle: Avalanche UTC Photodetector Using InAlAs Collection Layer at High Frequency Range
abstract: We propose a novel avalanche uni-traveling-carrier type photodetector (UTC-PD) using InAlAs as the collection layer. This UTC-PD achieves an f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3-dB</inf> of 43 GHz and near 30 GHz at multiplication factor of 1 and 2 respectively.

articleTitle: Strong-Field Effects Driven by Mid-Infrared Light in Metal-Silicon-Metal Photodiodes
abstract: We illuminate nanoantenna-based, metal-silicon-metal photodetectors with ultrafast, mid-infrared laser pulses. We record the current versus pulse energy response and observe microamp-level currents, low effective nonlinearities, and strong-field signatures.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Tunable Space-Time Wave Packets Carrying Time- and Longitudinal-Varying OAM
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate tunable ST-packets carrying both time- and longitudinal-varying OAM by synthesizing temporal and spatial frequencies of a comb. A measured local OAM value is shown to change every 0.87 ps and/or 10 cm.

articleTitle: AlGaN Deep Ultraviolet Light-Emitting Diodes Performance Enhancement Strategy at Last Quantum Barrier
abstract: To "function" as an inimitable strategy to decrease electron leakage and boost electron and hole injection efficiency for effective radiative recombination, we propose a DUV LED device design with a band-engineered last quantum barrier.

articleTitle: Photothermal Commonpath Interferometry of Silicon Nitride Membranes for Laser Light Sails
abstract: We measured the absorption of stoichiometric suspended silicon-nitride membranes at 1064 nm using photothermal common-path interferometry, aided by a new reference technique that uses monolayer graphene.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Decay of Polar Optical Vibrations in Cubic Perovskites
abstract: Decays of coherent phonons have been traced with 120 fs resolution in technologically important perovskites of BaSnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and SrTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. The phonon decay rates of 1.231.82 ps<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> are explained within the framework of anharmonic potential theory.

articleTitle: Tunable Work Functions of Nanophotonic Components and Plasmonic Metals
abstract: We have studied control of work functions in plasmonic metals and nanophotonic components with dielectric substrates as well as with visible light. Our findings pave the road to fundamental studies and applications of light-matter interactions.

articleTitle: Deployment-Oriented Classical/Quantum coexistence in X-haul fiber link for B5G Networks
abstract: Coexistence of weak coherent pulses and intense light is experimentally demonstrated in a practical 5G X-haul scenario. Acceptable QBER measurements were obtained over 5 km fiber transmission by optimizing the parameters of single-photon sender/receiver stations.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of Deep Learning-based Models for Optical Time Domain Analysis
abstract: Optical constellations generated by Deep Learning models trained with datasets generated through simulation are compared to experimentally collected ones. The obtained high accuracy enables its application for optical time domain analysis in complex network scenarios.

articleTitle: Scalable Heterogeneous Integration of a Pre-Processed Facet-Emitting Visible-Wavelength GaAs Laser
abstract: Heterogeneous integration of a pre-processed etched-facet GaAs multiple-quantum-well Fabry-Perot laser on silicon is shown through micro-transfer printing. Fiber-coupled output powers exceeding 3 mW at 789 nm are achieved with a threshold current of 60 mA.

articleTitle: Kerr beam cross-cleaning in multimode fiber
abstract: We report a cross-cleaning process of a powerful fundamental beam on a weak speckle at the second harmonic. This opens a new way to improving the brightness of weak laser beams in multimode fibers.

articleTitle: Drone-Based Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: Quantum networks between mobile platforms enable secure communication, distributed quantum sensors, and quantum computing networks. Here we present data from a quantum key distribution system between two aerial drones separated by 10 m.

articleTitle: Broadband Photonic Radar Enabling Millimeter Resolution for Vital Sign Detection
abstract: We demonstrate the first photonics-assisted vital sign radar for detecting the respiration of a cane toad as a human proxy. This work paves the way for photonics-enabled, high-performance, contactless vital sign detection and monitoring.

articleTitle: A Photonic Integrated High-power Soliton Microcomb Generator
abstract: We demonstrate a compact soliton microcomb light source. The soliton is generated from a Kerr microresonator and amplified by an erbium-implanted gain section integrated on the same photonic chip. We achieved an output power of 7.9 mW at a compact device footprint of 12.5 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Record-High Fiber Output of External Cavity Laser Modules Using GaInAsP/InP Electric-Field-Controlled Lasers for S-band-Raman Amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate record-high power external cavity laser (ECL) consisting of a GaInAsP/InP electric-field-controlled laser and fiber Bragg-grating for S-band Raman amplifiers. An ECL has 1W-fiber output and power fluctuation below 2% at over 40mW output.

articleTitle: 1060nm Single-mode Intra-cavity Metal-aperture VCSEL for over 2km Standard 1300nm SMF Transmission
abstract: We present 1060nm single-mode metal-aperture VCSEL for 1300nm-standard single-mode fiber transmission. The small-signal modulation bandwidth is 29GHz. We demonstrate 65Gbps(NRZ) and 90Gbps(PAM4) transmissions through 2km SMF. The bandwidth and distance product is 250GbpS km.

articleTitle: Graphene-hBN based Hybrid Plasmonic SOI Refractive Index Sensor
abstract: A simulation study has been performed on a graphene-based silicon hybrid plasmonic waveguide refractive index sensor which can be used for bio-chemical sensing. The mode propagation and characteristics performance of the hybrid modes of the sensor are calculated by varying the chemical potential of the graphene layer.

articleTitle: Single-Chip Laser Source with Linear FMCW LiDAR Chirp
abstract: We present a single-chip hybrid integrated laser source that contains an on-chip delay line for linear FMCW LiDAR chirp. The demonstrations shows the feasibility of chirp linearization without the need for long external optical delays.

articleTitle: Evaluation of α-parameter of 1.55-μm-band QD-LD during lasing operation with external injection locking
abstract: We report the α parameter of 1.55-μm-band quantum dot laser during lasing operation by the method of external injection locking. It was as low as 0.58, which was lower than that of a typical MQW-LD.

articleTitle: Wavelength-to-Phase Shift Keying the Master-to-Slave Injection-Locked O-band DFBLD for DPSK Link
abstract: By master-to-slave injection-locking and wavelength-to-phase-shift-keying an O-band TO-can-packed DFBLD at 1308.396 nm, the delayed-interferometric on-off-keying with Δθ=180° is achieved via direct master modulation at ΔI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</inf>=0.1mA/Δλ=0.4pm or ΔV<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</inf>=60.6 mV/Δλ=0 under overlapped or deviated master/slave coding, respectively.

articleTitle: High Energy Visible Dispersive Wave Generation in LP0,m Modes of a Large-Core Step-Index-Fiber
abstract: We demonstrate dispersive wave generation at visible wavelengths from a 1030nm pump in a single LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,m</inf> mode (m = 9,10) of a commercial 50um core fiber, obtaining pulses of 14nJ at 710nm and approximately 50fs.

articleTitle: 50W Continuous-Wave Operation of a 3mm-diameter Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Laser
abstract: We develop a 3mm large-area photonic-crystal surface-emitting laser (PCSEL) with controlled Hermitian and non-Hermitian optical couplings, as well as an in-plane lattice-constant distribution for compensation of the temperature distribution during continuous-wave (CW) operation. We demonstrate a CW output power of 50 W with a very narrow (<0.1°) beam divergence from the single-chip 3mm PCSEL.

articleTitle: Studying Terahertz Conical Emission by a Two-color Laser-based Air Plasma
abstract: We characterize the frequency-resolved terahertz (THz) beam profile created by two-color air-plasmas in the broadband frequency range (1-15 THz). Far-field conical emission patterns are confronted with current models proposed in the literature.

articleTitle: Pulse to Pulse Emission Characteristics of Fast and Ultrafast Lasers Emitting from UV to MIR Measured With a New Generation of High Speed Laser Energy Sensors
abstract: Pulse to Pulse Characteristics of UV to MIR Emitting Lasers Using a New High Speed Laser Energy Sensors Are Shown. A Methodology to Detect Missing Pulses Was Implemented for Ultimate Control of Laser Micromachining Processes.

articleTitle: Characterizing squeezed light: Schmidt decomposition vs. Whittaker-Shannon interpolation
abstract: For squeezed light with a large spectro-temporal correlation, we construct an approximate Schmidt decomposition, which is equivalent to the Whittaker-Shannon interpolation formula. Our decomposition leads to an intuitive description of the squeezed light photon statistics.

articleTitle: Advanced Applications of Optical Kerr Micro-combs
abstract: We review our work on advanced applications of optical Kerr frequency microcombs, including an optical convolutional accelerator operating at 11 Tera-OPS, as well as real-time video signal processing at a speed of 18 Terabits/s.

articleTitle: Generation of Longitudinally Structured Light Sheets Using Deep Neural Holography
abstract: We present a neural network holographic system based on superposition of Bessel beams that generates high quality images on a single or multiple planes perpendicular to the hologram plane in real time for AR/VR applications.

articleTitle: Sub 125-fs mJ-level Yb:CALYO Diode Pumped Regenerative Amplifier
abstract: We report a 1 kHz, Yb-based regenerative amplifier providing the ultimate 122 fs output pulses with 2.3 mJ of energy at 1039 nm, developed using a single disordered Yb:crystal-Yb:CaYAlO4 (Yb:CALYO).

articleTitle: Non-volatile electrically programmable integrated photonics with 5-bit operation based on phase-change material Sb2S3
abstract: We report a hybrid phase-change mateial Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-silicon photonic tunable directional coupler, which exhibits low insertion loss (< 1.0 dB), large extinction ratio (> 10 dB), high endurance (> 1,600 switching events), and 32 operation levels.

articleTitle: High Spatial Resolution and Large Measurement Range Strain Sensor Based on Special Fiber OFDR System
abstract: An excellent strain sensor based on longitudinal micro-structured fiber OFDR is proposed and demonstrated. Owing to the higher RBS intensity, the spatial resolution reaches 400μm and the strain measurement range is greatly increased to 4400με.

articleTitle: Integrated Reconfigurable Photonic Matrix Processor from Lithium-Niobate-on-Insulator
abstract: We design and demonstrate photonic in-memory computing utilizing broad bandwidth electro-optical modulators from Lithium-Niobate-on-Insulator. A tensor-core configuration gives rise to matrix-vector-multiplications, hence image edge detection.

articleTitle: Er-doping of thin-film lithium niobate on insulator using ion exchange process
abstract: We doped a thin-film lithium niobate on insulator substrate by Er ions, using an ion exchange process. We investigated and characterized the generated fluorescence light from the substrate.

articleTitle: A Portable Widefield HDR Fundus Camera
abstract: We report here a portable widefield fundus camera with high dynamic range (HDR) imaging capability. The effectiveness of HDR imaging was validated with both normal healthy and pathologic eyes.

articleTitle: Terahertz Photoconductive Metasurface Detector with enhanced Two-Step Photon Absorption at 1550 nm
abstract: We demonstrate the use of low-temperature grown GaAs (LT-GaAs) metasurface as an ultrafast photoconductive switching element gated with 1550 nm laser pulses. The metasurface is designed to enhance a weak two-step photon absorption at 1550 nm, enabling THz pulse detection.

articleTitle: Faraday-Ramsey rotation measurement in a thin cell as analogy to atomic beam
abstract: By confining Rubidium atoms in a micron scale vapor cell and illuminating them with two laterally displaced beams we mimic the behavior of an atomic beam and observe the Faraday-Ramsey effect at the micron scale.

articleTitle: Photonic Advantage of Optical Encoders
abstract: This research presents an optical/digital hybrid ANN which demonstrates a "photonic advantage" in intermediate classification accuracy over pure electronic ANNs with the same power and latency. The optical encoder uses incoherent light which is suitable for operation in ambient light with no additional optical power needed. Further research is needed to explore its efficiency in more complicated datasets, training algorithms, and nonlinear activation in the optical domain.

articleTitle: Real-time Si photonics nonmechanical FMCW LiDAR with SLG beam scanner and enhanced k-clock sampling
abstract: FMCW ranging with enhanced k-clock sampling was implemented in a Si photonics nonmechanical SLG LiDAR device to compensate for the nonlinearity of a swept laser source. Successful real-time operation was obtained with 2720 image pixels.

articleTitle: Non-Gaussian Quantum State Engineering with Squared-Quadrature Quantum Nondemolition Measurements
abstract: We present a method for generating squeezed Schrödinger cat states and cubic phase states via quantum nondemolition measurement of the squared-quadrature operator, offering a realistic route to fault-tolerant universal continuous-variable quantum computation.

articleTitle: Efficient Broadband Mid-Infrared Optical Parametric Amplification in Nanophotonic Waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate efficient optical parametric amplification in dispersion-engineered thin-film-lithium-niobate nanowaveguides. These devices exhibit parametric gains >30 dB/√pJ, enabling down-conversion of sub-10-pJ pump pulses to coherent 1.35-pJ idler pulses with a 140-nm-wide spectrum centered around 3200 nm.

articleTitle: A Purcell Enabled Monolayer Semiconductor Free-Space Optical Modulator
abstract: We illustrate a general pathway to reduce the detrimental impact of the non-radiative decay and dephasing in quantum materials through photonic design of the device electrodes, demonstrating a free-space electro-optical modulator based on atomically-thin semiconductors.

articleTitle: Emission spectra of octaethylporphyrin dissolved in liquid toluene and a tripropylene glycol diacrylate polymer matrix
abstract: Emission spectra of octaethylporphyrin is reported in liquid toluene solution and a rigid polymer matrix. The results of this study suggest that the lifetime of the triplet state of octaethylporphyrin increases in the polymer matrix.

articleTitle: Generation of Time-Energy Entangled Photon Pairs in Bichromatic Photonic Crystal Cavities
abstract: MHz-rate generation of time-energy entangled photon pairs is demonstrated on Silicon and InGaP bichromatic Photonic Crystal cavities with µW-level pump power. High visibility up to 94% is measured with 1 second integration.

articleTitle: Modulated temperature sensitivity based on silicon ring resonators with titanium dioxide cladding
abstract: We investigated the temperature dependence of silicon ring resonators deposited TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> cladding. It was experimentally demonstrated that temperature sensitivity can be greatly modulated from 7.68 pm/K to 51.95 pm/K by varying width of waveguide from 330 nm to 390 nm.

articleTitle: Design of an all-dielectric nanotweezer for particle trapping based on bound states in the continuum
abstract: A novel all-dielectric nanotweezer is designed. We excite the quasi-bound states in the continuum (quasi-BICs) mode by breaking the structural symmetry. As a result, we achieve an enhanced optical force trapping of polystyrene particle. © 2023 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Wavelength-Selective Distribution of Polarization Entanglement over Deployed Fiber
abstract: We demonstrate distribution of polarization entangled photon-pairs across multiple channels in a 6 km loop of deployed fiber. We use an all-optical networking switch to route Bell-state photons in three different wavelength pairs and verify entanglement distribution in all channel pairs by measuring two-photon interference fringes.

articleTitle: Microfabricated Strontium Vapor Cells for Compact Optical Frequency References
abstract: We demonstrate FM laser spectroscopy at 461 nm using a microfabricated strontium vapor cell. These compact and manufacturable vapor cells may accelerate the development of quantum devices based on alkaline earth atoms.

articleTitle: Two-Photon Dual-Comb LiDAR for Multi-Target Ranging
abstract: We demonstrate two-photon dual-comb LiDAR achieving simultaneous dynamic ranging to three moving targets driven by sinusoidal, triangular and square waveforms at 12-Hz frequency. For stationary targets, we show averaging to sub-μm precisions in 500 ms.

articleTitle: Waterproof perovskite quantum dot laser
abstract: We encapsulated CsPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> perovskite quantum dots with UiO-66 and dispersed them in an optical resonator to achieve underwater lasing at room temperature with the same luminescence intensity maintained even after 15 months.

articleTitle: Label-Free Three-Photon Deep Imaging with High Power Femtosecond Yb-fiber Laser
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous multicolor two- and three-photon imaging of bacterial filaments using a single high-power femtosecond Yb-fiber laser. Our experiments demonstrate the superior signal-to-background ratio obtainable with three-photon imaging deep below the sample surface.

articleTitle: Impact of Strong Atmospheric Turbulence on Two-Way Optical Time Transfer
abstract: Frequency comb based optical time transfer can provide femtosecond-level timing which will support future clock networks. However, for long-distance terrestrial links, nonreciprocal atmospheric turbulence induces a timing penalty. Here, we quantify this penalty.

articleTitle: Real-time stealth transmission via dither-based bias control
abstract: We report a real-time 1 kbps stealthy transmission in the 10 Gbps QPSK public communication. The stealth data is embedded in dither signals of bias control. The scheme is compatible with existing optical transmission systems.

articleTitle: Instantaneous, high-resolution imaging of turbid media using FRAME-based Fourier Ptychography
abstract: Visualizing fine details in a turbid media is extremely challenging due to multiple light scattering. Here we combine spatial filtering, Fourier Ptychography and image multiplexing to enable instantaneous high-resolution imaging of turbid media.

articleTitle: Highly Efficient Lasing and Thermal Properties of Tm:Y2O3 and Tm:(Y,Sc)2O3 Ceramics
abstract: Thermal, spectroscopic and laser properties of transparent Tm:(Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>Sc<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> sesquioxide ceramics fabricated by vacuum sintering at 1750 °C were studied. A Tm:Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> ceramic laser generated 812 mW at ~2.05 μm with a slope efficiency of 72.0%.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a polarization-agnostic geometric phase in nonlocal metasurfaces
abstract: We theoretically propose and experimentally demonstrate nonlocal metasurfaces rationally designed using symmetry-breaking principles to manipulate the optical wavefront with a geometric phase selective to custom elliptical polarizations.

articleTitle: Line-Scan Optical Sensing System for Surface Characterizations in Laser Material Processing and Additive Manufacturing of Metals
abstract: A prototype line-scan optical sensing system for applications in laser processing of metallic materials was evaluated. Identification and profiling of surface features (keyholes) was demonstrated and classification of surface roughnesses was achieved using neural networks.

articleTitle: Three-photon excitation of quantum two-level systems
abstract: We demonstrate that a two-level system, in form of an InGaN quantum dot, can only be efficiency excited using an odd number of photons (1 or 3) while resonant two-photon excitation is strongly suppressed.

articleTitle: Recent advances in upscaling ultrafast laser structuring of high-energy electrodes for lithium-ion batteries
abstract: For high energy and environmental-friendly water-based cathodes and anodes, laser processing was established in roll-to-roll handling systems. A push of laser structuring technology readiness level towards TRL 6 was demonstrated for pouch cell geometries.

articleTitle: Nonperturbative carrier generation and symmetry reduction in bismuth by intense terahertz excitation
abstract: The semimetal bismuth is studied by two-dimensional terahertz (2D-THz) spectroscopy in the nonperturbative regime. We observe and separate different components of the nonlinear THz response, including high harmonic generation and pump-probe signals pointing to anisotropic transient carrier distributions and phonon backfolding at reduced symmetry.

articleTitle: Complex Study of Ultrafast Dual Wavelength Nonlinear Switching in Mismatched Soft Glass Dual-Core Fibers
abstract: Effective all-optical switching using dual-core fibers is studied both experimentally and theoretically. C-band femtosecond pulses are switched by synchronized shorter wavelength ones and interpreted in terms of nonlinear balancing of the couplers mismatch.

articleTitle: Ultra-Low Loss Silicon Nitride Waveguides on Monolithic Integrated Photonics Circuits for a Mature 300 mm Wafer Scale Silicon Photonics Platform
abstract: We demonstrate silicon nitride waveguides with <0.1 and 0.3 dB/cm loss in nitride and fully integrated photonics wafers, respectively, by employing noble integration techniques while preserving the performance of the other devices of the platform.

articleTitle: Design of MPLC approach for high coupling efficiency OAM mode into ring-core optical fibers
abstract: Multiplane light converters (MPLC) for orbital angular momentum (OAM) modes previously targeted ideal free space modes. We design for coupling into a ring core fiber (RCF), contrast efficiency with general designs, and examine different implementations.

articleTitle: Design of Hybrid Gold-Graphene Metasurfaces for Efficient Excitation of Tunable Graphene Plasmons
abstract: We demonstrate a large-area, widely tunable hybrid metasurface consisting of gold rods on back-gated CVD-grown graphene. Under moderate doping (0.35 eV), localized graphene plasmons are excited with record-high extinction rates (17%) across the mid-infrared regime.

articleTitle: Compact MEMS-Based LiDAR for Long-Distance Range Over 350-m and High Resolution Point-Cloud Data of ±0.01°
abstract: We report a compact MEMS-based LiDAR module with a synchronized dual-laser beam to enhance both the long-distance range and clear point-cloud data. This LiDAR exhibits long-distance range over 350-m and high-resolution point-cloud data of ±0.01°.

articleTitle: High-Gain Parametric Amplification On-Chip at Low Pump Powers
abstract: We demonstrate a novel amplification scheme that yields high (30-dB), continuous-wave parametric amplification of weak signals using small-footprint microresonators at pump power levels (< 10 mW) compatible with typical chip-scale lasers.

articleTitle: Tunable Integrated 118 Million Q Reference Cavity for 780 nm Laser Stabilization and Rubidium Spectroscopy
abstract: We stabilize a 780 nm semiconductor laser to a thermally tuned 118 million Q silicon nitride photonic resonator. The stabilized laser is swept by 400 MHz and probes rubidium transitions at a 500 Hz rate.

articleTitle: High-resolution mid-IR spectra of methanol and dimethyl sulfide obtained with interleaved subharmonic OPO combs
abstract: We use a pair of highly-coherent subharmonic optical parametric oscillators (instantaneous span 3.2-5.4 μm) to obtain the first to our knowledge high-resolution (0.002cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) mid-infrared spectra of methanol (CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>OH) and dimethyl sulfide (CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S via interleaving comb-tooth-resolved spectra.

articleTitle: Impact of Mid-Spatial Frequency Errors in Stretcher Optics on the Temporal Contrast of Short Optical Pulses
abstract: The impact of mid-spatial-frequency errors in stretcher optics on temporal contrast via spatiotemporal coupling is studied experimentally. Three Offner secondary mirrors are compared, clearly showing temporal contrast degradation resulting from magnetorheological finishing.

articleTitle: Compact, single-shot and complete Mueller matrix imaging using metasurfaces
abstract: Mueller matrix imaging, an important technique in STEM, images the information-rich spatially varying polarization properties of an object. Using nanoengineered metasurfaces, we implement a compact Mueller imaging system that can, in a single-shot, acquire images for all sixteen Mueller matrix components.

articleTitle: Compact Surface-Normal Coherent Receiver with Wire-Grid Polarizers
abstract: We present a broadband and compact coherent receiver in a surface-normal configuration using wire-grid polarizers. Demodulation of 64-Gbaud QPSK and 50-Gbaud 16QAM signals as well as ultra-wideband operation covering 1260-1630 wavelength bands are demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Attenuators for Ultrafast High Peak Power Laser Pulses Based on Diffraction
abstract: Attenuators must have a damage threshold to handle input pulses while not introducing significant dispersion or altering the spectrum. We have developed such an attenuator based on diffraction that can meets these requirements.

articleTitle: Low-channel-crosstalk silicon CWDM wavelength (de)multiplexer employing fabrication-tolerant cascaded MZIs with cross-port connection
abstract: The combination fabrication-tolerant cascaded MZIs and cross-port connection scheme enables a broadband wavelength (de)multiplexer with -38.81±3.19 dB optical channel crosstalk and -0.212±0.6 nm wavelength deviation over 12-inch silicon-on-insulator wafer.

articleTitle: Quantifying the differentiation of 50B11 dorsal root ganglion cells using quantitative phase imaging
abstract: The immortalized dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neuron cell lines are promising sensory neuron models, with particular applicability to drug development. Here, we quantitatively assess morphological changes due to forskolin-augmented neuronal differentiation using quantitative phase imaging.

articleTitle: An Ultranarrow Linewidth Laser for Deployable Quantum Sensors
abstract: A novel ultranarrow linewidth laser that can be operated outside the laboratory is discussed. Short-term Allan Deviations of 2E-13 and frequency noise power spectral densities below 10 Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Hz at >100 Hz offset are presented.

articleTitle: Two-Color Tunable Mid-Infrared and Near-Infrared Ultrafast Laser System for Pump-Probe Studies at 1 kHz
abstract: We built and characterized a DFG mid-infrared source tunable between 4-14 µm and a synchronized 35 fs Ti:Sapphire laser. Mid-infrared XFROG measurements show 200 fs pulse lengths and pump-probe synchronization on a few femtosecond scale.

articleTitle: 3D poling and drive mechanism for high-speed PZT-on-SOI Electro-Optic modulator
abstract: We demonstrate a C-band PZT-on-SOI electro-optic modulator with an electro-optic bandwidth of >12 GHz and a V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> of 0.6 V-cm. An electro-optic response of 228 pm/V is measured with a 3D poling and measurement scheme.

articleTitle: Noise-resilient approach for deep tomographic imaging
abstract: We propose a noise-resilient deep reconstruction algorithm for X-ray tomography. Our approach shows strong noise resilience without obtaining noisy training examples. The advantages of our framework may further enable low-photon tomographic imaging.

articleTitle: Broadband Tunable OPOs for FTIR Spectroscopy
abstract: Broadband, tunable optical parametric oscillators (OPOs) are shown to have great potential for improving a range of Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy applications. These include stand-off detection, fiber-delivery, multi-species spectroscopy, and high-resolution, high sensitivity measurements.

articleTitle: Multi-pixel photoconductive THz emitters for active beam shaping and polarisation control
abstract: Multi-pixel THz photoconductive emitters are an emerging class of THz source that can extend the capabilities of THz time-domain spectrometers and THz imaging systems dramatically. Here we report our recent work using pixel arrays to steer and shape the transverse profile of a THz beam. Further, pixel arrays containing orthogonal elements can be used to generate linear, circular, radial or azimuthal THz beams, where the polarisation purity can be dynamically tuned electrically.

articleTitle: From Static to Dynamic Modulation of Second Harmonic Generation from Plasmonic Hotspots
abstract: We demonstrate modulation of second harmonic generation by systematically inducing field asymmetry in the gap of gold nanoantennas via controlled geometric symmetry breaking. The concept is extended to electrical tuning of the nonlinear signal.

articleTitle: Metalens-Integrated Optical Phased Array for Optical Manipulation with Wavelength Tuning
abstract: We have proposed a metalens-integrated optical phased array, enabling on-chip based optical manipulating with wavelength tuning. The movement of the focal point is demonstrated while there are no moving parts.

articleTitle: Super-resolution image projection using a diffractive optical decoder
abstract: We report a diffractive super-resolution image display framework consisting of a digital encoder and an all-optical decoder to synthesize/project high-resolution images at an output plane using a low-resolution input light-modulator.

articleTitle: Integrated Tunable Bell State Generator and Hong-Ou-Mandel Experiment on AlGaAsOI
abstract: We report an AlGaAsOI quantum photonic circuit with multiple pair sources and tunable interferometers. We demonstrate Hong-Ou-Mandel interference between two microring resonators and a tunable Bell state generator producing Ψ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> and Φ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup> bi-photon entangled states.

articleTitle: Bottom-up Fabricated Barium Titanate Nonlinear Photonic Crystal
abstract: Sol-gel derived barium titanate photonic crystals with a resonance centered at 780 nm were enabled by soft-nanoimprint lithography. The increased light-matter interaction at resonance is shown by 15 times enhancement of the second harmonic generation.

articleTitle: Witnessing Entangled Two-Photon Absorption via Quantum Interferometry
abstract: We demonstrate that a two-photon, N00N-state interferometer is insensitive to linear (single-photon) losses, and thus capable to unequivocally certify entangled two-photon absorption (eTPA) in arbitrary-sample transmission-based absorption measurements.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Optical Trapping Properties of Microplastics
abstract: As microplastics in the environment rise, it becomes increasingly important to understand their consequences on living species. We classify the optical trapping properties of various lab-made microplastics in order to characterize microplastics found in nature.

articleTitle: Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Electro-Optic Modulators with Integrated Silicon Photonic Thermo-Optic Phase Shifters
abstract: TFLN/silicon photonic modulators featuring active silicon photonic components are reported with a V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> of 3.6 Vcm. This hybrid architecture utilizes the bottom of the buried oxide as the bonding surface which features minimum topology.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of reconfigurable photonic topological phase transition with phase-change materials
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated photonic topological phase transition in GST (Ge2Sb2Te5) loaded photonic crystals by using material phase transition. The band inversion, which is evidence of topological phase transition, was observed with photonic band diagram measurements.

articleTitle: Single extracellular particle trapping with ultra-low heat generation using optical anapoles
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the trapping of nanoscale supermeres using a non-radiating anapole mode. All-dielectric anapole improves electric field enhancement with negligible heat dissipation, allowing low-power near-field trapping.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Aided Prediction of Fabrication Uncertainties in Integrated Multi-Ring Filters
abstract: We propose a machine learning-based framework to predict the fabrication uncertainty and evaluate the effective-index shift in multi-ring integrated filtering elements. Excellent results are achieved in predicting each ring’s effective-index shift.

articleTitle: Water Window Attosecond Pulses driven by Sub-cycle Tailored Waveforms
abstract: Tunable high-harmonic continua in the water window spectral region are generated in helium using sub-cycle infrared waveforms from a parametric waveform synthesizer. Yield enhancement is observed with specific driving waveforms.

articleTitle: Coherent Add/Drop Multiplexing Using an Optic-Electronic-Optic Interferometer
abstract: We demonstrate add/drop multiplexing of optical QPSK signals using an optic-electronic-optic (OEO) interferometer with a processing path including opto-electronic coherent detection, real-time digital signal processing, and electro-optic complex field remod-ulation.

articleTitle: 10-kW-level Yb-Raman fiber laser based on adjustable Raman threshold method
abstract: By adjusting Raman threshold method according to pump power, the residual pump and high-order Raman scattering are suppressed. A 10.7 kW Yb-Raman fiber laser operating at 1120 nm is achieved for the first time.

articleTitle: Precision spectral line-resolution to classify greenhouse gas species in broadband mid-infrared sensing
abstract: We present a novel methodology to classify greenhouse gas species by investigating the structural complexity of broadband overlapping molecular lines in the spectral region of 7.0 μm to 8.0 μm. The structural information is classified by resolving peaks and zero crossings by adaptive learning methods.

articleTitle: Single Shot Measurement of a Topological Invariant
abstract: We demonstrate a new method for taking a single shot measurement of a photonic topological invariant. The simplicity of this method is highlighted through our characterization of topological photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: A Simple and Low-latency MP2P Aggregation Architecture for Uplink Fronthaul
abstract: We proposed an economical, low-latency, MP2P uplink fronthaul architecture capable of aggregating four end-users with commercial 25G optical modules and a single photodiode. 4×380.16MHz bands are received independently over 20 km fiber.

articleTitle: Advantages and Limitations of Adaptive Optics in Multi-photon Microscopy
abstract: Combining adaptive optics in multiphoton microscopy can improve both resolution and signal. While resolution enhancement has been effectively demonstrated, signal improvement has shown only modest results. We discuss the potential and limitations of this method.

articleTitle: High Temperature Cryogenic Single Photon Detector with Ultra-Low Time Jitter and Dark Count Rate for Spaceborne Quantum Communication Applications
abstract: We report the development and testing of a photon-counting detector for space-borne quantum communication applications with an ultra-low dark count rate (10 counts per second) and low timing jitter (40 ps FWHM, 17 ps σ, 140 ps 1%) at a non-cryogenic temperature of -60°C.

articleTitle: Constructing a magneto-optical trap using transmissive metasurfaces
abstract: We use metasurfaces to construct a six-beam magneto optical trap for neutral strontium atoms. The configuration consists of a polarization-multiplexed metasurface splitter and three topology-optimized metagratings, requiring only two input beams and no bulk optics.

articleTitle: Spectral Narrowing of Cr:ZnS/Se Lasers Oscillation In Twisted Mode Cavity
abstract: It was demonstrated that suppression of the spatial hole burning effect via "mode twisting" in nonselective cavities results in linewidth narrowing to ~80-90 pm from ~20-50 nm for lasers based on polycrystalline Cr:ZnS and Cr:ZnSe.

articleTitle: Learning to control the complex light propagation through few-mode fiber without a reference wave
abstract: We show reference-less transmission matrix measurements using a neural network operating with up to 23 modes in real-time. We use synthetic training data enabling optical predistortion through an SLM for light control through disordered media.

articleTitle: Self-assembled gratings in chalcogenide microresonators for ultralow-threshold integrated Brillouin lasers
abstract: We present a reconfigurable selective mode splitting based on self-assembled refractive index grating in integrated GeSbS microresonators, enabling an efficient Brillouin laser with a record low threshold power of 0.46 mW in chalcogenide microresonators.

articleTitle: All-Optical Magnetization Reversal in Arbitrary Geometries using Metasurfaces
abstract: We report and experimentally demonstrate a monolithic multilayer nanostructure capable of achieving high speed, and high density of optical helicity-dependent magnetization switching using femtosecond circularly polarized optical pulses from a metasurface.

articleTitle: Atomic quantum memory as a time-frequency processor
abstract: We introduce an atomic quantum memory with built-in spectro-temporal processing capabilities. We demonstrate temporal far-field imaging setup operating in a previously unexplored narrowband regime and show quantum-optimal measurement of frequency separation between two spectral lines.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Integration of SiV- Centers in Diamond with Lithium Niobate Photonics for Quantum Networks
abstract: We report the high efficiency coupling of diamond waveguides to thin-film lithium-niobate photonics, allowing for the optical addressing and characterization of individual SiV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> color centers.

articleTitle: Platform independent integration of telluride thin films for high speed on-chip photodetection
abstract: We demonstrate platform-independent and scalable integration of tellurium thin film with photonic structures in silicon, silicon nitride and lithium niobate for ultra-broadband photodetection with a bandwidth of more than 40 GHz.

articleTitle: Photonic frequency synthetic dimensions for high-dimensional convolutions
abstract: We show that high-dimensional convolution can be realized in a single dynamically modulated optical ring resonator. The high-dimensional convolution introduced here has broad applications, such as 3D convolution for motion detection and scene reconstruction.

articleTitle: Full-spectrum visible electro-optic modulator
abstract: We report a visible-band electro-optic modulator that can operate over the full visible spectrum of 400–700 nm, with a record low V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> • L of 0.17V • cm.

articleTitle: High resolution Dynamic Strain Sensing Using Frequency-Scanning φ-OTDR with Frequency Comb Pulse
abstract: By modulating frequency comb into single interrogating pulse instead of sweeping the carrier frequency one by one in frequency-scanning φ-OTDR, a novel high resolution strain sensor with unprecedented dynamic response speed was proposed and demonstrated.

articleTitle: Multi-material achromatic phase converter for broadband ultrafast singular optics
abstract: We propose and examine a multi-material achromatic phase converter exploiting spiral phase plate concept. The spatio-spectro-temporal numerical simulations suggest viability of the proposal and possibility to generate broadband ultrashort vortices in different spectral ranges.

articleTitle: Extremize Optical Chiralities through Polarization Singularities
abstract: We report the way to realize maximization and minimization of optical chiralities of open photonic structures from perspectives of quasinormal modes and polarization singularities of their far-field radiations.

articleTitle: Subarray Design and Thermal Crosstalk Optimization for Power-Efficient Optical Phased Array
abstract: We propose to address thermal crosstalk in integrated optical phased arrays by circuit design and array control. A silicon photonic chip prototype demonstrates that subarray design and thermal crosstalk optimization reduce power consumption by 38%.

articleTitle: Polarization Mapping of Backscattered THz Speckle Fields Using the PHASR Scanner
abstract: We present a handheld polarization-sensitive imaging instrument to directly capture terahertz speckles in the back-scattering geometry. We demonstrated that the distribution of the polarization states are strongly dependent upon the surface roughness and the illumination frequency.

articleTitle: Soliton Crystals in a High-Q MgF2 Microresonator
abstract: Based on the power-kicking method, the soliton crystals and multiple solitons in high-Q magnesium fluoride microresonator are observed. Under constant pump, they could be obtained with different defects deterministically that occurred by the wavelength tuning.

articleTitle: Upconverting Quantum Correlations of Light Over Multiple Octaves
abstract: We show that extreme-nonlinear optics transfers quantum states of light between spectral ranges. We demonstrate high harmonic generation driven by squeezed light results in squeezed harmonics, and explore the dispersion & criticality of harmonic squeezing.

articleTitle: Controlling Thermal and Nonlinear Optical Instabilities in Fiber Amplifiers
abstract: We suppress transverse mode instability and stimulated Brillouin scattering in a multimode fiber by exciting many modes. High beam quality is maintained, and the output beam profile can be controlled by shaping the input wavefront.

articleTitle: Scanning Interferometer Aimed at Characterizing Laser Coherence Lengths
abstract: We report on the design and construction of a Mach-Zehnder Interferometer with an adjustable measuring arm aimed at quantifying the coherence lengths of lasers for use in undergraduate research projects and low-cost interferometers.

articleTitle: Direct Iterative Photonic Integrated Matrix Inverter
abstract: We demonstrate the first chip-based real-valued direct photonic matrix inverter using coherent sources. At a rate of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> inversions/s, a 16×16 diagonal matrix and a 2×2 arbitrary matrix are inverted with 99.2% and 93.7% accuracy.

articleTitle: Probing Vibrational Dephasing Dynamics in Crystalline Defects with Different Environments
abstract: Ultrafast infrared spectroscopy was used to unveil the rates at which different vibrational modes of atomic-scale defects in diamond interact with their environment. We adopted the N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>VH<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup> defect as a model system, and studied perturbed free induction decay (PFID) and population decay features. The faster dephasing times of the fundamental stretch mode in comparison to the observed bend mode (first overtone) was a result of its more direct perturbation of the crystal lattice. We further demonstrate the versatility of ultrafast spectroscopy by investigating the energy level structure and dynamics of an unknown defect that is infrared active at 3237 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>.

articleTitle: Parallel coherent LiDAR with low hardware requirements
abstract: A high-performance parallel coherent LiDAR based on phase-coded subcarrier modulation with record-high imaging rate and high ranging precision is demonstrated, which also breaks through the high-hardware requirements in the previous parallel coherent LiDARs.

articleTitle: Amplitude and Phase Retrieval of Optical Pulses Using A Silicon Photonics Optical Correlator
abstract: We propose retrieval of amplitude and phase of optical pulses using a silicon photonics optical correlator and tunable filter. The amplitude and phase of pico-second pulses with and without frequency chirp were successfully retrieved.

articleTitle: A Chip-based Orbital Angular Momentum Transceiver for Underwater Optical Communications
abstract: We demonstrate an on-chip orbital angular momentum transceiver operating at visible wavelengths for high-bandwidth low-loss underwater optical communications. Our device achieves an average crosstalk of better than 8 dB from testing in air.

articleTitle: Interband Cascade Infrared Photodetectors Based on Ga-Free Superlattice Absorbers
abstract: We present interband cascade infrared photodetectors based on InAs/InAsSb superlattice absorbers employing an alternative extraction path for photogenerated carriers. At 300 K specific detectivities D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> ≈1⋅10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> Jones were achieved for a cut-off wavelength of 9 μm.

articleTitle: Optimizing Laser Conversion in Microresonator Optical-Parametric Oscillation
abstract: We explore pump-laser conversion to the unit boundary, leveraging photonic crystal microresonators for universal phase-matching and on-chip reflectors to boost efficiency. Our experiments demonstrate high laser conversion efficiency and output power with integrated, wavelength-diverse lasers.

articleTitle: Velocity Measurement through Hilbert Phase Subdivision
abstract: Compared with the zero-crossing resampling, the Hilbert transform can resample the signal to compensate for the nonlinear frequency sweeping phenomenon and precisely characterize a velocity of 200 mm/s with its standard deviation of 0.749 mm/s.

articleTitle: Silicon Oxynitride Organic Hybrid Concentric Microrings Lasers
abstract: We demonstrate silicon oxynitride organic hybrid concentric microrings lasers. We measure lasing near the microresonator edge and center from a radial-grating-ring-embedded structure using a fiber tip.

articleTitle: Multi-species gas sensor based on QEPAS with wide tunable IC-ECDL for the MIR region
abstract: An IC-ECL for the coverage of the MIR region with outstanding performance, especially with respect to high acquisition rates, is presented. The results of the performance analysis and the QEPAS-based detection of multispecies are shown.

articleTitle: Ultrafast and All-Optical Imaging of Molecular Chirality via Low-Order Nonlinear Interactions
abstract: We introduce an ultrafast chiro-optical method based on sum-frequency generation. In contrast to traditional implementations, the medium’s chirality is encoded in the intensity of the nonlinear response, rather than in its phase, with high efficiency

articleTitle: Observation of Femtosecond Laser-induced Columnar Structures above the Surface Level of Al
abstract: Through femtosecond laser irradiation, we observed the formation of columnar structures above the surface level of Al and showed the control of their morphological profiles with the laser fluence and the number of irradiating pulses.

articleTitle: Efficient Broadband THz Generation from New Standards in Optical Rectification
abstract: We present the optical and THz properties of highly efficient organic nonlinear optical crystals PNPA and MNA. These crystals outperform industry standards in broadband THz generation through optical rectification of IR light pulses.

articleTitle: Linn Mollenauer, Solitons in Birefringent Optical Fibers, and PMD
abstract: My principal interactions with Linn centered around understanding the impact that randomly varying birefringence and polarization mode dispersion has on solitons in optical fibers. I describe this early work, its motivation, and some later work.

articleTitle: Continuous-Wave Photon-Pair Generation in Amorphous Hydrogenated Silicon
abstract: We demonstrate generation of highly correlated photon pairs via spontaneous four-wave mixing driven by continuous-wave pumping in a hydrogenated amorphous silicon waveguide and obtain a coincidence-to-accidental ratio of 106.2±1.3.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Forward Stimulated Brillouin Scattering in Microfibers with Elliptical Transverse Profile
abstract: We theoretically investigate the forward stimulated Brillouin scattering (FSBS) of microfibers with elliptical transverse profile, revealing distinctive FSBS frequency dependence on the fiber geometry.

articleTitle: Coherently combined high-brightness semiconductor amplifiers for a water vapor differential absorption lidar
abstract: We demonstrate the coherent combination of two microsecond-pulse semiconductor amplifiers for water vapor differential absorption lidar (DIAL) applications. The combined pulse energy reached 10.3 μJ with combining efficiencies above 82% ± 5%.

articleTitle: Enabling MHz-Level Tailored Ultrafast Photoemission via Simultaneous Laser Mixing and Shaping
abstract: We present a novel, versatile framework to generate W-level temporally shaped UV picosecond pulses via non-colinear sum frequency generation and demonstrate it producing temporally flattop, high-power UV pulses capable of enhancing femtosecond- and attosecond-level X-ray free electron lasers.

articleTitle: Fifth-order Dispersion Soliton in a Microresonator
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of continuous-wave-laser-driven soliton generation in the zero-group-velocity-dispersion regime in a microresonator. We show that the observed solitons are enabled by fifth-order dispersion.

articleTitle: Design of L-Valley Ge/GeSiSn Waveguide Quantum Cascade Detector
abstract: We propose a lattice-matched Ge/GeSiSn quantum cascade detector (QCD) capable of operating in the longwave infrared. The optical absorption and carrier transport based on intersubband transitions all occur within the L-valley of the conduction band.

articleTitle: Fish-inspired Optical Microfiber Sensor Encapsulated in Biomimetic Cupula for Underwater Perception
abstract: We present a bioinspired optical microfiber sensor for multi-parameter underwater perception including water depth, disturbance, orientation, and hydroacoustic signals. The water depth sensitivity is 2.17m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, while hydroacoustic signals with frequencies of 100-200Hz are detected.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously Integrated Hybrid III-V/Silicon Superluminescent Diode with >10 mW Output Power
abstract: We demonstrate an O-band on-chip superluminescent diode emitting 10 mW broadband output power at 65 °C with a ripple amplitude of 0.8 dB. This is the highest reported power and efficiency for an on-chip SLD.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of multiparty reference-frame-independent QKD
abstract: We report that RFI-QKD protocol can be extended to multiparty system using Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) state. We derive the asymptotic key rate and perform proof-of-principle experiment to verify the feasibility of secure quantum network.

articleTitle: Physics and Technology of Semiconductor Nanolasers
abstract: This tutorial deals with recent progress on semiconductor nanolasers. Both the basic physics of nanolasers and the technological aspects will be introduced and discussed systematically including key motivations, major results, potential applications, and remaining challenges.

articleTitle: Infrared micro-reflectance of small-area detectors for Earth energy imbalance measurements
abstract: We have developed a low-cost setup for absolute infrared micro-reflectance to measure microstructures (< 1 mm). This setup is designed to characterize carbon nanotube microbolometers for use in space-based global energy imbalance measurements.

articleTitle: Generation of 100 GHz Periodic Nyquist Pulses using Cascaded Mach-Zehnder Modulators in Silicon Electronic-Photonic Platform
abstract: A frequency-flexible Nyquist pulse synthesizer is presented with optical pulse bandwidths up to f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">opt</inf> = 100 GHz and repetition rates equal to f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">opt</inf>/9, fabricated in an electronic-photonic co-integrated platform utilizing linear on-chip drivers.

articleTitle: High-Sensitivity Time Error Detection of Pulse Repetition-Rate Multiplier Using Electro-Optic Sampling-Based Timing Detection
abstract: We demonstrate high-sensitivity measurement of delay time error in pulse repetition rate multiplier using electro-optic sampling-based timing detector. The proposed method showed 12-times higher sensitivity compared to radio-frequency spectrum measurement method.

articleTitle: A Multi-Scale Approach to Simulate Molecules in Complex Photonic Devices
abstract: We present a novel multi-scale approach for obtaining the optical response of molecular structures inside photonic devices from first principles. The approach combines quantum-chemical computations with rigorous Maxwell solvers.

articleTitle: Microcomb-driven photonic convolutional engine
abstract: We demonstrate a microcomb-driven chip-based photonic convolutional engine utilizing time-wavelength plane stretching approach. A preeminent photonic-core compute density of 1.04 TOPS/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and a record high weight control precision of 9 bits are achieved.

articleTitle: Resolution Tunable Single Shot optical Spectroscopy
abstract: We report an optical single shot Fourier transform spectroscopy with tunable resolution capability by using a programable optical loop. The proposed method will broaden the applications of single shot spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Breaking the Delay-Resolution Limit of Fourier Transform Spectrometers Using Chip-Scale Combs
abstract: Resolution enhancement of Fourier transform spectrometers from GHz to MHz level is demonstrated without any changes to the optical setup. The technique leverages the discrete spectral structure of a chip-scale optical frequency comb.

articleTitle: Simulation of Information Flow in Non-Markovian Quantum Systems
abstract: We experimentally simulate an open quantum system using the polarization and path degree of freedom of photons propagating in integrated waveguide arrays. This way we analyse different types of information transfer between system and environment.

articleTitle: Cavity Quantum Electrodynamics with Quantum Dots in Aperiodic Photonic Devices
abstract: We experimentally show that aperiodic photonic devices, composed of free-standing GaAs membranes embedding single InAs/GaAs quantum dots, allow controlling the spontaneous emission of single photons, with lifetime modifications up to a factor 10.

articleTitle: The Effective Permittivity of an Isotropic Composite Material
abstract: We present the solution to the long-standing problem of calculating the universal contribution to the effective dielectric permittivity of an arbitrary isotropic composite material.

articleTitle: Multimode Phonon Lasing in Diamond Optomechanical Crystals
abstract: We demonstrate a diamond optomechanical crystal whose angled sidewalls allow it to support two high-frequency mechanical modes with high optomechanical coupling, permitting the observation of two-mode self-oscillation indicative of coherent phonon-photon and phonon-phonon interactions.

articleTitle: Scattering of waves in finite periodic parity-time symmetric waveguide networks
abstract: With means of parametric space, obtained from Parity-time (PT) symmetric transfer matrix, Lorentz reciprocity theorem, and non-imaginary of Bloch phase, we discuss the conditions of wave propagation, coherent perfect absorption-lasing (CPAL), and bidirectional transparency occurred at finite periodic PT-symmetric waveguide networks.

articleTitle: Predicting the interplay between second- and third-order nonlinear interaction in periodically-poled nanophotonic waveguides using machine learning
abstract: We have developed a recurrent neural network that efficiently simulates the unidirectional pulse propagation equation. The model is validated via predicting complex nonlinear interactions in a periodically poled nanophotonic LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> waveguide.

articleTitle: Integrated electro-optical modulator and photodetector for the mid-infrared spectral range
abstract: We report high speed integrated electro-optic modulator and integrated photodetector operating in a wide spectral range from 5 to 8 µm wavelength. Modulation is reported up to 1 GHz, while the photodetector responsivity reaches up to 0.1 mA/W. The development of a complete photonic platform including modulator and photodetector paves the way for on chip synchronous detection for multi-molecule on-chip spectroscopic systems.

articleTitle: Temporal-encoded noise-like pulses for chaotic optical time-domain reflectometer
abstract: We reported on a high-resolution chaotic-OTDR utilizing the temporal-encoded noise-like pulses delivered from a passively mode-locked fiber laser. The experimental results showed that a millimeter scale resolution is achieved.

articleTitle: Eight-channel EML array based on four phase-shifted sampled Bragg gratings
abstract: An eight-channel electroabsorption modulated DFB laser (EML) array with a 0.8 nm channel spacing is demonstrated experimentally. The EMLs have a 20 dB extinction ratio at 3.6 V electroabsorption modulator reverse voltage.

articleTitle: Topological Broadband Slow Light in Synthetic Dimensions
abstract: Slow light devices are essential in photonics, yet they are limited by large footprints and disorder. We demonstrate that topological slow light in synthetic spaces tackles this challenge and slows down light in compact footprints beyond conventional limits.

articleTitle: Absolute Abundance Measurements of Molecular Species in a Plasma Reactor with Non-Uniform Temperature using Optical Frequency Comb Fourier Transform Spectroscopy
abstract: We perform optical frequency comb Fourier transform spectroscopy of molecules in a plasma reactor with non-uniform temperature. An N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> + H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> + CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> plasma is a model system for spectroscopy of extreme non-thermal environments.

articleTitle: Order-Invariant Two-Photon Quantum Correlations in PT-Symmetric Interferometers
abstract: We identify sequences of concatenated two-mode linear optical transformations whose two-photon behavior is invariant under reversal of the order. We experimentally verify this systematic behavior in parity-time-symmetric complex interferometer arrangements of varying composition.

articleTitle: Performance Analyses of High-Efficiency InGaN Red Micro-LEDs for Visible Light Communication
abstract: InGaN red micro-light-emitting diodes (micro-LEDs) with the external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 5.02% are adopted for visible light communication (VLC), achieving a modulation bandwidth of 271 MHz and a data transmission rate of 350 Mbit/s. )

articleTitle: Thermally Induced Fracture of Laser Glass in High Average Power Gas-Cooled Laser Systems
abstract: Laser glass fracture and cooling scalability in high average power gas-cooled laser amplifiers were studied by in-situ optical probing of laser glass during actual fracture events under realistic thermal load conditions.

articleTitle: A fully on-chip source of single-photons based on Purcell enhanced, resonantly excited single quantum dots
abstract: We develop a single-photon source based on single InAs/GaAs quantum dots in a nanobeam photonic crystal cavity engineered to allow waveguided resonant dot excitation, high Purcell radiative rate enhancements and efficient out-coupling into an on-chip waveguide.

articleTitle: Robust Interference Filter for FM-to-AM Conversion Compensation in a Regenerative Amplifier
abstract: We numerically and experimentally studied compensation of FM-to-AM conversion due to spectral gain response of a regenerative amplifier with an extra-cavity interference filter. We discuss the sensibility of this technology regarding different parameters.

articleTitle: 50-GHz-Spaced Flat Comb Generation by Inphase/Quadrature Electro-Optic Modulator Driven at 25 GHz
abstract: 50-GHz spaced flat comb is experimentally generated from in-phase/quadrature optical modulator driven with 25-GHz signals. By non-mechanically adjusting amplitude and phase of driving signals, optical comb with even or odd frequency components are selectively generated.

articleTitle: Classification of Energy Densities of Transmission Eigenchannels of Complex Photonic Media using Machine Learning
abstract: We demonstrate classification of energy densities of transmission eigenchannels and corresponding disorder strength of a single configuration of a complex medium using supervised machine learning techniques with an accuracy greater than 95 %.

articleTitle: Ultra-high-resolution dual-comb spectrometer based on densified gain-switching optical frequency combs
abstract: We demonstrate a dual-comb interferometer based on two externally densified gain-switching optical frequency combs and show its potential for ultra-high-resolution spectroscopy.

articleTitle: A dual-mode 2 × 2 semiconductor optical amplifier on an InP membrane
abstract: A 2 × 2 mode-division multiplexed semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) is realized, first time to the authors’ knowledge. The TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> and TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> modes exhibit 6 dB and 4 dB gain, respectively, at 4.1 kA cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>.

articleTitle: Exciton-polariton electroluminescence from electrically driven halide perovskite metatransistors
abstract: We report strong coupling between excitons and photonic bound states in the continuum in electrically driven perovskite metatransistors. Electroluminescence directivity is tuned by the drain-source voltage, which controls the recombination zone within the transistor channel.

articleTitle: Kerr Comb Generation in Normal-dispersion, Bi-directionally Coupled Microresonators
abstract: We design bi-directionally coupled microresonators to lift the degeneracy of counter-propagating modes and control nonlinear dynamics in the normal-dispersion regime. We demonstrate controllable mode-splitting and Kerr-comb generation without any nanoscale patterns.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Quantum Scanning Microscopy with Visible Light
abstract: A label-free quantum scanning imaging system is presented, capable of detecting in the visible regime, while illuminating with undetected light in the Mid-IR region by exploiting the quantum correlations of photon-pairs.

articleTitle: Visualizing Whispering-Gallery Modes through Second-Harmonic and Sum-Frequency Generation in Al0.4Ga0.6As-on-Insulator Microdisk Resonators
abstract: We report second-harmonic and sum-frequency generation in Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.6</inf>As-on-insulator microdisk resonators at ~775 nm wavelengths. Our experiments reveal clear polygonal-shaped whispering-gallery mode profiles.

articleTitle: Cryogenic Visible-to-Infrared Quantum Interface in a Lithium Niobate Photonic Circuit
abstract: We present our progress on cryogenic frequency conversion from visible to telecom band based on thin-film lithium niobate photonics.

articleTitle: Silicon Nitride Apodized Chirped Gratings in the Short-wave Infrared Band
abstract: We report on apodized chirped Bragg gratings in a silicon nitride-on-insulator platform. Applications for this device include nonlinear photonics, specifically dispersion compensation in mode-locked lasers operating in the short-wave infrared wavelength band.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Assisted Structure Design of Octagonal Photonic Crystal Fiber with High Birefringence and Low Confinement Loss
abstract: We present the design of an octagonal photonic crystal fiber assisted by the artificial neural network (ANN) with expected birefringence and confinement loss.
